book.title: Tanakh
book.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
book.license: Hebrew: Miqra according to the Masorah via Sefaria, CC BY-SA. English: JPS 1917, public domain.
book.notes: Torah, Nevi’im and Ketuvim in the Hebrew order. Hebrew verse numbering is retained; a few books (e.g. Joel) differ from Christian numbering.

verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהֹוָה בְּנֵ֣י אֵלִ֑ים הָב֥וּ לַ֝יהֹוָ֗ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃
verses.translit: mzmvr ldvd hbv lyhvh bny 'lym hbv lyhvh khbvd v'z
verses.translation: A Psalm of David. Ascribe unto the LORD, O ye sons of might, Ascribe unto the LORD glory and strength.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהֹוָה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ הִשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לַ֝יהֹוָ֗ה בְּהַדְרַת־קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: hbv lyhvh khbvd shmv hshtchvv lyhvh bhdrtqdsh
verses.translation: Ascribe unto the LORD the glory due unto His name; Worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֥וֹל יְהֹוָ֗ה עַל־הַ֫מָּ֥יִם אֵֽל־הַכָּב֥וֹד הִרְעִ֑ים יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה עַל־מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃
verses.translation: The voice of the LORD is upon the waters; The God of glory thundereth, Even the LORD upon many waters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קוֹל־יְהֹוָ֥ה בַּכֹּ֑חַ ק֥וֹל יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה בֶּהָדָֽר׃
verses.translation: The voice of the LORD is powerful; The voice of the LORD is full of majesty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֣וֹל יְ֭הֹוָה שֹׁבֵ֣ר אֲרָזִ֑ים וַיְשַׁבֵּ֥ר יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה אֶת־אַרְזֵ֥י הַלְּבָנֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: qvl yhvh shbr 'rzym vyshbr yhvh 't'rzy hlbnvn
verses.translation: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּרְקִידֵ֥ם כְּמוֹ־עֵ֑גֶל לְבָנ֥וֹן וְ֝שִׂרְיֹ֗ן כְּמ֣וֹ בֶן־רְאֵמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyrqydm khmv'gl lbnvn vshryn khmv bnr'mym
verses.translation: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild-ox.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קוֹל־יְהֹוָ֥ה חֹצֵ֗ב לַהֲב֥וֹת אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translation: The voice of the LORD heweth out flames of fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֣וֹל יְ֭הֹוָה יָחִ֣יל מִדְבָּ֑ר יָחִ֥יל יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה מִדְבַּ֥ר קָדֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: qvl yhvh ychyl mdbr ychyl yhvh mdbr qdsh
verses.translation: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; The LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֤וֹל יְהֹוָ֨ה  יְחוֹלֵ֣ל אַיָּלוֹת֮ וַֽיֶּחֱשֹׂ֢ף יְעָ֫ר֥וֹת וּבְהֵיכָל֑וֹ כֻּ֝לּ֗וֹ אֹמֵ֥ר כָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: qvl yhvh  ychvll 'ylvt vychshf y'rvt vbhykhlv khlv 'mr khbvd
verses.translation: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, And strippeth the forests bare; And in His temple all say: 'Glory.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְ֭הֹוָה לַמַּבּ֣וּל יָשָׁ֑ב וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה מֶ֣לֶךְ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: yhvh lmbvl yshb vyshb yhvh mlkh l'vlm
verses.translation: The LORD sat enthroned at the flood; Yea, the LORD sitteth as King for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה עֹ֭ז לְעַמּ֣וֹ יִתֵּ֑ן יְהֹוָ֓ה  יְבָרֵ֖ךְ אֶת־עַמּ֣וֹ בַשָּׁלֽוֹם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: yhvh 'z l'mv ytn yhvh  ybrkh 't'mv bshlvm {p}
verses.translation: The LORD will give strength unto His people; The LORD will bless his people with peace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִזְמ֡וֹר שִׁיר־חֲנֻכַּ֖ת הַבַּ֣יִת לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translation: A Psalm; a Song at the Dedication of the House; of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲרוֹמִמְךָ֣ יְ֭הֹוָה כִּ֣י דִלִּיתָ֑נִי וְלֹֽא־שִׂמַּ֖חְתָּ אֹיְבַ֣י לִֽי׃
verses.translation: I will extol thee, O LORD, for Thou hast raised me up, and hast not suffered mine enemies to rejoice over me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֑י שִׁוַּ֥עְתִּי אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ וַתִּרְפָּאֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: O LORD my God, I cried unto Thee, and Thou didst heal me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה הֶעֱלִ֣יתָ מִן־שְׁא֣וֹל נַפְשִׁ֑י חִ֝יִּיתַ֗נִי (מיורדי) [מִיׇּֽרְדִי־]בֽוֹר׃
verses.translation: O LORD, Thou broughtest up my soul from the nether-world; Thou didst kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זַמְּר֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה חֲסִידָ֑יו וְ֝הוֹד֗וּ לְזֵ֣כֶר קׇדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: zmrv lyhvh chsydyv vhvdv lzkhr qdshv
verses.translation: Sing praise unto the LORD, O ye His godly ones, and give thanks to His holy name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י רֶ֨גַע  בְּאַפּוֹ֮ חַיִּ֢ים בִּרְצ֫וֹנ֥וֹ בָּ֭עֶרֶב יָלִ֥ין בֶּ֗כִי וְלַבֹּ֥קֶר רִנָּֽה׃
verses.translit: khy rg'  b'pv chyym brtsvnv b'rb ylyn bkhy vlbqr rnh
verses.translation: For His anger is but for a moment, His favour is for a life-time; weeping may tarry for the night, but joy cometh in the morning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭אֲנִי אָמַ֣רְתִּי בְשַׁלְוִ֑י בַּל־אֶמּ֥וֹט לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translation: Now I had said in my security: 'I shall never be moved.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה בִּרְצוֹנְךָ֮ הֶעֱמַ֢דְתָּה לְֽהַרְרִ֫י־עֹ֥ז הִסְתַּ֥רְתָּ פָנֶ֗יךָ הָיִ֥יתִי נִבְהָֽל׃
verses.translit: yhvh brtsvnkh h'mdth lhrry'z hstrt pnykh hyyty nbhl
verses.translation: Thou hadst established, O LORD, in Thy favour my mountain as a stronghold— Thou didst hide Thy face; I was affrighted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֶקְרָ֑א וְאֶל־אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י אֶתְחַנָּֽן׃
verses.translation: Unto Thee, O LORD, did I call, And unto the LORD I made supplication:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־בֶּ֥צַע בְּדָמִי֮ בְּרִדְתִּ֢י אֶ֫ל־שָׁ֥חַת הֲיוֹדְךָ֥ עָפָ֑ר הֲיַגִּ֥יד אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: 'What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise Thee? shall it declare Thy truth?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁמַע־יְהֹוָ֥ה וְחׇנֵּ֑נִי יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה הֱֽיֵה־עֹזֵ֥ר לִֽי׃
verses.translation: Hear, O LORD, and be gracious unto me; LORD, be Thou my helper.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָפַ֣כְתָּ מִסְפְּדִי֮ לְמָח֢וֹל לִ֥֫י פִּתַּ֥חְתָּ שַׂקִּ֑י וַֽתְּאַזְּרֵ֥נִי שִׂמְחָֽה׃
verses.translit: hpkht mspdy lmchvl ly ptcht shqy vt'zrny shmchh
verses.translation: Thou didst turn for me my mourning into dancing; Thou didst loose my sackcloth, and gird me with gladness;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן  יְזַמֶּרְךָ֣ כָ֭בוֹד וְלֹ֣א יִדֹּ֑ם יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י לְעוֹלָ֥ם אוֹדֶֽךָּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lm'n  yzmrkh khbvd vl' ydm yhvh 'lhy l'vlm 'vdkh {p}
verses.translation: So that my glory may sing praise to Thee, and not be silent; O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto Thee for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּךָֽ־יְהֹוָ֣ה חָ֭סִיתִי אַל־אֵב֣וֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָ֑ם בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֥ פַלְּטֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: In thee, O LORD, have I taken refuge; let me never be ashamed; Deliver me in Thy righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַטֵּ֤ה אֵלַ֨י  אׇזְנְךָ֮ מְהֵרָ֢ה הַצִּ֫ילֵ֥נִי הֱיֵ֤ה לִ֨י  לְֽצוּר־מָ֭עוֹז לְבֵ֥ית מְצוּד֗וֹת לְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: hth 'ly  'znkh mhrh htsylny hyh ly  ltsvrm'vz lbyt mtsvdvt lhvshy'ny
verses.translation: Incline Thine ear unto me, deliver me speedily; Be Thou to me a rock of refuge, even a fortress of defence, to save me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־סַלְעִ֣י וּמְצוּדָתִ֣י אָ֑תָּה וּלְמַ֥עַן שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ תַּֽנְחֵ֥נִי וּֽתְנַהֲלֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: khysl'y vmtsvdty 'th vlm'n shmkh tnchny vtnhlny
verses.translation: For Thou art my rock and my fortress; Therefore for Thy name's sake lead me and guide me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תּוֹצִיאֵ֗נִי מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת ז֭וּ טָ֣מְנוּ לִ֑י כִּי־אַ֝תָּ֗ה מָעוּזִּֽי׃
verses.translit: tvtsy'ny mrsht zv tmnv ly khy'th m'vzy
verses.translation: Bring me forth out of the net that they have hidden for me; For Thou art my stronghold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּיָדְךָ֮ אַפְקִ֢יד ר֫וּחִ֥י פָּדִ֖יתָ אוֹתִ֥י יְהֹוָ֗ה אֵ֣ל אֱמֶֽת׃
verses.translation: Into Thy hand I commit my spirit; Thou hast redeemed me, O LORD, Thou God of truth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׂנֵ֗אתִי הַשֹּׁמְרִ֥ים הַבְלֵי־שָׁ֑וְא וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶל־יְהֹוָ֥ה בָּטָֽחְתִּי׃
verses.translation: I hate them that regard lying vanities; But I trust in the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָגִ֥ילָה וְאֶשְׂמְחָ֗ה בְּחַ֫סְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָ֭אִיתָ אֶת־עׇנְיִ֑י יָ֝דַ֗עְתָּ בְּצָר֥וֹת נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: 'gylh v'shmchh bchsdkh 'shr r'yt 't'nyy yd't btsrvt npshy
verses.translation: I will be glad and rejoice in Thy lovingkindness; For Thou hast seen mine affliction, Thou hast taken cognizance of the troubles of my soul,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א הִ֭סְגַּרְתַּנִי בְּיַד־אוֹיֵ֑ב הֶעֱמַ֖דְתָּ בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב רַגְלָֽי׃
verses.translit: vl' hsgrtny byd'vyb h'mdt bmrchb rgly
verses.translation: And Thou hast not given me over into the hand of the enemy; Thou hast set my feet in a broad place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חׇנֵּ֥נִי יְהֹוָה֮ כִּ֤י צַ֫ר־לִ֥י עָשְׁשָׁ֖ה בְכַ֥עַס עֵינִ֗י נַפְשִׁ֥י וּבִטְנִֽי׃
verses.translit: chnny yhvh khy tsrly 'shshh bkh's 'yny npshy vbtny
verses.translation: Be gracious unto me, O LORD, for I am in distress; Mine eye wasteth away with vexation, yea, my soul and my body.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י כָל֪וּ בְיָג֡וֹן חַיַּי֮ וּשְׁנוֹתַ֢י בַּאֲנָ֫חָ֥ה כָּשַׁ֣ל בַּעֲוֺנִ֣י כֹחִ֑י וַעֲצָמַ֥י עָשֵֽׁשׁוּ׃
verses.translit: khy khlv bygvn chyy vshnvty b'nchh khshl b'vny khchy v'tsmy 'shshv
verses.translation: For my life is spent in sorrow, and my years in sighing; My strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are wasted away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִכׇּל־צֹרְרַ֨י הָיִ֪יתִי חֶרְפָּ֡ה וְלִ֥שְׁכֵנַ֨י  מְאֹד֮ וּפַ֢חַד לִֽמְיֻדָּ֫עָ֥י רֹאַ֥י בַּח֑וּץ נָדְד֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: mkhltsrry hyyty chrph vlshkhny  m'd vpchd lmyd'y r'y bchvts nddv mmny
verses.translation: Because of all mine adversaries I am become a reproach, Yea, unto my neighbours exceedingly, and a dread to mine acquaintance; They that see me without flee from me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִ֭שְׁכַּחְתִּי כְּמֵ֣ת מִלֵּ֑ב הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כִּכְלִ֥י אֹבֵֽד׃
verses.translation: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind; I am like a useless vessel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי  דִּבַּ֥ת רַבִּים֮ מָג֢וֹר מִסָּ֫בִ֥יב בְּהִוָּסְדָ֣ם יַ֣חַד עָלַ֑י לָקַ֖חַת נַפְשִׁ֣י זָמָֽמוּ׃
verses.translit: khy shm'ty  dbt rbym mgvr msbyb bhvsdm ychd 'ly lqcht npshy zmmv
verses.translation: For I have heard the whispering of many, Terror on every side; While they took counsel together against me, They devised to take away my life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י  עָלֶ֣יךָ בָטַ֣חְתִּי יְהֹוָ֑ה אָ֝מַ֗רְתִּי אֱלֹהַ֥י אָֽתָּה׃
verses.translation: But as for me, I have trusted in Thee, O LORD; I have said: 'Thou art my God.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּיָדְךָ֥ עִתֹּתָ֑י הַצִּ֘ילֵ֤נִי מִיַּד־א֝וֹיְבַ֗י וּמֵֽרֹדְפָֽי׃
verses.translation: My times are in Thy hand; Deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאִ֣ירָה פָ֭נֶיךָ עַל־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ ה֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי בְחַסְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Make Thy face to shine upon Thy servant; Save me in Thy lovingkindness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה אַל־אֵ֭בוֹשָׁה כִּ֣י קְרָאתִ֑יךָ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יִדְּמ֥וּ לִשְׁאֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'l'bvshh khy qr'tykh ybshv rsh'ym ydmv lsh'vl
verses.translation: O LORD, let me not be ashamed, for I have called upon Thee; Let the wicked be ashamed, let them be put to silence in the nether-world.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תֵּ֥אָלַ֗מְנָה שִׂפְתֵ֫י־שָׁ֥קֶר הַדֹּבְר֖וֹת עַל־צַדִּ֥יק עָתָ֗ק בְּגַאֲוָ֥ה וָבֽוּז׃
verses.translation: Let the lying lips be dumb, Which speak arrogantly against the righteous, With pride and contempt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָ֤ה רַֽב־טוּבְךָ֮ אֲשֶׁר־צָפַ֢נְתָּ לִּירֵ֫אֶ֥יךָ פָּ֭עַלְתָּ לַחֹסִ֣ים בָּ֑ךְ נֶ֝֗גֶד בְּנֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: mh rbtvbkh 'shrtspnt lyr'ykh p'lt lchsym bkh ngd bny 'dm
verses.translation: Oh how abundant is Thy goodness, which Thou hast laid up for them that fear Thee; Which Thou hast wrought for them that take their refuge in Thee, in the sight of the sons of men!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּסְתִּירֵ֤ם  בְּסֵ֥תֶר פָּנֶיךָ֮ מֵרֻכְסֵ֫י־אִ֥ישׁ תִּצְפְּנֵ֥ם בְּסֻכָּ֗ה מֵרִ֥יב לְשֹׁנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: tstyrm  bstr pnykh mrkhsy'ysh ttspnm bskhh mryb lshnvt
verses.translation: Thou hidest them in the covert of Thy presence from the plottings of man; Thou concealest them in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּ֥י הִפְלִ֘יא־חַסְדּ֥וֹ לִ֝֗י בְּעִ֣יר מָצֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: brvkh yhvh khy hply'chsdv ly b'yr mtsvr
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD; For He hath shown me His wondrous lovingkindness in an entrenched city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י  אָ֘מַ֤רְתִּי בְחׇפְזִ֗י נִגְרַזְתִּי֮ מִנֶּ֢גֶד עֵ֫ינֶ֥יךָ אָכֵ֗ן שָׁ֭מַעְתָּ ק֥וֹל תַּחֲנוּנַ֗י בְּשַׁוְּעִ֥י אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: v'ny  'mrty bchpzy ngrzty mngd 'ynykh 'khn shm't qvl tchnvny bshv'y 'lykh
verses.translation: As for me, I said in my haste: 'I am cut off from before Thine eyes'; Nevertheless Thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֥הֱב֥וּ אֶֽת־יְהֹוָ֗ה כׇּֽל־חֲסִ֫ידָ֥יו אֱ֭מוּנִים נֹצֵ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה וּמְשַׁלֵּ֥ם עַל־יֶ֝֗תֶר עֹשֵׂ֥ה גַאֲוָֽה׃
verses.translation: O love the LORD, all ye His godly ones; The LORD preserveth the faithful, And plentifully repayeth him that acteth haughtily.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חִ֭זְקוּ וְיַאֲמֵ֣ץ לְבַבְכֶ֑ם כׇּל־הַ֝מְיַחֲלִ֗ים לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, All ye that wait for the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְדָוִ֗ד מַ֫שְׂכִּ֥יל אַשְׁרֵ֥י נְֽשׂוּי־פֶּ֗שַׁע כְּס֣וּי חֲטָאָֽה׃
verses.translation: [A Psalm] of David. Maschil. Happy is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is pardoned.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי־אָדָ֗ם לֹ֤א יַחְשֹׁ֬ב יְהֹוָ֣ה ל֣וֹ עָוֺ֑ן וְאֵ֖ין בְּרוּח֣וֹ רְמִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'shry'dm l' ychshb yhvh lv 'vn v'yn brvchv rmyh
verses.translation: Happy is the man unto whom the LORD counteth not iniquity, And in whose spirit there is no guile.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הֶ֭חֱרַשְׁתִּי בָּל֣וּ עֲצָמָ֑י בְּ֝שַׁאֲגָתִ֗י כׇּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translation: When I kept silence, my bones wore away Through my groaning all the day long.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י  יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַיְלָה֮ תִּכְבַּ֥ד עָלַ֗י יָ֫דֶ֥ךָ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ לְשַׁדִּ֑י בְּחַרְבֹ֖נֵי קַ֣יִץ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: khy  yvmm vlylh tkhbd 'ly ydkh nhpkh lshdy bchrbny qyts slh
verses.translation: For day and night Thy hand was heavy upon me; My sap was turned as in the droughts of summer. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַטָּאתִ֨י אוֹדִ֪יעֲךָ֡ וַעֲ֘וֺנִ֤י לֹֽא־כִסִּ֗יתִי אָמַ֗רְתִּי אוֹדֶ֤ה עֲלֵ֣י פְ֭שָׁעַי לַיהֹוָ֑ה וְאַתָּ֨ה נָ֘שָׂ֤אתָ עֲוֺ֖ן חַטָּאתִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: cht'ty 'vdy'kh v'vny l'khsyty 'mrty 'vdh 'ly psh'y lyhvh v'th nsh't 'vn cht'ty slh
verses.translation: I acknowledged my sin unto Thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid; I said: 'I will make confession concerning my transgressions unto the LORD' — And Thou, Thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־זֹ֡את יִתְפַּלֵּ֬ל כׇּל־חָסִ֨יד  אֵלֶיךָ֮ לְעֵ֢ת מְ֫צֹ֥א רַ֗ק לְ֭שֵׁטֶף מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים אֵ֝לָ֗יו לֹ֣א יַגִּֽיעוּ׃
verses.translit: 'lz't ytpll khlchsyd  'lykh l't mts' rq lshtf mym rbym 'lyv l' ygy'v
verses.translation: For this let every one that is godly pray unto Thee in a time when Thou mayest be found; Surely, when the great waters overflow, they will not reach unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה  סֵ֥תֶר לִי֮ מִצַּ֢ר תִּ֫צְּרֵ֥נִי רׇנֵּ֥י פַלֵּ֑ט תְּס֖וֹבְבֵ֣נִי סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: 'th  str ly mtsr ttsrny rny plt tsvbbny slh
verses.translation: Thou art my hiding-place; Thou wilt preserve me from the adversary; With songs of deliverance Thou wilt compass me about. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשְׂכִּֽילְךָ֨  וְֽאוֹרְךָ֗ בְּדֶֽרֶךְ־ז֥וּ תֵלֵ֑ךְ אִיעֲצָ֖ה עָלֶ֣יךָ עֵינִֽי׃
verses.translation: 'I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go; I will give counsel, Mine eye being upon thee.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּהְי֤וּ  כְּס֥וּס כְּפֶרֶד֮ אֵ֤ין הָ֫בִ֥ין בְּמֶתֶג־וָרֶ֣סֶן עֶדְי֣וֹ לִבְל֑וֹם בַּ֝֗ל קְרֹ֣ב אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'lthyv  khsvs khprd 'yn hbyn bmtgvrsn 'dyv lblvm bl qrb 'lykh
verses.translation: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding; Whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, That they come not near unto thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַבִּ֥ים מַכְאוֹבִ֗ים לָ֫רָשָׁ֥ע וְהַבּוֹטֵ֥חַ בַּֽיהֹוָ֑ה חֶ֝֗סֶד יְסוֹבְבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: rbym mkh'vbym lrsh' vhbvtch byhvh chsd ysvbbnv
verses.translation: Many are the sorrows of the wicked; But he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy compasseth him about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׂמְח֬וּ בַיהֹוָ֣ה וְ֭גִילוּ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝הַרְנִ֗ינוּ כׇּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵֽב׃ {פ}
verses.translit: shmchv byhvh vgylv tsdyqym vhrnynv khlyshrylb {p}
verses.translation: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous; And shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַנְּנ֣וּ צַ֭דִּיקִים בַּֽיהֹוָ֑ה לַ֝יְשָׁרִ֗ים נָאוָ֥ה תְהִלָּֽה׃
verses.translit: rnnv tsdyqym byhvh lyshrym n'vh thlh
verses.translation: Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous, Praise is comely for the upright.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה בְּכִנּ֑וֹר בְּנֵ֥בֶל עָ֝שׂ֗וֹר זַמְּרוּ־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: Give thanks unto the LORD with harp, Sing praises unto Him with the psaltery of ten strings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִֽׁירוּ־ל֭וֹ שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ הֵיטִ֥יבוּ נַ֝גֵּ֗ן בִּתְרוּעָֽה׃
verses.translit: shyrvlv shyr chdsh hytybv ngn btrv'h
verses.translation: Sing unto Him a new song; Play skilfully amid shouts of joy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יָשָׁ֥ר דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְכׇל־מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗הוּ בֶּאֱמוּנָֽה׃
verses.translation: For the word of the LORD is upright; And all His work is done in faithfulness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹ֭הֵב צְדָקָ֣ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט חֶ֥סֶד יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: 'hb tsdqh vmshpt chsd yhvh ml'h h'rts
verses.translation: He loveth righteousness and justice; The earth is full of the lovingkindness of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּדְבַ֣ר יְ֭הֹוָה שָׁמַ֣יִם נַעֲשׂ֑וּ וּבְר֥וּחַ פִּ֝֗יו כׇּל־צְבָאָֽם׃
verses.translit: bdbr yhvh shmym n'shv vbrvch pyv khltsb'm
verses.translation: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; And all the host of them by the breath of His mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּנֵ֣ס כַּ֭נֵּד מֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם נֹתֵ֖ן בְּאוֹצָר֣וֹת תְּהוֹמֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: khns khnd my hym ntn b'vtsrvt thvmvt
verses.translation: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as a heap; He layeth up the deeps in storehouses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִֽירְא֣וּ מֵ֭יְהֹוָה כׇּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ מִמֶּ֥נּוּ יָ֝ג֗וּרוּ כׇּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵֽל׃
verses.translit: yyr'v myhvh khlh'rts mmnv ygvrv khlyshby tbl
verses.translation: Let all the earth fear the LORD; Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא אָמַ֣ר וַיֶּ֑הִי הֽוּא־צִ֝וָּ֗ה וַֽיַּעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.translation: For He spoke, and it was; He commanded, and it stood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה הֵפִ֥יר עֲצַת־גּוֹיִ֑ם הֵ֝נִ֗יא מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת עַמִּֽים׃
verses.translation: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the nations to nought; He maketh the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲצַ֣ת יְ֭הֹוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תַּעֲמֹ֑ד מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת לִ֝בּ֗וֹ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.translit: 'tst yhvh l'vlm t'md mchshbvt lbv ldr vdr
verses.translation: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, The thoughts of His heart to all generations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הַ֭גּוֹי אֲשֶׁר־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו הָעָ֓ם  בָּחַ֖ר לְנַחֲלָ֣ה לֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: Happy is the nation whose God is the LORD; The people whom He hath chosen for His own inheritance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֭שָּׁמַיִם הִבִּ֣יט יְהֹוָ֑ה רָ֝אָ֗ה אֶֽת־כׇּל־בְּנֵ֥י הָאָדָֽם׃
verses.translation: The LORD looketh from heaven; He beholdeth all the sons of men;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽמְּכוֹן־שִׁבְתּ֥וֹ הִשְׁגִּ֑יחַ אֶ֖ל כׇּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translation: From the place of His habitation He looketh intently Upon all the inhabitants of the earth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַיֹּצֵ֣ר יַ֣חַד לִבָּ֑ם הַ֝מֵּבִ֗ין אֶל־כׇּל־מַעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם׃
verses.translation: He that fashioneth the hearts of them all, That considereth all their doings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵֽין־הַ֭מֶּלֶךְ נוֹשָׁ֣ע בְּרׇב־חָ֑יִל גִּ֝בּ֗וֹר לֹא־יִנָּצֵ֥ל בְּרׇב־כֹּֽחַ׃
verses.translation: A king is not saved by the multitude of a host; A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֶׁ֣קֶר הַ֭סּוּס לִתְשׁוּעָ֑ה וּבְרֹ֥ב חֵ֝יל֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט׃
verses.translit: shqr hsvs ltshv'h vbrb chylv l' ymlt
verses.translation: A horse is a vain thing for safety; Neither doth it afford escape by its great strength.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה עֵ֣ין יְ֭הֹוָה אֶל־יְרֵאָ֑יו לַֽמְיַחֲלִ֥ים לְחַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: Behold, the eye of the LORD is toward them that fear Him, Toward them that wait for His mercy;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְהַצִּ֣יל מִמָּ֣וֶת נַפְשָׁ֑ם וּ֝לְחַיּוֹתָ֗ם בָּרָעָֽב׃
verses.translation: To deliver their soul from death, And to keep them alive in famine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַ֭פְשֵׁנוּ חִכְּתָ֣ה לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה עֶזְרֵ֖נוּ וּמָגִנֵּ֣נוּ הֽוּא׃
verses.translation: Our soul hath waited for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־ב֭וֹ יִשְׂמַ֣ח לִבֵּ֑נוּ כִּ֤י בְשֵׁ֖ם קׇדְשׁ֣וֹ בָטָֽחְנוּ׃
verses.translit: khybv yshmch lbnv khy bshm qdshv btchnv
verses.translation: For in Him doth our heart rejoice, Because we have trusted in His holy name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהִי־חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֣ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ כַּ֝אֲשֶׁ֗ר יִחַ֥לְנוּ לָֽךְ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Let Thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, According as we have waited for Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְדָוִ֗ד בְּשַׁנּוֹת֣וֹ אֶת־טַ֭עְמוֹ לִפְנֵ֣י אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וַ֝יְגָרְשֵׁ֗הוּ וַיֵּלַֽךְ׃
verses.translation: [A Psalm] of David; when he changed his demeanour before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲבָרְכָ֣ה אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה בְּכׇל־עֵ֑ת תָּ֝מִ֗יד תְּֽהִלָּת֥וֹ בְּפִֽי׃
verses.translation: I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise shall continually be in my mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּ֭יהֹוָה תִּתְהַלֵּ֣ל נַפְשִׁ֑י יִשְׁמְע֖וּ עֲנָוִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָֽחוּ׃
verses.translation: My soul shall glory in the LORD; The humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּדְּל֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה אִתִּ֑י וּנְרוֹמְמָ֖ה שְׁמ֣וֹ יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.translation: O magnify the LORD with me, And let us exalt His name together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דָּרַ֣שְׁתִּי אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה וְעָנָ֑נִי וּמִכׇּל־מְ֝גוּרוֹתַ֗י הִצִּילָֽנִי׃
verses.translation: I sought the LORD, and He answered me, And delivered me from all my fears.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִבִּ֣יטוּ אֵלָ֣יו וְנָהָ֑רוּ וּ֝פְנֵיהֶ֗ם אַל־יֶחְפָּֽרוּ׃
verses.translation: They looked unto Him, and were radiant; And their faces shall never be abashed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֤ה עָנִ֣י קָ֭רָא וַיהֹוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ וּמִכׇּל־צָ֝רוֹתָ֗יו הוֹשִׁיעֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: zh 'ny qr' vyhvh shm' vmkhltsrvtyv hvshy'v
verses.translation: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard, And saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֹנֶ֤ה מַלְאַךְ־יְהֹוָ֓ה סָ֘בִ֤יב לִירֵאָ֗יו וַֽיְחַלְּצֵֽם׃
verses.translation: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear Him, And delivereth them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טַעֲמ֣וּ וּ֭רְאוּ כִּֽי־ט֣וֹב יְהֹוָ֑ה אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י הַ֝גֶּ֗בֶר יֶחֱסֶה־בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: t'mv vr'v khytvb yhvh 'shry hgbr ychshbv
verses.translation: O consider and see that the LORD is good; Happy is the man that taketh refuge in Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְר֣אוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה קְדֹשָׁ֑יו כִּי־אֵ֥ין מַ֝חְס֗וֹר לִירֵאָֽיו׃
verses.translation: O fear the LORD, ye His holy ones; For there is no want to them that fear Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּ֭פִירִים רָשׁ֣וּ וְרָעֵ֑בוּ וְדֹרְשֵׁ֥י יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה לֹא־יַחְסְר֥וּ כׇל־טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: khpyrym rshv vr'bv vdrshy yhvh l'ychsrv khltvb
verses.translation: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger; But they that seek the LORD want not any good thing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְֽכוּ־בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִ֑י יִֽרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה אֲלַמֶּדְכֶֽם׃
verses.translation: Come, ye children, hearken unto me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־הָ֭אִישׁ הֶחָפֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים אֹהֵ֥ב יָ֝מִ֗ים לִרְא֥וֹת טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: myh'ysh hchpts chyym 'hb ymym lr'vt tvb
verses.translation: Who is the man that desireth life, and loveth days, That he may see good therein?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְצֹ֣ר לְשׁוֹנְךָ֣ מֵרָ֑ע וּ֝שְׂפָתֶ֗יךָ מִדַּבֵּ֥ר מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: ntsr lshvnkh mr' vshptykh mdbr mrmh
verses.translation: Keep thy tongue from evil, And thy lips from speaking guile.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ס֣וּר מֵ֭רָע וַעֲשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב בַּקֵּ֖שׁ שָׁל֣וֹם וְרׇדְפֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: svr mr' v'shhtvb bqsh shlvm vrdphv
verses.translation: Depart from evil, and do good; Seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הֹוָה אֶל־צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝אׇזְנָ֗יו אֶל־שַׁוְעָתָֽם׃
verses.translation: The eyes of the LORD are toward the righteous, And His ears are open unto their cry.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּנֵ֣י יְ֭הֹוָה בְּעֹ֣שֵׂי רָ֑ע לְהַכְרִ֖ית מֵאֶ֣רֶץ זִכְרָֽם׃
verses.translit: pny yhvh b'shy r' lhkhryt m'rts zkhrm
verses.translation: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, To cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צָ֭עֲקוּ וַיהֹוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ וּמִכׇּל־צָ֝רוֹתָ֗ם הִצִּילָֽם׃
verses.translation: They cried, and the LORD heard, And delivered them out of all their troubles.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הֹוָה לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי־לֵ֑ב וְֽאֶת־דַּכְּאֵי־ר֥וּחַ יוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.translation: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart, And saveth such as are of a contrite spirit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֭בּוֹת רָע֣וֹת צַדִּ֑יק וּ֝מִכֻּלָּ֗ם יַצִּילֶ֥נּוּ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: rbvt r'vt tsdyq vmkhlm ytsylnv yhvh
verses.translation: Many are the ills of the righteous, But the LORD delivereth him out of them all.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֥ר כׇּל־עַצְמוֹתָ֑יו אַחַ֥ת מֵ֝הֵ֗נָּה לֹ֣א נִשְׁבָּֽרָה׃
verses.translation: He keepeth all his bones; Not one of them is broken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּמוֹתֵ֣ת רָשָׁ֣ע רָעָ֑ה וְשֹׂנְאֵ֖י צַדִּ֣יק יֶאְשָֽׁמוּ׃
verses.translit: tmvtt rsh' r'h vshn'y tsdyq y'shmv
verses.translation: Evil shall kill the wicked; And they that hate the righteous shall be held guilty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֹּדֶ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה נֶ֣פֶשׁ עֲבָדָ֑יו וְלֹ֥א יֶ֝אְשְׁמ֗וּ כׇּֽל־הַחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: pdh yhvh npsh 'bdyv vl' y'shmv khlhchsym bv {p}
verses.translation: The LORD redeemeth the soul of His servants; And none of them that take refuge in Him shall be desolate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְדָוִ֨ד  רִיבָ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה אֶת־יְרִיבַ֑י לְ֝חַ֗ם אֶת־לֹחֲמָֽי׃
verses.translation: [A Psalm] of David. Strive, O LORD, with them that strive with me; Fight against them that fight against me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַחֲזֵ֣ק מָגֵ֣ן וְצִנָּ֑ה וְ֝ק֗וּמָה בְּעֶזְרָתִֽי׃
verses.translation: Take hold of shield and buckler, And rise up to my help.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָ֘רֵ֤ק חֲנִ֣ית וּ֭סְגֹר לִקְרַ֣את רֹדְפָ֑י אֱמֹ֥ר לְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י יְֽשֻׁעָתֵ֥ךְ אָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vhrq chnyt vsgr lqr't rdpy 'mr lnpshy ysh'tkh 'ny
verses.translation: Draw out also the spear, and the battle-axe, against them that pursue me; Say unto my soul: 'I am Thy salvation.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ וְיִכָּלְמוּ֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֢י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָח֣וֹר וְיַחְפְּר֑וּ חֹ֝שְׁבֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: ybshv vykhlmv mbqshy npshy ysgv 'chvr vychprv chshby r'ty
verses.translation: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion that seek after my soul; Let them be turned back and be abashed that devise my hurt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִֽהְי֗וּ כְּמֹ֥ץ לִפְנֵי־ר֑וּחַ וּמַלְאַ֖ךְ יְהֹוָ֣ה דּוֹחֶֽה׃
verses.translit: yhyv khmts lpnyrvch vml'kh yhvh dvchh
verses.translation: Let them be as chaff before the wind, The angel of the LORD thrusting them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהִי־דַרְכָּ֗ם חֹ֥שֶׁךְ וַחֲלַקְלַקֹּ֑ת וּמַלְאַ֥ךְ יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה רֹדְפָֽם׃
verses.translit: yhydrkhm chshkh vchlqlqt vml'kh yhvh rdpm
verses.translation: Let their way be dark and slippery, The angel of the LORD pursuing them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־חִנָּ֣ם טָֽמְנוּ־לִ֭י שַׁ֣חַת רִשְׁתָּ֑ם חִ֝נָּ֗ם חָפְר֥וּ לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: khychnm tmnvly shcht rshtm chnm chprv lnpshy
verses.translation: For without cause have they hid for me the pit, even their net, Without cause have they digged for my soul. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּבוֹאֵ֣הוּ שׁוֹאָה֮ לֹֽא־יֵ֫דָ֥ע וְרִשְׁתּ֣וֹ אֲשֶׁר־טָמַ֣ן תִּלְכְּד֑וֹ בְּ֝שׁוֹאָ֗ה יִפׇּל־בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: tbv'hv shv'h l'yd' vrshtv 'shrtmn tlkhdv bshv'h yplbh
verses.translation: Let destruction come upon him unawares; And let his net that he hath hid catch himself; With destruction let him fall therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭נַפְשִׁי תָּגִ֣יל בַּיהֹוָ֑ה תָּ֝שִׂ֗ישׂ בִּישׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD; It shall rejoice in His salvation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּ֥ל־עַצְמוֹתַ֨י  תֹּאמַרְנָה֮ יְהֹוָ֗ה מִ֥י־כָ֫מ֥וֹךָ מַצִּ֣יל עָ֭נִי מֵחָזָ֣ק מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְעָנִ֥י וְ֝אֶבְי֗וֹן מִגֹּֽזְלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khl'tsmvty  t'mrnh yhvh mykhmvkh mtsyl 'ny mchzq mmnv v'ny v'byvn mgzlv
verses.translation: All my bones shall say: 'LORD, who is like unto Thee, Who deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, Yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְ֭קוּמוּן עֵדֵ֣י חָמָ֑ס אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי יִשְׁאָלֽוּנִי׃
verses.translation: Unrighteous witnesses rise up; They ask me of things that I know not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְשַׁלְּמ֣וּנִי רָ֭עָה תַּ֥חַת טוֹבָ֗ה שְׁכ֣וֹל לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: yshlmvny r'h tcht tvbh shkhvl lnpshy
verses.translation: They repay me evil for good; Bereavement is come to my soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י  בַּחֲלוֹתָ֡ם לְב֬וּשִׁי שָׂ֗ק עִנֵּ֣יתִי בַצּ֣וֹם נַפְשִׁ֑י וּ֝תְפִלָּתִ֗י עַל־חֵיקִ֥י תָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.translit: v'ny  bchlvtm lbvshy shq 'nyty btsvm npshy vtplty 'lchyqy tshvb
verses.translation: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth, I afflicted my soul with fasting; And my prayer, may it return into mine own bosom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּרֵעַ־כְּאָ֣ח לִ֭י הִתְהַלָּ֑כְתִּי כַּאֲבֶל־אֵ֝֗ם קֹדֵ֥ר שַׁחֽוֹתִי׃
verses.translit: khr'kh'ch ly hthlkhty kh'bl'm qdr shchvty
verses.translation: I went about as though it had been my friend or my brother; I bowed down mournful, as one that mourneth for his mother.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְצַלְעִי֮ שָׂמְח֢וּ וְֽנֶ֫אֱסָ֥פוּ נֶאֶסְפ֬וּ עָלַ֣י נֵ֭כִים וְלֹ֣א יָדַ֑עְתִּי קָרְע֥וּ וְלֹא־דָֽמּוּ׃
verses.translit: vbtsl'y shmchv vn'spv n'spv 'ly nkhym vl' yd'ty qr'v vl'dmv
verses.translation: But when I halt they rejoice, and gather themselves together; The abjects gather themselves together against me, and those whom I know not; They tear me, and cease not;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּ֭חַנְפֵי לַעֲגֵ֣י מָע֑וֹג חָרֹ֖ק עָלַ֣י שִׁנֵּֽימוֹ׃
verses.translation: With the profanest mockeries of backbiting They gnash at me with their teeth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲדֹנָי֮ כַּמָּ֢ה תִ֫רְאֶ֥ה הָשִׁ֣יבָה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִשֹּׁאֵיהֶ֑ם מִ֝כְּפִירִ֗ים יְחִידָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'dny khmh tr'h hshybh npshy msh'yhm mkhpyrym ychydty
verses.translation: Lord, how long wilt Thou look on? Rescue my soul from their destructions, Mine only one from the lions.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֭וֹדְךָ בְּקָהָ֣ל רָ֑ב בְּעַ֖ם עָצ֣וּם אֲהַלְלֶֽךָּ׃
verses.translation: I will give Thee thanks in the great congregation; I will praise Thee among a numerous people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַֽל־יִשְׂמְחוּ־לִ֣י אֹיְבַ֣י שֶׁ֑קֶר שֹׂנְאַ֥י חִ֝נָּ֗ם יִקְרְצוּ־עָֽיִן׃
verses.translation: Let not them that are wrongfully mine enemies rejoice over me; Neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֥א שָׁל֗וֹם יְדַ֫בֵּ֥רוּ וְעַ֥ל רִגְעֵי־אֶ֑רֶץ דִּבְרֵ֥י מִ֝רְמ֗וֹת יַחֲשֹׁבֽוּן׃
verses.translit: khy l' shlvm ydbrv v'l rg'y'rts dbry mrmvt ychshbvn
verses.translation: For they speak not peace; But they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּרְחִ֥יבוּ עָלַ֗י פִּ֫יהֶ֥ם אָ֭מְרוּ הֶאָ֣ח ׀ הֶאָ֑ח רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translation: Yea, they open their mouth wide against me; They say: 'Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָאִ֣יתָה יְ֭הֹוָה אַֽל־תֶּחֱרַ֑שׁ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י אַל־תִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.translation: Thou hast seen, O LORD; keep not silence; O Lord, be not far from me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָעִ֣ירָה וְ֭הָקִיצָה לְמִשְׁפָּטִ֑י אֱלֹהַ֖י וַאדֹנָ֣י לְרִיבִֽי׃
verses.translation: Rouse Thee, and awake to my judgment, Even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׇׁפְטֵ֣נִי כְ֭צִדְקְךָ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֗י וְאַל־יִשְׂמְחוּ־לִֽי׃
verses.translation: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to Thy righteousness; And let them not rejoice over me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־יֹאמְר֣וּ בְ֭לִבָּם הֶאָ֣ח נַפְשֵׁ֑נוּ אַל־יֹ֝אמְר֗וּ בִּֽלַּעֲנֽוּהוּ׃
verses.translation: Let them not say in their heart: 'Aha, we have our desire'; Let them not say: 'We have swallowed him up.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּר֨וּ  יַחְדָּו֮ שְׂמֵחֵ֢י רָעָ֫תִ֥י יִֽלְבְּשׁוּ־בֹ֥שֶׁת וּכְלִמָּ֑ה הַֽמַּגְדִּילִ֥ים עָלָֽי׃
verses.translit: ybshv vychprv  ychdv shmchy r'ty ylbshvbsht vkhlmh hmgdylym 'ly
verses.translation: Let them be ashamed and abashed together that rejoice at my hurt; Let them be clothed with shame and confusion that magnify themselves against me. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָרֹ֣נּוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ֮ חֲפֵצֵ֢י צִ֫דְקִ֥י וְיֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל יְהֹוָ֑ה הֶ֝חָפֵ֗ץ שְׁל֣וֹם עַבְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: yrnv vyshmchv chptsy tsdqy vy'mrv tmyd ygdl yhvh hchpts shlvm 'bdv
verses.translation: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that delight in my righteousness; Yea, let them say continually: 'Magnified be the LORD, Who delighteth in the peace of His servant.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּ֭לְשׁוֹנִי תֶּהְגֶּ֣ה צִדְקֶ֑ךָ כׇּל־הַ֝יּ֗וֹם תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: And my tongue shall speak of Thy righteousness, And of Thy praise all the day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ ׀ לְעֶבֶד־יְהֹוָ֬ה לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translation: For the Leader. [A Psalm] of David the servant of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְאֻֽם־פֶּ֣שַׁע לָ֭רָשָׁע בְּקֶ֣רֶב לִבִּ֑י אֵֽין־פַּ֥חַד אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃
verses.translation: Transgression speaketh to the wicked, methinks— There is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הֶחֱלִ֣יק אֵלָ֣יו בְּעֵינָ֑יו לִמְצֹ֖א עֲוֺנ֣וֹ לִשְׂנֹֽא׃
verses.translation: For it flattereth him in his eyes, Until his iniquity be found, and he be hated.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּבְרֵי־פִ֭יו אָ֣וֶן וּמִרְמָ֑ה חָדַ֖ל לְהַשְׂכִּ֣יל לְהֵיטִֽיב׃
verses.translation: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit; He hath left off to be wise, to do good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֤וֶן  יַחְשֹׁ֗ב עַֽל־מִשְׁכָּ֫ב֥וֹ יִ֭תְיַצֵּב עַל־דֶּ֣רֶךְ לֹא־ט֑וֹב רָ֝֗ע לֹ֣א יִמְאָֽס׃
verses.translit: 'vn  ychshb 'lmshkhbv ytytsb 'ldrkh l'tvb r' l' ym's
verses.translation: He deviseth iniquity upon his bed; He setteth himself in a way that is not good; He abhorreth not evil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְ֭הֹוָה בְּהַשָּׁמַ֣יִם חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ אֱ֝מ֥וּנָתְךָ֗ עַד־שְׁחָקִֽים׃
verses.translation: Thy lovingkindness, O LORD, is in the heavens; Thy faithfulness reacheth unto the skies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צִדְקָתְךָ֨  כְּֽהַרְרֵי־אֵ֗ל מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶיךָ תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֑ה אָ֤דָֽם־וּבְהֵמָ֖ה תוֹשִׁ֣יעַ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: tsdqtkh  khhrry'l mshptykh thvm rbh 'dmvbhmh tvshy' yhvh
verses.translation: Thy righteousness is like the mighty mountains; Thy judgments are like the great deep; Man and beast Thou preservest, O LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־יָּקָ֥ר חַסְדְּךָ֗ אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים וּבְנֵ֥י אָדָ֑ם בְּצֵ֥ל כְּ֝נָפֶ֗יךָ יֶחֱסָיֽוּן׃
verses.translit: mhyqr chsdkh 'lhym vbny 'dm btsl khnpykh ychsyvn
verses.translation: How precious is Thy lovingkindness, O God! And the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Thy wings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֭רְוְיֻן מִדֶּ֣שֶׁן בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וְנַ֖חַל עֲדָנֶ֣יךָ תַשְׁקֵֽם׃
verses.translation: They are abundantly satisfied with the fatness of Thy house; And Thou makest them drink of the river of Thy pleasures.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־עִ֭מְּךָ מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים בְּ֝אוֹרְךָ֗ נִרְאֶה־אֽוֹר׃
verses.translation: For with Thee is the fountain of life; In Thy light do we see light.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְשֹׁ֣ךְ חַ֭סְדְּךָ לְיֹדְעֶ֑יךָ וְ֝צִדְקָתְךָ֗ לְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵֽב׃
verses.translation: O continue Thy lovingkindness unto them that know Thee; And Thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תְּ֭בוֹאֵנִי רֶ֣גֶל גַּאֲוָ֑ה וְיַד־רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים אַל־תְּנִדֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Let not the foot of pride overtake me, And let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֣ם נָ֭פְלוּ פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן דֹּ֝ח֗וּ וְלֹא־יָ֥כְלוּ קֽוּם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: shm nplv p'ly 'vn dchv vl'ykhlv qvm {p}
verses.translation: There are the workers of iniquity fallen; They are thrust down, and are not able to rise.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְדָוִ֨ד  אַל־תִּתְחַ֥ר בַּמְּרֵעִ֑ים אַל־תְּ֝קַנֵּ֗א בְּעֹשֵׂ֥י עַוְלָֽה׃
verses.translation: [A Psalm] of David. Fret not thyself because of evil-doers, neither be thou envious against them that work unrighteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֶ֭חָצִיר מְהֵרָ֣ה יִמָּ֑לוּ וּכְיֶ֥רֶק דֶּ֝֗שֶׁא יִבּוֹלֽוּן׃
verses.translit: khy khchtsyr mhrh ymlv vkhyrq dsh' ybvlvn
verses.translation: For they shall soon wither like the grass, and fade as the green herb.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּטַ֣ח בַּ֭יהֹוָה וַעֲשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב שְׁכׇן־אֶ֝֗רֶץ וּרְעֵ֥ה אֱמוּנָֽה׃
verses.translation: Trust in the LORD, and do good; dwell in the land, and cherish faithfulness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִתְעַנַּ֥ג עַל־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְיִֽתֶּן־לְ֝ךָ֗ מִשְׁאֲלֹ֥ת לִבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: So shalt thou delight thyself in the LORD; and He shall give thee the petitions of thy heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גּ֣וֹל עַל־יְהֹוָ֣ה דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ וּבְטַ֥ח עָ֝לָ֗יו וְה֣וּא יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translation: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in Him, and He will bring it to pass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוֹצִ֣יא כָא֣וֹר צִדְקֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטֶ֗ךָ כַּֽצׇּהֳרָֽיִם׃
verses.translation: And He will make thy righteousness to go forth as the light, and thy right as the noonday.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דּ֤וֹם  לַיהֹוָה֮ וְהִתְח֢וֹלֵֽ֫ל ל֥וֹ אַל־תִּ֭תְחַר בְּמַצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכּ֑וֹ בְּ֝אִ֗ישׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה מְזִמּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: dvm  lyhvh vhtchvll lv 'lttchr bmtslych drkhv b'ysh 'shh mzmvt
verses.translation: Resign thyself unto the LORD, and wait patiently for Him; fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶ֣רֶף מֵ֭אַף וַעֲזֹ֣ב חֵמָ֑ה אַל־תִּ֝תְחַ֗ר אַךְ־לְהָרֵֽעַ׃
verses.translation: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath; fret not thyself, it tendeth only to evil-doing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־מְ֭רֵעִים יִכָּרֵת֑וּן וְקֹוֵ֥י יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה הֵ֣מָּה יִֽירְשׁוּ־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: khymr'ym ykhrtvn vqvy yhvh hmh yyrshv'rts
verses.translation: For evil-doers shall be cut off; but those that wait for the LORD, they shall inherit the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְע֣וֹד מְ֭עַט וְאֵ֣ין רָשָׁ֑ע וְהִתְבּוֹנַ֖נְתָּ עַל־מְקוֹמ֣וֹ וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: v'vd m't v'yn rsh' vhtbvnnt 'lmqvmv v'ynnv
verses.translation: And yet a little while, and the wicked is no more; yea, thou shalt look well at his place, and he is not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲנָוִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ־אָ֑רֶץ וְ֝הִֽתְעַנְּג֗וּ עַל־רֹ֥ב שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.translation: But the humble shall inherit the land, and delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹמֵ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע לַצַּדִּ֑יק וְחֹרֵ֖ק עָלָ֣יו שִׁנָּֽיו׃
verses.translation: The wicked plotteth against the righteous, and gnasheth at him with his teeth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֥י יִשְׂחַק־ל֑וֹ כִּי־רָ֝אָ֗ה כִּֽי־יָבֹ֥א יוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: The Lord doth laugh at him; for He seeth that his day is coming.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶ֤רֶב  פָּ֥תְח֣וּ רְשָׁעִים֮ וְדָרְכ֢וּ קַ֫שְׁתָּ֥ם לְ֭הַפִּיל עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֑וֹן לִ֝טְב֗וֹחַ יִשְׁרֵי־דָֽרֶךְ׃
verses.translit: chrb  ptchv rsh'ym vdrkhv qshtm lhpyl 'ny v'byvn ltbvch yshrydrkh
verses.translation: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow; to cast down the poor and needy, to slay such as are upright in the way;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַ֭רְבָּם תָּב֣וֹא בְלִבָּ֑ם וְ֝קַשְּׁתוֹתָ֗ם תִּשָּׁבַֽרְנָה׃
verses.translation: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טוֹב־מְ֭עַט לַצַּדִּ֑יק מֵ֝הֲמ֗וֹן רְשָׁעִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃
verses.translation: Better is a little that the righteous hath than the abundance of many wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י זְרוֹע֣וֹת רְ֭שָׁעִים תִּשָּׁבַ֑רְנָה וְסוֹמֵ֖ךְ צַדִּיקִ֣ים יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy zrv'vt rsh'ym tshbrnh vsvmkh tsdyqym yhvh
verses.translation: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken; but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הֹוָה יְמֵ֣י תְמִימִ֑ם וְ֝נַחֲלָתָ֗ם לְעוֹלָ֥ם תִּהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: yvd' yhvh ymy tmymm vnchltm l'vlm thyh
verses.translation: The LORD knoweth the days of them that are wholehearted; and their inheritance shall be for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־יֵ֭בֹשׁוּ בְּעֵ֣ת רָעָ֑ה וּבִימֵ֖י רְעָב֣וֹן יִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: l'ybshv b't r'h vbymy r'bvn yshb'v
verses.translation: They shall not be ashamed in the time of evil; and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י רְשָׁעִ֨ים  יֹאבֵ֗דוּ וְאֹיְבֵ֣י יְ֭הֹוָה כִּיקַ֣ר כָּרִ֑ים כָּל֖וּ בֶעָשָׁ֣ן כָּֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: khy rsh'ym  y'bdv v'yby yhvh khyqr khrym khlv b'shn khlv
verses.translation: For the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD shall be as the fat of lambs— They shall pass away in smoke, they shall pass away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹוֶ֣ה רָ֭שָׁע וְלֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑ם וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק חוֹנֵ֥ן וְנוֹתֵֽן׃
verses.translit: lvh rsh' vl' yshlm vtsdyq chvnn vnvtn
verses.translation: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not; but the righteous dealeth graciously, and giveth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י מְ֭בֹרָכָיו יִ֣ירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ וּ֝מְקֻלָּלָ֗יו יִכָּרֵֽתוּ׃
verses.translation: For such as are blessed of Him shall inherit the land; and they that are cursed of Him shall be cut off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵ֭יְהֹוָה מִֽצְעֲדֵי־גֶ֥בֶר כּוֹנָ֗נוּ וְדַרְכּ֥וֹ יֶחְפָּֽץ׃
verses.translation: It is of the LORD that a man's goings are established; and He delighted in his way.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יִפֹּ֥ל לֹֽא־יוּטָ֑ל כִּֽי־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה סוֹמֵ֥ךְ יָדֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down; for the LORD upholdeth his hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַ֤עַר  הָיִ֗יתִי גַּם־זָ֫קַ֥נְתִּי וְֽלֹא־רָ֭אִיתִי צַדִּ֣יק נֶעֱזָ֑ב וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ־לָֽחֶם׃
verses.translit: n'r  hyyty gmzqnty vl'r'yty tsdyq n'zb vzr'v mbqshlchm
verses.translation: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַ֭יּוֹם חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ לִבְרָכָֽה׃
verses.translation: All the day long he dealeth graciously, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ס֣וּר מֵ֭רָע וַעֲשֵׂה־ט֗וֹב וּשְׁכֹ֥ן לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translation: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י יְהֹוָ֨ה  אֹ֘הֵ֤ב מִשְׁפָּ֗ט וְלֹא־יַעֲזֹ֣ב אֶת־חֲ֭סִידָיו לְעוֹלָ֣ם נִשְׁמָ֑רוּ וְזֶ֖רַע רְשָׁעִ֣ים נִכְרָֽת׃
verses.translit: khy yhvh  'hb mshpt vl'y'zb 'tchsydyv l'vlm nshmrv vzr' rsh'ym nkhrt
verses.translation: For the LORD loveth justice, And forsaketh not His saints; they are preserved for ever; but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ־אָ֑רֶץ וְיִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ לָעַ֣ד עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translation: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פִּֽי־צַ֭דִּיק יֶהְגֶּ֣ה חׇכְמָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנ֗וֹ תְּדַבֵּ֥ר מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: pytsdyq yhgh chkhmh vlshvnv tdbr mshpt
verses.translation: The mouth of the righteous uttereth wisdom, and his tongue speaketh justice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תּוֹרַ֣ת אֱלֹהָ֣יו בְּלִבּ֑וֹ לֹ֖א תִמְעַ֣ד אֲשֻׁרָֽיו׃
verses.translation: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps slide.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צוֹפֶ֣ה רָ֭שָׁע לַצַּדִּ֑יק וּ֝מְבַקֵּ֗שׁ לַהֲמִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְ֭הֹוָה לֹא־יַעַזְבֶ֣נּוּ בְיָד֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א יַ֝רְשִׁיעֶ֗נּוּ בְּהִשָּׁפְטֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: yhvh l'y'zbnv bydv vl' yrshy'nv bhshptv
verses.translation: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor suffer him to be condemned when he is judged.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קַוֵּ֤ה אֶל־יְהֹוָ֨ה  וּשְׁמֹ֬ר דַּרְכּ֗וֹ וִֽ֭ירוֹמִמְךָ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אָ֑רֶץ בְּהִכָּרֵ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: qvh 'lyhvh  vshmr drkhv vyrvmmkh lrsht 'rts bhkhrt rsh'ym tr'h
verses.translation: Wait for the LORD, and keep His way, and He will exalt thee to inherit the land; when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָ֭אִיתִי רָשָׁ֣ע עָרִ֑יץ וּ֝מִתְעָרֶ֗ה כְּאֶזְרָ֥ח רַעֲנָֽן׃
verses.translation: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a leafy tree in its native soil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽ֭יַּעֲבֹר וְהִנֵּ֣ה אֵינֶ֑נּוּ וָ֝אֲבַקְשֵׁ֗הוּ וְלֹ֣א נִמְצָֽא׃
verses.translation: But one passed by, and, lo, he was not; yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁמׇר־תָּ֭ם וּרְאֵ֣ה יָשָׁ֑ר כִּֽי־אַחֲרִ֖ית לְאִ֣ישׁ שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: shmrtm vr'h yshr khy'chryt l'ysh shlvm
verses.translation: Mark the man of integrity, and behold the upright; for there is a future for the man of peace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽ֭פֹשְׁעִים נִשְׁמְד֣וּ יַחְדָּ֑ו אַחֲרִ֖ית רְשָׁעִ֣ים נִכְרָֽתָה׃
verses.translation: But transgressors shall be destroyed together; the future of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּתְשׁוּעַ֣ת צַ֭דִּיקִים מֵיְהֹוָ֑ה מָ֝עוּזָּ֗ם בְּעֵ֣ת צָרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vtshv't tsdyqym myhvh m'vzm b't tsrh
verses.translation: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD; He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֥יַּעְזְרֵ֥ם יְהֹוָ֗ה וַֽיְפַ֫לְּטֵ֥ם יְפַלְּטֵ֣ם מֵ֭רְשָׁעִים וְיוֹשִׁיעֵ֑ם כִּי־חָ֥סוּ בֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'zrm yhvh vypltm ypltm mrsh'ym vyvshy'm khychsv bv {p}
verses.translation: And the LORD helpeth them, and delivereth them; He delivereth them from the wicked, and saveth them, because they have taken refuge in Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִזְמ֖וֹר לְדָוִ֣ד לְהַזְכִּֽיר׃
verses.translation: A Psalm of David, to make memorial.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה אַל־בְּקֶצְפְּךָ֥ תוֹכִיחֵ֑נִי וּֽבַחֲמָתְךָ֥ תְיַסְּרֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: O LORD, rebuke me not in Thine anger; neither chasten me in Thy wrath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־חִ֭צֶּיךָ נִ֣חֲתוּ בִ֑י וַתִּנְחַ֖ת עָלַ֣י יָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: For Thine arrows are gone deep into me, and Thy hand is come down upon me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵין־מְתֹ֣ם בִּ֭בְשָׂרִי מִפְּנֵ֣י זַעְמֶ֑ךָ אֵין־שָׁל֥וֹם בַּ֝עֲצָמַ֗י מִפְּנֵ֥י חַטָּאתִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'ynmtm bbshry mpny z'mkh 'ynshlvm b'tsmy mpny cht'ty
verses.translation: There is no soundness in my flesh because of Thine indignation; neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י עֲ֭וֺנֹתַי עָבְר֣וּ רֹאשִׁ֑י כְּמַשָּׂ֥א כָ֝בֵ֗ד יִכְבְּד֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: khy 'vnty 'brv r'shy khmsh' khbd ykhbdv mmny
verses.translation: For mine iniquities are gone over my head; as a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִבְאִ֣ישׁוּ נָ֭מַקּוּ חַבּוּרֹתָ֑י מִ֝פְּנֵ֗י אִוַּלְתִּֽי׃
verses.translation: My wounds are noisome, they fester, because of my foolishness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַעֲוֵ֣יתִי שַׁחֹ֣תִי עַד־מְאֹ֑ד כׇּל־הַ֝יּ֗וֹם קֹדֵ֥ר הִלָּֽכְתִּי׃
verses.translation: I am bent and bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־כְ֭סָלַי מָלְא֣וּ נִקְלֶ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין מְ֝תֹ֗ם בִּבְשָׂרִֽי׃
verses.translit: khykhsly ml'v nqlh v'yn mtm bbshry
verses.translation: For my loins are filled with burning; and there is no soundness in my flesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְפוּג֣וֹתִי וְנִדְכֵּ֣יתִי עַד־מְאֹ֑ד שָׁ֝אַ֗גְתִּי מִֽנַּהֲמַ֥ת לִבִּֽי׃
verses.translation: I am benumbed and sore crushed; I groan by reason of the moaning of my heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲֽדֹנָ֗י נֶגְדְּךָ֥ כׇל־תַּאֲוָתִ֑י וְ֝אַנְחָתִ֗י מִמְּךָ֥ לֹֽא־נִסְתָּֽרָה׃
verses.translation: Lord, all my desire is before Thee; and my sighing is not hid from Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבִּ֣י סְ֭חַרְחַר עֲזָבַ֣נִי כֹחִ֑י וְֽאוֹר־עֵינַ֥י גַּם־הֵ֝֗ם אֵ֣ין אִתִּֽי׃
verses.translation: My heart fluttereth, my strength faileth me; as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹֽהֲבַ֨י  וְרֵעַ֗י מִנֶּ֣גֶד נִגְעִ֣י יַעֲמֹ֑דוּ וּ֝קְרוֹבַ֗י מֵרָחֹ֥ק עָמָֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: 'hby  vr'y mngd ng'y y'mdv vqrvby mrchq 'mdv
verses.translation: My friends and my companions stand aloof from my plague; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְנַקְשׁ֤וּ  מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י נַפְשִׁ֗י וְדֹרְשֵׁ֣י רָ֭עָתִי דִּבְּר֣וּ הַוּ֑וֹת וּ֝מִרְמ֗וֹת כׇּל־הַיּ֥וֹם יֶהְגּֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vynqshv  mbqshy npshy vdrshy r'ty dbrv hvvt vmrmvt khlhyvm yhgv
verses.translation: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me; and they that seek my hurt speak crafty devices, and utter deceits all the day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י כְ֭חֵרֵשׁ לֹ֣א אֶשְׁמָ֑ע וּ֝כְאִלֵּ֗ם לֹ֣א יִפְתַּח־פִּֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'ny khchrsh l' 'shm' vkh'lm l' yptchpyv
verses.translation: But I am as a deaf man, I hear not; and I am as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֱהִ֗י כְּ֭אִישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־שֹׁמֵ֑עַ וְאֵ֥ין בְּ֝פִ֗יו תּוֹכָחֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'hy kh'ysh 'shr l'shm' v'yn bpyv tvkhchvt
verses.translation: Yea, I am become as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no arguments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־לְךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֣ה הוֹחָ֑לְתִּי אַתָּ֥ה תַ֝עֲנֶ֗ה אֲדֹנָ֥י אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.translation: For in Thee, O LORD, do I hope; Thou wilt answer, O Lord my God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אָ֭מַרְתִּי פֶּן־יִשְׂמְחוּ־לִ֑י בְּמ֥וֹט רַ֝גְלִ֗י עָלַ֥י הִגְדִּֽילוּ׃
verses.translation: For I said: 'Lest they rejoice over me; when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אֲ֭נִי לְצֶ֣לַע נָכ֑וֹן וּמַכְאוֹבִ֖י נֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִֽיד׃
verses.translit: khy'ny ltsl' nkhvn vmkh'vby ngdy tmyd
verses.translation: For I am ready to halt, and my pain is continually before me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־עֲוֺנִ֥י אַגִּ֑יד אֶ֝דְאַ֗ג מֵ֖חַטָּאתִֽי׃
verses.translation: For I do declare mine iniquity; I am full of care because of my sin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽ֭אֹיְבַי חַיִּ֣ים עָצֵ֑מוּ וְרַבּ֖וּ שֹׂנְאַ֣י שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.translation: But mine enemies are strong in health; and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמְשַׁלְּמֵ֣י רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה יִ֝שְׂטְנ֗וּנִי תַּ֣חַת (רדופי) [רׇֽדְפִי־]טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: vmshlmy r'h tcht tvbh yshtnvny tcht (rdvpy) [rdpy]tvb
verses.translation: They also that repay evil for good are adversaries unto me, because I follow the thing that is good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תַּעַזְבֵ֥נִי יְהֹוָ֑ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אַל־תִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.translation: Forsake me not, O LORD; O my God, be not far from me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ח֥וּשָׁה לְעֶזְרָתִ֑י אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י תְּשׁוּעָתִֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ (לידיתון) [לִֽידוּת֗וּן] מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translation: For the Leader, for Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמַ֗רְתִּי אֶ֥שְׁמְרָ֣ה דְרָכַי֮ מֵחֲט֢וֹא בִלְשׁ֫וֹנִ֥י אֶשְׁמְרָ֥ה לְפִ֥י מַחְס֑וֹם בְּעֹ֖ד רָשָׁ֣ע לְנֶגְדִּֽי׃
verses.translit: 'mrty 'shmrh drkhy mchtv' blshvny 'shmrh lpy mchsvm b'd rsh' lngdy
verses.translation: I said: 'I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue; I will keep a curb upon my mouth, while the wicked is before me.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֶאֱלַ֣מְתִּי ד֭וּמִיָּה הֶחֱשֵׁ֣יתִי מִטּ֑וֹב וּכְאֵבִ֥י נֶעְכָּֽר׃
verses.translit: n'lmty dvmyh hchshyty mtvb vkh'by n'khr
verses.translation: I was dumb with silence; I held my peace, had no comfort; and my pain was held in check.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַם־לִבִּ֨י  בְּקִרְבִּ֗י בַּהֲגִיגִ֥י תִבְעַר־אֵ֑שׁ דִּ֝בַּ֗רְתִּי בִּלְשׁוֹנִֽי׃
verses.translit: chmlby  bqrby bhgygy tb'r'sh dbrty blshvny
verses.translation: My heart waxed hot within me; while I was musing, the fire kindled; Then spoke I with my tongue:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹדִ֘יעֵ֤נִי יְהֹוָ֨ה  קִצִּ֗י וּמִדַּ֣ת יָמַ֣י מַה־הִ֑יא אֵ֝דְעָ֗ה מֶה־חָדֵ֥ל אָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: hvdy'ny yhvh  qtsy vmdt ymy mhhy' 'd'h mhchdl 'ny
verses.translation: 'LORD, make me to know mine end, And the measure of my days, what it is; Let me know how short-lived I am.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה טְפָח֨וֹת  נָ֘תַ֤תָּה יָמַ֗י וְחֶלְדִּ֣י כְאַ֣יִן נֶגְדֶּ֑ךָ אַ֥ךְ כׇּֽל־הֶ֥בֶל כׇּל־אָ֝דָ֗ם נִצָּ֥ב סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: hnh tpchvt  ntth ymy vchldy kh'yn ngdkh 'kh khlhbl khl'dm ntsb slh
verses.translation: Behold, Thou hast made my days as hand-breadths; and mine age is as nothing before Thee; surely every man at his best estate is altogether vanity. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַךְ־בְּצֶ֤לֶם  יִֽתְהַלֶּךְ־אִ֗ישׁ אַךְ־הֶ֥בֶל יֶהֱמָי֑וּן יִ֝צְבֹּ֗ר וְֽלֹא־יֵדַ֥ע מִֽי־אֹסְפָֽם׃
verses.translation: Surely man walketh as a mere semblance; surely for vanity they are in turmoil; He heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה מַה־קִּוִּ֣יתִי אֲדֹנָ֑י תּ֝וֹחַלְתִּ֗י לְךָ֣ הִֽיא׃
verses.translation: And now, Lord, what wait I for? My hope, it is in Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִכׇּל־פְּשָׁעַ֥י הַצִּילֵ֑נִי חֶרְפַּ֥ת נָ֝בָ֗ל אַל־תְּשִׂימֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Deliver me from all my transgressions; make me not the reproach of the base.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֶ֭אֱלַמְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶפְתַּח־פִּ֑י כִּ֖י אַתָּ֣ה עָשִֽׂיתָ׃
verses.translation: I am dumb, I open not my mouth; because Thou hast done it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָסֵ֣ר מֵעָלַ֣י נִגְעֶ֑ךָ מִתִּגְרַ֥ת יָ֝דְךָ֗ אֲנִ֣י כָלִֽיתִי׃
verses.translit: hsr m'ly ng'kh mtgrt ydkh 'ny khlyty
verses.translation: Remove Thy stroke from off me; I am consumed by the blow of Thy hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּֽתוֹכָ֘ח֤וֹת עַל־עָוֺ֨ן  יִסַּ֬רְתָּ אִ֗ישׁ וַתֶּ֣מֶס כָּעָ֣שׁ חֲמוּד֑וֹ אַ֤ךְ הֶ֖בֶל כׇּל־אָדָ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: btvkhchvt 'l'vn  ysrt 'ysh vtms kh'sh chmvdv 'kh hbl khl'dm slh
verses.translation: With rebukes dost Thou chasten man for iniquity, and like a moth Thou makest his beauty to consume away; surely every man is vanity. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֥מְעָֽה־תְפִלָּתִ֨י  יְהֹוָ֡ה וְשַׁוְעָתִ֨י  הַאֲזִינָה֮ אֶֽל־דִּמְעָתִ֗י אַֽל־תֶּ֫חֱרַ֥שׁ כִּ֤י גֵ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י עִמָּ֑ךְ תּ֝וֹשָׁ֗ב כְּכׇל־אֲבוֹתָֽי׃
verses.translit: shm'htplty  yhvh vshv'ty  h'zynh 'ldm'ty 'ltchrsh khy gr 'nkhy 'mkh tvshb khkhl'bvty
verses.translation: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; keep not silence at my tears; for I am a stranger with Thee, a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָשַׁ֣ע מִמֶּ֣נִּי וְאַבְלִ֑יגָה בְּטֶ֖רֶם אֵלֵ֣ךְ וְאֵינֶֽנִּי׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Look away from me, that I may take comfort, before I go hence, and be no more.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַ֝מְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָוִ֥ד מִזְמֽוֹר׃
verses.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קַוֺּ֣ה קִוִּ֣יתִי יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥ט אֵ֝לַ֗י וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע שַׁוְעָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: qvh qvyty yhvh vyt 'ly vyshm' shv'ty
verses.translation: I waited patiently for the LORD; and He inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲלֵ֤נִי  מִבּ֥וֹר שָׁאוֹן֮ מִטִּ֢יט הַיָּ֫וֵ֥ן וַיָּ֖קֶם עַל־סֶ֥לַע רַגְלַ֗י כּוֹנֵ֥ן אֲשֻׁרָֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'lny  mbvr sh'vn mtyt hyvn vyqm 'lsl' rgly khvnn 'shry
verses.translation: He brought me up also out of the tumultuous pit, out of the miry clay; and He set my feet upon a rock, He established my goings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֬ן בְּפִ֨י  שִׁ֥יר חָדָשׁ֮ תְּהִלָּ֢ה לֵאלֹ֫הֵ֥ינוּ יִרְא֣וּ רַבִּ֣ים וְיִירָ֑אוּ וְ֝יִבְטְח֗וּ בַּיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vytn bpy  shyr chdsh thlh l'lhynv yr'v rbym vyyr'v vybtchv byhvh
verses.translation: And He hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God; many shall see, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי־הַגֶּ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֣ם יְ֭הֹוָה מִבְטַח֑וֹ וְֽלֹא־פָנָ֥ה אֶל־רְ֝הָבִ֗ים וְשָׂטֵ֥י כָזָֽב׃
verses.translation: Happy is the man that hath made the LORD his trust, and hath not turned unto the arrogant, nor unto such as fall away treacherously.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַבּ֤וֹת עָשִׂ֨יתָ  אַתָּ֤ה  יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַי֮ נִ֥פְלְאֹתֶ֥יךָ וּמַחְשְׁבֹתֶ֗יךָ אֵ֫לֵ֥ינוּ אֵ֤ין  עֲרֹ֬ךְ אֵלֶ֗יךָ אַגִּ֥ידָה וַאֲדַבֵּ֑רָה עָ֝צְמ֗וּ מִסַּפֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: rbvt 'shyt  'th  yhvh 'lhy npl'tykh vmchshbtykh 'lynv 'yn  'rkh 'lykh 'gydh v'dbrh 'tsmv mspr
verses.translation: Many things hast Thou done, O LORD my God, even Thy wonderful works, and Thy thoughts toward us; there is none to be compared unto Thee! If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be told.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֤בַח וּמִנְחָ֨ה  לֹֽא־חָפַ֗צְתָּ אׇ֭זְנַיִם כָּרִ֣יתָ לִּ֑י עוֹלָ֥ה וַ֝חֲטָאָ֗ה לֹ֣א שָׁאָֽלְתָּ׃
verses.translit: zbch vmnchh  l'chptst 'znym khryt ly 'vlh vcht'h l' sh'lt
verses.translation: Sacrifice and meal-offering Thou hast no delight in; mine ears hast Thou opened; burnt-offering and sin-offering hast Thou not required.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֣ז אָ֭מַרְתִּי הִנֵּה־בָ֑אתִי בִּמְגִלַּת־סֵ֝֗פֶר כָּת֥וּב עָלָֽי׃
verses.translation: Then said I: 'Lo, I am come with the roll of a book which is prescribed for me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַ֥עֲשׂוֹת־רְצוֹנְךָ֣ אֱלֹהַ֣י חָפָ֑צְתִּי וְ֝ת֥וֹרָתְךָ֗ בְּת֣וֹךְ מֵעָֽי׃
verses.translation: I delight to do Thy will, O my God; yea, Thy law is in my inmost parts.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּשַּׂ֤רְתִּי צֶ֨דֶק  בְּקָ֘הָ֤ל רָ֗ב הִנֵּ֣ה שְׂ֭פָתַי לֹ֣א אֶכְלָ֑א יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה אַתָּ֥ה יָדָֽעְתָּ׃
verses.translit: bshrty tsdq  bqhl rb hnh shpty l' 'khl' yhvh 'th yd't
verses.translation: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation, Lo, I did not refrain my lips; O LORD, Thou knowest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צִדְקָתְךָ֬ לֹֽא־כִסִּ֨יתִי  בְּת֬וֹךְ לִבִּ֗י אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ וּתְשׁוּעָתְךָ֣ אָמָ֑רְתִּי לֹא־כִחַ֥דְתִּי חַסְדְּךָ֥ וַ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ לְקָהָ֥ל רָֽב׃
verses.translit: tsdqtkh l'khsyty  btvkh lby 'mvntkh vtshv'tkh 'mrty l'khchdty chsdkh v'mtkh lqhl rb
verses.translation: I have not hid Thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared Thy faithfulness and Thy salvation; I have not concealed Thy mercy and Thy truth from the great congregation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה יְהֹוָ֗ה לֹֽא־תִכְלָ֣א רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּ֑נִּי חַסְדְּךָ֥ וַ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ תָּמִ֥יד יִצְּרֽוּנִי׃
verses.translit: 'th yhvh l'tkhl' rchmykh mmny chsdkh v'mtkh tmyd ytsrvny
verses.translation: Thou, O LORD, wilt not withhold Thy compassions from me; let Thy mercy and Thy truth continually preserve me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אָפְפֽוּ־עָלַ֨י  רָע֡וֹת עַד־אֵ֬ין מִסְפָּ֗ר הִשִּׂיג֣וּנִי עֲ֭וֺנֹתַי וְלֹא־יָכֹ֣לְתִּי לִרְא֑וֹת עָצְמ֥וּ מִשַּׂעֲר֥וֹת רֹ֝אשִׁ֗י וְלִבִּ֥י עֲזָבָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: khy 'ppv'ly  r'vt 'd'yn mspr hshygvny 'vnty vl'ykhlty lr'vt 'tsmv msh'rvt r'shy vlby 'zbny
verses.translation: For innumerable evils have compassed me about, mine iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart hath failed me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְצֵ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה לְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָׁה׃
verses.translit: rtsh yhvh lhtsylny yhvh l'zrty chvshh
verses.translation: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; O LORD, make haste to help me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּר֨וּ  יַחַד֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י נַפְשִׁ֗י לִסְפּ֫וֹתָ֥הּ יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָ֭חוֹר וְיִכָּלְמ֑וּ חֲ֝פֵצֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: ybshv vychprv  ychd mbqshy npshy lspvth ysgv 'chvr vykhlmv chptsy r'ty
verses.translation: Let them be ashamed and abashed together that seek after my soul to sweep it away; let them be turned backward and brought to confusion that delight in my hurt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָ֭שֹׁמּוּ עַל־עֵ֣קֶב בׇּשְׁתָּ֑ם הָאֹמְרִ֥ים לִ֝֗י הֶ֘אָ֥ח ׀ הֶאָֽח׃
verses.translation: Let them be appalled by reason of their shame that say unto me: 'Aha, aha.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָ֘שִׂ֤ישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ  בְּךָ֗ כׇּֽל־מְבַ֫קְשֶׁ֥יךָ יֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל יְהֹוָ֑ה אֹ֝הֲבֵ֗י תְּשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: yshyshv vyshmchv  bkh khlmbqshykh y'mrv tmyd ygdl yhvh 'hby tshv'tkh
verses.translation: Let all those that seek Thee rejoice and be glad in Thee; let such as love Thy salvation say continually: 'The LORD be magnified.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י  עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְיוֹן֮ אֲדֹנָ֢י יַחֲשׇׁ֫ב־לִ֥י עֶזְרָתִ֣י וּמְפַלְטִ֣י אַ֑תָּה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אַל־תְּאַחַֽר׃ {פ}
verses.translation: But, as for me, that am poor and needy, the Lord will account it unto me; Thou art my help and my deliverer; O my God, tarry not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֭שְׁרֵי מַשְׂכִּ֣יל אֶל־דָּ֑ל בְּי֥וֹם רָ֝עָ֗ה יְֽמַלְּטֵ֥הוּ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translation: Happy is he that considereth the poor; the LORD will deliver him in the day of evil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֤ה  יִשְׁמְרֵ֣הוּ וִ֭יחַיֵּהוּ (יאשר) [וְאֻשַּׁ֣ר] בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְאַֽל־תִּ֝תְּנֵ֗הוּ בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ אֹיְבָֽיו׃
verses.translit: yhvh  yshmrhv vychyhv (y'shr) [v'shr] b'rts v'lttnhv bnpsh 'ybyv
verses.translation: The LORD preserve him, and keep him alive, let him be called happy in the land; and deliver not Thou him unto the greed of his enemies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה יִ֭סְעָדֶנּוּ עַל־עֶ֣רֶשׂ דְּוָ֑י כׇּל־מִ֝שְׁכָּב֗וֹ הָפַ֥כְתָּ בְחׇלְיֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: yhvh ys'dnv 'l'rsh dvy khlmshkhbv hpkht bchlyv
verses.translation: The LORD support him upon the bed of illness; mayest Thou turn all his lying down in his sickness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲֽנִי־אָ֭מַרְתִּי יְהֹוָ֣ה חׇנֵּ֑נִי רְפָאָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י כִּי־חָטָ֥אתִי לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: 'ny'mrty yhvh chnny rp'h npshy khycht'ty lkh
verses.translation: As for me, I said: 'O LORD, be gracious unto me; heal my soul; for I have sinned against Thee.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוֹיְבַ֗י יֹאמְר֣וּ רַ֣ע לִ֑י מָתַ֥י יָ֝מ֗וּת וְאָבַ֥ד שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'vyby y'mrv r' ly mty ymvt v'bd shmv
verses.translation: Mine enemies speak evil of me: 'When shall he die, and his name perish?'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־בָּ֤א לִרְא֨וֹת  שָׁ֤וְא יְדַבֵּ֗ר לִבּ֗וֹ יִקְבׇּץ־אָ֥וֶן ל֑וֹ יֵצֵ֖א לַח֣וּץ יְדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: v'mb' lr'vt  shv' ydbr lbv yqbts'vn lv yts' lchvts ydbr
verses.translation: And if one come to see me, he speaketh falsehood; His heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he speaketh of it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֗חַד עָלַ֣י יִ֭תְלַחֲשׁוּ כׇּל־שֹׂנְאָ֑י עָלַ֓י  יַחְשְׁב֖וּ רָעָ֣ה לִֽי׃
verses.translit: ychd 'ly ytlchshv khlshn'y 'ly  ychshbv r'h ly
