verses.translation: All that hate me whisper together against me, against me do they devise my hurt:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דְּֽבַר־בְּ֭לִיַּעַל יָצ֣וּק בּ֑וֹ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁ֝כַ֗ב לֹא־יוֹסִ֥יף לָקֽוּם׃
verses.translit: dbrbly'l ytsvq bv v'shr shkhb l'yvsyf lqvm
verses.translation: 'An evil thing cleaveth fast unto him; and now that he lieth, he shall rise up no more.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־אִ֤ישׁ שְׁלוֹמִ֨י  אֲשֶׁר־בָּטַ֣חְתִּי ב֭וֹ אוֹכֵ֣ל לַחְמִ֑י הִגְדִּ֖יל עָלַ֣י עָקֵֽב׃
verses.translation: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who did eat of my bread, Hath lifted up his heel against me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֤ה יְהֹוָ֗ה חׇנֵּ֥נִי וַהֲקִימֵ֑נִי וַאֲשַׁלְּמָ֥ה לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'th yhvh chnny vhqymny v'shlmh lhm
verses.translation: But Thou, O LORD, be gracious unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּזֹ֣את יָ֭דַעְתִּי כִּֽי־חָפַ֣צְתָּ בִּ֑י כִּ֤י לֹֽא־יָרִ֖יעַ אֹיְבִ֣י עָלָֽי׃
verses.translit: bz't yd'ty khychptst by khy l'yry' 'yby 'ly
verses.translation: By this I know that Thou delightest in me, that mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֗י בְּ֭תֻמִּי תָּמַ֣כְתָּ בִּ֑י וַתַּצִּיבֵ֖נִי לְפָנֶ֣יךָ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'ny btmy tmkht by vttsybny lpnykh l'vlm
verses.translation: And as for me, Thou upholdest me because of mine integrity, and settest me before Thy face for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּ֘ר֤וּךְ יְהֹוָ֨ה  אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵֽ֭הָעוֹלָם וְעַ֥ד הָעוֹלָ֗ם אָ֘מֵ֥ן ׀ וְאָמֵֽן׃
verses.translit: brvkh yhvh  'lhy yshr'l mh'vlm v'd h'vlm 'mn  v'mn
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לִבְנֵי־קֹֽרַח׃
verses.translation: For the Leader; Maschil of the sons of Korah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּאַיָּ֗ל תַּעֲרֹ֥ג עַל־אֲפִֽיקֵי־מָ֑יִם כֵּ֤ן נַפְשִׁ֨י תַעֲרֹ֖ג אֵלֶ֣יךָ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translation: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after Thee, O God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צָמְאָ֬ה נַפְשִׁ֨י  לֵאלֹהִים֮ לְאֵ֢ל חָ֥֫י מָתַ֥י אָב֑וֹא וְ֝אֵרָאֶ֗ה פְּנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: tsm'h npshy  l'lhym l'l chy mty 'bv' v'r'h pny 'lhym
verses.translation: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: 'When shall I come and appear before God?'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָֽיְתָה־לִּ֬י דִמְעָתִ֣י לֶ֭חֶם יוֹמָ֣ם וָלָ֑יְלָה בֶּאֱמֹ֥ר אֵלַ֥י כׇּל־הַ֝יּ֗וֹם אַיֵּ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: hythly dm'ty lchm yvmm vlylh b'mr 'ly khlhyvm 'yh 'lhykh
verses.translation: My tears have been my food day and night, while they say unto me all the day: 'Where is Thy God?'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֤לֶּה אֶזְכְּרָ֨ה  וְאֶשְׁפְּכָ֬ה עָלַ֨י  נַפְשִׁ֗י כִּ֤י אֶעֱבֹ֨ר  בַּסָּךְ֮ אֶדַּדֵּ֗ם עַד־בֵּ֥ית־אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים בְּקוֹל־רִנָּ֥ה וְתוֹדָ֗ה הָמ֥וֹן חוֹגֵֽג׃
verses.translit: 'lh 'zkhrh  v'shpkhh 'ly  npshy khy ''br  bskh 'ddm 'dbyt'lhym bqvlrnh vtvdh hmvn chvgg
verses.translation: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I passed on with the throng, and led them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping holyday.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־תִּשְׁתּ֬וֹחֲחִ֨י  נַפְשִׁי֮ וַתֶּהֱמִ֢י עָ֫לָ֥י הוֹחִ֣לִי לֵ֭אלֹהִים כִּי־ע֥וֹד אוֹדֶ֗נּוּ יְשׁוּע֥וֹת פָּנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: mhtshtvchchy  npshy vthmy 'ly hvchly l'lhym khy'vd 'vdnv yshv'vt pnyv
verses.translation: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why moanest thou within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise Him for the salvation of His countenance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהַ֗י עָלַי֮ נַפְשִׁ֢י תִשְׁתּ֫וֹחָ֥ח עַל־כֵּ֗ן אֶ֭זְכׇּרְךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ יַרְדֵּ֑ן וְ֝חֶרְמוֹנִ֗ים מֵהַ֥ר מִצְעָֽר׃
verses.translit: 'lhy 'ly npshy tshtvchch 'lkhn 'zkhrkh m'rts yrdn vchrmvnym mhr mts'r
verses.translation: O my God, my soul is cast down within me; therefore do I remember Thee from the land of Jordan, and the Hermons, from the hill Mizar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּהוֹם־אֶל־תְּה֣וֹם ק֭וֹרֵא לְק֣וֹל צִנּוֹרֶ֑יךָ כׇּֽל־מִשְׁבָּרֶ֥יךָ וְ֝גַלֶּ֗יךָ עָלַ֥י עָבָֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: thvm'lthvm qvr' lqvl tsnvrykh khlmshbrykh vglykh 'ly 'brv
verses.translation: Deep calleth unto deep at the voice of Thy cataracts; all Thy waves and Thy billows are gone over me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹמָ֤ם  יְצַוֶּ֬ה יְהֹוָ֨ה  חַסְדּ֗וֹ וּ֭בַלַּיְלָה שִׁירֹ֣ה עִמִּ֑י תְּ֝פִלָּ֗ה לְאֵ֣ל חַיָּֽי׃
verses.translit: yvmm  ytsvh yhvh  chsdv vblylh shyrh 'my tplh l'l chyy
verses.translation: By day the LORD will command His lovingkindness, and in the night His song shall be with me, even a prayer unto the God of my life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוֹמְרָ֤ה  לְאֵ֥ל סַלְעִי֮ לָמָ֢ה שְׁכַ֫חְתָּ֥נִי לָֽמָּה־קֹדֵ֥ר אֵלֵ֗ךְ בְּלַ֣חַץ אוֹיֵֽב׃
verses.translit: 'vmrh  l'l sl'y lmh shkhchtny lmhqdr 'lkh blchts 'vyb
verses.translation: I will say unto God my Rock: 'Why hast Thou forgotten me? Why go I mourning under the oppression of the enemy?'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּרֶ֤צַח  בְּֽעַצְמוֹתַ֗י חֵרְפ֥וּנִי צוֹרְרָ֑י בְּאׇמְרָ֥ם אֵלַ֥י כׇּל־הַ֝יּ֗וֹם אַיֵּ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: brtsch  b'tsmvty chrpvny tsvrry b'mrm 'ly khlhyvm 'yh 'lhykh
verses.translation: As with a crushing in my bones, mine adversaries taunt me; while they say unto me all the day: 'Where is Thy God?'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־תִּשְׁתּ֬וֹחֲחִ֨י  נַפְשִׁי֮ וּֽמַה־תֶּהֱמִ֢י עָ֫לָ֥י הוֹחִ֣ילִי לֵ֭אלֹהִים כִּי־ע֣וֹד אוֹדֶ֑נּוּ יְשׁוּעֹ֥ת פָּ֝נַ֗י וֵאלֹהָֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: mhtshtvchchy  npshy vmhthmy 'ly hvchyly l'lhym khy'vd 'vdnv yshv't pny v'lhy {p}
verses.translation: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why moanest thou within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise Him, the salvation of my countenance, and my God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׇׁפְטֵ֤נִי אֱלֹהִ֨ים  וְרִ֘יבָ֤ה רִיבִ֗י מִגּ֥וֹי לֹֽא־חָסִ֑יד מֵ֤אִישׁ־מִרְמָ֖ה וְעַוְלָ֣ה תְפַלְּטֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: shptny 'lhym  vrybh ryby mgvy l'chsyd m'yshmrmh v'vlh tpltny
verses.translation: Be Thou my judge, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation; O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־אַתָּ֤ה  אֱלֹהֵ֣י מָעוּזִּי֮ לָמָ֢ה זְנַ֫חְתָּ֥נִי לָֽמָּה־קֹדֵ֥ר אֶתְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בְּלַ֣חַץ אוֹיֵֽב׃
verses.translit: khy'th  'lhy m'vzy lmh znchtny lmhqdr 'thlkh blchts 'vyb
verses.translation: For Thou art the God of my strength; why hast Thou cast me off? Why go I mourning under the oppression of the enemy?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁלַח־אוֹרְךָ֣ וַ֭אֲמִתְּךָ הֵ֣מָּה יַנְח֑וּנִי יְבִיא֥וּנִי אֶל־הַֽר־קׇ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ וְאֶל־מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: shlch'vrkh v'mtkh hmh ynchvny yby'vny 'lhrqdshkh v'lmshkhnvtykh
verses.translation: O send out Thy light and Thy truth; let them lead me; Let them bring me unto Thy holy mountain, and to Thy dwelling-places.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָב֤וֹאָה  אֶל־מִזְבַּ֬ח אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֶל־אֵל֮ שִׂמְחַ֢ת גִּ֫ילִ֥י וְאוֹדְךָ֥ בְכִנּ֗וֹר אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.translation: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God, my exceeding joy; And praise Thee upon the harp, O God, my God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־תִּשְׁתּ֬וֹחֲחִ֨י  נַפְשִׁי֮ וּֽמַה־תֶּהֱמִ֢י עָ֫לָ֥י הוֹחִ֣ילִי לֵ֭אלֹהִים כִּי־ע֣וֹד אוֹדֶ֑נּוּ יְשׁוּעֹ֥ת פָּ֝נַ֗י וֵאלֹהָֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: mhtshtvchchy  npshy vmhthmy 'ly hvchyly l'lhym khy'vd 'vdnv yshv't pny v'lhy {p}
verses.translation: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why moanest thou within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise Him, The salvation of my countenance, and my God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ ׀ לִבְנֵי־קֹ֬רַח מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃
verses.translation: For the Leader; [a Psalm] of the sons of Korah. Maschil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֤ים  בְּאׇזְנֵ֬ינוּ שָׁמַ֗עְנוּ אֲבוֹתֵ֥ינוּ סִפְּרוּ־לָ֑נוּ פֹּ֥עַל פָּעַ֥לְתָּ בִ֝ימֵיהֶ֗ם בִּ֣ימֵי קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.translit: 'lhym  b'znynv shm'nv 'bvtynv sprvlnv p'l p'lt bymyhm bymy qdm
verses.translation: O God, we have heard with our ears, our fathers have told us; a work Thou didst in their days, in the days of old.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה  יָדְךָ֡ גּוֹיִ֣ם ה֭וֹרַשְׁתָּ וַתִּטָּעֵ֑ם תָּרַ֥ע לְ֝אֻמִּ֗ים וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵֽם׃
verses.translit: 'th  ydkh gvym hvrsht vtt'm tr' l'mym vtshlchm
verses.translation: Thou with Thy hand didst drive out the nations, and didst plant them in; Thou didst break the peoples, and didst spread them abroad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֪א בְחַרְבָּ֡ם יָ֥רְשׁוּ אָ֗רֶץ וּזְרוֹעָם֮ לֹא־הוֹשִׁ֢יעָ֫ה לָּ֥מוֹ כִּֽי־יְמִינְךָ֣ וּ֭זְרוֹעֲךָ וְא֥וֹר פָּנֶ֗יךָ כִּ֣י רְצִיתָֽם׃
verses.translit: khy l' bchrbm yrshv 'rts vzrv'm l'hvshy'h lmv khyymynkh vzrv'kh v'vr pnykh khy rtsytm
verses.translation: For not by their own sword did they get the land in possession, Neither did their own arm save them; but Thy right hand, and Thine arm, and the light of Thy countenance, because Thou wast favourable unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּה־ה֣וּא מַלְכִּ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים צַ֝וֵּ֗ה יְשׁוּע֥וֹת יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translation: Thou art my King, O God; command the salvation of Jacob.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּ֭ךָ צָרֵ֣ינוּ נְנַגֵּ֑חַ בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ֗ נָב֥וּס קָמֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: bkh tsrynv nngch bshmkh nbvs qmynv
verses.translation: Through Thee do we push down our adversaries; through Thy name do we tread them under that rise up against us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א בְקַשְׁתִּ֣י אֶבְטָ֑ח וְ֝חַרְבִּ֗י לֹ֣א תוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: khy l' bqshty 'btch vchrby l' tvshy'ny
verses.translation: For I trust not in my bow, neither can my sword save me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י ה֭וֹשַׁעְתָּנוּ מִצָּרֵ֑ינוּ וּמְשַׂנְאֵ֥ינוּ הֱבִישֽׁוֹתָ׃
verses.translation: But Thou hast saved us from our adversaries, and hast put them to shame that hate us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּ֭אלֹהִים הִלַּ֣לְנוּ כׇל־הַיּ֑וֹם וְשִׁמְךָ֓  לְעוֹלָ֖ם נוֹדֶ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: b'lhym hllnv khlhyvm vshmkh  l'vlm nvdh slh
verses.translation: In God have we gloried all the day, and we will give thanks unto Thy name for ever. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַף־זָ֭נַחְתָּ וַתַּכְלִימֵ֑נוּ וְלֹא־תֵ֝צֵ֗א בְּצִבְאוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translation: Yet Thou hast cast off, and brought us to confusion; and goest not forth with our hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּשִׁיבֵ֣נוּ אָ֭חוֹר מִנִּי־צָ֑ר וּ֝מְשַׂנְאֵ֗ינוּ שָׁ֣סוּ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translation: Thou makest us to turn back from the adversary; and they that hate us spoil at their will.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּ֭תְּנֵנוּ כְּצֹ֣אן מַאֲכָ֑ל וּ֝בַגּוֹיִ֗ם זֵרִיתָֽנוּ׃
verses.translation: Thou hast given us like sheep to be eaten; and hast scattered us among the nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּמְכֹּֽר־עַמְּךָ֥ בְלֹא־ה֑וֹן וְלֹֽא־רִ֝בִּ֗יתָ בִּמְחִירֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translation: Thou sellest Thy people for small gain, and hast not set their prices high.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ חֶ֭רְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ לַ֥עַג וָ֝קֶ֗לֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: tshymnv chrph lshkhnynv l'g vqls lsbybvtynv
verses.translation: Thou makest us a taunt to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ מָ֭שָׁל בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם מְנֽוֹד־רֹ֝֗אשׁ בַּלְאֻמִּֽים׃
verses.translation: Thou makest us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַ֭יּוֹם כְּלִמָּתִ֣י נֶגְדִּ֑י וּבֹ֖שֶׁת פָּנַ֣י כִּסָּֽתְנִי׃
verses.translit: khlhyvm khlmty ngdy vbsht pny khstny
verses.translation: All the day is my confusion before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֭קּוֹל מְחָרֵ֣ף וּמְגַדֵּ֑ף מִפְּנֵ֥י א֝וֹיֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם׃
verses.translation: For the voice of him that taunteth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and the revengeful.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־זֹ֣את בָּ֭אַתְנוּ וְלֹ֣א שְׁכַחֲנ֑וּךָ וְלֹֽא־שִׁ֝קַּ֗רְנוּ בִּבְרִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: khlz't b'tnv vl' shkhchnvkh vl'shqrnv bbrytkh
verses.translation: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten Thee, neither have we been false to Thy covenant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־נָס֣וֹג אָח֣וֹר לִבֵּ֑נוּ וַתֵּ֥ט אֲ֝שֻׁרֵ֗ינוּ מִנִּ֥י אׇרְחֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from Thy path;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י דִ֭כִּיתָנוּ בִּמְק֣וֹם תַּנִּ֑ים וַתְּכַ֖ס עָלֵ֣ינוּ בְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.translit: khy dkhytnv bmqvm tnym vtkhs 'lynv btslmvt
verses.translation: Though Thou hast crushed us into a place of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־שָׁ֭כַחְנוּ שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וַנִּפְרֹ֥שׂ כַּ֝פֵּ֗ינוּ לְאֵ֣ל זָֽר׃
verses.translation: If we had forgotten the name of our God, or spread forth our hands to a strange god; .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹ֣א אֱ֭לֹהִים יַחֲקׇר־זֹ֑את כִּי־ה֥וּא יֹ֝דֵ֗עַ תַּעֲלֻמ֥וֹת לֵֽב׃
verses.translit: hl' 'lhym ychqrz't khyhv' yd' t'lmvt lb
verses.translation: Would not God search this out? For He knoweth the secrets of the heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־עָ֭לֶיךָ הֹרַ֣גְנוּ כׇל־הַיּ֑וֹם נֶ֝חְשַׁ֗בְנוּ כְּצֹ֣אן טִבְחָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy'lykh hrgnv khlhyvm nchshbnv khts'n tbchh
verses.translation: Nay, but for Thy sake are we killed all the day; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ע֤וּרָה  לָ֖מָּה תִישַׁ֥ן ׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י הָ֝קִ֗יצָה אַל־תִּזְנַ֥ח לָנֶֽצַח׃
verses.translation: Awake, why sleepest Thou, O Lord? Arouse Thyself, cast not off for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָֽמָּה־פָנֶ֥יךָ תַסְתִּ֑יר תִּשְׁכַּ֖ח עׇנְיֵ֣נוּ וְֽלַחֲצֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translation: Wherefore hidest Thou Thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י שָׁ֣חָה לֶעָפָ֣ר נַפְשֵׁ֑נוּ דָּבְקָ֖ה לָאָ֣רֶץ בִּטְנֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: khy shchh l'pr npshnv dbqh l'rts btnnv
verses.translation: For our soul is bowed down to the dust; our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֭וּמָֽה עֶזְרָ֣תָה לָּ֑נוּ וּ֝פְדֵ֗נוּ לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Arise for our help, and redeem us for Thy mercy's sake.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ עַל־שֹׁ֭שַׁנִּים לִבְנֵי־קֹ֑רַח מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל שִׁ֣יר יְדִידֹֽת׃
verses.translation: For the Leader; upon Shoshannim; [a Psalm] of the sons of Korah. Maschil. A Song of loves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָ֘חַ֤שׁ לִבִּ֨י  דָּ֘בָ֤ר ט֗וֹב אֹמֵ֣ר אָ֭נִי מַעֲשַׂ֣י לְמֶ֑לֶךְ לְ֝שׁוֹנִ֗י עֵ֤ט  סוֹפֵ֬ר מָהִֽיר׃
verses.translit: rchsh lby  dbr tvb 'mr 'ny m'shy lmlkh lshvny 't  svpr mhyr
verses.translation: My heart overfloweth with a goodly matter; I say: 'My work is concerning a king'; My tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יׇפְיָפִ֡יתָ מִבְּנֵ֬י אָדָ֗ם ה֣וּצַק חֵ֭ן בְּשִׂפְתוֹתֶ֑יךָ עַל־כֵּ֤ן בֵּרַכְךָ֖ אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: ypypyt mbny 'dm hvtsq chn bshptvtykh 'lkhn brkhkh 'lhym l'vlm
verses.translation: Thou art fairer than the children of men; Grace is poured upon thy lips; Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲגֽוֹר־חַרְבְּךָ֣ עַל־יָרֵ֣ךְ גִּבּ֑וֹר ה֝וֹדְךָ֗ וַהֲדָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O mighty one, Thy glory and thy majesty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲדָ֬רְךָ֨  צְלַ֬ח רְכַ֗ב עַֽל־דְּבַר־אֱ֭מֶת וְעַנְוָה־צֶ֑דֶק וְתוֹרְךָ֖ נוֹרָא֣וֹת יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vhdrkh  tslch rkhb 'ldbr'mt v'nvhtsdq vtvrkh nvr'vt ymynkh
verses.translation: And in thy majesty prosper, ride on, In behalf of truth and meekness and righteousness; And let thy right hand teach thee tremendous things.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חִצֶּ֗יךָ שְׁנ֫וּנִ֥ים עַ֭מִּים תַּחְתֶּ֣יךָ יִפְּל֑וּ בְּ֝לֵ֗ב אוֹיְבֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: chtsykh shnvnym 'mym tchtykh yplv blb 'vyby hmlkh
verses.translation: Thine arrows are sharp— The peoples fall under thee— [They sink] into the heart of the king's enemies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּסְאֲךָ֣ אֱ֭לֹהִים עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד שֵׁ֥בֶט מִ֝ישֹׁ֗ר שֵׁ֣בֶט מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: khs'kh 'lhym 'vlm v'd shbt myshr shbt mlkhvtkh
verses.translation: Thy throne given of God is for ever and ever; A sceptre of equity is the sceptre of thy kingdom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָהַ֣בְתָּ צֶּדֶק֮ וַתִּשְׂנָ֫א־רֶ֥שַׁע עַל־כֵּ֤ן  מְשָׁחֲךָ֡ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֱ֭לֹהֶיךָ שֶׁ֥מֶן שָׂשׂ֗וֹן מֵחֲבֵרֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: 'hbt tsdq vtshn'rsh' 'lkhn  mshchkh 'lhym 'lhykh shmn shshvn mchbrkh
verses.translation: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated wickedness; Therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee With the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֹר־וַאֲהָל֣וֹת קְ֭צִיעוֹת כׇּל־בִּגְדֹתֶ֑יךָ מִֽן־הֵ֥יכְלֵי שֵׁ֝֗ן מִנִּ֥י שִׂמְּחֽוּךָ׃
verses.translit: mrv'hlvt qtsy'vt khlbgdtykh mnhykhly shn mny shmchvkh
verses.translation: Myrrh, and aloes, and cassia are all thy garments; Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made thee glad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנ֣וֹת מְ֭לָכִים בְּיִקְּרוֹתֶ֑יךָ נִצְּבָ֥ה שֵׁגַ֥ל לִ֝ימִינְךָ֗ בְּכֶ֣תֶם אוֹפִֽיר׃
verses.translit: bnvt mlkhym byqrvtykh ntsbh shgl lymynkh bkhtm 'vpyr
verses.translation: Kings' daughters are among thy favourites; At thy right hand doth stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְעִי־בַ֣ת וּ֭רְאִי וְהַטִּ֣י אׇזְנֵ֑ךְ וְשִׁכְחִ֥י עַ֝מֵּ֗ךְ וּבֵ֥ית אָבִֽיךְ׃
verses.translation: 'Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; Forget also thine own people, and thy father's house;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִתְאָ֣ו הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יׇפְיֵ֑ךְ כִּי־ה֥וּא אֲ֝דֹנַ֗יִךְ וְהִשְׁתַּֽחֲוִי־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: So shall the king desire thy beauty; For he is thy lord; and do homage unto him. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַֽת־צֹ֨ר  בְּ֭מִנְחָה פָּנַ֥יִךְ יְחַלּ֗וּ עֲשִׁ֣ירֵי עָֽם׃
verses.translation: And, O daughter of Tyre, the richest of the people Shall entreat thy favour with a gift.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־כְּבוּדָּ֣ה בַת־מֶ֣לֶךְ פְּנִ֑ימָה מִֽמִּשְׁבְּצ֖וֹת זָהָ֣ב לְבוּשָֽׁהּ׃
verses.translit: khlkhbvdh btmlkh pnymh mmshbtsvt zhb lbvshh
verses.translation: All glorious is the king's daughter within the palace; Her raiment is of chequer work inwrought with gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִרְקָמוֹת֮ תּוּבַ֢ל לַ֫מֶּ֥לֶךְ בְּתוּל֣וֹת אַ֭חֲרֶיהָ רֵעוֹתֶ֑יהָ מ֖וּבָא֣וֹת לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: lrqmvt tvbl lmlkh btvlvt 'chryh r'vtyh mvb'vt lkh
verses.translation: She shall be led unto the king on richly woven stuff; The virgins her companions in her train being brought unto thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תּ֭וּבַלְנָה בִּשְׂמָחֹ֣ת וָגִ֑יל תְּ֝בֹאֶ֗ינָה בְּהֵ֣יכַל מֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: tvblnh bshmcht vgyl tb'ynh bhykhl mlkh
verses.translation: They shall be led with gladness and rejoicing; They shall enter into the king's palace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּ֣חַת אֲ֭בֹתֶיךָ יִהְי֣וּ בָנֶ֑יךָ תְּשִׁיתֵ֥מוֹ לְ֝שָׂרִ֗ים בְּכׇל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: tcht 'btykh yhyv bnykh tshytmv lshrym bkhlh'rts
verses.translation: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy sons, Whom thou shalt make princes in all the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַזְכִּ֣ירָה שִׁ֭מְךָ בְּכׇל־דֹּ֣ר וָדֹ֑ר עַל־כֵּ֥ן עַמִּ֥ים יְ֝הוֹד֗וּךָ לְעֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'zkhyrh shmkh bkhldr vdr 'lkhn 'mym yhvdvkh l'lm v'd {p}
verses.translation: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations; Therefore shall the peoples praise thee for ever and ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ לִבְנֵי־קֹ֑רַח עַֽל־עֲלָמ֥וֹת שִֽׁיר׃
verses.translation: For the Leader; [a Psalm] of the sons of Korah; upon Alamoth. A Song.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֣ים לָ֭נוּ מַחֲסֶ֣ה וָעֹ֑ז עֶזְרָ֥ה בְ֝צָר֗וֹת נִמְצָ֥א מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: 'lhym lnv mchsh v'z 'zrh btsrvt nmts' m'd
verses.translation: God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֣ן לֹֽא־נִ֭ירָא בְּהָמִ֣יר אָ֑רֶץ וּבְמ֥וֹט הָ֝רִ֗ים בְּלֵ֣ב יַמִּֽים׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn l'nyr' bhmyr 'rts vbmvt hrym blb ymym
verses.translation: Therefore will we not fear, though the earth do change, And though the mountains be moved into the heart of the seas;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֶהֱמ֣וּ יֶחְמְר֣וּ מֵימָ֑יו יִ֥רְעֲשֽׁוּ־הָרִ֖ים בְּגַאֲוָת֣וֹ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: yhmv ychmrv mymyv yr'shvhrym bg'vtv slh
verses.translation: Though the waters thereof roar and foam, Though the mountains shake at the swelling thereof. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָהָ֗ר פְּלָגָ֗יו יְשַׂמְּח֥וּ עִיר־אֱלֹהִ֑ים קְ֝דֹ֗שׁ מִשְׁכְּנֵ֥י עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.translation: There is a river, the streams whereof make glad the city of God, The holiest dwelling-place of the Most High.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּ֭קִרְבָּהּ בַּל־תִּמּ֑וֹט יַעְזְרֶ֥הָ אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לִפְנ֥וֹת בֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.translation: God is in the midst of her, she shall not be moved; God shall help her, at the approach of morning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָמ֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם מָ֣טוּ מַמְלָכ֑וֹת נָתַ֥ן בְּ֝קוֹל֗וֹ תָּמ֥וּג אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: hmv gvym mtv mmlkhvt ntn bqvlv tmvg 'rts
verses.translation: Nations were in tumult, kingdoms were moved; He uttered His voice, the earth melted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֣וֹת עִמָּ֑נוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב־לָ֨נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translation: The LORD of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our high tower. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְֽכוּ־חֲ֭זוּ מִפְעֲל֣וֹת יְהֹוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֖ם שַׁמּ֣וֹת בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translation: Come, behold the works of the LORD, Who hath made desolations in the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשְׁבִּ֥ית מִלְחָמוֹת֮ עַד־קְצֵ֢ה הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ קֶ֣שֶׁת יְ֭שַׁבֵּר וְקִצֵּ֣ץ חֲנִ֑ית עֲ֝גָל֗וֹת יִשְׂרֹ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: mshbyt mlchmvt 'dqtsh h'rts qsht yshbr vqtsts chnyt 'glvt yshrf b'sh
verses.translation: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; He breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; He burneth the chariots in the fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַרְפּ֣וּ וּ֭דְעוּ כִּֽי־אָנֹכִ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָר֥וּם בַּ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם אָר֥וּם בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translation: 'Let be, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֣וֹת עִמָּ֑נוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב־לָ֨נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃ {פ}
verses.translation: The LORD of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our high tower. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ ׀ לִבְנֵי־קֹ֬רַח מִזְמֽוֹר׃
verses.translation: For the Leader; a Psalm for the sons of Korah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּֽל־הָ֭עַמִּים תִּקְעוּ־כָ֑ף הָרִ֥יעוּ לֵ֝אלֹהִ֗ים בְּק֣וֹל רִנָּֽה׃
verses.translit: khlh'mym tq'vkhf hry'v l'lhym bqvl rnh
verses.translation: O clap your hands, all ye peoples; shout unto God with the voice of triumph. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יְהֹוָ֣ה עֶלְי֣וֹן נוֹרָ֑א מֶ֥לֶךְ גָּ֝ד֗וֹל עַל־כׇּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translation: For the LORD is most high, awful; a great King over all the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַדְבֵּ֣ר עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתֵּ֑ינוּ וּ֝לְאֻמִּ֗ים תַּ֣חַת רַגְלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translation: He subdueth peoples under us, and nations under our feet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִבְחַר־לָ֥נוּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתֵ֑נוּ אֶ֥ת־גְּא֨וֹן יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֲשֶׁר־אָהֵ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translation: He chooseth our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob whom He loveth. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָלָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים בִּתְרוּעָ֑ה יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה בְּק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃
verses.translation: God is gone up amidst shouting, the LORD amidst the sound of the horn.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זַמְּר֣וּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים זַמֵּ֑רוּ זַמְּר֖וּ לְמַלְכֵּ֣נוּ זַמֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.translation: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י מֶ֖לֶךְ כׇּל־הָאָ֥רֶץ אֱלֹהִ֗ים זַמְּר֥וּ מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃
verses.translation: For God is the King of all the earth; sing ye praises in a skilful song.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָלַ֣ךְ אֱ֭לֹהִים עַל־גּוֹיִ֑ם אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים יָשַׁ֤ב  עַל־כִּסֵּ֬א קׇדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translation: God reigneth over the nations; God sitteth upon His holy throne.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְדִ֘יבֵ֤י עַמִּ֨ים  נֶאֱסָ֗פוּ עַם֮ אֱלֹהֵ֢י אַבְרָ֫הָ֥ם כִּ֣י לֵ֭אלֹהִים מָֽגִנֵּי־אֶ֗רֶץ מְאֹ֣ד נַעֲלָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: ndyby 'mym  n'spv 'm 'lhy 'brhm khy l'lhym mgny'rts m'd n'lh {p}
verses.translation: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham; for unto God belong the shields of the earth; He is greatly exalted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֥יר מִ֝זְמ֗וֹר לִבְנֵי־קֹֽרַח׃
verses.translation: A Song; a Psalm of the sons of Korah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גָּ֘ד֤וֹל יְהֹוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד בְּעִ֥יר אֱ֝לֹהֵ֗ינוּ הַר־קׇדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: gdvl yhvh vmhll m'd b'yr 'lhynv hrqdshv
verses.translation: Great is the LORD, and highly to be praised, In the city of our God, His holy mountain,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְפֵ֥ה נוֹף֮ מְשׂ֢וֹשׂ כׇּל־הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ הַר־צִ֭יּוֹן יַרְכְּתֵ֣י צָפ֑וֹן קִ֝רְיַ֗ת מֶ֣לֶךְ רָֽב׃
verses.translit: yph nvf mshvsh khlh'rts hrtsyvn yrkhty tspvn qryt mlkh rb
verses.translation: Fair in situation, the joy of the whole earth; Even mount Zion, the uttermost parts of the north, The city of the great King.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֥ים בְּאַרְמְנוֹתֶ֗יהָ נוֹדַ֥ע לְמִשְׂגָּֽב׃
verses.translation: God in her palaces Hath made Himself known for a stronghold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֣ה הַ֭מְּלָכִים נ֥וֹעֲד֑וּ עָבְר֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.translation: For, lo, the kings assembled themselves, They came onward together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֣מָּה רָ֭אוּ כֵּ֣ן תָּמָ֑הוּ נִבְהֲל֥וּ נֶחְפָּֽזוּ׃
verses.translit: hmh r'v khn tmhv nbhlv nchpzv
verses.translation: They saw, straightway they were amazed; They were affrighted, they hasted away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְ֭עָדָה אֲחָזָ֣תַם שָׁ֑ם חִ֝֗יל כַּיּוֹלֵדָֽה׃
verses.translation: Trembling took hold of them there, Pangs, as of a woman in travail.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּר֥וּחַ קָדִ֑ים תְּ֝שַׁבֵּ֗ר אֳנִיּ֥וֹת תַּרְשִֽׁישׁ׃
verses.translation: With the east wind Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁמַ֨עְנוּ  כֵּ֤ן רָאִ֗ינוּ בְּעִיר־יְהֹוָ֣ה צְ֭בָאוֹת בְּעִ֣יר אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ אֱלֹ֘הִ֤ים יְכוֹנְנֶ֖הָ עַד־עוֹלָ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: kh'shr shm'nv  khn r'ynv b'yryhvh tsb'vt b'yr 'lhynv 'lhym ykhvnnh 'd'vlm slh
verses.translation: As we have heard, so have we seen In the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God— God establish it for ever. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּמִּ֣ינוּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ בְּ֝קֶ֗רֶב הֵיכָלֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: We have thought on Thy lovingkindness, O God, In the midst of Thy temple.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּשִׁמְךָ֤ אֱלֹהִ֗ים כֵּ֣ן תְּ֭הִלָּתְךָ עַל־קַצְוֵי־אֶ֑רֶץ צֶ֝֗דֶק מָלְאָ֥ה יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: khshmkh 'lhym khn thltkh 'lqtsvy'rts tsdq ml'h ymynkh
verses.translation: As is Thy name, O God, So is Thy praise unto the ends of the earth; Thy right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׂמַ֤ח  הַר־צִיּ֗וֹן תָּ֭גֵלְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה לְ֝מַ֗עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: yshmch  hrtsyvn tglnh bnvt yhvdh lm'n mshptykh
verses.translation: Let mount Zion be glad, Let the daughters of Judah rejoice, Because of Thy judgments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סֹ֣בּוּ צִ֭יּוֹן וְהַקִּיפ֑וּהָ סִ֝פְר֗וּ מִגְדָּלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translation: Walk about Zion, and go round about her; Count the towers thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֤יתוּ לִבְּכֶ֨ם  לְֽחֵילָ֗הֿ פַּסְּג֥וּ אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ לְמַ֥עַן תְּ֝סַפְּר֗וּ לְד֣וֹר אַחֲרֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: shytv lbkhm  lchylh psgv 'rmnvtyh lm'n tsprv ldvr 'chrvn
verses.translation: Mark ye well her ramparts, Traverse her palaces; That ye may tell it to the generation following. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י זֶ֨ה  אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֱ֭לֹהֵינוּ עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד ה֖וּא יְנַהֲגֵ֣נוּ עַל־מֽוּת׃ {פ}
verses.translation: For such is God, our God, for ever and ever; He will guide us eternally.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ ׀ לִבְנֵי־קֹ֬רַח מִזְמֽוֹר׃
verses.translation: For the Leader; a Psalm for the sons of Korah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ־זֹ֭את כׇּל־הָעַמִּ֑ים הַ֝אֲזִ֗ינוּ כׇּל־יֹ֥שְׁבֵי חָֽלֶד׃
verses.translation: Hear this, all ye peoples; Give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־בְּנֵ֣י אָ֭דָם גַּם־בְּנֵי־אִ֑ישׁ יַ֝֗חַד עָשִׁ֥יר וְאֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.translation: Both low and high, Rich and poor together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פִּ֭י יְדַבֵּ֣ר חׇכְמ֑וֹת וְהָג֖וּת לִבִּ֣י תְבוּנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: py ydbr chkhmvt vhgvt lby tbvnvt
verses.translation: My mouth shall speak wisdom, and the meditation of my heart shall be understanding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַטֶּ֣ה לְמָשָׁ֣ל אׇזְנִ֑י אֶפְתַּ֥ח בְּ֝כִנּ֗וֹר חִידָתִֽי׃
verses.translation: I will incline mine ear to a parable; I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֣מָּה אִ֭ירָא בִּ֣ימֵי רָ֑ע עֲוֺ֖ן עֲקֵבַ֣י יְסוּבֵּֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my supplanters compasseth me about,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַבֹּטְחִ֥ים עַל־חֵילָ֑ם וּבְרֹ֥ב עׇ֝שְׁרָ֗ם יִתְהַלָּֽלוּ׃
verses.translation: Of them that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֗ח לֹא־פָדֹ֣ה יִפְדֶּ֣ה אִ֑ישׁ לֹא־יִתֵּ֖ן לֵאלֹהִ֣ים כׇּפְרֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: No man can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭יֵקַר פִּדְי֥וֹן נַפְשָׁ֗ם וְחָדַ֥ל לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translation: For too costly is the redemption of their soul, and must be let alone for ever—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִיחִי־ע֥וֹד לָנֶ֑צַח לֹ֖א יִרְאֶ֣ה הַשָּֽׁחַת׃
verses.translation: That he should still live always, that he should not see the pit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י יִרְאֶ֨ה  חֲכָ֘מִ֤ים יָמ֗וּתוּ יַ֤חַד כְּסִ֣יל וָבַ֣עַר יֹאבֵ֑דוּ וְעָזְב֖וּ לַאֲחֵרִ֣ים חֵילָֽם׃
verses.translit: khy yr'h  chkhmym ymvtv ychd khsyl vb'r y'bdv v'zbv l'chrym chylm
verses.translation: For he seeth that wise men die, The fool and the brutish together perish, And leave their wealth to others.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קִרְבָּ֤ם בָּתֵּ֨ימוֹ  לְֽעוֹלָ֗ם מִ֭שְׁכְּנֹתָם לְד֣וֹר וָדֹ֑ר קָרְא֥וּ בִ֝שְׁמוֹתָ֗ם עֲלֵ֣י אֲדָמֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: qrbm btymv  l'vlm mshkhntm ldvr vdr qr'v bshmvtm 'ly 'dmvt
verses.translation: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, And their dwelling-places to all generations; They call their lands after their own names.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָדָ֣ם בִּ֭יקָר בַּל־יָלִ֑ין נִמְשַׁ֖ל כַּבְּהֵמ֣וֹת נִדְמֽוּ׃
verses.translit: v'dm byqr blylyn nmshl khbhmvt ndmv
verses.translation: But man abideth not in honour; He is like the beasts that perish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֣ה דַ֭רְכָּם כֵּ֣סֶל לָ֑מוֹ וְאַחֲרֵיהֶ֓ם  בְּפִיהֶ֖ם יִרְצ֣וּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: zh drkhm khsl lmv v'chryhm  bpyhm yrtsv slh
verses.translation: This is the way of them that are foolish, and of those who after them approve their sayings. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּצֹּ֤אן  לִ֥שְׁא֣וֹל שַׁתּוּ֮ מָ֤וֶת יִ֫רְעֵ֥ם וַיִּרְדּ֘וּ־בָ֤ם יְשָׁרִ֨ים  לַבֹּ֗קֶר (וצירם) [וְ֭צוּרָם] לְבַלּ֥וֹת שְׁא֗וֹל מִזְּבֻ֥ל לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khts'n  lsh'vl shtv mvt yr'm vyrdvbm yshrym  lbqr (vtsyrm) [vtsvrm] lblvt sh'vl mzbl lv
verses.translation: Like sheep they are appointed for the nether-world; death shall be their shepherd; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; And their form shall be for the nether-world to wear away, That there be no habitation for it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַךְ־אֱלֹהִ֗ים יִפְדֶּ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִֽיַּד־שְׁא֑וֹל כִּ֖י יִקָּחֵ֣נִי סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: 'kh'lhym ypdh npshy mydsh'vl khy yqchny slh
verses.translation: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the nether-world; For He shall receive me. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּ֭ירָא כִּֽי־יַעֲשִׁ֣ר אִ֑ישׁ כִּי־יִ֝רְבֶּ֗ה כְּב֣וֹד בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: Be not thou afraid when one waxeth rich, When the wealth of his house is increased;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א בְ֭מוֹתוֹ יִקַּ֣ח הַכֹּ֑ל לֹֽא־יֵרֵ֖ד אַחֲרָ֣יו כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy l' bmvtv yqch hkhl l'yrd 'chryv khbvdv
verses.translation: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away; His wealth shall not descend after him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־נַ֭פְשׁוֹ בְּחַיָּ֣יו יְבָרֵ֑ךְ וְ֝יוֹדֻ֗ךָ כִּי־תֵיטִ֥יב לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khynpshv bchyyv ybrkh vyvdkh khytytyb lkh
verses.translation: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: 'Men will praise thee, when thou shalt do well to thyself';
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תָּ֭בוֹא עַד־דּ֣וֹר אֲבוֹתָ֑יו עַד־נֵ֝֗צַח לֹ֣א יִרְאוּ־אֽוֹר׃
verses.translation: It shall go to the generation of his fathers; They shall never see the light. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָדָ֣ם בִּ֭יקָר וְלֹ֣א יָבִ֑ין נִמְשַׁ֖ל כַּבְּהֵמ֣וֹת נִדְמֽוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'dm byqr vl' ybyn nmshl khbhmvt ndmv {p}
verses.translation: Man that is in honour understandeth not; He is like the beasts that perish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֵ֤ל  אֱֽלֹהִ֡ים יְֽהֹוָ֗ה דִּבֶּ֥ר וַיִּקְרָא־אָ֑רֶץ מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁ֝֗מֶשׁ עַד־מְבֹאֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mzmvr l'sf 'l  'lhym yhvh dbr vyqr''rts mmzrchshmsh 'dmb'v
verses.translation: A Psalm of Asaph. God, God, the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth From the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִצִּיּ֥וֹן מִכְלַל־יֹ֗פִי אֱלֹהִ֥ים הוֹפִֽיעַ׃
verses.translation: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined forth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָ֤בֹ֥א אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְֽאַל־יֶ֫חֱרַ֥שׁ אֵשׁ־לְפָנָ֥יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל וּ֝סְבִיבָ֗יו נִשְׂעֲרָ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: yb' 'lhynv v'lychrsh 'shlpnyv t'khl vsbybyv nsh'rh m'd
verses.translation: Our God cometh, and doth not keep silence; a fire devoureth before Him, And round about Him it stormeth mightily.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִקְרָ֣א אֶל־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם מֵעָ֑ל וְאֶל־הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ לָדִ֥ין עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: He calleth to the heavens above, and to the earth, that He may judge His people:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִסְפוּ־לִ֥י חֲסִידָ֑י כֹּרְתֵ֖י בְרִיתִ֣י עֲלֵי־זָֽבַח׃
verses.translation: 'Gather My saints together unto Me; those that have made a covenant with Me by sacrifice.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּגִּ֣ידוּ שָׁמַ֣יִם צִדְק֑וֹ כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֓ים  שֹׁפֵ֖ט ה֣וּא סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: vygydv shmym tsdqv khy'lhym  shpt hv' slh
verses.translation: And the heavens declare His righteousness; for God, He is judge. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְעָ֤ה עַמִּ֨י  וַאֲדַבֵּ֗רָה יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל וְאָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֑ךְ אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֱלֹהֶ֣יךָ אָנֹֽכִי׃
verses.translation: 'Hear, O My people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: God, thy God, am I.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א עַל־זְ֭בָחֶיךָ אוֹכִיחֶ֑ךָ וְעוֹלֹתֶ֖יךָ לְנֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִֽיד׃
verses.translation: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices; and thy burnt-offerings are continually before Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־אֶקַּ֣ח מִבֵּיתְךָ֣ פָ֑ר מִ֝מִּכְלְאֹתֶ֗יךָ עַתּוּדִֽים׃
verses.translation: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he-goats out of thy folds.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־לִ֥י כׇל־חַיְתוֹ־יָ֑עַר בְּ֝הֵמ֗וֹת בְּהַרְרֵי־אָֽלֶף׃
verses.translation: For every beast of the forest is Mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָ֭דַעְתִּי כׇּל־ע֣וֹף הָרִ֑ים וְזִ֥יז שָׂ֝דַ֗י עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.translation: I know all the fowls of the mountains; and the wild beasts of the field are Mine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אֶ֭רְעַב לֹא־אֹ֣מַר לָ֑ךְ כִּי־לִ֥י תֵ֝בֵ֗ל וּמְלֹאָֽהּ׃
verses.translation: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee; for the world is Mine, and the fulness thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֭אוֹכַל בְּשַׂ֣ר אַבִּירִ֑ים וְדַ֖ם עַתּוּדִ֣ים אֶשְׁתֶּֽה׃
verses.translation: Do I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְבַ֣ח לֵאלֹהִ֣ים תּוֹדָ֑ה וְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לְעֶלְי֣וֹן נְדָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: zbch l'lhym tvdh vshlm l'lyvn ndrykh
verses.translation: Offer unto God the sacrifice of thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the Most High;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּ֭קְרָאֵנִי בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה אֲ֝חַלֶּצְךָ֗ וּֽתְכַבְּדֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: And call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver thee, and thou shalt honour Me.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָ֤רָשָׁ֨ע  אָ֘מַ֤ר אֱלֹהִ֗ים מַה־לְּ֭ךָ לְסַפֵּ֣ר חֻקָּ֑י וַתִּשָּׂ֖א בְרִיתִ֣י עֲלֵי־פִֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vlrsh'  'mr 'lhym mhlkh lspr chqy vtsh' bryty 'lypykh
verses.translation: But unto the wicked God saith: 'What hast thou to do to declare My statutes, And that thou hast taken My covenant in thy mouth?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭אַתָּה שָׂנֵ֣אתָ מוּסָ֑ר וַתַּשְׁלֵ֖ךְ דְּבָרַ֣י אַחֲרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest My words behind thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־רָאִ֣יתָ גַ֭נָּב וַתִּ֣רֶץ עִמּ֑וֹ וְעִ֖ם מְנָאֲפִ֣ים חֶלְקֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: When thou sawest a thief, thou hadst company with him, and with adulterers was thy portion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פִּ֭יךָ שָׁלַ֣חְתָּ בְרָעָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנְךָ֗ תַּצְמִ֥יד מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: pykh shlcht br'h vlshvnkh ttsmyd mrmh
verses.translation: Thou hast let loose thy mouth for evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.translation: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; Thou slanderest thine own mother's son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֤לֶּה עָשִׂ֨יתָ  וְֽהֶחֱרַ֗שְׁתִּי דִּמִּ֗יתָ הֱיֽוֹת־אֶהְיֶ֥ה כָמ֑וֹךָ אוֹכִיחֲךָ֖ וְאֶעֶרְכָ֣ה לְעֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'lh 'shyt  vhchrshty dmyt hyvt'hyh khmvkh 'vkhychkh v''rkhh l'ynykh
verses.translation: These things hast thou done, and should I have kept silence? Thou hadst thought that I was altogether such a one as thyself; but I will reprove thee, and set the cause before thine eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּינוּ־נָ֣א זֹ֭את שֹׁכְחֵ֣י אֱל֑וֹהַּ פֶּן־אֶ֝טְרֹ֗ף וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.translit: bynvn' z't shkhchy 'lvh pn'trf v'yn mtsyl
verses.translation: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear in pieces, and there be none to deliver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹבֵ֥חַ תּוֹדָ֗ה יְֽכַ֫בְּדָ֥נְנִי וְשָׂ֥ם דֶּ֑רֶךְ אַ֝רְאֶ֗נּוּ בְּיֵ֣שַׁע אֱלֹהִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: zbch tvdh ykhbdnny vshm drkh 'r'nv bysh' 'lhym {p}
verses.translation: Whoso offereth the sacrifice of thanksgiving honoureth Me; and to him that ordereth his way aright Will I show the salvation of God.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּֽבוֹא־אֵ֭לָיו נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֑יא כַּאֲשֶׁר־בָּ֝֗א אֶל־בַּת־שָֽׁבַע׃
verses.translation: when Nathan the prophet came unto him, after he had gone in to Bath-sheba.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חׇנֵּ֣נִי אֱלֹהִ֣ים כְּחַסְדֶּ֑ךָ כְּרֹ֥ב רַ֝חֲמֶ֗יךָ מְחֵ֣ה פְשָׁעָֽי׃
verses.translit: chnny 'lhym khchsdkh khrb rchmykh mchh psh'y
verses.translation: Be gracious unto me, O God, according to Thy mercy; According to the multitude of Thy compassions blot out my transgressions.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (הרבה) [הֶ֭רֶב] כַּבְּסֵ֣נִי מֵעֲוֺנִ֑י וּֽמֵחַטָּאתִ֥י טַהֲרֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Wash me thoroughly from mine iniquity, And cleanse me from my sin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־פְ֭שָׁעַי אֲנִ֣י אֵדָ֑ע וְחַטָּאתִ֖י נֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִֽיד׃
verses.translation: For I know my transgressions; And my sin is ever before me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְךָ֤ לְבַדְּךָ֨  חָטָאתִי֮ וְהָרַ֥ע בְּעֵינֶ֗יךָ עָ֫שִׂ֥יתִי לְ֭מַעַן תִּצְדַּ֥ק בְּדׇבְרֶ֗ךָ תִּזְכֶּ֥ה בְשׇׁפְטֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: lkh lbdkh  cht'ty vhr' b'ynykh 'shyty lm'n ttsdq bdbrkh tzkhh bshptkh
verses.translation: Against Thee, Thee only, have I sinned, And done that which is evil in Thy sight; That Thou mayest be justified when Thou speakest, And be in the right when Thou judgest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵן־בְּעָו֥וֹן חוֹלָ֑לְתִּי וּ֝בְחֵ֗טְא יֶחֱמַ֥תְנִי אִמִּֽי׃
verses.translation: Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity, and in sin did my mother conceive me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵן־אֱ֭מֶת חָפַ֣צְתָּ בַטֻּח֑וֹת וּ֝בְסָתֻ֗ם חׇכְמָ֥ה תוֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: hn'mt chptst btchvt vbstm chkhmh tvdy'ny
verses.translation: Behold, Thou desirest truth in the inward parts; make me, therefore, to know wisdom in mine inmost heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּחַטְּאֵ֣נִי בְאֵז֣וֹב וְאֶטְהָ֑ר תְּ֝כַבְּסֵ֗נִי וּמִשֶּׁ֥לֶג אַלְבִּֽין׃
verses.translation: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean; wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּ֭שְׁמִיעֵנִי שָׂשׂ֣וֹן וְשִׂמְחָ֑ה תָּ֝גֵ֗לְנָה עֲצָמ֥וֹת דִּכִּֽיתָ׃
verses.translation: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which Thou hast crushed may rejoice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נֶיךָ מֵחֲטָאָ֑י וְֽכׇל־עֲוֺ֖נֹתַ֣י מְחֵֽה׃
verses.translation: Hide Thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵ֣ב טָ֭הוֹר בְּרָא־לִ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְר֥וּחַ נָ֝כ֗וֹן חַדֵּ֥שׁ בְּקִרְבִּֽי׃
verses.translit: lb thvr br'ly 'lhym vrvch nkhvn chdsh bqrby
verses.translation: Create me a clean heart, O God; and renew a stedfast spirit within me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תַּשְׁלִיכֵ֥נִי מִלְּפָנֶ֑יךָ וְר֥וּחַ קׇ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ אַל־תִּקַּ֥ח מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.translation: Cast me not away from Thy presence; and take not Thy holy spirit from me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָשִׁ֣יבָה לִּ֭י שְׂשׂ֣וֹן יִשְׁעֶ֑ךָ וְר֖וּחַ נְדִיבָ֣ה תִסְמְכֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: hshybh ly shshvn ysh'kh vrvch ndybh tsmkhny
verses.translation: Restore unto me the joy of Thy salvation; and let a willing spirit uphold me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲלַמְּדָ֣ה פֹשְׁעִ֣ים דְּרָכֶ֑יךָ וְ֝חַטָּאִ֗ים אֵלֶ֥יךָ יָשֽׁוּבוּ׃
verses.translation: Then will I teach transgressors Thy ways; and sinners shall return unto Thee. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַצִּ֘ילֵ֤נִי מִדָּמִ֨ים  אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י תְשׁוּעָתִ֑י תְּרַנֵּ֥ן לְ֝שׁוֹנִ֗י צִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: htsylny mdmym  'lhym 'lhy tshv'ty trnn lshvny tsdqtkh
verses.translation: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, Thou God of my salvation; so shall my tongue sing aloud of Thy righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲ֭דֹנָי שְׂפָתַ֣י תִּפְתָּ֑ח וּ֝פִ֗י יַגִּ֥יד תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: O Lord, open Thou my lips; and my mouth shall declare Thy praise.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י  לֹא־תַחְפֹּ֣ץ זֶ֣בַח וְאֶתֵּ֑נָה ע֝וֹלָ֗ה לֹ֣א תִרְצֶֽה׃
verses.translit: khy  l'tchpts zbch v'tnh 'vlh l' trtsh
verses.translation: For Thou delightest not in sacrifice, else would I give it; Thou hast no pleasure in burnt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זִ֥בְחֵ֣י אֱלֹהִים֮ ר֤וּחַ נִשְׁבָּ֫רָ֥ה לֵב־נִשְׁבָּ֥ר וְנִדְכֶּ֑ה אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לֹ֣א תִבְזֶֽה׃
verses.translit: zbchy 'lhym rvch nshbrh lbnshbr vndkhh 'lhym l' tbzh
verses.translation: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart, O God, Thou wilt not despise.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵיטִ֣יבָה בִ֭רְצוֹנְךָ אֶת־צִיּ֑וֹן תִּ֝בְנֶ֗ה חוֹמ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translation: Do good in Thy favour unto Zion; build Thou the walls of Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֤ז תַּחְפֹּ֣ץ זִבְחֵי־צֶ֭דֶק עוֹלָ֣ה וְכָלִ֑יל אָ֤ז יַעֲל֖וּ עַל־מִזְבַּחֲךָ֣ פָרִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Then wilt Thou delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt-offering and whole offering; Then will they offer bullocks upon Thine altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translation: For the Leader. Maschil of David;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּב֤וֹא  דּוֹאֵ֣ג הָאֲדֹמִי֮ וַיַּגֵּ֢ד לְשָׁ֫א֥וּל וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֑וֹ בָּ֥א דָ֝וִ֗ד אֶל־בֵּ֥ית אֲחִימֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: bbv'  dv'g h'dmy vygd lsh'vl vy'mr lv b' dvd 'lbyt 'chymlkh
verses.translation: when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said unto him: 'David is come to the house of Ahimelech.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־תִּתְהַלֵּ֣ל בְּ֭רָעָה הַגִּבּ֑וֹר חֶ֥סֶד אֵ֝֗ל כׇּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translation: Why boastest thou thyself of evil, O mighty man? The mercy of God endureth continually.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֭וּוֹת תַּחְשֹׁ֣ב לְשׁוֹנֶ֑ךָ כְּתַ֥עַר מְ֝לֻטָּ֗שׁ עֹשֵׂ֥ה רְמִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: hvvt tchshb lshvnkh kht'r mltsh 'shh rmyh
verses.translation: Thy tongue deviseth destruction; Like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָהַ֣בְתָּ רָּ֣ע מִטּ֑וֹב שֶׁ֓קֶר  מִדַּבֵּ֖ר צֶ֣דֶק סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: 'hbt r' mtvb shqr  mdbr tsdq slh
verses.translation: Thou lovest evil more than good; Falsehood rather than speaking righteousness. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָהַ֥בְתָּ כׇֽל־דִּבְרֵי־בָ֗לַע לְשׁ֣וֹן מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.translation: Thou lovest all devouring words, The deceitful tongue.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־אֵל֮ יִתׇּצְךָ֢ לָ֫נֶ֥צַח יַחְתְּךָ֣ וְיִסָּחֲךָ֣ מֵאֹ֑הֶל וְשֵׁרֶשְׁךָ֨ מֵאֶ֖רֶץ חַיִּ֣ים סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: gm'l yttskh lntsch ychtkh vyschkh m'hl vshrshkh m'rts chyym slh
verses.translation: God will likewise break thee for ever, He will take thee up, and pluck thee out of thy tent, And root thee out of the land of the living. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִרְא֖וּ צַדִּיקִ֥ים וְיִירָ֗אוּ וְעָלָ֥יו יִשְׂחָֽקוּ׃
verses.translation: The righteous also shall see, and fear, And shall laugh at him:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה הַגֶּ֗בֶר לֹ֤א יָשִׂ֥ים אֱלֹהִ֗ים מָ֫עוּזּ֥וֹ וַ֭יִּבְטַח בְּרֹ֣ב עׇשְׁר֑וֹ יָ֝עֹ֗ז בְּהַוָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hnh hgbr l' yshym 'lhym m'vzv vybtch brb 'shrv y'z bhvtv
verses.translation: 'Lo, this is the man that made not God his stronghold; But trusted in the abundance of his riches, And strengthened himself in his wickedness.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י  כְּזַ֣יִת רַ֭עֲנָן בְּבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים בָּטַ֥חְתִּי בְחֶסֶד־אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.translit: v'ny  khzyt r'nn bbyt 'lhym btchty bchsd'lhym 'vlm v'd
verses.translation: But as for me, I am like a leafy olive-tree in the house of God; I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוֹדְךָ֣ לְ֭עוֹלָם כִּ֣י עָשִׂ֑יתָ וַאֲקַוֶּ֥ה שִׁמְךָ֥ כִי־ט֝֗וֹב נֶ֣גֶד חֲסִידֶֽיךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'vdkh l'vlm khy 'shyt v'qvh shmkh khytvb ngd chsydykh {p}
verses.translation: I will give Thee thanks for ever, because Thou hast done it; And I will wait for Thy name, for it is good, in the presence of Thy saints.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־מָחֲלַ֗ת מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translation: For the Leader; upon Mahalath. Maschil of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֘מַ֤ר נָבָ֣ל בְּ֭לִבּוֹ אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִֽ֝שְׁחִ֗יתוּ וְהִֽתְעִ֥יבוּ עָ֝֗וֶל אֵ֣ין עֹֽשֵׂה־טֽוֹב׃
verses.translation: The fool hath said in his heart: 'There is no God'; They have dealt corruptly, and have done abominable iniquity; There is none that doeth good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים מִשָּׁמַיִם֮ הִשְׁקִ֢יף עַֽל־בְּנֵי־אָ֫דָ֥ם לִ֭רְאוֹת הֲיֵ֣שׁ מַשְׂכִּ֑יל דֹּ֝רֵ֗שׁ אֶת־אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'lhym mshmym hshqyf 'lbny'dm lr'vt hysh mshkhyl drsh 't'lhym
verses.translation: God looked forth from heaven upon the children of men, To see if there were any man of understanding, that did seek after God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֻּלּ֥וֹ סָג֮ יַחְדָּ֢ו נֶ֫אֱלָ֥חוּ אֵ֤ין עֹֽשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב אֵ֝֗ין גַּם־אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translation: Every one of them is unclean, they are together become impure; There is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹ֥א יָדְעוּ֮ פֹּ֤עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן אֹכְלֵ֣י עַ֭מִּי אָ֣כְלוּ לֶ֑חֶם אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: hl' yd'v p'ly 'vn 'khly 'my 'khlv lchm 'lhym l' qr'v
verses.translation: ’Shall not the workers of iniquity know it, Who eat up My people as they eat bread, And call not upon God?'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֤ם  פָּ֥חֲדוּ פַחַד֮ לֹא־הָ֢יָ֫ה פָ֥חַד כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֗ים פִּ֭זַּר עַצְמ֣וֹת חֹנָ֑ךְ הֱ֝בִשֹׁ֗תָה כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֥ים מְאָסָֽם׃
verses.translit: shm  pchdv pchd l'hyh pchd khy'lhym pzr 'tsmvt chnkh hbshth khy'lhym m'sm
verses.translation: There are they in great fear, where no fear was; For God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee; Thou hast put them to shame, because God hath rejected them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֥י־יִתֵּ֣ן מִצִּיּוֹן֮ יְשֻׁע֢וֹת יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל בְּשׁ֣וּב אֱ֭לֹהִים שְׁב֣וּת עַמּ֑וֹ יָגֵ֥ל יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב יִשְׂמַ֥ח יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: myytn mtsyvn ysh'vt yshr'l bshvb 'lhym shbvt 'mv ygl y'qb yshmch yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God turneth the captivity of His people, Let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינֹ֗ת מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translation: For the Leader; with string-music. Maschil of David:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּבֹ֣א הַ֭זִּיפִים וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לְשָׁא֑וּל הֲלֹ֥א דָ֝וִ֗ד מִסְתַּתֵּ֥ר עִמָּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: bb' hzypym vy'mrv lsh'vl hl' dvd msttr 'mnv
verses.translation: when the Ziphites came and said to Saul: 'Doth not David hide himself with us?'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים בְּשִׁמְךָ֣ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי וּבִגְבוּרָתְךָ֥ תְדִינֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: O God, save me by Thy name, And right me by Thy might.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים שְׁמַ֣ע תְּפִלָּתִ֑י הַ֝אֲזִ֗ינָה לְאִמְרֵי־פִֽי׃
verses.translation: O God, hear my prayer; give ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י זָרִ֨ים  קָ֤מוּ עָלַ֗י וְֽ֭עָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י לֹ֤א שָׂ֨מוּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְנֶגְדָּ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: khy zrym  qmv 'ly v'rytsym bqshv npshy l' shmv 'lhym lngdm slh
verses.translation: For strangers are risen up against me, And violent men have sought after my soul; They have not set God before them. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים עֹזֵ֣ר לִ֑י אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י בְּֽסֹמְכֵ֥י נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translation: Behold, God is my helper; The Lord is for me as the upholder of my soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (ישוב) [יָשִׁ֣יב] הָ֭רַע לְשֹׁרְרָ֑י בַּ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ הַצְמִיתֵֽם׃
verses.translation: He will requite the evil unto them that lie in wait for me; Destroy Thou them in Thy truth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּנְדָבָ֥ה אֶזְבְּחָה־לָּ֑ךְ א֤וֹדֶה־שִּׁמְךָ֖ יְהֹוָ֣ה כִּי־טֽוֹב׃
verses.translation: With a freewill-offering will I sacrifice unto Thee; I will give thanks unto Thy name, O LORD, for it is good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י מִכׇּל־צָ֭רָה הִצִּילָ֑נִי וּ֝בְאֹיְבַ֗י רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינִֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translation: For He hath delivered me out of all trouble; And mine eye hath gazed upon mine enemies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינֹ֗ת מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translation: For the Leader; with string-music. Maschil of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַאֲזִ֣ינָה אֱ֭לֹהִים תְּפִלָּתִ֑י וְאַל־תִּ֝תְעַלַּ֗ם מִתְּחִנָּתִֽי׃
verses.translation: Give ear, O God, to my prayer; And hide not Thyself from my supplication.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַקְשִׁ֣יבָה לִּ֣י וַעֲנֵ֑נִי אָרִ֖יד בְּשִׂיחִ֣י וְאָהִֽימָה׃
verses.translation: Attend unto me, and hear me; I am distraught in my complaint, and will moan;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִקּ֤וֹל אוֹיֵ֗ב מִ֭פְּנֵי עָקַ֣ת רָשָׁ֑ע כִּֽי־יָמִ֥יטוּ עָלַ֥י אָ֝֗וֶן וּבְאַ֥ף יִשְׂטְמֽוּנִי׃
verses.translit: mqvl 'vyb mpny 'qt rsh' khyymytv 'ly 'vn vb'f yshtmvny
verses.translation: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked; For they cast mischief upon me, and in anger they persecute me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִ֭בִּי יָחִ֣יל בְּקִרְבִּ֑י וְאֵימ֥וֹת מָ֝֗וֶת נָפְל֥וּ עָלָֽי׃
verses.translit: lby ychyl bqrby v'ymvt mvt nplv 'ly
verses.translation: My heart doth writhe within me; and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִרְאָ֣ה וָ֭רַעַד יָ֣בֹא בִ֑י וַ֝תְּכַסֵּ֗נִי פַּלָּצֽוּת׃
verses.translit: yr'h vr'd yb' by vtkhsny pltsvt
verses.translation: Fear and trembling come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר מִֽי־יִתֶּן־לִ֣י אֵ֭בֶר כַּיּוֹנָ֗ה אָע֥וּפָה וְאֶשְׁכֹּֽנָה׃
verses.translation: And I said: 'Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then would I fly away, and be at rest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִ֭נֵּה אַרְחִ֣יק נְדֹ֑ד אָלִ֖ין בַּמִּדְבָּ֣ר סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translation: Lo, then would I wander far off, I would lodge in the wilderness. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָחִ֣ישָׁה מִפְלָ֣ט לִ֑י מֵר֖וּחַ סֹעָ֣ה מִסָּֽעַר׃
verses.translation: I would haste me to a shelter from the stormy wind and tempest.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּלַּ֣ע אֲ֭דֹנָי פַּלַּ֣ג לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם כִּֽי־רָאִ֨יתִי חָמָ֖ס וְרִ֣יב בָּעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: bl' 'dny plg lshvnm khyr'yty chms vryb b'yr
verses.translation: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongue; For I have seen violence and strife in the city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹמָ֤ם וָלַ֗יְלָה יְסוֹבְבֻ֥הָ עַל־חוֹמֹתֶ֑יהָ וְאָ֖וֶן וְעָמָ֣ל בְּקִרְבָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: yvmm vlylh ysvbbh 'lchvmtyh v'vn v'ml bqrbh
verses.translation: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof; iniquity also and mischief are in the midst of it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַוּ֥וֹת בְּקִרְבָּ֑הּ וְֽלֹא־יָמִ֥ישׁ מֵ֝רְחֹבָ֗הּ תֹּ֣ךְ וּמִרְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: hvvt bqrbh vl'ymysh mrchbh tkh vmrmh
verses.translation: Wickedness is in the midst thereof; oppression and guile depart not from her broad place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹֽא־אוֹיֵ֥ב יְחָֽרְפֵ֗נִי וְאֶ֫שָּׂ֥א לֹא־מְ֭שַׂנְאִי עָלַ֣י הִגְדִּ֑יל וְאֶסָּתֵ֥ר מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: khy l''vyb ychrpny v'sh' l'mshn'y 'ly hgdyl v'str mmnv
verses.translation: For it was not an enemy that taunted me, Then I could have borne it; Neither was it mine adversary that did magnify himself against me, Then I would have hid myself from him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה אֱנ֣וֹשׁ כְּעֶרְכִּ֑י אַ֝לּוּפִ֗י וּמְיֻדָּעִֽי׃
verses.translation: But it was thou, a man mine equal, My companion, and my familiar friend;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַ֭חְדָּו נַמְתִּ֣יק ס֑וֹד בְּבֵ֥ית אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים נְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בְּרָֽגֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: 'shr ychdv nmtyq svd bbyt 'lhym nhlkh brgsh
verses.translation: We took sweet counsel together, In the house of God we walked with the throng.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (ישימות) [יַשִּׁ֤י מָ֨וֶת ] עָלֵ֗ימוֹ יֵרְד֣וּ שְׁא֣וֹל חַיִּ֑ים כִּֽי־רָע֖וֹת בִּמְגוּרָ֣ם בְּקִרְבָּֽם׃
verses.translit: (yshymvt) [yshy mvt ] 'lymv yrdv sh'vl chyym khyr'vt bmgvrm bqrbm
verses.translation: May He incite death against them, Let them go down alive into the nether-world; For evil is in their dwelling, and within them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲ֭נִי אֶל־אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֶקְרָ֑א וַ֝יהֹוָ֗ה יוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: As for me, I will call upon God; And the LORD shall save me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֶ֤רֶב וָבֹ֣קֶר וְ֭צׇהֳרַיִם אָשִׂ֣יחָה וְאֶהֱמֶ֑ה וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע קוֹלִֽי׃
verses.translation: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I complain, and moan; And He hath heard my voice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּ֘דָ֤ה בְשָׁל֣וֹם נַ֭פְשִׁי מִקְּרׇב־לִ֑י כִּֽי־בְ֝רַבִּ֗ים הָי֥וּ עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.translit: pdh bshlvm npshy mqrbly khybrbym hyv 'mdy
verses.translation: He hath redeemed my soul in peace so that none came nigh me; For they were many that strove with me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׁמַ֤ע  אֵ֨ל  וְֽיַעֲנֵם֮ וְיֹ֤שֵׁ֥ב קֶ֗דֶם סֶ֥֫לָה אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵ֣ין חֲלִיפ֣וֹת לָ֑מוֹ וְלֹ֖א יָרְא֣וּ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: yshm'  'l  vy'nm vyshb qdm slh 'shr 'yn chlypvt lmv vl' yr'v 'lhym
verses.translation: God shall hear, and humble them, even He that is enthroned of old, Selah, such as have no changes, and fear not God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁלַ֣ח יָ֭דָיו בִּשְׁלֹמָ֗יו חִלֵּ֥ל בְּרִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: He hath put forth his hands against them that were at peace with him; He hath profaned his covenant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָלְק֤וּ  מַחְמָאֹ֣ת פִּיו֮ וּֽקְרָב־לִ֫בּ֥וֹ רַכּ֖וּ דְבָרָ֥יו מִשֶּׁ֗מֶן וְהֵ֣מָּה פְתִחֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: chlqv  mchm't pyv vqrblbv rkhv dbryv mshmn vhmh ptchvt
verses.translation: Smoother than cream were the speeches of his mouth, But his heart was war; His words were softer than oil, Yet were they keen-edged swords.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשְׁלֵ֤ךְ עַל־יְהֹוָ֨ה  יְהָבְךָ֮ וְה֢וּא יְכַ֫לְכְּלֶ֥ךָ לֹא־יִתֵּ֖ן לְעוֹלָ֥ם מ֗וֹט לַצַּדִּֽיק׃
verses.translit: hshlkh 'lyhvh  yhbkh vhv' ykhlkhlkh l'ytn l'vlm mvt ltsdyq
verses.translation: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and He will sustain thee; He will never suffer the righteous to be moved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֤ה אֱלֹהִ֨ים  תּוֹרִדֵ֬ם ׀ לִבְאֵ֬ר שַׁ֗חַת אַנְשֵׁ֤י דָמִ֣ים וּ֭מִרְמָה לֹא־יֶחֱצ֣וּ יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶבְטַח־בָּֽךְ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'th 'lhym  tvrdm  lb'r shcht 'nshy dmym vmrmh l'ychtsv ymyhm v'ny 'btchbkh {p}
verses.translation: But Thou, O God, wilt bring them down into the nethermost pit; Men of blood and deceit shall not live out half their days; But as for me, I will trust in Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֤חַ  עַל־י֬וֹנַת אֵ֣לֶם רְ֭חֹקִים לְדָוִ֣ד מִכְתָּ֑ם בֶּאֱחֹ֨ז אוֹת֖וֹ פְלִשְׁתִּ֣ים בְּגַֽת׃
verses.translit: lmntsch  'lyvnt 'lm rchqym ldvd mkhtm b'chz 'vtv plshtym bgt
verses.translation: For the Leader; upon Jonath-elem-rehokim. [A Psalm] of David; Michtam; when the Philistines took him in Gath. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חׇנֵּ֣נִי אֱ֭לֹהִים כִּֽי־שְׁאָפַ֣נִי אֱנ֑וֹשׁ כׇּל־הַ֝יּ֗וֹם לֹחֵ֥ם יִלְחָצֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Be gracious unto me, O God, for man would swallow me up; All the day he fighting oppresseth me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁאֲפ֣וּ שׁ֭וֹרְרַי כׇּל־הַיּ֑וֹם כִּֽי־רַבִּ֨ים לֹחֲמִ֖ים לִ֣י מָרֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: sh'pv shvrry khlhyvm khyrbym lchmym ly mrvm
verses.translation: They that lie in wait for me would swallow me up all the day; For they are many that fight against me, O Most High,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: י֥וֹם אִירָ֑א אֲ֝נִ֗י אֵלֶ֥יךָ אֶבְטָֽח׃
verses.translation: In the day that I am afraid, I will put my trust in Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאלֹהִים֮ אֲהַלֵּ֢ל דְּבָ֫ר֥וֹ בֵּאלֹהִ֣ים בָּ֭טַחְתִּי לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בָשָׂ֣ר לִֽי׃
verses.translit: b'lhym 'hll dbrv b'lhym btchty l' 'yr' mhy'shh bshr ly
verses.translation: In God—I will praise His word— In God do I trust, I will not be afraid; What can flesh do unto me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַ֭יּוֹם דְּבָרַ֣י יְעַצֵּ֑בוּ עָלַ֖י כׇּל־מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֣ם לָרָֽע׃
verses.translation: All the day they trouble mine affairs; All their thoughts are against me for evil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָג֤וּרוּ  (יצפינו) [יִצְפּ֗וֹנוּ] הֵ֭מָּה עֲקֵבַ֣י יִשְׁמֹ֑רוּ כַּ֝אֲשֶׁ֗ר קִוּ֥וּ נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: ygvrv  (ytspynv) [ytspvnv] hmh 'qby yshmrv kh'shr qvv npshy
verses.translation: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, They mark my steps; According as they have waited for my soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־אָ֥וֶן פַּלֶּט־לָ֑מוֹ בְּ֝אַ֗ף עַמִּ֤ים  הוֹרֵ֬ד אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translation: Because of iniquity cast them out; In anger bring down the peoples, O God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֹדִי֮ סָפַ֢רְתָּ֫ה אָ֥תָּה שִׂ֣ימָה דִמְעָתִ֣י בְנֹאדֶ֑ךָ הֲ֝לֹ֗א בְּסִפְרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: ndy sprth 'th shymh dm'ty bn'dkh hl' bsprtkh
verses.translation: Thou has counted my wanderings; Put Thou my tears into Thy bottle; Are they not in Thy book?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֨ז יָ֘שׁ֤וּבוּ אוֹיְבַ֣י אָ֭חוֹר בְּי֣וֹם אֶקְרָ֑א זֶֽה־יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֥ים לִֽי׃
verses.translation: Then shall mine enemies turn back in the day that I call; This I know, that God is for me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּ֭אלֹהִים אֲהַלֵּ֣ל דָּבָ֑ר בַּ֝יהֹוָ֗ה אֲהַלֵּ֥ל דָּבָֽר׃
verses.translation: In God—I will praise His word— In the LORD—I will praise His word—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאלֹהִ֣ים בָּ֭טַחְתִּי לֹּ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה אָדָ֣ם לִֽי׃
verses.translation: In God do I trust, I will not be afraid; What can man do unto me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָלַ֣י אֱלֹהִ֣ים נְדָרֶ֑יךָ אֲשַׁלֵּ֖ם תּוֹדֹ֣ת לָֽךְ׃
verses.translation: Thy vows are upon me, O God; I will render thank-offerings unto Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י הִצַּ֪לְתָּ נַפְשִׁ֡י מִמָּוֶת֮ הֲלֹ֥א רַגְלַ֗י מִ֫דֶּ֥חִי לְ֭הִֽתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּ֝א֗וֹר הַחַיִּֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy htslt npshy mmvt hl' rgly mdchy lhthlkh lpny 'lhym b'vr hchyym {p}
verses.translation: For thou hast delivered my soul from death; Hast Thou not delivered my feet from stumbling? That I may walk before God in the light of the living?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ אַל־תַּ֭שְׁחֵת לְדָוִ֣ד מִכְתָּ֑ם בְּבׇרְח֥וֹ מִפְּנֵי־שָׁ֝א֗וּל בַּמְּעָרָֽה׃
verses.translit: lmntsch 'ltshcht ldvd mkhtm bbrchv mpnysh'vl bm'rh
verses.translation: For the Leader; Al-tashheth. [A Psalm] of David; Michtam; when he fled from Saul, in the cave.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חׇנֵּ֤נִי אֱלֹהִ֨ים  חׇנֵּ֗נִי כִּ֥י בְךָ֮ חָסָ֢יָה נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י וּבְצֵֽל־כְּנָפֶ֥יךָ אֶחְסֶ֑ה עַ֝֗ד יַעֲבֹ֥ר הַוּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: chnny 'lhym  chnny khy bkh chsyh npshy vbtslkhnpykh 'chsh 'd y'br hvvt
verses.translation: Be gracious unto me, O God, be gracious unto me, for in Thee hath my soul taken refuge; yea, in the shadow of Thy wings will I take refuge, until calamities be overpast.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֭קְרָא לֵאלֹהִ֣ים עֶלְי֑וֹן לָ֝אֵ֗ל גֹּמֵ֥ר עָלָֽי׃
verses.translation: I will cry unto God Most high; unto God that accomplisheth it for me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׁלַ֤ח מִשָּׁמַ֨יִם  וְֽיוֹשִׁיעֵ֗נִי חֵרֵ֣ף שֹׁאֲפִ֣י סֶ֑לָה יִשְׁלַ֥ח אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים חַסְדּ֥וֹ וַאֲמִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: yshlch mshmym  vyvshy'ny chrf sh'py slh yshlch 'lhym chsdv v'mtv
verses.translation: He will send from heaven, and save me, when he that would swallow me up taunteth, Selah; God shall send forth His mercy and His truth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַפְשִׁ֤י  בְּת֥וֹךְ לְבָאִם֮ אֶשְׁכְּבָ֢ה לֹ֫הֲטִ֥ים בְּֽנֵי־אָדָ֗ם שִׁ֭נֵּיהֶם חֲנִ֣ית וְחִצִּ֑ים וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם חֶ֣רֶב חַדָּֽה׃
verses.translit: npshy  btvkh lb'm 'shkhbh lhtym bny'dm shnyhm chnyt vchtsym vlshvnm chrb chdh
verses.translation: My soul is among lions, I do lie down among them that are aflame; Even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, And their tongue a sharp sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ר֣וּמָה עַל־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים עַ֖ל כׇּל־הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; Thy glory be above all the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֶ֤שֶׁת  הֵכִ֣ינוּ לִפְעָמַי֮ כָּפַ֢ף נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י כָּר֣וּ לְפָנַ֣י שִׁיחָ֑ה נָפְל֖וּ בְתוֹכָ֣הּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: rsht  hkhynv lp'my khpf npshy khrv lpny shychh nplv btvkhh slh
verses.translation: They have prepared a net for my steps, My soul is bowed down; They have digged a pit before me, They are fallen into the midst thereof themselves. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָ֘כ֤וֹן לִבִּ֣י אֱ֭לֹהִים נָכ֣וֹן לִבִּ֑י אָ֝שִׁ֗ירָה וַאֲזַמֵּֽרָה׃
verses.translation: My heart is stedfast, O God, my heart is stedfast; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ע֤וּרָה כְבוֹדִ֗י ע֭וּרָֽה הַנֵּ֥בֶל וְכִנּ֗וֹר אָעִ֥ירָה שָּֽׁחַר׃
verses.translation: Awake, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp; I will awake the dawn.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוֹדְךָ֖ בָעַמִּ֥ים ׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י אֲ֝זַמֶּרְךָ֗ בַּלְאֻמִּֽים׃
verses.translation: I will give thanks unto Thee, O Lord, among the peoples; I will sing praises unto Thee among the nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־גָדֹ֣ל עַד־שָׁמַ֣יִם חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְֽעַד־שְׁחָקִ֥ים אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: For Thy mercy is great unto the heavens, And Thy truth unto the skies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ר֣וּמָה עַל־שָׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים עַ֖ל כׇּל־הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; Thy glory be above all the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אַל־תַּשְׁחֵ֗ת לְדָוִ֥ד מִכְתָּֽם׃
verses.translation: For the Leader; Al-tashheth. [A Psalm] of David; Michtam.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַאֻמְנָ֗ם אֵ֣לֶם צֶ֭דֶק תְּדַבֵּר֑וּן מֵישָׁרִ֥ים תִּ֝שְׁפְּט֗וּ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: h'mnm 'lm tsdq tdbrvn myshrym tshptv bny 'dm
verses.translation: Do ye indeed speak as a righteous company? Do ye judge with equity the sons of men?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַף־בְּלֵב֮ עוֹלֹ֢ת תִּפְעָ֫ל֥וּן בָּאָ֡רֶץ חֲמַ֥ס יְ֝דֵיכֶ֗ם תְּפַלֵּסֽוּן׃
