verses.translation: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; Ye weigh out in the earth the violence of your hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֣רוּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים מֵרָ֑חֶם תָּע֥וּ מִ֝בֶּ֗טֶן דֹּבְרֵ֥י כָזָֽב׃
verses.translit: zrv rsh'ym mrchm t'v mbtn dbry khzb
verses.translation: The wicked are estranged from the womb; The speakers of lies go astray as soon as they are born.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲמַת־לָ֗מוֹ כִּדְמ֥וּת חֲמַת־נָחָ֑שׁ כְּמוֹ־פֶ֥תֶן חֵ֝רֵ֗שׁ יַאְטֵ֥ם אׇזְנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: chmtlmv khdmvt chmtnchsh khmvptn chrsh y'tm 'znv
verses.translation: Their venom is like the venom of a serpent; They are like the deaf asp that stoppeth her ear;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־יִ֭שְׁמַע לְק֣וֹל מְלַחֲשִׁ֑ים חוֹבֵ֖ר חֲבָרִ֣ים מְחֻכָּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'shr l'yshm' lqvl mlchshym chvbr chbrym mchkhm
verses.translation: Which hearkeneth not to the voice of charmers, Or of the most cunning binder of spells.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים הֲרׇס־שִׁנֵּ֥ימֽוֹ בְּפִ֑ימוֹ מַלְתְּע֥וֹת כְּ֝פִירִ֗ים נְתֹ֣ץ ׀ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translation: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth; Break out the cheek-teeth of the young lions, O LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִמָּאֲס֣וּ כְמוֹ־מַ֭יִם יִתְהַלְּכוּ־לָ֑מוֹ יִדְרֹ֥ךְ חִ֝צָּ֗ו כְּמ֣וֹ יִתְמֹלָֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: ym'sv khmvmym ythlkhvlmv ydrkh chtsv khmv ytmllv
verses.translation: Let them melt away as water that runneth apace; When he aimeth his arrows, let them be as though they were cut off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּמ֣וֹ שַׁ֭בְּלוּל תֶּ֣מֶס יַהֲלֹ֑ךְ נֵ֥פֶל אֵ֝֗שֶׁת בַּל־חָ֥זוּ שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: khmv shblvl tms yhlkh npl 'sht blchzv shmsh
verses.translation: Let them be as a snail which melteth and passeth away; Like the untimely births of a woman, that have not seen the sun.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּטֶ֤רֶם  יָבִ֣ינוּ סִּירֹתֵכֶ֣ם אָטָ֑ד כְּמוֹ־חַ֥י כְּמוֹ־חָ֝ר֗וֹן יִשְׂעָרֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: btrm  ybynv syrtkhm 'td khmvchy khmvchrvn ysh'rnv
verses.translation: Before your pots can feel the thorns, He will sweep it away with a whirlwind, the raw and the burning alike.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׂמַ֣ח צַ֭דִּיק כִּי־חָזָ֣ה נָקָ֑ם פְּעָמָ֥יו יִ֝רְחַ֗ץ בְּדַ֣ם הָרָשָֽׁע׃
verses.translit: yshmch tsdyq khychzh nqm p'myv yrchts bdm hrsh'
verses.translation: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance; He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֹאמַ֣ר אָ֭דָם אַךְ־פְּרִ֣י לַצַּדִּ֑יק אַ֥ךְ יֵשׁ־אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים שֹׁפְטִ֥ים בָּאָֽרֶץ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: And men shall say: 'Verily there is a reward for the righteous; Verily there is a God that judgeth in the earth.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ אַל־תַּשְׁחֵת֮ לְדָוִ֢ד מִ֫כְתָּ֥ם בִּשְׁלֹ֥חַ שָׁא֑וּל וַֽיִּשְׁמְר֥וּ אֶת־הַ֝בַּ֗יִת לַהֲמִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: lmntsch 'ltshcht ldvd mkhtm bshlch sh'vl vyshmrv 'thbyt lhmytv
verses.translation: For the Leader; Al-tashheth. [A Psalm] of David; Michtam; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַצִּילֵ֖נִי מֵאֹיְבַ֥י ׀ אֱלֹהָ֑י מִֽמִּתְקוֹמְמַ֥י תְּשַׂגְּבֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God; set me on high from them that rise up against me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֭צִּילֵנִי מִפֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן וּֽמֵאַנְשֵׁ֥י דָ֝מִ֗ים הוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from the men of blood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה אָרְב֡וּ לְנַפְשִׁ֗י יָג֣וּרוּ עָלַ֣י עַזִּ֑ים לֹֽא־פִשְׁעִ֖י וְלֹא־חַטָּאתִ֣י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy hnh 'rbv lnpshy ygvrv 'ly 'zym l'psh'y vl'cht'ty yhvh
verses.translation: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul; the impudent gather themselves together against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּֽלִי־עָ֭וֺן יְרֻצ֣וּן וְיִכּוֹנָ֑נוּ ע֖וּרָה לִקְרָאתִ֣י וּרְאֵֽה׃
verses.translation: Without my fault, they run and prepare themselves; awake Thou to help me, and behold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֤ה יְהֹוָֽה־אֱלֹהִ֥ים ׀ צְבָא֡וֹת אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הָקִ֗יצָה לִפְקֹ֥ד כׇּֽל־הַגּוֹיִ֑ם אַל־תָּחֹ֨ן כׇּל־בֹּ֖גְדֵי אָ֣וֶן סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: v'th yhvh'lhym  tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hqytsh lpqd khlhgvym 'ltchn khlbgdy 'vn slh
verses.translation: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, arouse Thyself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to any iniquitous traitors. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָשׁ֣וּבוּ לָ֭עֶרֶב יֶהֱמ֥וּ כַכָּ֗לֶב וִיס֥וֹבְבוּ עִֽיר׃
verses.translation: They return at evening, they howl like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה  יַבִּ֘יע֤וּן בְּפִיהֶ֗ם חֲ֭רָבוֹת בְּשִׂפְתֽוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם כִּי־מִ֥י שֹׁמֵֽעַ׃
verses.translit: hnh  yby'vn bpyhm chrbvt bshptvtyhm khymy shm'
verses.translation: Behold, they belch out with their mouth; swords are in their lips: 'For who doth hear?'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה תִּשְׂחַק־לָ֑מוֹ תִּ֝לְעַ֗ג לְכׇל־גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translation: But Thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; Thou shalt have all the nations in derision.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֻ֭זּוֹ אֵלֶ֣יךָ אֶשְׁמֹ֑רָה כִּֽי־אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים מִשְׂגַּבִּֽי׃
verses.translation: Because of his strength, I will wait for Thee; for God is my high tower.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלֹהֵ֣י (חסדו) [חַסְדִּ֣י] יְקַדְּמֵ֑נִי אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים יַרְאֵ֥נִי בְשֹׁרְרָֽי׃
verses.translation: The God of my mercy will come to meet me; God will let me gaze upon mine adversaries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תַּהַרְגֵ֤ם  פֶּֽן־יִשְׁכְּח֬וּ עַמִּ֗י הֲנִיעֵ֣מוֹ בְ֭חֵילְךָ וְהוֹרִידֵ֑מוֹ מָ֖גִנֵּ֣נוּ אֲדֹנָֽי׃
verses.translation: Slay them not, lest my people forget, make them wander to and fro by Thy power, and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַטַּאת־פִּ֗ימוֹ דְּֽבַר־שְׂפָ֫תֵ֥ימוֹ וְיִלָּכְד֥וּ בִגְאוֹנָ֑ם וּמֵאָלָ֖ה וּמִכַּ֣חַשׁ יְסַפֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: cht'tpymv dbrshptymv vylkhdv bg'vnm vm'lh vmkhchsh ysprv
verses.translation: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them even be taken in their pride, and for cursing and lying which they speak.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּלֵּ֥ה בְחֵמָה֮ כַּלֵּ֢ה וְֽאֵ֫ינֵ֥מוֹ וְֽיֵדְע֗וּ כִּֽי־אֱ֭לֹהִים מֹשֵׁ֣ל בְּֽיַעֲקֹ֑ב לְאַפְסֵ֖י הָאָ֣רֶץ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: khlh bchmh khlh v'ynmv vyd'v khy'lhym mshl by'qb l'psy h'rts slh
verses.translation: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they be no more; and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob, unto the ends of the earth. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָשֻׁ֣בוּ לָ֭עֶרֶב יֶהֱמ֥וּ כַכָּ֗לֶב וִיס֥וֹבְבוּ עִֽיר׃
verses.translation: And they return at evening, they howl like a dog, and go round about the city;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֭מָּה (ינועון) [יְנִיע֣וּן] לֶאֱכֹ֑ל אִם־לֹ֥א יִ֝שְׂבְּע֗וּ וַיָּלִֽינוּ׃
verses.translation: They wander up and down to devour, and tarry all night if they have not their fill.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י  אָשִׁ֣יר עֻזֶּךָ֮ וַאֲרַנֵּ֥ן לַבֹּ֗קֶר חַ֫סְדֶּ֥ךָ כִּֽי־הָיִ֣יתָ מִשְׂגָּ֣ב לִ֑י וּ֝מָנ֗וֹס בְּי֣וֹם צַר־לִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'ny  'shyr 'zkh v'rnn lbqr chsdkh khyhyyt mshgb ly vmnvs byvm tsrly
verses.translation: But as for me, I will sing of Thy strength; yea, I will sing aloud of Thy mercy in the morning; for Thou hast been my high tower, and a refuge in the day of my distress.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֻ֭זִּי אֵלֶ֣יךָ אֲזַמֵּ֑רָה כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֥ים מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗י אֱלֹהֵ֥י חַסְדִּֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translation: O my strength, unto Thee will I sing praises; for God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַל־שׁוּשַׁ֣ן עֵד֑וּת מִכְתָּ֖ם לְדָוִ֣ד לְלַמֵּֽד׃
verses.translation: For the Leader; upon Shushan Eduth; Michtam of David, to teach;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּהַצּוֹת֨וֹ  אֶ֥ת־אֲרַ֣ם נַהֲרַיִם֮ וְאֶת־אֲרַ֢ם צ֫וֹבָ֥ה וַיָּ֤שׇׁב יוֹאָ֗ב וַיַּ֣ךְ אֶת־אֱד֣וֹם בְּגֵיא־מֶ֑לַח שְׁנֵ֖ים עָשָׂ֣ר אָֽלֶף׃
verses.translit: bhtsvtv  't'rm nhrym v't'rm tsvbh vyshb yv'b vykh 't'dvm bgy'mlch shnym 'shr 'lf
verses.translation: when he strove with Aram-naharaim and with Aram-zobah, and Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the Valley of Salt twelve thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים זְנַחְתָּ֣נוּ פְרַצְתָּ֑נוּ אָ֝נַ֗פְתָּ תְּשׁ֣וֹבֵֽב לָֽנוּ׃
verses.translation: O God, Thou hast cast us off, Thou hast broken us down; Thou hast been angry; O restore us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִרְעַ֣שְׁתָּה אֶ֣רֶץ פְּצַמְתָּ֑הּ רְפָ֖ה שְׁבָרֶ֣יהָ כִי־מָֽטָה׃
verses.translation: Thou hast made the land to shake, Thou hast cleft it; Heal the breaches thereof; for it tottereth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִרְאִ֣יתָ עַמְּךָ֣ קָשָׁ֑ה הִ֝שְׁקִיתָ֗נוּ יַ֣יִן תַּרְעֵלָֽה׃
verses.translation: Thou hast made Thy people to see hard things; Thou hast made us to drink the wine of staggering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָ֘תַ֤תָּה לִּירֵאֶ֣יךָ נֵּ֭ס לְהִתְנוֹסֵ֑ס מִ֝פְּנֵ֗י קֹ֣שֶׁט סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: ntth lyr'ykh ns lhtnvss mpny qsht slh
verses.translation: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear Thee, That it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֭מַעַן יֵחָלְצ֣וּן יְדִידֶ֑יךָ הוֹשִׁ֖יעָה יְמִינְךָ֣ (ועננו) [וַעֲנֵֽנִי]׃
verses.translation: That Thy beloved may be delivered, Save with Thy right hand, and answer me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֤ים  דִּבֶּ֥ר בְּקׇדְשׁ֗וֹ אֶ֫עְלֹ֥זָה אֲחַלְּקָ֥ה שְׁכֶ֑ם וְעֵ֖מֶק סֻכּ֣וֹת אֲמַדֵּֽד׃
verses.translation: God spoke in His holiness, that I would exult; That I would divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִ֤י גִלְעָ֨ד  וְלִ֬י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה וְ֭אֶפְרַיִם מָע֣וֹז רֹאשִׁ֑י יְ֝הוּדָ֗ה מְחֹֽקְקִֽי׃
verses.translit: ly gl'd  vly mnshh v'prym m'vz r'shy yhvdh mchqqy
verses.translation: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מוֹאָ֤ב  סִ֬יר רַחְצִ֗י עַל־אֱ֭דוֹם אַשְׁלִ֣יךְ נַעֲלִ֑י עָ֝לַ֗י פְּלֶ֣שֶׁת הִתְרוֹעָֽעִי׃
verses.translit: mv'b  syr rchtsy 'l'dvm 'shlykh n'ly 'ly plsht htrv''y
verses.translation: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom do I cast my shoe; Philistia, cry aloud because of me!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֣י יֹ֭בִלֵנִי עִ֣יר מָצ֑וֹר מִ֖י נָחַ֣נִי עַד־אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.translation: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me unto Edom?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹֽא־אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים זְנַחְתָּ֑נוּ וְֽלֹא־תֵצֵ֥א אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בְּצִבְאוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translation: Hast not Thou, O God, cast us off? And Thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָֽבָה־לָּ֣נוּ עֶזְרָ֣ת מִצָּ֑ר וְ֝שָׁ֗וְא תְּשׁוּעַ֥ת אָדָֽם׃
verses.translation: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאלֹהִ֥ים נַֽעֲשֶׂה־חָ֑יִל וְ֝ה֗וּא יָב֥וּס צָרֵֽינוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Through God we shall do valiantly; For He it is that will tread down our adversaries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ ׀ עַֽל־נְגִינַ֬ת לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translation: For the Leader; with string-music. [A Psalm] of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְעָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים רִנָּתִ֑י הַ֝קְשִׁ֗יבָה תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃
verses.translation: Hear my cry, O God; Attend unto my prayer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִקְצֵ֤ה הָאָ֨רֶץ  אֵלֶ֣יךָ אֶ֭קְרָא בַּעֲטֹ֣ף לִבִּ֑י בְּצוּר־יָר֖וּם מִמֶּ֣נִּי תַנְחֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: mqtsh h'rts  'lykh 'qr' b'tf lby btsvryrvm mmny tnchny
verses.translation: From the end of the earth will I call unto Thee, when my heart fainteth; Lead me to a rock that is too high for me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הָיִ֣יתָ מַחְסֶ֣ה לִ֑י מִגְדַּל־עֹ֝֗ז מִפְּנֵ֥י אוֹיֵֽב׃
verses.translation: For Thou hast been a refuge for me, A tower of strength in the face of the enemy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָג֣וּרָה בְ֭אׇהׇלְךָ עוֹלָמִ֑ים אֶ֥חֱסֶ֨ה בְסֵ֖תֶר כְּנָפֶ֣יךָ סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.translation: I will dwell in Thy Tent for ever; I will take refuge in the covert of Thy wings. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים שָׁמַ֣עְתָּ לִנְדָרָ֑י נָתַ֥תָּ יְ֝רֻשַּׁ֗ת יִרְאֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: khy'th 'lhym shm't lndry ntt yrsht yr'y shmkh
verses.translation: For Thou, O God, hast heard my vows; Thou hast granted the heritage of those that fear Thy name. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָמִ֣ים עַל־יְמֵי־מֶ֣לֶךְ תּוֹסִ֑יף שְׁ֝נוֹתָ֗יו כְּמוֹ־דֹ֥ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.translation: Mayest Thou add days unto the king's days! May his years be as many generations!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵשֵׁ֣ב ע֭וֹלָם לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים חֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת מַ֣ן יִנְצְרֻֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: yshb 'vlm lpny 'lhym chsd v'mt mn yntsrhv
verses.translation: May he be enthroned before God for ever! Appoint mercy and truth, that they may preserve him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֵּ֤ן אֲזַמְּרָ֣ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לָעַ֑ד לְֽשַׁלְּמִ֥י נְ֝דָרַ֗י י֣וֹם ׀ יֽוֹם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khn 'zmrh shmkh l'd lshlmy ndry yvm  yvm {p}
verses.translation: So will I sing praise unto Thy name for ever, That I may daily perform my vows.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־יְדוּת֗וּן מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translation: For the Leader; for Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ אֶל־אֱ֭לֹהִים דּֽוּמִיָּ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ יְשׁוּעָתִֽי׃
verses.translation: Only for God doth my soul wait in stillness; From Him cometh my salvation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַךְ־ה֣וּא צ֭וּרִי וִישׁוּעָתִ֑י מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗י לֹא־אֶמּ֥וֹט רַבָּֽה׃
verses.translation: He only is my rock and my salvation, My high tower, I shall not be greatly moved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־אָ֤נָה  תְּה֥וֹתְת֣וּ עַל־אִישׁ֮ תְּרָצְּח֢וּ כֻ֫לְּכֶ֥ם כְּקִ֥יר נָט֑וּי גָּ֝דֵ֗ר הַדְּחוּיָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'd'nh  thvttv 'l'ysh trtschv khlkhm khqyr ntvy gdr hdchvyh
verses.translation: How long will ye set upon a man, That ye may slay him, all of you, As a leaning wall, a tottering fence?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֤ךְ מִשְּׂאֵת֨וֹ  יָ֥עֲצ֣וּ לְהַדִּיחַ֮ יִרְצ֢וּ כָ֫זָ֥ב בְּפִ֥יו יְבָרֵ֑כוּ וּ֝בְקִרְבָּ֗ם יְקַֽלְלוּ־סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: 'kh msh'tv  y'tsv lhdych yrtsv khzb bpyv ybrkhv vbqrbm yqllvslh
verses.translation: They only devise to thrust him down from his height, delighting in lies; They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ לֵ֭אלֹהִים דּ֣וֹמִּי נַפְשִׁ֑י כִּֽי־מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ תִּקְוָתִֽי׃
verses.translation: Only for God wait thou in stillness, my soul; For from Him cometh my hope.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַךְ־ה֣וּא צ֭וּרִי וִישׁוּעָתִ֑י מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗י לֹ֣א אֶמּֽוֹט׃
verses.translation: He only is my rock and my salvation, My high tower, I shall not be moved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־אֱ֭לֹהִים יִשְׁעִ֣י וּכְבוֹדִ֑י צוּר־עֻזִּ֥י מַ֝חְסִ֗י בֵּאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translation: Upon God resteth my salvation and my glory; The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּטְח֘וּ־ב֤וֹ בְכׇל־עֵ֨ת  עָ֗ם שִׁפְכֽוּ־לְפָנָ֥יו לְבַבְכֶ֑ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים מַחֲסֶה־לָּ֣נוּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: btchvbv bkhl't  'm shpkhvlpnyv lbbkhm 'lhym mchshlnv slh
verses.translation: Trust in Him at all times, ye people; Pour out your heart before Him; God is a refuge for us. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֤ךְ  הֶ֥בֶל בְּנֵֽי־אָדָם֮ כָּזָ֢ב בְּנֵ֫י־אִ֥ישׁ בְּמֹאזְנַ֥יִם לַעֲל֑וֹת הֵ֝֗מָּה מֵהֶ֥בֶל יָֽחַד׃
verses.translit: 'kh  hbl bny'dm khzb bny'ysh bm'znym l'lvt hmh mhbl ychd
verses.translation: Men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie; If they be laid in the balances, they are together lighter than vanity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּבְטְח֣וּ בְעֹשֶׁק֮ וּבְגָזֵ֢ל אַל־תֶּ֫הְבָּ֥לוּ חַ֤יִל  כִּֽי־יָנ֑וּב אַל־תָּשִׁ֥יתוּ לֵֽב׃
verses.translation: Trust not in oppression, And put not vain hope in robbery; If riches increase, set not your heart thereon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחַ֤ת  דִּבֶּ֬ר אֱלֹהִ֗ים שְׁתַּֽיִם־ז֥וּ שָׁמָ֑עְתִּי כִּ֥י עֹ֝֗ז לֵֽאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translation: God hath spoken once, Twice have I heard this: That strength belongeth unto God;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְךָֽ־אֲדֹנָ֥י חָ֑סֶד כִּֽי־אַתָּ֨ה תְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לְאִ֣ישׁ כְּֽמַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vlkh'dny chsd khy'th tshlm l'ysh khm'shhv {p}
verses.translation: Also unto Thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy; For Thou renderest to every man according to his work.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד בִּ֝הְיוֹת֗וֹ בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translation: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֤ים  אֵלִ֥י אַתָּ֗ה אֲֽשַׁ֫חֲרֶ֥ךָּ צָמְאָ֬ה לְךָ֨  נַפְשִׁ֗י כָּמַ֣הּ לְךָ֣ בְשָׂרִ֑י בְּאֶרֶץ־צִיָּ֖ה וְעָיֵ֣ף בְּלִי־מָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: 'lhym  'ly 'th 'shchrkh tsm'h lkh  npshy khmh lkh bshry b'rtstsyh v'yf blymym
verses.translation: O God, Thou art my God, earnestly will I seek Thee; My soul thirsteth for Thee, my flesh longeth for Thee, In a dry and weary land, where no water is.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֵּ֭ן בַּקֹּ֣דֶשׁ חֲזִיתִ֑ךָ לִרְא֥וֹת עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ וּכְבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: So have I looked for Thee in the sanctuary, To see Thy power and Thy glory. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־ט֣וֹב חַ֭סְדְּךָ מֵחַיִּ֗ים שְׂפָתַ֥י יְשַׁבְּחֽוּנְךָ׃
verses.translation: For Thy lovingkindness is better than life; My lips shall praise Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.translation: So will I bless Thee as long as I live; In Thy name will I lift up my hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּמ֤וֹ חֵ֣לֶב וָ֭דֶשֶׁן תִּשְׂבַּ֣ע נַפְשִׁ֑י וְשִׂפְתֵ֥י רְ֝נָנ֗וֹת יְהַלֶּל־פִּֽי׃
verses.translit: khmv chlb vdshn tshb' npshy vshpty rnnvt yhllpy
verses.translation: My soul is satisfied as with marrow and fatness; And my mouth doth praise Thee with joyful lips;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־זְכַרְתִּ֥יךָ עַל־יְצוּעָ֑י בְּ֝אַשְׁמֻר֗וֹת אֶהְגֶּה־בָּֽךְ׃
verses.translation: When I remember Thee upon my couch, And meditate on Thee in the night-watches.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הָיִ֣יתָ עֶזְרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י וּבְצֵ֖ל כְּנָפֶ֣יךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן׃
verses.translation: For Thou hast been my help, And in the shadow of Thy wings do I rejoice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דָּבְקָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֣י אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ בִּ֝֗י תָּמְכָ֥ה יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: My soul cleaveth unto Thee; Thy right hand holdeth me fast.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵ֗מָּה לְ֭שׁוֹאָה יְבַקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י יָ֝בֹ֗אוּ בְּֽתַחְתִּיּ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vhmh lshv'h ybqshv npshy yb'v btchtyvt h'rts
verses.translation: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, Shall go into the nethermost parts of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַגִּירֻ֥הוּ עַל־יְדֵי־חָ֑רֶב מְנָ֖ת שֻׁעָלִ֣ים יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.translation: They shall be hurled to the power of the sword; They shall be a portion for foxes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ֮ יִשְׂמַ֢ח בֵּאלֹ֫הִ֥ים יִ֭תְהַלֵּל כׇּל־הַנִּשְׁבָּ֣ע בּ֑וֹ כִּ֥י יִ֝סָּכֵ֗ר פִּ֣י דוֹבְרֵי־שָֽׁקֶר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhmlkh yshmch b'lhym ythll khlhnshb' bv khy yskhr py dvbryshqr {p}
verses.translation: But the king shall rejoice in God; Every one that sweareth by Him shall glory; For the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁמַע־אֱלֹהִ֣ים קוֹלִ֣י בְשִׂיחִ֑י מִפַּ֥חַד א֝וֹיֵ֗ב תִּצֹּ֥ר חַיָּֽי׃
verses.translit: shm''lhym qvly bshychy mpchd 'vyb ttsr chyy
verses.translation: Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint; preserve my life from the terror of the enemy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּ֭סְתִּירֵנִי מִסּ֣וֹד מְרֵעִ֑ים מֵ֝רִגְשַׁ֗ת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.translation: Hide me from the council of evil-doers; from the tumult of the workers of iniquity;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁנְנ֣וּ כַחֶ֣רֶב לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם דָּרְכ֥וּ חִ֝צָּ֗ם דָּבָ֥ר מָֽר׃
verses.translit: 'shr shnnv khchrb lshvnm drkhv chtsm dbr mr
verses.translation: Who have whet their tongue like a sword, and have aimed their arrow, a poisoned word;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִירֹ֣ת בַּמִּסְתָּרִ֣ים תָּ֑ם פִּתְאֹ֥ם יֹ֝רֻ֗הוּ וְלֹ֣א יִירָֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: lyrt bmstrym tm pt'm yrhv vl' yyr'v
verses.translation: That they may shoot in secret places at the blameless; suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְחַזְּקוּ־לָ֨מוֹ  דָּ֘בָ֤ר רָ֗ע יְֽ֭סַפְּרוּ לִטְמ֣וֹן מוֹקְשִׁ֑ים אָ֝מְר֗וּ מִ֣י יִרְאֶה־לָּֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: ychzqvlmv  dbr r' ysprv ltmvn mvqshym 'mrv my yr'hlmv
verses.translation: They encourage one another in an evil matter; they converse of laying snares secretly; they ask, who would see them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֥חְפְּֽשׂוּ־עוֹלֹ֗ת תַּ֭מְנוּ חֵ֣פֶשׂ מְחֻפָּ֑שׂ וְקֶ֥רֶב אִ֝֗ישׁ וְלֵ֣ב עָמֹֽק׃
verses.translit: ychpshv'vlt tmnv chpsh mchpsh vqrb 'ysh vlb 'mq
verses.translation: They search out iniquities, they have accomplished a diligent search; even in the inward thought of every one, and the deep heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּרֵ֗ם אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים חֵ֥ץ פִּתְא֑וֹם הָ֝י֗וּ מַכּוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translation: But God doth shoot at them with an arrow suddenly; thence are their wounds.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּכְשִׁיל֣וּהוּ עָלֵ֣ימוֹ לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם יִ֝תְנֹדְד֗וּ כׇּל־רֹ֥אֵה בָֽם׃
verses.translation: So they make their own tongue a stumbling unto themselves; all that see them shake the head.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽירְא֗וּ כׇּל־אָ֫דָ֥ם וַ֭יַּגִּידוּ פֹּ֥עַל אֱלֹהִ֗ים וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥הוּ הִשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃
verses.translit: vyyr'v khl'dm vygydv p'l 'lhym vm'shhv hshkhylv
verses.translation: And all men fear; and they declare the work of God, and understand His doing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׂמַ֬ח צַדִּ֣יק בַּ֭יהֹוָה וְחָ֣סָה ב֑וֹ וְ֝יִתְהַלְל֗וּ כׇּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵֽב׃ {פ}
verses.translit: yshmch tsdyq byhvh vchsh bv vythllv khlyshrylb {p}
verses.translation: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in Him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָוִ֥ד שִֽׁיר׃
verses.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm. A Song of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְךָ֤ דֻֽמִיָּ֬ה תְהִלָּ֓ה אֱלֹ֘הִ֥ים בְּצִיּ֑וֹן וּ֝לְךָ֗ יְשֻׁלַּם־נֶֽדֶר׃
verses.translit: lkh dmyh thlh 'lhym btsyvn vlkh yshlmndr
verses.translation: Praise waiteth for Thee, O God, in Zion; and unto Thee the vow is performed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֥עַ תְּפִלָּ֑ה עָ֝דֶ֗יךָ כׇּל־בָּשָׂ֥ר יָבֹֽאוּ׃
verses.translation: O Thou that hearest prayer, unto Thee doth all flesh come.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֣י עֲ֭וֺנֹת גָּ֣בְרוּ מֶ֑נִּי פְּ֝שָׁעֵ֗ינוּ אַתָּ֥ה תְכַפְּרֵֽם׃
verses.translation: The tale of iniquities is too heavy for me; as for our transgressions, Thou wilt pardon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֤י  תִּ֥בְחַ֣ר וּתְקָרֵב֮ יִשְׁכֹּ֢ן חֲצֵ֫רֶ֥יךָ נִ֭שְׂבְּעָה בְּט֣וּב בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ קְ֝דֹ֗שׁ הֵיכָלֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: 'shry  tbchr vtqrb yshkhn chtsrykh nshb'h btvb bytkh qdsh hykhlkh
verses.translation: Happy is the man whom Thou choosest, and bringest near, that he may dwell in Thy courts; may we be satisfied with the goodness of Thy house, the holy place of Thy temple!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נ֤וֹרָא֨וֹת  בְּצֶ֣דֶק תַּ֭עֲנֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑נוּ מִבְטָ֥ח כׇּל־קַצְוֵי־אֶ֝֗רֶץ וְיָ֣ם רְחֹקִֽים׃
verses.translit: nvr'vt  btsdq t'nnv 'lhy ysh'nv mbtch khlqtsvy'rts vym rchqym
verses.translation: With wondrous works dost Thou answer us in righteousness, O God of our salvation; Thou the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of the far distant seas;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵכִ֣ין הָרִ֣ים בְּכֹח֑וֹ נֶ֝אְזָ֗ר בִּגְבוּרָֽה׃
verses.translation: Who by Thy strength settest fast the mountains, who art girded about with might;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשְׁבִּ֤יחַ  שְׁא֣וֹן יַ֭מִּים שְׁא֥וֹן גַּלֵּיהֶ֗ם וַהֲמ֥וֹן לְאֻמִּֽים׃
verses.translit: mshbych  sh'vn ymym sh'vn glyhm vhmvn l'mym
verses.translation: Who stillest the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the tumult of the peoples;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֤ירְא֨וּ  יֹשְׁבֵ֣י קְ֭צָוֺת מֵאוֹתֹתֶ֑יךָ מ֤וֹצָֽאֵי־בֹ֖קֶר וָעֶ֣רֶב תַּרְנִֽין׃
verses.translit: vyyr'v  yshby qtsvt m'vttykh mvts'ybqr v'rb trnyn
verses.translation: So that they that dwell in the uttermost parts stand in awe of Thy signs; Thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּ֤קַֽדְתָּ־הָאָ֨רֶץ וַתְּשֹׁ֪קְקֶ֡הָ רַבַּ֬ת תַּעְשְׁרֶ֗נָּה פֶּ֣לֶג אֱ֭לֹהִים מָ֣לֵא מָ֑יִם תָּכִ֥ין דְּ֝גָנָ֗ם כִּי־כֵ֥ן תְּכִינֶֽהָ׃
verses.translit: pqdth'rts vtshqqh rbt t'shrnh plg 'lhym ml' mym tkhyn dgnm khykhn tkhynh
verses.translation: Thou hast remembered the earth, and watered her, greatly enriching her, with the river of God that is full of water; Thou preparest them corn, for so preparest Thou her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּלָמֶ֣יהָ רַ֭וֵּה נַחֵ֣ת גְּדוּדֶ֑הָ בִּרְבִיבִ֥ים תְּ֝מֹגְגֶ֗נָּה צִמְחָ֥הּ תְּבָרֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: tlmyh rvh ncht gdvdh brbybym tmggnh tsmchh tbrkh
verses.translation: Watering her ridges abundantly, settling down the furrows thereof, Thou makest her soft with showers; Thou blessest the growth thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִ֭טַּרְתָּ שְׁנַ֣ת טוֹבָתֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מַעְגָּלֶ֗יךָ יִרְעֲפ֥וּן דָּֽשֶׁן׃
verses.translation: Thou crownest the year with Thy goodness; and Thy paths drop fatness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֭רְעֲפוּ נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֑ר וְ֝גִ֗יל גְּבָע֥וֹת תַּחְגֹּֽרְנָה׃
verses.translit: yr'pv n'vt mdbr vgyl gb'vt tchgrnh
verses.translation: The pastures of the wilderness do drop; and the hills are girded with joy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָבְשׁ֬וּ כָרִ֨ים  הַצֹּ֗אן וַעֲמָקִ֥ים יַֽעַטְפוּ־בָ֑ר יִ֝תְרוֹעֲע֗וּ אַף־יָשִֽׁירוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lbshv khrym  hts'n v'mqym y'tpvbr ytrv''v 'fyshyrv {p}
verses.translation: The meadows are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, yea, they sing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ שִׁ֣יר מִזְמ֑וֹר הָרִ֥יעוּ לֵ֝אלֹהִ֗ים כׇּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: lmntsch shyr mzmvr hry'v l'lhym khlh'rts
verses.translation: For the Leader. A Song, a Psalm. Shout unto God, all the earth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זַמְּר֥וּ כְבֽוֹד־שְׁמ֑וֹ שִׂ֥ימוּ כָ֝ב֗וֹד תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: Sing praises unto the glory of His name; Make His praise glorious.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִמְר֣וּ לֵ֭אלֹהִים מַה־נּוֹרָ֣א מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ בְּרֹ֥ב עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ יְֽכַחֲשׁ֖וּ לְךָ֣ אֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'mrv l'lhym mhnvr' m'shykh brb 'zkh ykhchshv lkh 'ybykh
verses.translation: Say unto God: 'How tremendous is Thy work! Through the greatness of Thy power shall Thine enemies dwindle away before Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הָאָ֤רֶץ  יִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לְ֭ךָ וִיזַמְּרוּ־לָ֑ךְ יְזַמְּר֖וּ שִׁמְךָ֣ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: khlh'rts  yshtchvv lkh vyzmrvlkh yzmrv shmkh slh
verses.translation: All the earth shall worship Thee, And shall sing praises unto Thee; They shall sing praises to Thy name.' Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְכ֣וּ וּ֭רְאוּ מִפְעֲל֣וֹת אֱלֹהִ֑ים נוֹרָ֥א עֲ֝לִילָ֗ה עַל־בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.translation: Come, and see the works of God; He is terrible in His doing toward the children of men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָ֤פַךְ יָ֨ם  לְֽיַבָּשָׁ֗ה בַּ֭נָּהָר יַעַבְר֣וּ בְרָ֑גֶל שָׁ֝֗ם נִשְׂמְחָה־בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hpkh ym  lybshh bnhr y'brv brgl shm nshmchhbv
verses.translation: He turned the sea into dry land; They went through the river on foot; There let us rejoice in Him!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֹ֘שֵׁ֤ל בִּגְבוּרָת֨וֹ  עוֹלָ֗ם עֵ֭ינָיו בַּגּוֹיִ֣ם תִּצְפֶּ֑ינָה הַסּוֹרְרִ֓ים  אַל־[יָר֖וּמוּ] (ירימו) לָ֣מוֹ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: mshl bgbvrtv  'vlm 'ynyv bgvym ttspynh hsvrrym  'l[yrvmv] (yrymv) lmv slh
verses.translation: Who ruleth by His might for ever; His eyes keep watch upon the nations; Let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּרְכ֖וּ עַמִּ֥ים ׀ אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְ֝הַשְׁמִ֗יעוּ ק֣וֹל תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: Bless our God, ye peoples, And make the voice of His praise to be heard;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשָּׂ֣ם נַ֭פְשֵׁנוּ בַּחַיִּ֑ים וְלֹֽא־נָתַ֖ן לַמּ֣וֹט רַגְלֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: hshm npshnv bchyym vl'ntn lmvt rglnv
verses.translation: Who hath set our soul in life, And suffered not our foot to be moved,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־בְחַנְתָּ֥נוּ אֱלֹהִ֑ים צְ֝רַפְתָּ֗נוּ כִּצְרׇף־כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.translation: For Thou, O God, hast tried us; Thou hast refined us, as silver is refined.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲבֵאתָ֥נוּ בַמְּצוּדָ֑ה שַׂ֖מְתָּ מוּעָקָ֣ה בְמׇתְנֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translation: Thou didst bring us into the hold; Thou didst lay constraint upon our loins.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִרְכַּ֥בְתָּֽ אֱנ֗וֹשׁ לְרֹ֫אשֵׁ֥נוּ בָּֽאנוּ־בָאֵ֥שׁ וּבַמַּ֑יִם וַ֝תּוֹצִיאֵ֗נוּ לָרְוָיָֽה׃
verses.translit: hrkhbt 'nvsh lr'shnv b'nvb'sh vbmym vtvtsy'nv lrvyh
verses.translation: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; We went through fire and through water; But Thou didst bring us out unto abundance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָב֣וֹא בֵיתְךָ֣ בְעוֹל֑וֹת אֲשַׁלֵּ֖ם לְךָ֣ נְדָרָֽי׃
verses.translation: I will come into Thy house with burnt-offerings, I will perform unto Thee my vows,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־פָּצ֥וּ שְׂפָתָ֑י וְדִבֶּר־פִּ֝֗י בַּצַּר־לִֽי׃
verses.translation: Which my lips have uttered, And my mouth hath spoken, when I was in distress.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹ֘ל֤וֹת מֵיחִ֣ים אַֽעֲלֶה־לָּ֭ךְ עִם־קְטֹ֣רֶת אֵילִ֑ים אֶ֥עֱשֶֽׂה־בָקָ֖ר עִם־עַתּוּדִ֣ים סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translation: I will offer unto Thee burnt-offerings of fatlings, With the sweet smoke of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְכוּ־שִׁמְע֣וּ וַ֭אֲסַפְּרָה כׇּל־יִרְאֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עָשָׂ֣ה לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translation: Come, and hearken, all ye that fear God, And I will declare what He hath done for my soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵלָ֥יו פִּֽי־קָרָ֑אתִי וְ֝רוֹמַ֗ם תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנִֽי׃
verses.translation: I cried unto Him with my mouth, And He was extolled with my tongue.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֭וֶן אִם־רָאִ֣יתִי בְלִבִּ֑י לֹ֖א יִשְׁמַ֣ע ׀ אֲדֹנָֽי׃
verses.translation: If I had regarded iniquity in my heart, The Lord would not hear;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֭כֵן שָׁמַ֣ע אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִ֝קְשִׁ֗יב בְּק֣וֹל תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃
verses.translation: But verily God hath heard; He hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־הֵסִ֘יר־תְּפִלָּתִ֥י וְ֝חַסְדּ֗וֹ מֵאִתִּֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Blessed be God, Who hath not turned away my prayer, nor His mercy from me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינֹ֗ת מִזְמ֥וֹר שִֽׁיר׃
verses.translation: For the Leader; with string-music. A Psalm, a Song.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים יְחׇנֵּ֥נוּ וִיבָרְכֵ֑נוּ יָ֤אֵֽר־פָּנָ֖יו אִתָּ֣נוּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translation: God be gracious unto us, and bless us; May He cause His face to shine toward us; Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָדַ֣עַת בָּאָ֣רֶץ דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ בְּכׇל־גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם יְשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: That Thy way may be known upon earth, Thy salvation among all nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹד֖וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים ׀ אֱלֹהִ֑ים י֝וֹד֗וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.translation: Let the peoples give thanks unto Thee, O God; Let the peoples give thanks unto Thee, all of them. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֥שְׂמְח֥וּ וִירַנְּנ֗וּ לְאֻ֫מִּ֥ים כִּֽי־תִשְׁפֹּ֣ט עַמִּ֣ים מִישֹׁ֑ר וּלְאֻמִּ֓ים  בָּאָ֖רֶץ תַּנְחֵ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: yshmchv vyrnnv l'mym khytshpt 'mym myshr vl'mym  b'rts tnchm slh
verses.translation: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy; For Thou wilt judge the peoples with equity, And lead the nations upon earth. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹד֖וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים ׀ אֱלֹהִ֑ים י֝וֹד֗וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.translation: Let the peoples give thanks unto Thee, O God; Let the peoples give thanks unto Thee, all of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֭רֶץ נָתְנָ֣ה יְבוּלָ֑הּ יְ֝בָרְכֵ֗נוּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translation: The earth hath yielded her increase; May God, our own God, bless us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְבָרְכֵ֥נוּ אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְיִֽירְא֥וּ א֝וֹת֗וֹ כׇּל־אַפְסֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: May God bless us; And let all the ends of the earth fear Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ לְדָוִ֗ד מִזְמ֥וֹר שִֽׁיר׃
verses.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David, a Song.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָק֣וּם אֱ֭לֹהִים יָפ֣וּצוּ אוֹיְבָ֑יו וְיָנ֥וּסוּ מְ֝שַׂנְאָ֗יו מִפָּנָֽיו׃
verses.translation: Let God arise, let His enemies be scattered; And let them that hate Him flee before Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּהִנְדֹּ֥ף עָשָׁ֗ן תִּ֫נְדֹּ֥ף כְּהִמֵּ֣ס דּ֭וֹנַג מִפְּנֵי־אֵ֑שׁ יֹאבְד֥וּ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים מִפְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: khhndf 'shn tndf khhms dvng mpny'sh y'bdv rsh'ym mpny 'lhym
verses.translation: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away; As wax melteth before the fire, So let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽצַדִּיקִ֗ים יִשְׂמְח֣וּ יַ֭עַלְצוּ לִפְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִ֗ים וְיָשִׂ֥ישׂוּ בְשִׂמְחָֽה׃
verses.translit: vtsdyqym yshmchv y'ltsv lpny 'lhym vyshyshv bshmchh
verses.translation: But let the righteous be glad, let them exult before God; Yea, let them rejoice with gladness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֤ירוּ  לֵאלֹהִים֮ זַמְּר֢וּ שְׁ֫מ֥וֹ סֹ֡לּוּ לָרֹכֵ֣ב בָּ֭עֲרָבוֹת בְּיָ֥הּ שְׁמ֗וֹ וְעִלְז֥וּ לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: shyrv  l'lhym zmrv shmv slv lrkhb b'rbvt byh shmv v'lzv lpnyv
verses.translation: Sing unto God, sing praises to His name; Extol Him that rideth upon the skies, whose name is the LORD; And exult ye before Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲבִ֣י יְ֭תוֹמִים וְדַיַּ֣ן אַלְמָנ֑וֹת אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בִּמְע֥וֹן קׇדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translation: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, Is God in His holy habitation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֤ים  מ֘וֹשִׁ֤יב יְחִידִ֨ים  בַּ֗יְתָה מוֹצִ֣יא אֲ֭סִירִים בַּכּוֹשָׁר֑וֹת אַ֥ךְ ס֝וֹרְרִ֗ים שָׁכְנ֥וּ צְחִיחָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lhym  mvshyb ychydym  byth mvtsy' 'syrym bkhvshrvt 'kh svrrym shkhnv tschychh
verses.translation: God maketh the solitary to dwell in a house; He bringeth out the prisoners into prosperity; The rebellious dwell but in a parched land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים בְּ֭צֵאתְךָ לִפְנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֑ךָ בְּצַעְדְּךָ֖ בִישִׁימ֣וֹן סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translation: O God, when Thou wentest forth before Thy people, When Thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֤רֶץ רָעָ֨שָׁה  אַף־שָׁמַ֣יִם נָטְפוּ֮ מִפְּנֵ֢י אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים זֶ֥ה סִינַ֑י מִפְּנֵ֥י אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: 'rts r'shh  'fshmym ntpv mpny 'lhym zh syny mpny 'lhym 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: The earth trembled, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God; Even yon Sinai trembled at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גֶּ֣שֶׁם נְ֭דָבוֹת תָּנִ֣יף אֱלֹהִ֑ים נַחֲלָתְךָ֥ וְ֝נִלְאָ֗ה אַתָּ֥ה כוֹנַנְתָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: gshm ndbvt tnyf 'lhym nchltkh vnl'h 'th khvnnth
verses.translation: A bounteous rain didst Thou pour down, O God; When Thine inheritance was weary, Thou didst confirm it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַיָּתְךָ֥ יָשְׁבוּ־בָ֑הּ תָּ֤כִֽין־בְּטוֹבָתְךָ֖ לֶֽעָנִ֣י אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translation: Thy flock settled therein; Thou didst prepare in Thy goodness for the poor, O God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֥י יִתֶּן־אֹ֑מֶר הַֽ֝מְבַשְּׂר֗וֹת צָבָ֥א רָֽב׃
verses.translation: The Lord giveth the word; The women that proclaim the tidings are a great host.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַלְכֵ֣י צְ֭בָאוֹת יִדֹּד֣וּן יִדֹּד֑וּן וּנְוַת־בַּ֝֗יִת תְּחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁלָֽל׃
verses.translit: mlkhy tsb'vt yddvn yddvn vnvtbyt tchlq shll
verses.translation: Kings of armies flee, they flee; And she that tarrieth at home divideth the spoil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִֽם־תִּשְׁכְּבוּן֮ בֵּ֤ין שְׁפַ֫תָּ֥יִם כַּנְפֵ֣י י֭וֹנָה נֶחְפָּ֣ה בַכֶּ֑סֶף וְ֝אֶבְרוֹתֶ֗יהָ בִּירַקְרַ֥ק חָרֽוּץ׃
verses.translit: 'mtshkhbvn byn shptym khnpy yvnh nchph bkhsf v'brvtyh byrqrq chrvts
verses.translation: When ye lie among the sheepfolds, The wings of the dove are covered with silver, And her pinions with the shimmer of gold. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּפָ֘רֵ֤שׂ שַׁדַּ֓י מְלָ֘כִ֤ים בָּ֗הּ תַּשְׁלֵ֥ג בְּצַלְמֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: bprsh shdy mlkhym bh tshlg btslmvn
verses.translation: When the Almighty scattereth kings therein, It snoweth in Zalmon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַר־אֱ֭לֹהִים הַר־בָּשָׁ֑ן הַ֥ר גַּ֝בְנֻנִּ֗ים הַר־בָּשָֽׁן׃
verses.translation: A mountain of God is the mountain of Bashan; A mountain of peaks is the mountain of Bashan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה  תְּֽרַצְּדוּן֮ הָרִ֢ים גַּבְנֻ֫נִּ֥ים הָהָ֗ר חָמַ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְשִׁבְתּ֑וֹ אַף־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָנֶֽצַח׃
verses.translit: lmh  trtsdvn hrym gbnnym hhr chmd 'lhym lshbtv 'fyhvh yshkhn lntsch
verses.translation: Why look ye askance, ye mountains of peaks, At the mountain which God hath desired for His abode? Yea, the LORD will dwell therein for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֶ֤כֶב אֱלֹהִ֗ים רִבֹּתַ֣יִם אַלְפֵ֣י שִׁנְאָ֑ן אֲדֹנָ֥י בָֿ֝֗ם סִינַ֥י בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: rkhb 'lhym rbtym 'lpy shn'n 'dny bm syny bqdsh
verses.translation: The chariots of God are myriads, even thousands upon thousands; The Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in holiness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָ֘לִ֤יתָ לַמָּר֨וֹם  שָׁ֘בִ֤יתָ שֶּׁ֗בִי לָקַ֣חְתָּ מַ֭תָּנוֹת בָּאָדָ֑ם וְאַ֥ף ס֝וֹרְרִ֗ים לִשְׁכֹּ֤ן  יָ֬הּ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'lyt lmrvm  shbyt shby lqcht mtnvt b'dm v'f svrrym lshkhn  yh 'lhym
verses.translation: Thou hast ascended on high, Thou hast led captivity captive; Thou hast received gifts among men, Yea, among the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּ֤ר֣וּךְ אֲדֹנָי֮ י֤וֹם  י֥֫וֹם יַעֲמׇס־לָ֗נוּ הָ֘אֵ֤ל יְֽשׁוּעָתֵ֬נוּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: brvkh 'dny yvm  yvm y'mslnv h'l yshv'tnv slh
verses.translation: Blessed be the Lord, day by day He beareth our burden, Even the God who is our salvation. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָ֤אֵ֣ל ׀ לָנוּ֮ אֵ֤ל לְֽמ֫וֹשָׁע֥וֹת וְלֵיהֹוִ֥ה אֲדֹנָ֑י לַ֝מָּ֗וֶת תֹּצָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translation: God is unto us a God of deliverances; And unto GOD the Lord belong the issues of death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַךְ־אֱלֹהִ֗ים יִמְחַץ֮ רֹ֤אשׁ אֹ֫יְבָ֥יו קׇדְקֹ֥ד שֵׂעָ֑ר מִ֝תְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בַּאֲשָׁמָֽיו׃
verses.translit: 'kh'lhym ymchts r'sh 'ybyv qdqd sh'r mthlkh b'shmyv
verses.translation: Surely God will smite through the head of His enemies, The hairy scalp of him that goeth about in his guiltiness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמַ֣ר אֲ֭דֹנָי מִבָּשָׁ֣ן אָשִׁ֑יב אָ֝שִׁ֗יב מִֽמְּצֻל֥וֹת יָֽם׃
verses.translation: The Lord said: 'I will bring back from Bashan, I will bring them back from the depths of the sea;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן  תִּ֥מְחַ֥ץ רַגְלְךָ֗ בְּ֫דָ֥ם לְשׁ֥וֹן כְּלָבֶ֑יךָ מֵאֹיְבִ֥ים מִנֵּֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: lm'n  tmchts rglkh bdm lshvn khlbykh m'ybym mnhv
verses.translation: That thy foot may wade through blood, That the tongue of thy dogs may have its portion from thine enemies.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָא֣וּ הֲלִיכוֹתֶ֣יךָ אֱלֹהִ֑ים הֲלִ֘יכ֤וֹת אֵלִ֖י מַלְכִּ֣י בַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translation: They see Thy goings, O God, Even the goings of my God, my King, in holiness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קִדְּמ֣וּ שָׁ֭רִים אַחַ֣ר נֹגְנִ֑ים בְּת֥וֹךְ עֲ֝לָמ֗וֹת תּוֹפֵפֽוֹת׃
verses.translation: The singers go before, the minstrels follow after, In the midst of damsels playing upon timbrels.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּֽ֭מַקְהֵלוֹת בָּרְכ֣וּ אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י מִמְּק֥וֹר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translation: 'Bless ye God in full assemblies, Even the Lord, ye that are from the fountain of Israel.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֤ם בִּנְיָמִ֨ן  צָעִ֡יר רֹדֵ֗ם שָׂרֵ֣י יְ֭הוּדָה רִגְמָתָ֑ם שָׂרֵ֥י זְ֝בֻל֗וּן שָׂרֵ֥י נַפְתָּלִֽי׃
verses.translit: shm bnymn  ts'yr rdm shry yhvdh rgmtm shry zblvn shry nptly
verses.translation: There is Benjamin, the youngest, ruling them, The princes of Judah their council, The princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צִוָּ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ עֻ֫זֶּ֥ךָ עוּזָּ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים ז֝֗וּ פָּעַ֥לְתָּ לָּֽנוּ׃
verses.translation: Thy God hath commanded thy strength; Be strong, O God, Thou that hast wrought for us
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵ֭הֵיכָלֶךָ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם לְךָ֤ יוֹבִ֖ילוּ מְלָכִ֣ים שָֽׁי׃
verses.translation: Out of Thy temple at Jerusalem, Whither kings shall bring presents unto Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גְּעַ֨ר חַיַּ֪ת קָנֶ֡ה עֲדַ֤ת אַבִּירִ֨ים  בְּעֶגְלֵ֬י עַמִּ֗ים מִתְרַפֵּ֥ס בְּרַצֵּי־כָ֑סֶף בִּזַּ֥ר עַ֝מִּ֗ים קְרָב֥וֹת יֶחְפָּֽצוּ׃
verses.translit: g'r chyt qnh 'dt 'byrym  b'gly 'mym mtrps brtsykhsf bzr 'mym qrbvt ychptsv
verses.translation: Rebuke the wild beast of the reeds, The multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the peoples, Every one submitting himself with pieces of silver; He hath scattered the peoples that delight in war!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֶאֱתָ֣יוּ חַ֭שְׁמַנִּים מִנִּ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם כּ֥וּשׁ תָּרִ֥יץ יָ֝דָ֗יו לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: y'tyv chshmnym mny mtsrym khvsh tryts ydyv l'lhym
verses.translation: Nobles shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall hasten to stretch out her hands unto God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָ֭אָרֶץ שִׁ֣ירוּ לֵאלֹהִ֑ים זַמְּר֖וּ אֲדֹנָ֣י סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: mmlkhvt h'rts shyrv l'lhym zmrv 'dny slh
verses.translation: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֭רֹכֵב בִּשְׁמֵ֣י שְׁמֵי־קֶ֑דֶם הֵ֥ן יִתֵּ֥ן בְּ֝קוֹל֗וֹ ק֣וֹל עֹֽז׃
verses.translit: lrkhb bshmy shmyqdm hn ytn bqvlv qvl 'z
verses.translation: To Him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which are of old; Lo, He uttereth His voice, a mighty voice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּנ֥וּ עֹ֗ז לֵאלֹ֫הִ֥ים עַֽל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל גַּאֲוָת֑וֹ וְ֝עֻזּ֗וֹ בַּשְּׁחָקִֽים׃
verses.translation: Ascribe ye strength unto God; His majesty is over Israel, And His strength is in the skies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נ֤וֹרָ֥א אֱלֹהִ֗ים מִֽמִּקְדָּ֫שֶׁ֥יךָ אֵ֤ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל ה֤וּא נֹתֵ֨ן  עֹ֖ז וְתַעֲצֻמ֥וֹת לָעָ֗ם בָּר֥וּךְ אֱלֹהִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: nvr' 'lhym mmqdshykh 'l yshr'l hv' ntn  'z vt'tsmvt l'm brvkh 'lhym {p}
verses.translation: Awful is God out of thy holy places; The God of Israel, He giveth strength and power unto the people; Blessed be God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ ׀ עַֽל־שׁוֹשַׁנִּ֬ים לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translation: For the Leader; upon Shoshannim. [A Psalm] of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נִי אֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֤י בָ֖אוּ מַ֣יִם עַד־נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.translation: Save me, O God; For the waters are come in even unto the soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טָבַ֤עְתִּי  בִּיוֵ֣ן מְ֭צוּלָה וְאֵ֣ין מׇעֳמָ֑ד בָּ֥אתִי בְמַעֲמַקֵּי־מַ֝֗יִם וְשִׁבֹּ֥לֶת שְׁטָפָֽתְנִי׃
verses.translit: tb'ty  byvn mtsvlh v'yn m'md b'ty bm'mqymym vshblt shtptny
verses.translation: I am sunk in deep mire, where there is no standing; I am come into deep waters, and the flood overwhelmeth me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָגַ֣עְתִּי בְקׇרְאִי֮ נִחַ֢ר גְּר֫וֹנִ֥י כָּל֥וּ עֵינַ֑י מְ֝יַחֵ֗ל לֵאלֹהָֽי׃
verses.translit: yg'ty bqr'y nchr grvny khlv 'yny mychl l'lhy
verses.translation: I am weary of my crying; my throat is dried; Mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַבּ֤וּ  מִשַּׂעֲר֣וֹת רֹאשִׁי֮ שֹׂנְאַ֢י חִ֫נָּ֥ם עָצְמ֣וּ מַ֭צְמִיתַי אֹיְבַ֣י שֶׁ֑קֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־גָ֝זַ֗לְתִּי אָ֣ז אָשִֽׁיב׃
verses.translit: rbv  msh'rvt r'shy shn'y chnm 'tsmv mtsmyty 'yby shqr 'shr l'gzlty 'z 'shyb
verses.translation: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head; They that would cut me off, being mine enemies wrongfully, are many; Should I restore that which I took not away?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים אַתָּ֣ה יָ֭דַעְתָּ לְאִוַּלְתִּ֑י וְ֝אַשְׁמוֹתַ֗י מִמְּךָ֥ לֹֽא־נִכְחָֽדוּ׃
verses.translation: O God, Thou knowest my folly; And my trespasses are not hid from Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ בִ֨י  קֹוֶיךָ֮ אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִ֗ה צְבָ֫א֥וֹת אַל־יִכָּ֣לְמֽוּ בִ֣י מְבַקְשֶׁ֑יךָ אֱ֝לֹהֵ֗י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: 'lybshv by  qvykh 'dny yhvh tsb'vt 'lykhlmv by mbqshykh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Let not them that wait for Thee be ashamed through me, O Lord GOD of hosts; Let not those that seek Thee be brought to confusion through me, O God of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־עָ֭לֶיךָ נָשָׂ֣אתִי חֶרְפָּ֑ה כִּסְּתָ֖ה כְלִמָּ֣ה פָנָֽי׃
verses.translit: khy'lykh nsh'ty chrph khsth khlmh pny
verses.translation: Because for Thy sake I have borne reproach; Confusion hath covered my face.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מ֭וּזָר הָיִ֣יתִי לְאֶחָ֑י וְ֝נׇכְרִ֗י לִבְנֵ֥י אִמִּֽי׃
verses.translation: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, And an alien unto my mother's children.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־קִנְאַ֣ת בֵּיתְךָ֣ אֲכָלָ֑תְנִי וְחֶרְפּ֥וֹת ח֝וֹרְפֶ֗יךָ נָפְל֥וּ עָלָֽי׃
verses.translation: Because zeal for Thy house hath eaten me up, And the reproaches of them that reproach Thee are fallen upon me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶבְכֶּ֣ה בַצּ֣וֹם נַפְשִׁ֑י וַתְּהִ֖י לַחֲרָפ֣וֹת לִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'bkhh btsvm npshy vthy lchrpvt ly
verses.translation: And I wept with my soul with fasting, And that became unto me a reproach.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶתְּנָ֣ה לְבוּשִׁ֣י שָׂ֑ק וָאֱהִ֖י לָהֶ֣ם לְמָשָֽׁל׃
verses.translit: v'tnh lbvshy shq v'hy lhm lmshl
verses.translation: I made sackcloth also my garment, And I became a byword unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָשִׂ֣יחוּ בִ֭י יֹ֣שְׁבֵי שָׁ֑עַר וּ֝נְגִינ֗וֹת שׁוֹתֵ֥י שֵׁכָֽר׃
verses.translit: yshychv by yshby sh'r vngynvt shvty shkhr
verses.translation: They that sit in the gate talk of me; And I am the song of the drunkards. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י תְפִלָּֽתִי־לְךָ֨  יְהֹוָ֡ה עֵ֤ת רָצ֗וֹן אֱלֹהִ֥ים בְּרׇב־חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ עֲ֝נֵ֗נִי בֶּאֱמֶ֥ת יִשְׁעֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: v'ny tpltylkh  yhvh 't rtsvn 'lhym brbchsdkh 'nny b'mt ysh'kh
verses.translation: But as for me, let my prayer be unto Thee, O LORD, in an acceptable time; O God, in the abundance of Thy mercy, Answer me with the truth of Thy salvation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַצִּילֵ֣נִי מִ֭טִּיט וְאַל־אֶטְבָּ֑עָה אִנָּצְלָ֥ה מִ֝שֹּׂנְאַ֗י וּמִמַּ֖עֲמַקֵּי־מָֽיִם׃
verses.translation: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink; Let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּשְׁטְפֵ֤נִי  שִׁבֹּ֣לֶת מַ֭יִם וְאַל־תִּבְלָעֵ֣נִי מְצוּלָ֑ה וְאַל־תֶּאְטַר־עָלַ֖י בְּאֵ֣ר פִּֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: 'ltshtpny  shblt mym v'ltbl'ny mtsvlh v'lt'tr'ly b'r pyh
verses.translation: Let not the waterflood overwhelm me, Neither let the deep swallow me up; And let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲנֵ֣נִי יְ֭הֹוָה כִּי־ט֣וֹב חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ כְּרֹ֥ב רַ֝חֲמֶ֗יךָ פְּנֵ֣ה אֵלָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'nny yhvh khytvb chsdkh khrb rchmykh pnh 'ly
verses.translation: Answer me, O LORD, for Thy mercy is good; According to the multitude of Thy compassions turn Thou unto me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַל־תַּסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נֶיךָ מֵעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּי־צַר־לִ֝֗י מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: And hide not Thy face from Thy servant; For I am in distress; answer me speedily.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קׇרְבָ֣ה אֶל־נַפְשִׁ֣י גְאָלָ֑הּ לְמַ֖עַן אֹיְבַ֣י פְּדֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it; Ransom me because of mine enemies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתָּ חֶרְפָּתִ֣י וּ֭בׇשְׁתִּי וּכְלִמָּתִ֑י נֶ֝גְדְּךָ֗ כׇּל־צוֹרְרָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'th yd't chrpty vbshty vkhlmty ngdkh khltsvrry
verses.translation: Thou knowest my reproach, and my shame, and my confusion; Mine adversaries are all before Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶרְפָּ֤ה  שָׁ֥בְרָ֥ה לִבִּ֗י וָאָ֫נ֥וּשָׁה וָאֲקַוֶּ֣ה לָנ֣וּד וָאַ֑יִן וְ֝לַמְנַחֲמִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א מָצָֽאתִי׃
verses.translit: chrph  shbrh lby v'nvshh v'qvh lnvd v'yn vlmnchmym vl' mts'ty
verses.translation: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am sore sick; And I looked for some to show compassion, but there was none; And for comforters, but I found none.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֣וּ בְּבָרוּתִ֣י רֹ֑אשׁ וְ֝לִצְמָאִ֗י יַשְׁק֥וּנִי חֹֽמֶץ׃
verses.translit: vytnv bbrvty r'sh vltsm'y yshqvny chmts
verses.translation: Yea, they put poison into my food; And in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהִי־שֻׁלְחָנָ֣ם לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם לְפָ֑ח וְלִשְׁלוֹמִ֥ים לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translation: Let their table before them become a snare; And when they are in peace, let it become a trap.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תֶּחְשַׁ֣כְנָה עֵ֭ינֵיהֶם מֵרְא֑וֹת וּ֝מׇתְנֵיהֶ֗ם תָּמִ֥יד הַמְעַֽד׃
verses.translation: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; And make their loins continually to totter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁפׇךְ־עֲלֵיהֶ֥ם זַעְמֶ֑ךָ וַחֲר֥וֹן אַ֝פְּךָ֗ יַשִּׂיגֵֽם׃
verses.translation: Pour out Thine indignation upon them, And let the fierceness of Thine anger overtake them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּהִי־טִירָתָ֥ם נְשַׁמָּ֑ה בְּ֝אׇהֳלֵיהֶ֗ם אַל־יְהִ֥י יֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.translation: Let their encampment be desolate; Let none dwell in their tents.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־אַתָּ֣ה אֲשֶׁר־הִכִּ֣יתָ רָדָ֑פוּ וְאֶל־מַכְא֖וֹב חֲלָלֶ֣יךָ יְסַפֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.translation: For they persecute him whom Thou hast smitten; And they tell of the pain of those whom Thou hast wounded.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּֽנָה־עָ֭וֺן עַל־עֲוֺנָ֑ם וְאַל־יָ֝בֹ֗אוּ בְּצִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Add iniquity unto their iniquity; And let them not come into Thy righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֭מָּחֽוּ מִסֵּ֣פֶר חַיִּ֑ים וְעִ֥ם צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים אַל־יִכָּתֵֽבוּ׃
verses.translation: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, And not be written with the righteous.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭אֲנִי עָנִ֣י וְכוֹאֵ֑ב יְשׁוּעָתְךָ֖ אֱלֹהִ֣ים תְּשַׂגְּבֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: But I am afflicted and in pain; Let Thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲהַלְלָ֣ה שֵׁם־אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּשִׁ֑יר וַאֲגַדְּלֶ֥נּוּ בְתוֹדָֽה׃
verses.translation: I will praise the name of God with a song, And will magnify Him with thanksgiving. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתִיטַ֣ב לַ֭יהֹוָה מִשּׁ֥וֹר פָּ֗ר מַקְרִ֥ן מַפְרִֽיס׃
verses.translit: vtytb lyhvh mshvr pr mqrn mprys
verses.translation: And it shall please the LORD better than a bullock That hath horns and hoofs.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָא֣וּ עֲנָוִ֣ים יִשְׂמָ֑חוּ דֹּרְשֵׁ֥י אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים וִיחִ֥י לְבַבְכֶֽם׃
verses.translation: The humble shall see it, and be glad; Ye that seek after God, let your heart revive.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־שֹׁמֵ֣עַ אֶל־אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים יְהֹוָ֑ה וְאֶת־אֲ֝סִירָ֗יו לֹ֣א בָזָֽה׃
verses.translation: For the LORD hearkeneth unto the needy, And despiseth not His prisoners.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽ֭הַלְלוּהוּ שָׁמַ֣יִם וָאָ֑רֶץ יַ֝מִּ֗ים וְֽכׇל־רֹמֵ֥שׂ בָּֽם׃
verses.translit: yhllvhv shmym v'rts ymym vkhlrmsh bm
verses.translation: Let heaven and earth praise Him, The seas, and every thing that moveth therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֱלֹהִ֨ים  י֘וֹשִׁ֤יעַ צִיּ֗וֹן וְ֭יִבְנֶה עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וְיָ֥שְׁבוּ שָׁ֝֗ם וִירֵשֽׁוּהָ׃
verses.translit: khy 'lhym  yvshy' tsyvn vybnh 'ry yhvdh vyshbv shm vyrshvh
verses.translation: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah; And they shall abide there, and have it in possession.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֶ֣רַע עֲ֭בָדָיו יִנְחָל֑וּהָ וְאֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁ֝מ֗וֹ יִשְׁכְּנוּ־בָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: The seed also of His servants shall inherit it; And they that love His name shall dwell therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַ֝מְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָוִ֥ד לְהַזְכִּֽיר׃
verses.translation: For the Leader. [A Psalm] of David; to make memorial.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֥ים לְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָׁה׃
verses.translation: O God, to deliver me, O LORD, to help me, make haste.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֢י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָ֭חוֹר וְיִכָּלְמ֑וּ חֲ֝פֵצֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: ybshv vychprv mbqshy npshy ysgv 'chvr vykhlmv chptsy r'ty
verses.translation: Let them be ashamed and abashed That seek after my soul; Let them be turned backward and brought to confusion That delight in my hurt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָ֭שׁוּבוּ עַל־עֵ֣קֶב בׇּשְׁתָּ֑ם הָ֝אֹמְרִ֗ים הֶ֘אָ֥ח ׀ הֶאָֽח׃
verses.translation: Let them be turned back by reason of their shame That say: 'Aha, aha.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָ֘שִׂ֤ישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ  בְּךָ֗ כׇּֽל־מְבַ֫קְשֶׁ֥יךָ וְיֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֹ֝הֲבֵ֗י יְשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: yshyshv vyshmchv  bkh khlmbqshykh vy'mrv tmyd ygdl 'lhym 'hby yshv'tkh
verses.translation: Let all those that seek Thee rejoice and be glad in Thee; And let such as love Thy salvation say continually: 'Let God be magnified.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י  עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְיוֹן֮ אֱלֹהִ֢ים ח֫וּשָׁה־לִּ֥י עֶזְרִ֣י וּמְפַלְטִ֣י אַ֑תָּה יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה אַל־תְּאַחַֽר׃ {פ}
verses.translation: But I am poor and needy; O God, make haste unto me; Thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, tarry not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּךָֽ־יְהֹוָ֥ה חָסִ֑יתִי אַל־אֵב֥וֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translation: In Thee, O LORD, have I taken refuge; Let me never be ashamed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֗ תַּצִּילֵ֥נִי וּֽתְפַלְּטֵ֑נִי הַטֵּֽה־אֵלַ֥י אׇ֝זְנְךָ֗ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Deliver me in Thy righteousness, and rescue me; Incline Thine ear unto me, and save me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֱיֵ֤ה לִ֨י  לְצ֥וּר מָע֡וֹן לָב֗וֹא תָּמִ֗יד צִוִּ֥יתָ לְהוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי כִּֽי־סַלְעִ֖י וּמְצוּדָתִ֣י אָֽתָּה׃
verses.translit: hyh ly  ltsvr m'vn lbv' tmyd tsvyt lhvshy'ny khysl'y vmtsvdty 'th
verses.translation: Be Thou to me a sheltering rock, whereunto I may continually resort, Which Thou hast appointed to save me; For Thou art my rock and my fortress.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהַ֗י פַּ֭לְּטֵנִי מִיַּ֣ד רָשָׁ֑ע מִכַּ֖ף מְעַוֵּ֣ל וְחוֹמֵֽץ׃
verses.translit: 'lhy pltny myd rsh' mkhf m'vl vchvmts
verses.translation: O my God, rescue me out of the hand of the wicked, Out of the grasp of the unrighteous and ruthless man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה תִקְוָתִ֑י אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱ֝הֹוִ֗ה מִבְטַחִ֥י מִנְּעוּרָֽי׃
verses.translation: For Thou art my hope; O Lord GOD, my trust from my youth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָלֶ֤יךָ  נִסְמַ֬כְתִּי מִבֶּ֗טֶן מִמְּעֵ֣י אִ֭מִּי אַתָּ֣ה גוֹזִ֑י בְּךָ֖ תְהִלָּתִ֣י תָמִֽיד׃
verses.translit: 'lykh  nsmkhty mbtn mm'y 'my 'th gvzy bkh thlty tmyd
verses.translation: Upon Thee have I stayed myself from birth; Thou art he that took me out of my mother's womb; My praise is continually of Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּ֭מוֹפֵת הָיִ֣יתִי לְרַבִּ֑ים וְ֝אַתָּ֗ה מַֽחֲסִי־עֹֽז׃
verses.translation: I am as a wonder unto many; But Thou art my strong refuge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִמָּ֣לֵא פִ֭י תְּהִלָּתֶ֑ךָ כׇּל־הַ֝יּ֗וֹם תִּפְאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: My mouth shall be filled with Thy praise, And with Thy glory all the day. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַֽל־תַּ֭שְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵ֣ת זִקְנָ֑ה כִּכְל֥וֹת כֹּ֝חִ֗י אַֽל־תַּעַזְבֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Cast me not off in the time of old age; When my strength faileth, forsake me not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אָמְר֣וּ אוֹיְבַ֣י לִ֑י וְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י נוֹעֲצ֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.translit: khy'mrv 'vyby ly vshmry npshy nv'tsv ychdv
verses.translation: For mine enemies speak concerning me, And they that watch for my soul take counsel together,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵ֭אמֹר אֱלֹהִ֣ים עֲזָב֑וֹ רִֽדְפ֥וּ וְ֝תִפְשׂ֗וּהוּ כִּי־אֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.translation: Saying: 'God hath forsaken him; Pursue and take him; for there is none to deliver.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים אַל־תִּרְחַ֣ק מִמֶּ֑נִּי אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי (חישה) [חֽוּשָׁה]׃
verses.translation: O God, be not far from me; O my God, make haste to help me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ יִכְלוּ֮ שֹׂטְנֵ֢י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יַעֲט֣וּ חֶ֭רְפָּה וּכְלִמָּ֑ה מְ֝בַקְשֵׁ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: ybshv ykhlv shtny npshy y'tv chrph vkhlmh mbqshy r'ty
verses.translation: Let them be ashamed and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; Let them be covered with reproach and confusion that seek my hurt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭אֲנִי תָּמִ֣יד אֲיַחֵ֑ל וְ֝הוֹסַפְתִּ֗י עַל־כׇּל־תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: But as for me, I will hope continually, And will praise Thee yet more and more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פִּ֤י  יְסַפֵּ֬ר צִדְקָתֶ֗ךָ כׇּל־הַיּ֥וֹם תְּשׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹ֖א יָדַ֣עְתִּי סְפֹרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: py  yspr tsdqtkh khlhyvm tshv'tkh khy l' yd'ty sprvt
verses.translation: My mouth shall tell of Thy righteousness, And of Thy salvation all the day; For I know not the numbers thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָב֗וֹא בִּ֭גְבֻרוֹת אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה אַזְכִּ֖יר צִדְקָתְךָ֣ לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: I will come with Thy mighty acts, O Lord GOD; I will make mention of Thy righteousness, even of Thine only.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים לִמַּדְתַּ֥נִי מִנְּעוּרָ֑י וְעַד־הֵ֝֗נָּה אַגִּ֥יד נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: O God, Thou hast taught me from my youth; And until now do I declare Thy wondrous works.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַ֤ם עַד־זִקְנָ֨ה  וְשֵׂיבָה֮ אֱלֹהִ֢ים אַֽל־תַּ֫עַזְבֵ֥נִי עַד־אַגִּ֣יד זְרוֹעֲךָ֣ לְד֑וֹר לְכׇל־יָ֝ב֗וֹא גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vgm 'dzqnh  vshybh 'lhym 'lt'zbny 'd'gyd zrv'kh ldvr lkhlybv' gbvrtkh
verses.translation: And even unto old age and hoary hairs, O God, forsake me not; Until I have declared Thy strength unto the next generation, Thy might to every one that is to come.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ אֱלֹהִ֗ים עַד־מָ֫ר֥וֹם אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֥יתָ גְדֹל֑וֹת אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים מִ֣י כָמֽוֹךָ׃
verses.translation: Thy righteousness also, O God, which reacheth unto high heaven; Thou who hast done great things, O God, who is like unto Thee?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר (הראיתנו) [הִרְאִיתַ֨נִי ] צָר֥וֹת רַבּ֗וֹת וְרָ֫ע֥וֹת תָּשׁ֥וּב (תחינו) [תְּחַיֵּ֑נִי] וּֽמִתְּהֹמ֥וֹת הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ תָּשׁ֥וּב תַּעֲלֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: 'shr (hr'ytnv) [hr'ytny ] tsrvt rbvt vr'vt tshvb (tchynv) [tchyny] vmthmvt h'rts tshvb t'lny
verses.translation: Thou, who hast made me to see many and sore troubles, Wilt quicken me again, and bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תֶּ֤רֶב  גְּֽדֻלָּתִ֗י וְתִסֹּ֥ב תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Thou wilt increase my greatness, And turn and comfort me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־אֲנִ֤י  אוֹדְךָ֣ בִכְלִי־נֶבֶל֮ אֲמִתְּךָ֢ אֱלֹ֫הָ֥י אֲזַמְּרָ֣ה לְךָ֣ בְכִנּ֑וֹר קְ֝ד֗וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: gm'ny  'vdkh bkhlynbl 'mtkh 'lhy 'zmrh lkh bkhnvr qdvsh yshr'l
verses.translation: I also will give thanks unto Thee with the psaltery, Even unto Thy truth, O my God; I will sing praises unto Thee with the harp, O Thou Holy One of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּרַנֵּ֣נָּה שְׂ֭פָתַי כִּ֣י אֲזַמְּרָה־לָּ֑ךְ וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּדִֽיתָ׃
verses.translation: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing praises unto Thee; And my soul, which Thou hast redeemed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־לְשׁוֹנִ֗י כׇּל־הַ֭יּוֹם תֶּהְגֶּ֣ה צִדְקָתֶ֑ךָ כִּי־בֹ֥שׁוּ כִי־חָ֝פְר֗וּ מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י רָעָתִֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: gmlshvny khlhyvm thgh tsdqtkh khybshv khychprv mbqshy r'ty {p}
verses.translation: My tongue also shall tell of Thy righteousness all the day; For they are ashamed, for they are abashed, that seek my hurt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִשְׁלֹמֹ֨ה  אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶיךָ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ תֵּ֑ן וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ לְבֶן־מֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: lshlmh  'lhym mshptykh lmlkh tn vtsdqtkh lbnmlkh
verses.translation: [A Psalm] of Solomon. Give the king Thy judgments, O God, and Thy righteousness unto the king's son;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָדִ֣ין עַמְּךָ֣ בְצֶ֑דֶק וַעֲנִיֶּ֥יךָ בְמִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translation: That he may judge Thy people with righteousness, and Thy poor with justice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׂא֤וּ הָרִ֓ים שָׁ֘ל֥וֹם לָעָ֑ם וּ֝גְבָע֗וֹת בִּצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.translit: ysh'v hrym shlvm l'm vgb'vt btsdqh
verses.translation: Let the mountains bear peace to the people, and the hills, through righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׁפֹּ֤ט  עֲֽנִיֵּי־עָ֗ם י֭וֹשִׁיעַ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶבְי֑וֹן וִ֖ידַכֵּ֣א עוֹשֵֽׁק׃
verses.translation: May he judge the poor of the people, and save the children of the needy, And crush the oppressor.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִירָא֥וּךָ עִם־שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וְלִפְנֵ֥י יָ֝רֵ֗חַ דּ֣וֹר דּוֹרִֽים׃
verses.translation: They shall fear Thee while the sun endureth, and so long as the moon, throughout all generations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵ֭רֵד כְּמָטָ֣ר עַל־גֵּ֑ז כִּ֝רְבִיבִ֗ים זַרְזִ֥יף אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translation: May he come down like rain upon the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִֽפְרַח־בְּיָמָ֥יו צַדִּ֑יק וְרֹ֥ב שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם עַד־בְּלִ֥י יָרֵֽחַ׃
verses.translation: In his days let the righteous flourish, and abundance of peace, till the moon be no more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭יֵרְדְּ מִיָּ֣ם עַד־יָ֑ם וּ֝מִנָּהָ֗ר עַד־אַפְסֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translation: May he have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the River unto the ends of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֭פָנָיו יִכְרְע֣וּ צִיִּ֑ים וְ֝אֹיְבָ֗יו עָפָ֥ר יְלַחֵֽכוּ׃
verses.translation: Let them that dwell in the wilderness bow before him; and his enemies lick the dust.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַלְכֵ֬י תַרְשִׁ֣ישׁ וְ֭אִיִּים מִנְחָ֣ה יָשִׁ֑יבוּ מַלְכֵ֥י שְׁבָ֥א וּ֝סְבָ֗א אֶשְׁכָּ֥ר יַקְרִֽיבוּ׃
verses.translit: mlkhy trshysh v'yym mnchh yshybv mlkhy shb' vsb' 'shkhr yqrybv
verses.translation: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall render tribute; the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־ל֥וֹ כׇל־מְלָכִ֑ים כׇּל־גּוֹיִ֥ם יַעַבְדֽוּהוּ׃
verses.translation: Yea, all kings shall prostrate themselves before him; All nations shall serve him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יַ֭צִּיל אֶבְי֣וֹן מְשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וְ֝עָנִ֗י וְֽאֵין־עֹזֵ֥ר לֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: For he will deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָ֭חֹס עַל־דַּ֣ל וְאֶבְי֑וֹן וְנַפְשׁ֖וֹת אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים יוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.translation: He will have pity on the poor and needy, And the souls of the needy he will save.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִתּ֣וֹךְ וּ֭מֵחָמָס יִגְאַ֣ל נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְיֵיקַ֖ר דָּמָ֣ם בְּעֵינָֽיו׃
verses.translit: mtvkh vmchms yg'l npshm vyyqr dmm b'ynyv
verses.translation: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence, And precious will their blood be in his sight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִיחִ֗י וְיִתֶּן־לוֹ֮ מִזְּהַ֢ב שְׁ֫בָ֥א וְיִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל בַּעֲד֣וֹ תָמִ֑יד כׇּל־הַ֝יּ֗וֹם יְבָרְכֶֽנְהוּ׃
verses.translit: vychy vytnlv mzhb shb' vytpll b'dv tmyd khlhyvm ybrkhnhv
verses.translation: That they may live, and that he may give them of the gold of Sheba, That they may pray for him continually, Yea, bless him all the day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהִ֤י פִסַּת־בַּ֨ר  בָּאָרֶץ֮ בְּרֹ֢אשׁ הָ֫רִ֥ים יִרְעַ֣שׁ כַּלְּבָנ֣וֹן פִּרְי֑וֹ וְיָצִ֥יצוּ מֵ֝עִ֗יר כְּעֵ֣שֶׂב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: yhy pstbr  b'rts br'sh hrym yr'sh khlbnvn pryv vytsytsv m'yr kh'shb h'rts
verses.translation: May he be as a rich cornfield in the land upon the top of the mountains; May his fruit rustle like Lebanon; And may they blossom out of the city like grass of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהִ֤י שְׁמ֨וֹ  לְֽעוֹלָ֗ם לִפְנֵי־שֶׁמֶשׁ֮ (ינין) [יִנּ֢וֹן] שְׁ֫מ֥וֹ וְיִתְבָּ֥רְכוּ ב֑וֹ כׇּל־גּוֹיִ֥ם יְאַשְּׁרֽוּהוּ׃
verses.translit: yhy shmv  l'vlm lpnyshmsh (ynyn) [ynvn] shmv vytbrkhv bv khlgvym y'shrvhv
verses.translation: May his name endure for ever; May his name be continued as long as the sun; May men also bless themselves by him; May all nations call him happy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּר֤וּךְ  יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עֹשֵׂ֖ה נִפְלָא֣וֹת לְבַדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, Who only doeth wondrous things;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָר֤וּךְ  שֵׁ֥ם כְּבוֹד֗וֹ לְע֫וֹלָ֥ם וְיִמָּלֵ֣א כְ֭בוֹדוֹ אֶת־כֹּ֥ל הָאָ֗רֶץ אָ֘מֵ֥ן ׀ וְאָמֵֽן׃
verses.translit: vbrvkh  shm khbvdv l'vlm vyml' khbvdv 'tkhl h'rts 'mn  v'mn
