verses.translation: And blessed be His glorious name for ever; And let the whole earth be filled with His glory. Amen, and Amen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּלּ֥וּ תְפִלּ֑וֹת דָּ֝וִ֗ד בֶּן־יִשָֽׁי׃
verses.translation: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אַ֤ךְ ט֖וֹב לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אֱלֹהִ֗ים לְבָרֵ֥י לֵבָֽב׃
verses.translit: mzmvr l'sf 'kh tvb lyshr'l 'lhym lbry lbb
verses.translation: A Psalm of Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, even to such as are pure in heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֗י כִּ֭מְעַט (נטוי) [נָטָ֣יוּ] רַגְלָ֑י כְּ֝אַ֗יִן (שפכה) [שֻׁפְּכ֥וּ] אֲשֻׁרָֽי׃
verses.translation: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־קִ֭נֵּאתִי בַּהוֹלְלִ֑ים שְׁל֖וֹם רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֶרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translation: For I was envious at the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֖ין חַרְצֻבּ֥וֹת לְמוֹתָ֗ם וּבָרִ֥יא אוּלָֽם׃
verses.translation: For there are no pangs at their death, and their body is sound.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּעֲמַ֣ל אֱנ֣וֹשׁ אֵינֵ֑מוֹ וְעִם־אָ֝דָ֗ם לֹ֣א יְנֻגָּֽעוּ׃
verses.translation: In the trouble of man they are not; neither are they plagued like men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֭כֵן עֲנָקַ֣תְמוֹ גַאֲוָ֑ה יַעֲטָף־שִׁ֝֗ית חָמָ֥ס לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translation: Therefore pride is as a chain about their neck; violence covereth them as a garment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָ֭צָא מֵחֵ֣לֶב עֵינֵ֑מוֹ עָ֝בְר֗וּ מַשְׂכִּיּ֥וֹת לֵבָֽב׃
verses.translation: Their eyes stand forth from fatness; they are gone beyond the imaginations of their heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָמִ֤יקוּ  וִידַבְּר֣וּ בְרָ֣ע עֹ֑שֶׁק מִמָּר֥וֹם יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.translation: They scoff, and in wickedness utter oppression; they speak as if there were none on high.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁתּ֣וּ בַשָּׁמַ֣יִם פִּיהֶ֑ם וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם תִּהֲלַ֥ךְ בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: shtv bshmym pyhm vlshvnm thlkh b'rts
verses.translation: They have set their mouth against the heavens, And their tongue walketh through the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֤ן  (ישיב) [יָשׁ֣וּב] עַמּ֣וֹ הֲלֹ֑ם וּמֵ֥י מָ֝לֵ֗א יִמָּ֥צוּ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: lkhn  (yshyb) [yshvb] 'mv hlm vmy ml' ymtsv lmv
verses.translation: Therefore His people return hither; And waters of fullness are drained out by them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאָמְר֗וּ אֵיכָ֥ה יָדַֽע־אֵ֑ל וְיֵ֖שׁ דֵּעָ֣ה בְעֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.translation: And they say: 'How doth God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּה־אֵ֥לֶּה רְשָׁעִ֑ים וְשַׁלְוֵ֥י ע֝וֹלָ֗ם הִשְׂגּוּ־חָֽיִל׃
verses.translation: Behold, such are the wicked; And they that are always at ease increase riches.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַךְ־רִ֭יק זִכִּ֣יתִי לְבָבִ֑י וָאֶרְחַ֖ץ בְּנִקָּי֣וֹן כַּפָּֽי׃
verses.translation: Surely in vain have I cleansed my heart, And washed my hands in innocency;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֱהִ֣י נָ֭גוּעַ כׇּל־הַיּ֑וֹם וְ֝תוֹכַחְתִּ֗י לַבְּקָרִֽים׃
verses.translation: For all the day have I been plagued, And my chastisement came every morning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אָ֭מַרְתִּי אֲסַפְּרָ֥ה כְמ֑וֹ הִנֵּ֤ה ד֖וֹר בָּנֶ֣יךָ בָגָֽדְתִּי׃
verses.translation: If I had said: 'I will speak thus', Behold, I had been faithless to the generation of Thy children.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָ֭אֲחַשְּׁבָה לָדַ֣עַת זֹ֑את עָמָ֖ל (היא) [ה֣וּא] בְעֵינָֽי׃
verses.translation: And when I pondered how I might know this, It was wearisome in mine eyes;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־אָ֭בוֹא אֶל־מִקְדְּשֵׁי־אֵ֑ל אָ֝בִ֗ינָה לְאַחֲרִיתָֽם׃
verses.translation: Until I entered into the sanctuary of God, And considered their end.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ בַּ֭חֲלָקוֹת תָּשִׁ֣ית לָ֑מוֹ הִ֝פַּלְתָּ֗ם לְמַשּׁוּאֽוֹת׃
verses.translation: Surely Thou settest them in slippery places; Thou hurlest them down to utter ruin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֤יךְ הָי֣וּ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה כְרָ֑גַע סָ֥פוּ תַ֝֗מּוּ מִן־בַּלָּהֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: 'ykh hyv lshmh khrg' spv tmv mnblhvt
verses.translation: How are they become a desolation in a moment! They are wholly consumed by terrors.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּחֲל֥וֹם מֵהָקִ֑יץ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י בָּעִ֤יר  צַלְמָ֬ם תִּבְזֶֽה׃
verses.translation: As a dream when one awaketh, So, O Lord, when Thou arousest Thyself, Thou wilt despise their semblance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֭י יִתְחַמֵּ֣ץ לְבָבִ֑י וְ֝כִלְיוֹתַ֗י אֶשְׁתּוֹנָֽן׃
verses.translation: For my heart was in a ferment, And I was pricked in my reins. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִי־בַ֭עַר וְלֹ֣א אֵדָ֑ע בְּ֝הֵמ֗וֹת הָיִ֥יתִי עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.translation: But I was brutish, and ignorant; I was as a beast before Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י תָמִ֣יד עִמָּ֑ךְ אָ֝חַ֗זְתָּ בְּיַד־יְמִינִֽי׃
verses.translation: Nevertheless I am continually with Thee; Thou holdest my right hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּעֲצָתְךָ֥ תַנְחֵ֑נִי וְ֝אַחַ֗ר כָּב֥וֹד תִּקָּחֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Thou wilt guide me with Thy counsel, And afterward receive me with glory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִי־לִ֥י בַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ֝עִמְּךָ֗ לֹא־חָפַ֥צְתִּי בָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translation: Whom have I in heaven but Thee? And beside Thee I desire none upon earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כָּלָ֥ה שְׁאֵרִ֗י וּלְבָ֫בִ֥י צוּר־לְבָבִ֥י וְחֶלְקִ֗י אֱלֹהִ֥ים לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: khlh sh'ry vlbby tsvrlbby vchlqy 'lhym l'vlm
verses.translation: My flesh and my heart faileth; But God is the rock of my heart and my portion for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֣ה רְחֵקֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ הִ֝צְמַ֗תָּה כׇּל־זוֹנֶ֥ה מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: khyhnh rchqykh y'bdv htsmth khlzvnh mmkh
verses.translation: For, lo, they that go far from Thee shall perish; Thou dost destroy all them that go astray from Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י  קִ֥רְבַ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֗ים לִ֫י־ט֥וֹב שַׁתִּ֤י  בַּאדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י לְ֝סַפֵּ֗ר כׇּל־מַלְאֲכוֹתֶֽיךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'ny  qrbt 'lhym lytvb shty  b'dny yhvh mchsy lspr khlml'khvtykh {p}
verses.translation: But as for me, the nearness of God is my good; I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, That I may tell of all Thy works.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשְׂכִּ֗יל לְאָ֫סָ֥ף לָמָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים זָנַ֣חְתָּ לָנֶ֑צַח יֶעְשַׁ֥ן אַ֝פְּךָ֗ בְּצֹ֣אן מַרְעִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: mshkhyl l'sf lmh 'lhym zncht lntsch y'shn 'pkh bts'n mr'ytkh
verses.translation: Maschil of Asaph. Why, O God, hast Thou cast us off for ever? Why doth Thine anger smoke against the flock of Thy pasture?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְכֹ֤ר עֲדָתְךָ֨  קָ֘נִ֤יתָ קֶּ֗דֶם גָּ֭אַלְתָּ שֵׁ֣בֶט נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ הַר־צִ֝יּ֗וֹן זֶ֤ה  שָׁכַ֬נְתָּ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: zkhr 'dtkh  qnyt qdm g'lt shbt nchltkh hrtsyvn zh  shkhnt bv
verses.translation: Remember Thy congregation, which Thou hast gotten of old, Which Thou hast redeemed to be the tribe of Thine inheritance; And mount Zion, wherein Thou hast dwelt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָרִ֣ימָה פְ֭עָמֶיךָ לְמַשֻּׁא֣וֹת נֶ֑צַח כׇּל־הֵרַ֖ע אוֹיֵ֣ב בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: hrymh p'mykh lmsh'vt ntsch khlhr' 'vyb bqdsh
verses.translation: Lift up Thy steps because of the perpetual ruins, Even all the evil that the enemy hath done in the sanctuary.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁאֲג֣וּ צֹ֭רְרֶיךָ בְּקֶ֣רֶב מוֹעֲדֶ֑ךָ שָׂ֖מוּ אוֹתֹתָ֣ם אֹתֽוֹת׃
verses.translation: Thine adversaries have roared in the midst of Thy meeting-place; They have set up their own signs for signs.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֭וָּדַע כְּמֵבִ֣יא לְמָ֑עְלָה בִּסְבׇךְ־עֵ֝֗ץ קַרְדֻּמּֽוֹת׃
verses.translation: It seemed as when men wield upwards Axes in a thicket of trees.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (ועת) [וְ֭עַתָּה] פִּתּוּחֶ֣יהָ יָּ֑חַד בְּכַשִּׁ֥יל וְ֝כֵילַפּ֗וֹת יַהֲלֹמֽוּן׃
verses.translation: And now all the carved work thereof together They strike down with hatchet and hammers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁלְח֣וּ בָ֭אֵשׁ מִקְדָּשֶׁ֑ךָ לָ֝אָ֗רֶץ חִלְּל֥וּ מִֽשְׁכַּן־שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: shlchv b'sh mqdshkh l'rts chllv mshkhnshmkh
verses.translation: They have set Thy sanctuary on fire; They have profaned the dwelling-place of Thy name even to the ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמְר֣וּ בְ֭לִבָּם נִינָ֣ם יָ֑חַד שָׂרְפ֖וּ כׇל־מוֹעֲדֵי־אֵ֣ל בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: 'mrv blbm nynm ychd shrpv khlmv'dy'l b'rts
verses.translation: They said in their heart: 'Let us make havoc of them altogether'; They have burned up all the meeting-places of God in the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֽוֹתֹתֵ֗ינוּ לֹ֥א־רָ֫אִ֥ינוּ אֵֽין־ע֥וֹד נָבִ֑יא וְלֹֽא־אִ֝תָּ֗נוּ יֹדֵ֥עַ עַד־מָֽה׃
verses.translation: We see not our signs; There is no more any prophet; Neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־מָתַ֣י אֱ֭לֹהִים יְחָ֣רֶף צָ֑ר יְנָ֘אֵ֤ץ אוֹיֵ֖ב שִׁמְךָ֣ לָנֶֽצַח׃
verses.translation: How long, O God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme Thy name for ever?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה תָשִׁ֣יב יָ֭דְךָ וִימִינֶ֑ךָ מִקֶּ֖רֶב (חוקך) [חֵיקְךָ֣] כַלֵּֽה׃
verses.translit: lmh tshyb ydkh vymynkh mqrb (chvqkh) [chyqkh] khlh
verses.translation: Why withdrawest Thou Thy hand, even Thy right hand? Draw it out of Thy bosom and consume them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וֵ֭אלֹהִים מַלְכִּ֣י מִקֶּ֑דֶם פֹּעֵ֥ל יְ֝שׁוּע֗וֹת בְּקֶ֣רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: v'lhym mlkhy mqdm p'l yshv'vt bqrb h'rts
verses.translation: Yet God is my King of old, Working salvation in the midst of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה פוֹרַ֣רְתָּ בְעׇזְּךָ֣ יָ֑ם שִׁבַּ֥רְתָּ רָאשֵׁ֥י תַ֝נִּינִ֗ים עַל־הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: 'th pvrrt b'zkh ym shbrt r'shy tnynym 'lhmym
verses.translation: Thou didst break the sea in pieces by Thy strength; Thou didst shatter the heads of the sea-monsters in the waters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה רִ֭צַּצְתָּ רָאשֵׁ֣י לִוְיָתָ֑ן תִּתְּנֶ֥נּוּ מַ֝אֲכָ֗ל לְעָ֣ם לְצִיִּֽים׃
verses.translit: 'th rtstst r'shy lvytn ttnnv m'khl l'm ltsyym
verses.translation: Thou didst crush the heads of leviathan, Thou gavest him to be food to the folk inhabiting the wilderness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה בָ֭קַעְתָּ מַעְיָ֣ן וָנָ֑חַל אַתָּ֥ה ה֝וֹבַ֗שְׁתָּ נַהֲר֥וֹת אֵיתָֽן׃
verses.translation: Thou didst cleave fountain and brook; Thou driedst up ever-flowing rivers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְךָ֣ י֭וֹם אַף־לְךָ֥ לָ֑יְלָה אַתָּ֥ה הֲ֝כִינ֗וֹתָ מָא֥וֹר וָשָֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: lkh yvm 'flkh lylh 'th hkhynvt m'vr vshmsh
verses.translation: Thine is the day, Thine also the night; Thou hast established luminary and sun.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה הִ֭צַּבְתָּ כׇּל־גְּבוּל֣וֹת אָ֑רֶץ קַ֥יִץ וָ֝חֹ֗רֶף אַתָּ֥ה יְצַרְתָּֽם׃
verses.translation: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth; Thou hast made summer and winter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְכׇר־זֹ֗את א֭וֹיֵב חֵרֵ֣ף ׀ יְהֹוָ֑ה וְעַ֥ם נָ֝בָ֗ל נִאֲצ֥וּ שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: zkhrz't 'vyb chrf  yhvh v'm nbl n'tsv shmkh
verses.translation: Remember this, how the enemy hath reproached the LORD, And how a base people have blasphemed Thy name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭חַיַּת נֶ֣פֶשׁ תּוֹרֶ֑ךָ חַיַּ֥ת עֲ֝נִיֶּ֗יךָ אַל־תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח לָנֶֽצַח׃
verses.translation: O deliver not the soul of Thy turtle-dove unto the wild beast; Forget not the life of Thy poor for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַבֵּ֥ט לַבְּרִ֑ית כִּ֥י מָלְא֥וּ מַחֲשַׁכֵּי־אֶ֝֗רֶץ נְא֣וֹת חָמָֽס׃
verses.translit: hbt lbryt khy ml'v mchshkhy'rts n'vt chms
verses.translation: Look upon the covenant; For the dark places of the land are full of the habitations of violence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־יָשֹׁ֣ב דַּ֣ךְ נִכְלָ֑ם עָנִ֥י וְ֝אֶבְי֗וֹן יְֽהַלְל֥וּ שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: O let not the oppressed turn back in confusion; Let the poor and needy praise Thy name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קוּמָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים רִיבָ֣ה רִיבֶ֑ךָ זְכֹ֥ר חֶרְפָּתְךָ֥ מִנִּי־נָ֝בָ֗ל כׇּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: qvmh 'lhym rybh rybkh zkhr chrptkh mnynbl khlhyvm
verses.translation: Arise, O God, plead Thine own cause; Remember Thy reproach all the day at the hand of the base man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּ֭שְׁכַּח ק֣וֹל צֹרְרֶ֑יךָ שְׁא֥וֹן קָ֝מֶ֗יךָ עֹלֶ֥ה תָמִֽיד׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Forget not the voice of Thine adversaries, The tumult of those that rise up against Thee which ascendeth continually.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אַל־תַּשְׁחֵ֑ת מִזְמ֖וֹר לְאָסָ֣ף שִֽׁיר׃
verses.translation: For the Leader; Al-tashheth. A Psalm of Asaph, a Song.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֘וֹדִ֤ינוּ לְּךָ֨  אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים ה֭וֹדִינוּ וְקָר֣וֹב שְׁמֶ֑ךָ סִ֝פְּר֗וּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: hvdynv lkh  'lhym hvdynv vqrvb shmkh sprv npl'vtykh
verses.translation: We give thanks unto Thee, O God, We give thanks, and Thy name is near; Men tell of Thy wondrous works.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֭י אֶקַּ֣ח מוֹעֵ֑ד אֲ֝נִ֗י מֵישָׁרִ֥ים אֶשְׁפֹּֽט׃
verses.translation: 'When I take the appointed time, I Myself will judge with equity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְֽמֹגִ֗ים אֶ֥רֶץ וְכׇל־יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ אָנֹכִ֨י תִכַּ֖נְתִּי עַמּוּדֶ֣יהָ סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.translation: When the earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved, I Myself establish the pillars of it.' Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמַ֣רְתִּי לַ֭הוֹלְלִים אַל־תָּהֹ֑לּוּ וְ֝לָרְשָׁעִ֗ים אַל־תָּרִ֥ימוּ קָֽרֶן׃
verses.translation: I say unto the arrogant 'Deal not arrogantly'; And to the wicked 'Lift not up the horn.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תָּרִ֣ימוּ לַמָּר֣וֹם קַרְנְכֶ֑ם תְּדַבְּר֖וּ בְצַוָּ֣אר עָתָֽק׃
verses.translation: Lift not up your horn on high; Speak not insolence with a haughty neck.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א מִ֭מּוֹצָא וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב וְ֝לֹ֗א מִמִּדְבַּ֥ר הָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy l' mmvts' vmm'rb vl' mmdbr hrym
verses.translation: For neither from the east, nor from the west, Nor yet from the wilderness, cometh lifting up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֥ים שֹׁפֵ֑ט זֶ֥ה יַ֝שְׁפִּ֗יל וְזֶ֣ה יָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy'lhym shpt zh yshpyl vzh yrym
verses.translation: For God is judge; He putteth down one, and lifteth up another.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י כ֪וֹס בְּֽיַד־יְהֹוָ֡ה וְיַ֤יִן חָמַ֨ר  מָ֥לֵא מֶסֶךְ֮ וַיַּגֵּ֢ר מִ֫זֶּ֥ה אַךְ־שְׁ֭מָרֶיהָ יִמְצ֣וּ יִשְׁתּ֑וּ כֹּ֝֗ל רִשְׁעֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: khy khvs bydyhvh vyyn chmr  ml' mskh vygr mzh 'khshmryh ymtsv yshtv khl rsh'y'rts
verses.translation: For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, with foaming wine, full of mixture, And He poureth out of the same; Surely the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall drain them, and drink them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭אֲנִי אַגִּ֣יד לְעֹלָ֑ם אֲ֝זַמְּרָ֗ה לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translation: But as for me, I will declare for ever, I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־קַרְנֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֲגַדֵּ֑עַ תְּ֝רוֹמַ֗מְנָה קַֽרְנ֥וֹת צַדִּֽיק׃ {פ}
verses.translation: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; But the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינֹ֑ת מִזְמ֖וֹר לְאָסָ֣ף שִֽׁיר׃
verses.translation: For the Leader; with string-music. A Psalm of Asaph, a Song.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נוֹדָ֣ע בִּיהוּדָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל גָּד֥וֹל שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: In Judah is God known; His name is great in Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י בְשָׁלֵ֣ם סוּכּ֑וֹ וּמְע֖וֹנָת֣וֹ בְצִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.translation: In Salem also is set His tabernacle, And His dwelling-place in Zion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֭מָּה שִׁבַּ֣ר רִשְׁפֵי־קָ֑שֶׁת מָגֵ֬ן וְחֶ֖רֶב וּמִלְחָמָ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: shmh shbr rshpyqsht mgn vchrb vmlchmh slh
verses.translation: There He broke the fiery shafts of the bow; The shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָ֭אוֹר אַתָּ֥ה אַדִּ֗יר מֵֽהַרְרֵי־טָֽרֶף׃
verses.translation: Glorious art Thou and excellent, coming down from the mountains of prey.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶשְׁתּֽוֹלְל֨וּ  אַבִּ֣ירֵי לֵ֭ב נָמ֣וּ שְׁנָתָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־מָצְא֖וּ כׇל־אַנְשֵׁי־חַ֣יִל יְדֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'shtvllv  'byry lb nmv shntm vl'mts'v khl'nshychyl ydyhm
verses.translation: The stout-hearted are bereft of sense, they sleep their sleep; And none of the men of might have found their hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֭גַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֑ב נִ֝רְדָּ֗ם וְרֶ֣כֶב וָסֽוּס׃
verses.translation: At Thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, They are cast into a dead sleep, the riders also and the horses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה  נ֥וֹרָא אַ֗תָּה וּמִֽי־יַעֲמֹ֥ד לְפָנֶ֗יךָ מֵאָ֥ז אַפֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Thou, even Thou, art terrible; And who may stand in Thy sight when once Thou art angry?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֭שָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמַ֣עְתָּ דִּ֑ין אֶ֖רֶץ יָֽרְאָ֣ה וְשָׁקָֽטָה׃
verses.translation: Thou didst cause sentence to be heard from heaven; The earth feared, and was still,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּקוּם־לַמִּשְׁפָּ֥ט אֱלֹהִ֑ים לְהוֹשִׁ֖יעַ כׇּל־עַנְוֵי־אֶ֣רֶץ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translation: When God arose to judgment, To save all the humble of the earth. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־חֲמַ֣ת אָדָ֣ם תּוֹדֶ֑ךָּ שְׁאֵרִ֖ית חֵמֹ֣ת תַּחְגֹּֽר׃
verses.translation: Surely the wrath of man shall praise Thee; The residue of wrath shalt Thou gird upon Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִ֥דְר֣וּ וְשַׁלְּמוּ֮ לַיהֹוָ֢ה אֱֽלֹהֵ֫יכֶ֥ם כׇּל־סְבִיבָ֑יו יֹבִ֥ילוּ שַׁ֝֗י לַמּוֹרָֽא׃
verses.translit: ndrv vshlmv lyhvh 'lhykhm khlsbybyv ybylv shy lmvr'
verses.translation: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God; Let all that are round about Him bring presents unto Him that is to be feared;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֭בְצֹר ר֣וּחַ נְגִידִ֑ים נ֝וֹרָ֗א לְמַלְכֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: He minisheth the spirit of princes; He is terrible to the kings of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־[יְדוּת֗וּן] (ידיתון) לְאָסָ֥ף מִזְמֽוֹר׃
verses.translation: For the Leader; for Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קוֹלִ֣י אֶל־אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאֶצְעָ֑קָה קוֹלִ֥י אֶל־אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים וְהַאֲזִ֥ין אֵלָֽי׃
verses.translation: I will lift up my voice unto God, an cry; I will lift up my voice unto God, that He may give ear unto me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּי֥וֹם צָרָתִי֮ אֲדֹנָ֢י דָּ֫רָ֥שְׁתִּי יָדִ֤י  לַ֣יְלָה נִ֭גְּרָה וְלֹ֣א תָפ֑וּג מֵאֲנָ֖ה הִנָּחֵ֣ם נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: byvm tsrty 'dny drshty ydy  lylh ngrh vl' tpvg m'nh hnchm npshy
verses.translation: In the day of my trouble I seek the Lord; With my hand uplifted, [mine eye] streameth in the night without ceasing; My soul refuseth to be comforted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶזְכְּרָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאֶהֱמָ֑יָה אָשִׂ֓יחָה  וְתִתְעַטֵּ֖ף רוּחִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translation: When I think thereon, O God, I must moan; When I muse thereon, my spirit fainteth. Selah .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֭חַזְתָּ שְׁמֻר֣וֹת עֵינָ֑י נִ֝פְעַ֗מְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אֲדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.translation: Thou holdest fast the lids of mine eyes; I am troubled, and cannot speak.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חִשַּׁ֣בְתִּי יָמִ֣ים מִקֶּ֑דֶם שְׁ֝נ֗וֹת עוֹלָמִֽים׃
verses.translation: I have pondered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֥זְכְּרָ֥ה נְגִינָתִ֗י בַּ֫לָּ֥יְלָה עִם־לְבָבִ֥י אָשִׂ֑יחָה וַיְחַפֵּ֥שׂ רוּחִֽי׃
verses.translation: In the night I will call to remembrance my song; I will commune with mine own heart; And my spirit maketh diligent search
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽ֭לְעוֹלָמִים יִזְנַ֥ח ׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י וְלֹא־יֹסִ֖יף לִרְצ֣וֹת עֽוֹד׃
verses.translation: 'Will the Lord cast off for ever? And will He be favourable no more?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶאָפֵ֣ס לָנֶ֣צַח חַסְדּ֑וֹ גָּ֥מַר אֹ֝֗מֶר לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.translit: h'ps lntsch chsdv gmr 'mr ldr vdr
verses.translation: Is His mercy clean gone for ever? Is His promise come to an end for evermore?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲשָׁכַ֣ח חַנּ֣וֹת אֵ֑ל אִם־קָפַ֥ץ בְּ֝אַ֗ף רַחֲמָ֥יו סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translation: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? Hath He in anger shut up his compassions?' Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָ֭אֹמַר חַלּ֣וֹתִי הִ֑יא שְׁ֝נ֗וֹת יְמִ֣ין עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.translation: And I say 'This is my weakness, That the right hand of the Most High could change.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (אזכיר) [אֶזְכּ֥וֹר] מַעַלְלֵי־יָ֑הּ כִּֽי־אֶזְכְּרָ֖ה מִקֶּ֣דֶם פִּלְאֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: I will make mention of the deeds of the LORD; Yea, I will remember Thy wonders of old.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָגִ֥יתִי בְכׇל־פׇּעֳלֶ֑ךָ וּֽבַעֲלִ֖ילוֹתֶ֣יךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה׃
verses.translation: I will meditate also upon all Thy work, And muse on Thy doings.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים בַּקֹּ֣דֶשׁ דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ מִי־אֵ֥ל גָּ֝ד֗וֹל כֵּאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translation: O God, Thy way is in holiness; Who is a great god like unto God?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה הָ֭אֵל עֹ֣שֵׂה פֶ֑לֶא הוֹדַ֖עְתָּ בָעַמִּ֣ים עֻזֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Thou art the God that doest wonders; Thou hast made known Thy strength among the peoples.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גָּאַ֣לְתָּ בִּזְר֣וֹעַ עַמֶּ֑ךָ בְּנֵֽי־יַעֲקֹ֖ב וְיוֹסֵ֣ף סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translation: Thou hast with Thine arm redeemed Thy people, The sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָ֘א֤וּךָ מַּ֨יִם  אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים רָא֣וּךָ מַּ֣יִם יָחִ֑ילוּ אַ֝֗ף יִרְגְּז֥וּ תְהֹמֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: r'vkh mym  'lhym r'vkh mym ychylv 'f yrgzv thmvt
verses.translation: The waters saw Thee, O God; The waters saw Thee, they were in pain; The depths also trembled.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֤רְמוּ מַ֨יִם  עָב֗וֹת ק֭וֹל נָתְנ֣וּ שְׁחָקִ֑ים אַף־חֲ֝צָצֶ֗יךָ יִתְהַלָּֽכוּ׃
verses.translit: zrmv mym  'bvt qvl ntnv shchqym 'fchtstsykh ythlkhv
verses.translation: The clouds flooded forth waters; The skies sent out a sound; Thine arrows also went abroad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֤וֹל רַעַמְךָ֨  בַּגַּלְגַּ֗ל הֵאִ֣ירוּ בְרָקִ֣ים תֵּבֵ֑ל רָגְזָ֖ה וַתִּרְעַ֣שׁ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: qvl r'mkh  bglgl h'yrv brqym tbl rgzh vtr'sh h'rts
verses.translation: The voice of Thy thunder was in the whirlwind; The lightnings lighted up the world; The earth trembled and shook.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיָּ֤ם דַּרְכֶּ֗ךָ (ושביליך) [וּֽ֭שְׁבִילְךָ] בְּמַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝עִקְּבוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א נֹדָֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: bym drkhkh (vshbylykh) [vshbylkh] bmym rbym v'qbvtykh l' nd'v
verses.translation: Thy way was in the sea, And Thy path in the great waters, And Thy footsteps were not known.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָחִ֣יתָ כַצֹּ֣אן עַמֶּ֑ךָ בְּֽיַד־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Thou didst lead Thy people like a flock, By the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשְׂכִּ֗יל לְאָ֫סָ֥ף הַאֲזִ֣ינָה עַ֭מִּי תּוֹרָתִ֑י הַטּ֥וּ אׇ֝זְנְכֶ֗ם לְאִמְרֵי־פִֽי׃
verses.translit: mshkhyl l'sf h'zynh 'my tvrty htv 'znkhm l'mrypy
verses.translation: Maschil of Asaph. Give ear, O my people, to my teaching; Incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶפְתְּחָ֣ה בְמָשָׁ֣ל פִּ֑י אַבִּ֥יעָה חִ֝יד֗וֹת מִנִּי־קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.translation: I will open my mouth with a parable; I will utter dark sayings concerning days of old;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁ֭מַעְנוּ וַנֵּדָעֵ֑ם וַ֝אֲבוֹתֵ֗ינוּ סִפְּרוּ־לָֽנוּ׃
verses.translation: That which we have heard and known, And our fathers have told us,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֤א נְכַחֵ֨ד  מִבְּנֵיהֶ֗ם לְד֥וֹר אַחֲר֗וֹן מְֽ֭סַפְּרִים תְּהִלּ֣וֹת יְהֹוָ֑ה וֶעֱזוּז֥וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאֹתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.translit: l' nkhchd  mbnyhm ldvr 'chrvn msprym thlvt yhvh v'zvzv vnpl'tyv 'shr 'shh
verses.translation: We will not hide from their children, Telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, And His strength, and His wondrous works that He hath done. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֤קֶם עֵד֨וּת  בְּֽיַעֲקֹ֗ב וְתוֹרָה֮ שָׂ֤ם בְּיִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִ֭וָּה אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵ֑ינוּ לְ֝הוֹדִיעָ֗ם לִבְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyqm 'dvt  by'qb vtvrh shm byshr'l 'shr tsvh 't'bvtynv lhvdy'm lbnyhm
verses.translation: For He established a testimony in Jacob, And appointed a law in Israel, Which He commanded our fathers, That they should make them known to their children;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן יֵדְע֨וּ  דּ֣וֹר אַ֭חֲרוֹן בָּנִ֣ים יִוָּלֵ֑דוּ יָ֝קֻ֗מוּ וִיסַפְּר֥וּ לִבְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: lm'n yd'v  dvr 'chrvn bnym yvldv yqmv vysprv lbnyhm
verses.translation: That the generation to come might know them, even the children that should be born; Who should arise and tell them to their children,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָשִׂ֥ימוּ בֵאלֹהִ֗ים כִּ֫סְלָ֥ם וְלֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁכְּחוּ מַ֥עַלְלֵי־אֵ֑ל וּמִצְוֺתָ֥יו יִנְצֹֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: vyshymv b'lhym khslm vl' yshkhchv m'lly'l vmtsvtyv yntsrv
verses.translation: That they might put their confidence in God, And not forget the works of God, But keep His commandments;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א יִהְי֨וּ  כַּאֲבוֹתָ֗ם דּוֹר֮ סוֹרֵ֢ר וּמֹ֫רֶ֥ה דּ֭וֹר לֹא־הֵכִ֣ין לִבּ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־נֶאֶמְנָ֖ה אֶת־אֵ֣ל רוּחֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vl' yhyv  kh'bvtm dvr svrr vmrh dvr l'hkhyn lbv vl'n'mnh 't'l rvchv
verses.translation: And might not be as their fathers, A stubborn and rebellious generation; A generation that set not their heart aright, And whose spirit was not stedfast with God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּֽנֵי־אֶפְרַ֗יִם נוֹשְׁקֵ֥י רֽוֹמֵי־קָ֑שֶׁת הָ֝פְכ֗וּ בְּי֣וֹם קְרָֽב׃
verses.translit: bny'prym nvshqy rvmyqsht hpkhv byvm qrb
verses.translation: The children of Ephraim were as archers handling the bow, That turned back in the day of battle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א שָׁ֭מְרוּ בְּרִ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים וּ֝בְתוֹרָת֗וֹ מֵאֲנ֥וּ לָלֶֽכֶת׃
verses.translit: l' shmrv bryt 'lhym vbtvrtv m'nv llkht
verses.translation: They kept not the covenant of God, And refused to walk in His law;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכְּח֥וּ עֲלִילוֹתָ֑יו וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶרְאָֽם׃
verses.translation: And they forgot His doings, And His wondrous works that He had shown them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֶ֣גֶד אֲ֭בוֹתָם עָ֣שָׂה פֶ֑לֶא בְּאֶ֖רֶץ מִצְרַ֣יִם שְׂדֵה־צֹֽעַן׃
verses.translation: Marvellous things did He in the sight of their fathers, In the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּ֣קַע יָ֭ם וַיַּעֲבִירֵ֑ם וַֽיַּצֶּב־מַ֥יִם כְּמוֹ־נֵֽד׃
verses.translation: He cleaved the sea, and caused them to pass through; And He made the waters to stand as a heap.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּנְחֵ֣ם בֶּעָנָ֣ן יוֹמָ֑ם וְכׇל־הַ֝לַּ֗יְלָה בְּא֣וֹר אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translation: By day also He led them with a cloud, And all the night with a light of fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְבַקַּ֣ע צֻ֭רִים בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַ֝יַּ֗שְׁקְ כִּתְהֹמ֥וֹת רַבָּֽה׃
verses.translit: ybq' tsrym bmdbr vyshq khthmvt rbh
verses.translation: He cleaved rocks in the wilderness, And gave them drink abundantly as out of the great deep.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּוֹצִ֣א נוֹזְלִ֣ים מִסָּ֑לַע וַיּ֖וֹרֶד כַּנְּהָר֣וֹת מָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vyvts' nvzlym msl' vyvrd khnhrvt mym
verses.translation: He brought streams also out of the rock, And caused waters to run down like rivers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּוֹסִ֣יפוּ ע֭וֹד לַחֲטֹא־ל֑וֹ לַֽמְר֥וֹת עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן בַּצִּיָּֽה׃
verses.translation: Yet went they on still to sin against Him, To rebel against the Most High in the desert.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְנַסּוּ־אֵ֥ל בִּלְבָבָ֑ם לִֽשְׁאׇל־אֹ֥כֶל לְנַפְשָֽׁם׃
verses.translation: And they tried God in their heart By asking food for their craving.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְדַבְּר֗וּ בֵּאלֹ֫הִ֥ים אָ֭מְרוּ הֲי֣וּכַל אֵ֑ל לַעֲרֹ֥ךְ שֻׁ֝לְחָ֗ן בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbrv b'lhym 'mrv hyvkhl 'l l'rkh shlchn bmdbr
verses.translation: Yea, they spoke against God; They said 'Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֤ן הִכָּה־צ֨וּר  וַיָּז֣וּבוּ מַיִם֮ וּנְחָלִ֢ים יִ֫שְׁטֹ֥פוּ הֲגַם־לֶ֭חֶם י֣וּכַל תֵּ֑ת אִם־יָכִ֖ין שְׁאֵ֣ר לְעַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hn hkhhtsvr  vyzvbv mym vnchlym yshtpv hgmlchm yvkhl tt 'mykhyn sh'r l'mv
verses.translation: Behold, He smote the rock, that waters gushed out, And streams overflowed; Can He give bread also? Or will He provide flesh for His people?'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֤ן  שָׁמַ֥ע יְהֹוָ֗ה וַֽיִּתְעַ֫בָּ֥ר וְ֭אֵשׁ נִשְּׂקָ֣ה בְיַעֲקֹ֑ב וְגַם־אַ֝֗ף עָלָ֥ה בְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: lkhn  shm' yhvh vyt'br v'sh nshqh by'qb vgm'f 'lh byshr'l
verses.translation: Therefore the LORD heard, and was wroth; And a fire was kindled against Jacob, And anger also went up against Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א הֶ֭אֱמִינוּ בֵּאלֹהִ֑ים וְלֹ֥א בָ֝טְח֗וּ בִּישׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy l' h'mynv b'lhym vl' btchv byshv'tv
verses.translation: Because they believed not in God, And trusted not in His salvation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַ֣ו שְׁחָקִ֣ים מִמָּ֑עַל וְדַלְתֵ֖י שָׁמַ֣יִם פָּתָֽח׃
verses.translit: vytsv shchqym mm'l vdlty shmym ptch
verses.translation: And He commanded the skies above, And opened the doors of heaven;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּמְטֵ֬ר עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מָ֣ן לֶאֱכֹ֑ל וּדְגַן־שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם נָ֣תַן לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: vymtr 'lyhm mn l'khl vdgnshmym ntn lmv
verses.translation: And He caused manna to rain upon them for food, And gave them of the corn of heaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֶ֣חֶם אַ֭בִּירִים אָ֣כַל אִ֑ישׁ צֵידָ֬ה שָׁלַ֖ח לָהֶ֣ם לָשֹֽׂבַע׃
verses.translation: Man did eat the bread of the mighty; He sent them provisions to the full.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַסַּ֣ע קָ֭דִים בַּשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַיְנַהֵ֖ג בְּעֻזּ֣וֹ תֵימָֽן׃
verses.translit: ys' qdym bshmym vynhg b'zv tymn
verses.translation: He caused the east wind to set forth in heaven; And by His power He brought on the south wind.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּמְטֵ֬ר עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם כֶּעָפָ֣ר שְׁאֵ֑ר וּֽכְח֥וֹל יַ֝מִּ֗ים ע֣וֹף כָּנָֽף׃
verses.translit: vymtr 'lyhm kh'pr sh'r vkhchvl ymym 'vf khnf
verses.translation: He caused flesh also to rain upon them as the dust, And winged fowl as the sand of the seas;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭יַּפֵּל בְּקֶ֣רֶב מַחֲנֵ֑הוּ סָ֝בִ֗יב לְמִשְׁכְּנֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translation: And He let it fall in the midst of their camp, Round about their dwellings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאכְל֣וּ וַיִּשְׂבְּע֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וְ֝תַאֲוָתָ֗ם יָבִ֥א לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'khlv vyshb'v m'd vt'vtm yb' lhm
verses.translation: So they did eat, and were well filled; And He gave them that which they craved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־זָ֥רוּ מִתַּאֲוָתָ֑ם ע֝֗וֹד אׇכְלָ֥ם בְּפִיהֶֽם׃
verses.translation: They were not estranged from their craving, Their food was yet in their mouths,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַ֤ף אֱלֹהִ֨ים  עָ֘לָ֤ה בָהֶ֗ם וַֽ֭יַּהֲרֹג בְּמִשְׁמַנֵּיהֶ֑ם וּבַחוּרֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל הִכְרִֽיעַ׃
verses.translit: v'f 'lhym  'lh bhm vyhrg bmshmnyhm vbchvry yshr'l hkhry'
verses.translation: When the anger of God went up against them, And slew of the lustieth among them, And smote down the young men of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּכׇל־זֹ֥את חָֽטְאוּ־ע֑וֹד וְלֹֽא־הֶ֝אֱמִ֗ינוּ בְּנִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translation: For all this they sinned still, And believed not in His wondrous works.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְכַל־בַּהֶ֥בֶל יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וּ֝שְׁנוֹתָ֗ם בַּבֶּהָלָֽה׃
verses.translation: Therefore He ended their days as a breath, And their years in terror.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־הֲרָגָ֥ם וּדְרָשׁ֑וּהוּ וְ֝שָׁ֗בוּ וְשִֽׁחֲרוּ־אֵֽל׃
verses.translation: When He slew them, then they would inquire after Him, And turn back and seek God earnestly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽ֭יִּזְכְּרוּ כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֣ים צוּרָ֑ם וְאֵ֥ל עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן גֹּאֲלָֽם׃
verses.translation: And they remembered that God was their Rock, And the Most High God their redeemer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְפַתּ֥וּהוּ בְּפִיהֶ֑ם וּ֝בִלְשׁוֹנָ֗ם יְכַזְּבוּ־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: But they beguiled Him with their mouth, And lied unto Him with their tongue.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭לִבָּם לֹא־נָכ֣וֹן עִמּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א נֶ֝אֶמְנ֗וּ בִּבְרִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: For their heart was not stedfast with Him, Neither were they faithful in His covenant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְה֤וּא רַח֨וּם  יְכַפֵּ֥ר עָוֺן֮ וְֽלֹא־יַֽ֫שְׁחִ֥ית וְ֭הִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁ֣יב אַפּ֑וֹ וְלֹא־יָ֝עִ֗יר כׇּל־חֲמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhv' rchvm  ykhpr 'vn vl'yshchyt vhrbh lhshyb 'pv vl'y'yr khlchmtv
verses.translation: But He, being full of compassion, forgiveth iniquity, and destroyeth not; Yea, many a time doth He turn His anger away, And doth not stir up all His wrath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭יִּזְכֹּר כִּֽי־בָשָׂ֣ר הֵ֑מָּה ר֥וּחַ ה֝וֹלֵ֗ךְ וְלֹ֣א יָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.translit: vyzkhr khybshr hmh rvch hvlkh vl' yshvb
verses.translation: So He remembered that they were but flesh, A wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּ֭מָּה יַמְר֣וּהוּ בַמִּדְבָּ֑ר יַ֝עֲצִיב֗וּהוּ בִּישִׁימֽוֹן׃
verses.translation: How oft did they rebel against Him in the wilderness, And grieve Him in the desert!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּשׁ֣וּבוּ וַיְנַסּ֣וּ אֵ֑ל וּקְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל הִתְוֽוּ׃
verses.translation: And still again they tried God, And set bounds to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־זָכְר֥וּ אֶת־יָד֑וֹ י֝֗וֹם אֲֽשֶׁר־פָּדָ֥ם מִנִּי־צָֽר׃
verses.translation: They remembered not His hand, Nor the day when He redeemed them from the adversary.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֣ם בְּ֭מִצְרַיִם אֹתוֹתָ֑יו וּ֝מוֹפְתָ֗יו בִּשְׂדֵה־צֹֽעַן׃
verses.translation: How He set His signs in Egypt, And His wonders in the field of Zoan; .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּהֲפֹ֣ךְ לְ֭דָם יְאֹרֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝נֹזְלֵיהֶ֗ם בַּל־יִשְׁתָּיֽוּן׃
verses.translation: And turned their rivers into blood, So that they could not drink their streams.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְשַׁלַּ֬ח בָּהֶ֣ם עָ֭רֹב וַיֹּאכְלֵ֑ם וּ֝צְפַרְדֵּ֗עַ וַתַּשְׁחִיתֵֽם׃
verses.translation: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; And frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לֶחָסִ֣יל יְבוּלָ֑ם וִ֝יגִיעָ֗ם לָאַרְבֶּֽה׃
verses.translation: He gave also their increase unto the caterpillar, And their labour unto the locust.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַהֲרֹ֣ג בַּבָּרָ֣ד גַּפְנָ֑ם וְ֝שִׁקְמוֹתָ֗ם בַּחֲנָמַֽל׃
verses.translation: He destroyed their vines with hail, And their sycamore-trees with frost.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּסְגֵּ֣ר לַבָּרָ֣ד בְּעִירָ֑ם וּ֝מִקְנֵיהֶ֗ם לָרְשָׁפִֽים׃
verses.translation: He gave over their cattle also to the hail, And their flocks to fiery bolts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְשַׁלַּח־בָּ֨ם  חֲר֬וֹן אַפּ֗וֹ עֶבְרָ֣ה וָזַ֣עַם וְצָרָ֑ה מִ֝שְׁלַ֗חַת מַלְאֲכֵ֥י רָעִֽים׃
verses.translit: yshlchbm  chrvn 'pv 'brh vz'm vtsrh mshlcht ml'khy r'ym
verses.translation: He sent forth upon them the fierceness of His anger, Wrath, and indignation, and trouble, A sending of messengers of evil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְפַלֵּ֥ס נָתִ֗יב לְאַ֫פּ֥וֹ לֹא־חָשַׂ֣ךְ מִמָּ֣וֶת נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְ֝חַיָּתָ֗ם לַדֶּ֥בֶר הִסְגִּֽיר׃
verses.translit: ypls ntyb l'pv l'chshkh mmvt npshm vchytm ldbr hsgyr
verses.translation: He levelled a path for His anger; He spared not their soul from death, But gave their life over to the pestilence;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣ךְ כׇּל־בְּכ֣וֹר בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם רֵאשִׁ֥ית א֝וֹנִ֗ים בְּאׇהֳלֵי־חָֽם׃
verses.translation: And smote all the first-born in Egypt, The first-fruits of their strength in the tents of Ham;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּסַּ֣ע כַּצֹּ֣אן עַמּ֑וֹ וַֽיְנַהֲגֵ֥ם כַּ֝עֵ֗דֶר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.translation: But He made His own people to go forth like sheep, And guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּנְחֵ֣ם לָ֭בֶטַח וְלֹ֣א פָחָ֑דוּ וְאֶת־א֝וֹיְבֵיהֶ֗ם כִּסָּ֥ה הַיָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vynchm lbtch vl' pchdv v't'vybyhm khsh hym
verses.translation: And He led them safely, and they feared not; But the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭יְבִיאֵם אֶל־גְּב֣וּל קׇדְשׁ֑וֹ הַר־זֶ֝֗ה קָנְתָ֥ה יְמִינֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: And He brought them to His holy border, To the mountain, which His right hand had gotten.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְגָ֤רֶשׁ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֨ם  גּוֹיִ֗ם וַֽ֭יַּפִּילֵם בְּחֶ֣בֶל נַחֲלָ֑ה וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֥ן בְּ֝אׇהֳלֵיהֶ֗ם שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vygrsh mpnyhm  gvym vypylm bchbl nchlh vyshkhn b'hlyhm shbty yshr'l
verses.translation: He drove out the nations also before them, And allotted them for an inheritance by line, And made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְנַסּ֣וּ וַ֭יַּמְרוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהִ֣ים עֶלְי֑וֹן וְ֝עֵדוֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א שָׁמָֽרוּ׃
verses.translation: Yet they tried and provoked God, the Most High, And kept not His testimonies;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסֹּ֣גוּ וַֽ֭יִּבְגְּדוּ כַּאֲבוֹתָ֑ם נֶ֝הְפְּכ֗וּ כְּקֶ֣שֶׁת רְמִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vysgv vybgdv kh'bvtm nhpkhv khqsht rmyh
verses.translation: But turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers; They were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּכְעִיס֥וּהוּ בְּבָמוֹתָ֑ם וּ֝בִפְסִילֵיהֶ֗ם יַקְנִיאֽוּהוּ׃
verses.translation: For they provoked Him with their high places, And moved Him to jealousy with their graven images.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣ע אֱ֭לֹהִים וַֽיִּתְעַבָּ֑ר וַיִּמְאַ֥ס מְ֝אֹ֗ד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translation: God heard, and was wroth, And He greatly abhorred Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.translation: And He forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, The tent which He had made to dwell among men;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לַשְּׁבִ֣י עֻזּ֑וֹ וְֽתִפְאַרְתּ֥וֹ בְיַד־צָֽר׃
verses.translation: And delivered His strength into captivity, And His glory into the adversary's hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּסְגֵּ֣ר לַחֶ֣רֶב עַמּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְנַחֲלָת֗וֹ הִתְעַבָּֽר׃
verses.translation: He gave His people over also unto the sword; And was wroth with His inheritance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּחוּרָ֥יו אָכְלָה־אֵ֑שׁ וּ֝בְתוּלֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א הוּלָּֽלוּ׃
verses.translation: Fire devoured their young men; And their virgins had no marriage-song.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֭הֲנָיו בַּחֶ֣רֶב נָפָ֑לוּ וְ֝אַלְמְנֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִבְכֶּֽינָה׃
verses.translit: khhnyv bchrb nplv v'lmntyv l' tbkhynh
verses.translation: Their priests fell by the sword; And their widows made no lamentation. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַ֖ץ כְּיָשֵׁ֥ן ׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י כְּ֝גִבּ֗וֹר מִתְרוֹנֵ֥ן מִיָּֽיִן׃
verses.translation: Then the Lord awaked as one asleep, Like a mighty man recovering from wine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּךְ־צָרָ֥יו אָח֑וֹר חֶרְפַּ֥ת ע֝וֹלָ֗ם נָ֣תַן לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translation: And He smote His adversaries backward; He put upon them a perpetual reproach.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭יִּמְאַס בְּאֹ֣הֶל יוֹסֵ֑ף וּֽבְשֵׁ֥בֶט אֶ֝פְרַ֗יִם לֹ֣א בָחָֽר׃
verses.translit: vym's b'hl yvsf vbshbt 'prym l' bchr
verses.translation: Moreover He abhorred the tent of Joseph, And chose not the tribe of Ephraim;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭יִּבְחַר אֶת־שֵׁ֣בֶט יְהוּדָ֑ה אֶֽת־הַ֥ר צִ֝יּ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהֵֽב׃
verses.translation: But chose the tribe of Judah, The mount Zion which He loved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֣בֶן כְּמֽוֹ־רָ֭מִים מִקְדָּשׁ֑וֹ כְּ֝אֶ֗רֶץ יְסָדָ֥הּ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vybn khmvrmym mqdshv kh'rts ysdh l'vlm
verses.translation: And He built His sanctuary like the heights, Like the earth which He hath founded for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭יִּבְחַר בְּדָוִ֣ד עַבְדּ֑וֹ וַ֝יִּקָּחֵ֗הוּ מִֽמִּכְלְאֹ֥ת צֹֽאן׃
verses.translation: He chose David also His servant, And took him from the sheepfolds;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵאַחַ֥ר עָל֗וֹת הֱבִ֫יא֥וֹ לִ֭רְעוֹת בְּיַעֲקֹ֣ב עַמּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: m'chr 'lvt hby'v lr'vt by'qb 'mv vbyshr'l nchltv
verses.translation: From following the ewes that give suck He brought him, To be shepherd over Jacob His people, and Israel His inheritance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭יִּרְעֵם כְּתֹ֣ם לְבָב֑וֹ וּבִתְבוּנ֖וֹת כַּפָּ֣יו יַנְחֵֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyr'm khtm lbbv vbtbvnvt khpyv ynchm {p}
verses.translation: So he shepherded them according to the integrity of his heart; And lead them by the skilfulness of his hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֱֽלֹהִ֡ים בָּ֤אוּ גוֹיִ֨ם  בְּֽנַחֲלָתֶ֗ךָ טִ֭מְּאוּ אֶת־הֵיכַ֣ל קׇדְשֶׁ֑ךָ שָׂ֖מוּ אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ֣͏ִם לְעִיִּֽים׃
verses.translit: mzmvr l'sf 'lhym b'v gvym  bnchltkh tm'v 'thykhl qdshkh shmv 'tyrvshl͏m l'yym
verses.translation: A Psalm of Asaph. O God, the heathen are come into Thine inheritance; They have defiled Thy holy temple; They have made Jerusalem into heaps.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָתְנ֡וּ אֶת־נִבְלַ֬ת עֲבָדֶ֗יךָ מַ֭אֲכָל לְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם בְּשַׂ֥ר חֲ֝סִידֶ֗יךָ לְחַיְתוֹ־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: ntnv 'tnblt 'bdykh m'khl l'vf hshmym bshr chsydykh lchytv'rts
verses.translation: They have given the dead bodies of Thy servants to be food unto the fowls of the heaven, The flesh of Thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁפְכ֬וּ דָמָ֨ם  כַּמַּ֗יִם סְֽבִ֘יב֤וֹת יְֽרוּשָׁלָ֗͏ִם וְאֵ֣ין קוֹבֵֽר׃
verses.translit: shpkhv dmm  khmym sbybvt yrvshl͏m v'yn qvbr
verses.translation: They have shed their blood like water Round about Jerusalem, with none to bury them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָיִ֣ינוּ חֶ֭רְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ לַ֥עַג וָ֝קֶ֗לֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: hyynv chrph lshkhnynv l'g vqls lsbybvtynv
verses.translation: We are become a taunt to our neighbours, A scorn and derision to them that are round about us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־מָ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה תֶּאֱנַ֣ף לָנֶ֑צַח תִּֽבְעַ֥ר כְּמוֹ־אֵ֝֗שׁ קִנְאָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: 'dmh yhvh t'nf lntsch tb'r khmv'sh qn'tkh
verses.translation: How long, O LORD, wilt Thou be angry for ever? How long will Thy jealousy burn like fire?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁפֹ֤ךְ חֲמָתְךָ֗ אֶֽל־הַגּוֹיִם֮ אֲשֶׁ֢ר לֹא־יְדָ֫ע֥וּךָ וְעַ֥ל מַמְלָכ֑וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ֗ לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: shpkh chmtkh 'lhgvym 'shr l'yd'vkh v'l mmlkhvt 'shr bshmkh l' qr'v
verses.translation: Pour out Thy wrath upon the nations that know Thee not, And upon the kingdoms that call not upon Thy name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֭י אָכַ֣ל אֶֽת־יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְֽאֶת־נָוֵ֥הוּ הֵשַֽׁמּוּ׃
verses.translation: For they have devoured Jacob, And laid waste his habitation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַֽל־תִּזְכׇּר־לָנוּ֮ עֲוֺנֹ֢ת רִאשֹׁ֫נִ֥ים מַ֭הֵר יְקַדְּמ֣וּנוּ רַחֲמֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י דַלּ֣וֹנוּ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: 'ltzkhrlnv 'vnt r'shnym mhr yqdmvnv rchmykh khy dlvnv m'd
verses.translation: Remember not against us the iniquities of our forefathers; Let Thy compassions speedily come to meet us; For we are brought very low.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עׇזְרֵ֤נוּ  אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׁעֵ֗נוּ עַֽל־דְּבַ֥ר כְּבֽוֹד־שְׁמֶ֑ךָ וְהַצִּילֵ֥נוּ וְכַפֵּ֥ר עַל־חַ֝טֹּאתֵ֗ינוּ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: 'zrnv  'lhy ysh'nv 'ldbr khbvdshmkh vhtsylnv vkhpr 'lcht'tynv lm'n shmkh
verses.translation: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the sake of the glory of Thy name; And deliver us, and forgive our sins, for Thy name's sake.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה  יֹאמְר֣וּ הַגּוֹיִם֮ אַיֵּ֢ה אֱֽלֹהֵ֫יהֶ֥ם יִוָּדַ֣ע (בגיים) [בַּגּוֹיִ֣ם] לְעֵינֵ֑ינוּ נִ֝קְמַ֗ת דַּֽם־עֲבָדֶ֥יךָ הַשָּׁפֽוּךְ׃
verses.translit: lmh  y'mrv hgvym 'yh 'lhyhm yvd' (bgyym) [bgvym] l'ynynv nqmt dm'bdykh hshpvkh
verses.translation: Wherefore should the nations say: 'Where is their God?' Let the avenging of Thy servants' blood that is shed Be made known among the nations in our sight. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תָּ֤ב֣וֹא לְפָנֶיךָ֮ אֶנְקַ֢ת אָ֫סִ֥יר כְּגֹ֥דֶל זְרוֹעֲךָ֑ ה֝וֹתֵ֗ר בְּנֵ֣י תְמוּתָֽה׃
verses.translit: tbv' lpnykh 'nqt 'syr khgdl zrv'kh hvtr bny tmvth
verses.translation: Let the groaning of the prisoner come before Thee; According to the greatness of Thy power set free those that are appointed to death;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָ֘שֵׁ֤ב לִשְׁכֵנֵ֣ינוּ שִׁ֭בְעָתַיִם אֶל־חֵיקָ֑ם חֶרְפָּ֘תָ֤ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר חֵרְפ֣וּךָ אֲדֹנָֽי׃
verses.translation: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom Their reproach, wherewith they have reproached Thee, O Lord.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַמְּךָ֨  וְצֹ֥אן מַרְעִיתֶךָ֮ נ֤וֹדֶ֥ה לְּךָ֗ לְע֫וֹלָ֥ם לְד֥וֹר וָדֹ֑ר נְ֝סַפֵּ֗ר תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'nchnv 'mkh  vts'n mr'ytkh nvdh lkh l'vlm ldvr vdr nspr thltkh {p}
verses.translation: So we that are Thy people and the flock of Thy pasture Will give Thee thanks for ever; We will tell of Thy praise to all generations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אֶל־שֹׁשַׁנִּ֑ים עֵד֖וּת לְאָסָ֣ף מִזְמֽוֹר׃
verses.translation: For the Leader; upon Shoshannim. A testimony. A Psalm of Asaph.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֹ֘עֵ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל  הַאֲזִ֗ינָה נֹהֵ֣ג כַּצֹּ֣אן יוֹסֵ֑ף יֹשֵׁ֖ב הַכְּרוּבִ֣ים הוֹפִֽיעָה׃
verses.translit: r'h yshr'l  h'zynh nhg khts'n yvsf yshb hkhrvbym hvpy'h
verses.translation: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, Thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; Thou that art enthroned upon the cherubim, shine forth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִפְנֵ֤י אֶפְרַ֨יִם  וּבִנְיָ֘מִ֤ן וּמְנַשֶּׁ֗ה עוֹרְרָ֥ה אֶת־גְּבוּרָתֶ֑ךָ וּלְכָ֖ה לִישֻׁעָ֣תָה לָּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: lpny 'prym  vbnymn vmnshh 'vrrh 'tgbvrtkh vlkhh lysh'th lnv
verses.translation: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up Thy might, And come to save us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֥ים הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נוּ וְהָאֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעָה׃
verses.translation: O God, restore us; And cause Thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָא֑וֹת עַד־מָתַ֥י עָ֝שַׁ֗נְתָּ בִּתְפִלַּ֥ת עַמֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: O LORD God of hosts, How long wilt Thou be angry against the prayer of Thy people?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶ֭אֱכַלְתָּם לֶ֣חֶם דִּמְעָ֑ה וַ֝תַּשְׁקֵ֗מוֹ בִּדְמָע֥וֹת שָׁלִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: h'khltm lchm dm'h vtshqmv bdm'vt shlysh
verses.translation: Thou hast fed them with the bread of tears, And given them tears to drink in large measure.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ מָ֭דוֹן לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ וְ֝אֹיְבֵ֗ינוּ יִלְעֲגוּ־לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translation: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours; And our enemies mock as they please.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָא֣וֹת הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נוּ וְהָאֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעָה׃
verses.translation: O God of hosts, restore us; And cause Thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גֶּ֭פֶן מִמִּצְרַ֣יִם תַּסִּ֑יעַ תְּגָרֵ֥שׁ גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם וַתִּטָּעֶֽהָ׃
verses.translit: gpn mmtsrym tsy' tgrsh gvym vtt'h
verses.translation: Thou didst pluck up a vine out of Egypt; Thou didst drive out the nations, and didst plant it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פִּנִּ֥יתָ לְפָנֶ֑יהָ וַתַּשְׁרֵ֥שׁ שׇׁ֝רָשֶׁ֗יהָ וַתְּמַלֵּא־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translation: Thou didst clear a place before it, And it took deep root, and filled the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּסּ֣וּ הָרִ֣ים צִלָּ֑הּ וַ֝עֲנָפֶ֗יהָ אַֽרְזֵי־אֵֽל׃
verses.translation: The mountains were covered with the shadow of it, And the mighty cedars with the boughs thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּשַׁלַּ֣ח קְצִירֶ֣הָ עַד־יָ֑ם וְאֶל־נָ֝הָ֗ר יוֹנְקוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translation: She sent out her branches unto the sea, And her shoots unto the River.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֭מָּה פָּרַ֣צְתָּ גְדֵרֶ֑יהָ וְ֝אָר֗וּהָ כׇּל־עֹ֥בְרֵי דָֽרֶךְ׃
verses.translit: lmh prtst gdryh v'rvh khl'bry drkh
verses.translation: Why hast Thou broken down her fences, So that all they that pass by the way do pluck her?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְכַרְסְמֶ֣נָּֽה חֲזִ֣יר מִיָּ֑ר וְזִ֖יז שָׂדַ֣י יִרְעֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: ykhrsmnh chzyr myr vzyz shdy yr'nh
verses.translation: The boar out of the wood doth ravage it, That which moveth in the field feedeth on it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָאוֹת֮ שֽׁ֫וּב־נָ֥א הַבֵּ֣ט מִשָּׁמַ֣יִם וּרְאֵ֑ה וּ֝פְקֹ֗ד גֶּ֣פֶן זֹֽאת׃
verses.translit: 'lhym tsb'vt shvbn' hbt mshmym vr'h vpqd gpn z't
verses.translation: O God of hosts, return, we beseech Thee; Look from heaven, and behold, and be mindful of this vine,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭כַנָּה אֲשֶׁר־נָטְעָ֣ה יְמִינֶ֑ךָ וְעַל־בֵּ֝֗ן אִמַּ֥צְתָּה לָּֽךְ׃
verses.translation: And of the stock which Thy right hand hath planted, And the branch that Thou madest strong for Thyself. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂרֻפָ֣ה בָאֵ֣שׁ כְּסוּחָ֑ה מִגַּעֲרַ֖ת פָּנֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: shrph b'sh khsvchh mg'rt pnykh y'bdv
verses.translation: It is burned with fire, it is cut down; They perish at the rebuke of Thy countenance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּֽהִי־יָ֭דְךָ עַל־אִ֣ישׁ יְמִינֶ֑ךָ עַל־בֶּן־אָ֝דָ֗ם אִמַּ֥צְתָּ לָּֽךְ׃
verses.translation: Let Thy hand be upon the man of Thy right hand, Upon the son of man whom Thou madest strong for Thyself.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־נָס֥וֹג מִמֶּ֑ךָּ תְּ֝חַיֵּ֗נוּ וּבְשִׁמְךָ֥ נִקְרָֽא׃
verses.translation: So shall we not turn back from Thee; Quicken Thou us, and we will call upon Thy name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְ֘הֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָא֣וֹת הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נוּ הָאֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעָה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhym tsb'vt hshybnv h'r pnykh vnvsh'h {p}
verses.translation: O LORD God of hosts, restore us; Cause Thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ ׀ עַֽל־הַגִּתִּ֬ית לְאָסָֽף׃
verses.translation: For the Leader; upon the Gittith. [A Psalm] of Asaph.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֭רְנִינוּ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים עוּזֵּ֑נוּ הָ֝רִ֗יעוּ לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translation: Sing aloud unto God our strength; shout unto the God of Jacob.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְֽׂאוּ־זִ֭מְרָה וּתְנוּ־תֹ֑ף כִּנּ֖וֹר נָעִ֣ים עִם־נָֽבֶל׃
verses.translation: Take up the melody, and sound the timbrel, the sweet harp with the psaltery.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּקְע֣וּ בַחֹ֣דֶשׁ שׁוֹפָ֑ר בַּ֝כֵּ֗סֶה לְי֣וֹם חַגֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: tq'v bchdsh shvpr bkhsh lyvm chgnv
verses.translation: Blow the horn at the new moon, at the full moon for our feast-day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י חֹ֣ק לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל ה֑וּא מִ֝שְׁפָּ֗ט לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translit: khy chq lyshr'l hv' mshpt l'lhy y'qb
verses.translation: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵד֤וּת  בִּיה֘וֹסֵ֤ף שָׂמ֗וֹ בְּ֭צֵאתוֹ עַל־אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם שְׂפַ֖ת לֹא־יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.translit: 'dvt  byhvsf shmv bts'tv 'l'rts mtsrym shpt l'yd'ty 'shm'
verses.translation: He appointed it in Joseph for a testimony, when He went forth against the land of Egypt. The speech of one that I knew not did I hear:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲסִיר֣וֹתִי מִסֵּ֣בֶל שִׁכְמ֑וֹ כַּ֝פָּ֗יו מִדּ֥וּד תַּעֲבֹֽרְנָה׃
verses.translit: hsyrvty msbl shkhmv khpyv mdvd t'brnh
verses.translation: 'I removed his shoulder from the burden; His hands were freed from the basket.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּצָּרָ֥ה קָרָ֗אתָ וָאֲחַ֫לְּצֶ֥ךָּ אֶ֭עֶנְךָ בְּסֵ֣תֶר רַ֑עַם אֶבְחׇנְךָ֨ עַל־מֵ֖י מְרִיבָ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: btsrh qr't v'chltskh ''nkh bstr r'm 'bchnkh 'lmy mrybh slh
verses.translation: Thou didst call in trouble, and I rescued thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder; I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע עַ֭מִּי וְאָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֑ךְ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל אִם־תִּֽשְׁמַֽע־לִֽי׃
verses.translation: Hear, O My people, and I will admonish thee: O Israel, if thou wouldest hearken unto Me!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יִהְיֶ֣ה בְ֭ךָ אֵ֣ל זָ֑ר וְלֹ֥א תִ֝שְׁתַּחֲוֶ֗ה לְאֵ֣ל נֵכָֽר׃
verses.translit: l'yhyh bkh 'l zr vl' tshtchvh l'l nkhr
verses.translation: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any foreign god.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָֽנֹכִ֨י  יְ֘הֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ הַֽ֭מַּעַלְךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם הַרְחֶב־פִּ֝֗יךָ וַאֲמַלְאֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: 'nkhy  yhvh 'lhykh hm'lkh m'rts mtsrym hrchbpykh v'ml'hv
verses.translation: I am the LORD thy God, who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt; open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־שָׁמַ֣ע עַמִּ֣י לְקוֹלִ֑י וְ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֹא־אָ֥בָה לִֽי׃
verses.translation: But My people hearkened not to My voice; And Israel would none of Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָ֭אֲשַׁלְּחֵהוּ בִּשְׁרִיר֣וּת לִבָּ֑ם יֵ֝לְכ֗וּ בְּֽמוֹעֲצ֖וֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translation: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their heart, That they might walk in their own counsels.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ל֗וּ עַ֭מִּי שֹׁמֵ֣עַֽ לִ֑י יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל בִּדְרָכַ֥י יְהַלֵּֽכוּ׃
verses.translit: lv 'my shm' ly yshr'l bdrkhy yhlkhv
verses.translation: Oh that My people would hearken unto Me, That Israel would walk in My ways!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֭מְעַט אוֹיְבֵיהֶ֣ם אַכְנִ֑יעַ וְעַ֥ל צָ֝רֵיהֶ֗ם אָשִׁ֥יב יָדִֽי׃
verses.translation: I would soon subdue their enemies, And turn My hand against their adversaries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְשַׂנְאֵ֣י יְ֭הֹוָה יְכַחֲשׁוּ־ל֑וֹ וִיהִ֖י עִתָּ֣ם לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translation: The haters of the LORD should dwindle away before Him; And their punishment should endure for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽ֭יַּאֲכִילֵהוּ מֵחֵ֣לֶב חִטָּ֑ה וּ֝מִצּ֗וּר דְּבַ֣שׁ אַשְׂבִּיעֶֽךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: They should also be fed with the fat of wheat; and with honey out of the rock would I satisfy thee.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים נִצָּ֥ב בַּעֲדַת־אֵ֑ל בְּקֶ֖רֶב אֱלֹהִ֣ים יִשְׁפֹּֽט׃
verses.translit: mzmvr l'sf 'lhym ntsb b'dt'l bqrb 'lhym yshpt
verses.translation: A Psalm of Asaph. God standeth in the congregation of God; in the midst of the judges He judgeth:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־מָתַ֥י תִּשְׁפְּטוּ־עָ֑וֶל וּפְנֵ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תִּשְׂאוּ־סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translation: 'How long will ye judge unjustly, and respect the persons of the wicked? Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁפְטוּ־דַ֥ל וְיָת֑וֹם עָנִ֖י וָרָ֣שׁ הַצְדִּֽיקוּ׃
verses.translation: Judge the poor and fatherless; do justice to the afflicted and destitute.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פַּלְּטוּ־דַ֥ל וְאֶבְי֑וֹן מִיַּ֖ד רְשָׁעִ֣ים הַצִּֽילוּ׃
verses.translation: Rescue the poor and needy; deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֤א יָדְע֨וּ  וְלֹ֥א יָבִ֗ינוּ בַּחֲשֵׁכָ֥ה יִתְהַלָּ֑כוּ יִ֝מּ֗וֹטוּ כׇּל־מ֥וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: l' yd'v  vl' ybynv bchshkhh ythlkhv ymvtv khlmvsdy 'rts
verses.translation: They know not, neither do they understand; they go about in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are moved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲֽנִי־אָ֭מַרְתִּי אֱלֹהִ֣ים אַתֶּ֑ם וּבְנֵ֖י עֶלְי֣וֹן כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃
verses.translation: I said: Ye are godlike beings, and all of you sons of the Most High.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֭כֵן כְּאָדָ֣ם תְּמוּת֑וּן וּכְאַחַ֖ד הַשָּׂרִ֣ים תִּפֹּֽלוּ׃
verses.translation: Nevertheless ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קוּמָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים שׇׁפְטָ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה תִ֝נְחַ֗ל בְּכׇל־הַגּוֹיִֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: qvmh 'lhym shpth h'rts khy'th tnchl bkhlhgvym {p}
verses.translation: Arise, O God, judge the earth; for Thou shalt possess all the nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֖יר מִזְמ֣וֹר לְאָסָֽף׃
verses.translation: A Song, a Psalm of Asaph.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֥ים אַל־דֳּמִי־לָ֑ךְ אַל־תֶּחֱרַ֖שׁ וְאַל־תִּשְׁקֹ֣ט אֵֽל׃
verses.translation: O God, keep not Thou silence; Hold not Thy peace, and be not still, O God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֣ה א֭וֹיְבֶיךָ יֶהֱמָי֑וּן וּ֝מְשַׂנְאֶ֗יךָ נָ֣שְׂאוּ רֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.translation: For, lo, Thine enemies are in an uproar; And they that hate Thee have lifted up the head.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַֽל־עַ֭מְּךָ יַעֲרִ֣ימוּ ס֑וֹד וְ֝יִתְיָעֲצ֗וּ עַל־צְפוּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: They hold crafty converse against Thy people, And take counsel against Thy treasured ones.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמְר֗וּ לְ֭כוּ וְנַכְחִידֵ֣ם מִגּ֑וֹי וְלֹֽא־יִזָּכֵ֖ר שֵֽׁם־יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עֽוֹד׃
verses.translation: They have said: 'Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; That the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י נוֹעֲצ֣וּ לֵ֣ב יַחְדָּ֑ו עָ֝לֶ֗יךָ בְּרִ֣ית יִכְרֹֽתוּ׃
verses.translit: khy nv'tsv lb ychdv 'lykh bryt ykhrtv
verses.translation: For they have consulted together with one consent; Against Thee do they make a covenant;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אׇהֳלֵ֣י אֱ֭דוֹם וְיִשְׁמְעֵאלִ֗ים מוֹאָ֥ב וְהַגְרִֽים׃
verses.translation: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גְּבָ֣ל וְ֭עַמּוֹן וַעֲמָלֵ֑ק פְּ֝לֶ֗שֶׁת עִם־יֹ֥שְׁבֵי צֽוֹר׃
verses.translation: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־אַ֭שּׁוּר נִלְוָ֣ה עִמָּ֑ם הָ֤יֽוּ־זְר֖וֹעַ לִבְנֵי־ל֣וֹט סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translation: Assyria also is joined with them; They have been an arm to the children of Lot. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲשֵֽׂה־לָהֶ֥ם כְּמִדְיָ֑ן כְּֽסִיסְרָ֥א כְ֝יָבִ֗ין בְּנַ֣חַל קִישֽׁוֹן׃
verses.translation: Do Thou unto them as unto Midian; As to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook Kishon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִשְׁמְד֥וּ בְֽעֵין־דֹּ֑אר הָ֥יוּ דֹ֝֗מֶן לָאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.translation: Who were destroyed at En-dor; They became as dung for the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁיתֵ֣מוֹ נְ֭דִיבֵימוֹ כְּעֹרֵ֣ב וְכִזְאֵ֑ב וּֽכְזֶ֥בַח וּ֝כְצַלְמֻנָּ֗ע כׇּל־נְסִיכֵֽימוֹ׃
verses.translit: shytmv ndybymv kh'rb vkhz'b vkhzbch vkhtslmn' khlnsykhymv
verses.translation: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, And like Zebah and Zalmunna all their princes;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָ֭מְרוּ נִ֣ירְשָׁה לָּ֑נוּ אֵ֝֗ת נְא֣וֹת אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translation: Who said: 'Let us take to ourselves in possession The habitations of God.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהַ֗י שִׁיתֵ֥מוֹ כַגַּלְגַּ֑ל כְּ֝קַ֗שׁ לִפְנֵי־רֽוּחַ׃
verses.translation: O my God, make them like the whirling dust; As stubble before the wind.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּאֵ֥שׁ תִּבְעַר־יָ֑עַר וּ֝כְלֶהָבָ֗ה תְּלַהֵ֥ט הָרִֽים׃
verses.translation: As the fire that burneth the forest, And as the flame that setteth the mountains ablaze;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֵּ֭ן תִּרְדְּפֵ֣ם בְּסַעֲרֶ֑ךָ וּבְסוּפָתְךָ֥ תְבַהֲלֵֽם׃
verses.translation: So pursue them with Thy tempest, And affright them with Thy storm.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַלֵּ֣א פְנֵיהֶ֣ם קָל֑וֹן וִיבַקְשׁ֖וּ שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: ml' pnyhm qlvn vybqshv shmkh yhvh
verses.translation: Fill their faces with shame; That they may seek Thy name, O LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵבֹ֖שׁוּ וְיִבָּהֲל֥וּ עֲדֵי־עַ֗ד וְֽיַחְפְּר֥וּ וְיֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
verses.translation: Let them be ashamed and affrighted for ever; Yea, let them be abashed and perish;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽיֵדְע֗וּ כִּי־אַתָּ֬ה שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֣ה לְבַדֶּ֑ךָ עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן עַל־כׇּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: That they may know that it is Thou alone whose name is the LORD, The Most High over all the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־הַגִּתִּ֑ית לִבְנֵי־קֹ֥רַח מִזְמֽוֹר׃
verses.translation: For the Leader; upon the Gittith. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־יְּדִיד֥וֹת מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶ֗יךָ יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translation: How lovely are Thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִכְסְפָ֬ה וְגַם־כָּלְתָ֨ה  נַפְשִׁי֮ לְחַצְר֢וֹת יְ֫הֹוָ֥ה לִבִּ֥י וּבְשָׂרִ֑י יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ אֶ֣ל אֵֽל־חָֽי׃
verses.translit: nkhsph vgmkhlth  npshy lchtsrvt yhvh lby vbshry yrnnv 'l 'lchy
verses.translation: My soul yearneth, yea, even pineth for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh sing for joy unto the living God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־צִפּ֨וֹר מָ֪צְאָה בַ֡יִת וּדְר֤וֹר  קֵ֥ן לָהּ֮ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁ֢תָה אֶפְרֹ֫חֶ֥יהָ אֶֽת־מִ֭זְבְּחוֹתֶיךָ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת מַ֝לְכִּ֗י וֵאלֹהָֽי׃
verses.translit: gmtspvr mts'h byt vdrvr  qn lh 'shrshth 'prchyh 'tmzbchvtykh yhvh tsb'vt mlkhy v'lhy
verses.translation: Yea, the sparrow hath found a house, and the swallow a nest for herself, Where she may lay her young; Thine altars, O LORD of hosts, My King, and my God—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֭שְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י בֵיתֶ֑ךָ ע֝֗וֹד יְֽהַלְל֥וּךָ סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.translation: Happy are they that dwell in Thy house, they are ever praising Thee. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם עֽוֹז־ל֥וֹ בָ֑ךְ מְ֝סִלּ֗וֹת בִּלְבָבָֽם׃
verses.translation: Happy is the man whose strength is in Thee; in whose heart are the highways.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹבְרֵ֤י  בְּעֵ֣מֶק הַ֭בָּכָא מַעְיָ֣ן יְשִׁית֑וּהוּ גַּם־בְּ֝רָכ֗וֹת יַעְטֶ֥ה מוֹרֶֽה׃
verses.translit: 'bry  b'mq hbkh' m'yn yshytvhv gmbrkhvt y'th mvrh
verses.translation: Passing through the valley of Baca they make it a place of springs; yea, the early rain clotheth it with blessings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵ֭לְכוּ מֵחַ֣יִל אֶל־חָ֑יִל יֵרָאֶ֖ה אֶל־אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּצִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.translation: They go from strength to strength, every one of them appeareth before God in Zion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְ֘הֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְ֭בָאוֹת שִׁמְעָ֣ה תְפִלָּתִ֑י הַאֲזִ֨ינָה אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhym tsb'vt shm'h tplty h'zynh 'lhy y'qb slh
verses.translation: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָ֭גִנֵּנוּ רְאֵ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ֝הַבֵּ֗ט פְּנֵ֣י מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of Thine anointed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י טֽוֹב־י֥וֹם בַּחֲצֵרֶ֗יךָ מֵ֫אָ֥לֶף בָּחַ֗רְתִּי הִ֭סְתּוֹפֵף בְּבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהַ֑י מִ֝דּ֗וּר בְּאׇהֳלֵי־רֶֽשַׁע׃
verses.translit: khy tvbyvm bchtsrykh m'lf bchrty hstvpf bbyt 'lhy mdvr b'hlyrsh'
verses.translation: For a day in Thy courts is better than a thousand; I had rather stand at the threshold of the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י שֶׁ֨מֶשׁ  וּמָגֵן֮ יְהֹוָ֢ה אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים חֵ֣ן וְ֭כָבוֹד יִתֵּ֣ן יְהֹוָ֑ה לֹ֥א יִמְנַע־ט֝֗וֹב לַֽהֹלְכִ֥ים בְּתָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy shmsh  vmgn yhvh 'lhym chn vkhbvd ytn yhvh l' ymn'tvb lhlkhym btmym
verses.translation: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD giveth grace and glory; No good thing will He withhold from them that walk uprightly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֑וֹת אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י אָ֝דָ֗ם בֹּטֵ֥חַ בָּֽךְ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: O LORD of hosts, happy is the man that trusteth in Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ ׀ לִבְנֵי־קֹ֬רַח מִזְמֽוֹר׃
verses.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָצִ֣יתָ יְהֹוָ֣ה אַרְצֶ֑ךָ שַׁ֝֗בְתָּ (שבות) [שְׁבִ֣ית] יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translation: LORD, Thou hast been favourable unto Thy land, Thou hast turned the captivity of Jacob.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָ֭שָׂאתָ עֲוֺ֣ן עַמֶּ֑ךָ כִּסִּ֖יתָ כׇל־חַטָּאתָ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translation: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of Thy people, Thou hast pardoned all their sin. Selah .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָסַ֥פְתָּ כׇל־עֶבְרָתֶ֑ךָ הֱ֝שִׁיב֗וֹתָ מֵחֲר֥וֹן אַפֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Thou hast withdrawn all Thy wrath; Thou hast turned from the fierceness of Thine anger.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁ֭וּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑נוּ וְהָפֵ֖ר כַּעַסְךָ֣ עִמָּֽנוּ׃
verses.translation: Restore us, O God of our salvation, And cause Thine indignation toward us to cease.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַלְעוֹלָ֥ם תֶּאֱנַף־בָּ֑נוּ תִּמְשֹׁ֥ךְ אַ֝פְּךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃
