verses.translation: Wilt Thou be angry with us for ever? Wilt Thou draw out Thine anger to all generations?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲֽלֹא־אַ֭תָּה תָּשׁ֣וּב תְּחַיֵּ֑נוּ וְ֝עַמְּךָ֗ יִשְׂמְחוּ־בָֽךְ׃
verses.translation: Wilt Thou not quicken us again, That Thy people may rejoice in Thee?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַרְאֵ֣נוּ יְהֹוָ֣ה חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝יֶשְׁעֲךָ֗ תִּתֶּן־לָֽנוּ׃
verses.translation: Show us Thy mercy, O LORD, And grant us Thy salvation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶשְׁמְעָ֗ה מַה־יְדַבֵּר֮ הָאֵ֢ל ׀ יְ֫הֹוָ֥ה כִּ֤י  יְדַבֵּ֬ר שָׁל֗וֹם אֶל־עַמּ֥וֹ וְאֶל־חֲסִידָ֑יו וְאַל־יָשׁ֥וּבוּ לְכִסְלָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'shm'h mhydbr h'l  yhvh khy  ydbr shlvm 'l'mv v'lchsydyv v'lyshvbv lkhslh
verses.translation: I will hear what God the LORD will speak; For He will speak peace unto His people, and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֤ךְ קָר֣וֹב לִירֵאָ֣יו יִשְׁע֑וֹ לִשְׁכֹּ֖ן כָּב֣וֹד בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: 'kh qrvb lyr'yv ysh'v lshkhn khbvd b'rtsnv
verses.translation: Surely His salvation is nigh them that fear Him; That glory may dwell in our land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶסֶד־וֶאֱמֶ֥ת נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ צֶ֖דֶק וְשָׁל֣וֹם נָשָֽׁקוּ׃
verses.translation: Mercy and truth are met together; Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱ֭מֶת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תִּצְמָ֑ח וְ֝צֶ֗דֶק מִשָּׁמַ֥יִם נִשְׁקָֽף׃
verses.translation: Truth springeth out of the earth; And righteousness hath looked down from heaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־יְ֭הֹוָה יִתֵּ֣ן הַטּ֑וֹב וְ֝אַרְצֵ֗נוּ תִּתֵּ֥ן יְבוּלָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: gmyhvh ytn htvb v'rtsnv ttn ybvlh
verses.translation: Yea, the LORD will give that which is good; And our land shall yield her produce.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צֶ֭דֶק לְפָנָ֣יו יְהַלֵּ֑ךְ וְיָשֵׂ֖ם לְדֶ֣רֶךְ פְּעָמָֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: tsdq lpnyv yhlkh vyshm ldrkh p'myv {p}
verses.translation: Righteousness shall go before Him, And shall make His footsteps a way.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּפִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הַטֵּֽה־יְהֹוָ֣ה אׇזְנְךָ֣ עֲנֵ֑נִי כִּֽי־עָנִ֖י וְאֶבְי֣וֹן אָֽנִי׃
verses.translation: A Prayer of David. Incline Thine ear, O LORD, and answer me; For I am poor and needy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׇׁ֥מְרָ֣ה נַפְשִׁי֮ כִּֽי־חָסִ֢יד אָ֥֫נִי הוֹשַׁ֣ע עַ֭בְדְּךָ אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֑י הַבּוֹטֵ֥חַ אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: Keep my soul, for I am godly; O Thou my God, save Thy servant that trusteth in Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חׇנֵּ֥נִי אֲדֹנָ֑י כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֥יךָ אֶ֝קְרָ֗א כׇּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translation: Be gracious unto me, O Lord; For unto Thee do I cry all the day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׂ֭מֵּחַ נֶ֣פֶשׁ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֥יךָ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י נַפְשִׁ֥י אֶשָּֽׂא׃
verses.translation: Rejoice the soul of Thy servant; For unto Thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי ט֣וֹב וְסַלָּ֑ח וְרַב־חֶ֝֗סֶד לְכׇל־קֹֽרְאֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: For Thou, Lord, art good, and ready to pardon, And plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַאֲזִ֣ינָה יְ֭הֹוָה תְּפִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבָה בְּק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנוֹתָֽי׃
verses.translit: h'zynh yhvh tplty vhqshybh bqvl tchnvnvty
verses.translation: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; And attend unto the voice of my supplications.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּי֣וֹם צָ֭רָתִֽי אֶקְרָאֶ֗ךָּ כִּ֣י תַעֲנֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: In the day of my trouble I call upon Thee; For Thou wilt answer me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵין־כָּמ֖וֹךָ בָאֱלֹהִ֥ים ׀ אֲדֹנָ֗י וְאֵ֣ין כְּֽמַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ׃
verses.translation: There is none like unto Thee among the gods, O Lord, And there are no works like Thine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־גּוֹיִ֤ם  אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֗יתָ יָב֤וֹאוּ  וְיִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לְפָנֶ֣יךָ אֲדֹנָ֑י וִ֖יכַבְּד֣וּ לִשְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: khlgvym  'shr 'shyt ybv'v  vyshtchvv lpnykh 'dny vykhbdv lshmkh
verses.translation: All nations whom Thou hast made shall come and prostrate themselves before Thee, O Lord; And they shall glorify Thy name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־גָד֣וֹל אַ֭תָּה וְעֹשֵׂ֣ה נִפְלָא֑וֹת אַתָּ֖ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: For Thou art great, and doest wondrous things; Thou art God alone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֘וֹרֵ֤נִי יְהֹוָ֨ה  דַּרְכֶּ֗ךָ אֲהַלֵּ֥ךְ בַּאֲמִתֶּ֑ךָ יַחֵ֥ד לְ֝בָבִ֗י לְיִרְאָ֥ה שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: hvrny yhvh  drkhkh 'hlkh b'mtkh ychd lbby lyr'h shmkh
verses.translation: Teach me, O LORD, Thy way, that I may walk in Thy truth; Make one my heart to fear Thy name. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוֹדְךָ֤  אֲדֹנָ֣י אֱ֭לֹהַי בְּכׇל־לְבָבִ֑י וַאֲכַבְּדָ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translation: I will thank Thee, O Lord my God, with my whole heart; And I will glorify Thy name for evermore.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־חַ֭סְדְּךָ גָּד֣וֹל עָלָ֑י וְהִצַּ֥לְתָּ נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י מִשְּׁא֥וֹל תַּחְתִּיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: khychsdkh gdvl 'ly vhtslt npshy msh'vl tchtyh
verses.translation: For great is Thy mercy toward me; And Thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest nether-world.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֤ים  זֵ֘דִ֤ים קָמוּ־עָלַ֗י וַעֲדַ֣ת עָ֭רִיצִים בִּקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י וְלֹ֖א שָׂמ֣וּךָ לְנֶגְדָּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lhym  zdym qmv'ly v'dt 'rytsym bqshv npshy vl' shmvkh lngdm
verses.translation: O God, the proud are risen up against me, And the company of violent men have sought after my soul, And have not set Thee before them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי אֵל־רַח֣וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם וְרַב־חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃
verses.translation: But Thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion and gracious, Slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּנֵ֥ה אֵלַ֗י וְחׇ֫נֵּ֥נִי תְּנָֽה־עֻזְּךָ֥ לְעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝הוֹשִׁ֗יעָה לְבֶן־אֲמָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: pnh 'ly vchnny tnh'zkh l'bdkh vhvshy'h lbn'mtkh
verses.translation: O turn unto me, and be gracious unto me; Give Thy strength unto Thy servant, And save the son of Thy handmaid.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲשֵֽׂה־עִמִּ֥י א֗וֹת לְט֫וֹבָ֥ה וְיִרְא֣וּ שֹׂנְאַ֣י וְיֵבֹ֑שׁוּ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה עֲזַרְתַּ֥נִי וְנִחַמְתָּֽנִי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'shh'my 'vt ltvbh vyr'v shn'y vybshv khy'th yhvh 'zrtny vnchmtny {p}
verses.translation: Work in my behalf a sign for good; That they that hate me may see it, and be put to shame, Because Thou, LORD, hast helped me, and comforted me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵי־קֹ֭רַח מִזְמ֣וֹר שִׁ֑יר יְ֝סוּדָת֗וֹ בְּהַרְרֵי־קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translation: A Psalm of the sons of Korah; a Song. His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹהֵ֣ב יְ֭הֹוָה שַׁעֲרֵ֣י צִיּ֑וֹן מִ֝כֹּ֗ל מִשְׁכְּנ֥וֹת יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translit: 'hb yhvh sh'ry tsyvn mkhl mshkhnvt y'qb
verses.translation: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִ֭כְבָּדוֹת מְדֻבָּ֣ר בָּ֑ךְ עִ֖יר הָאֱלֹהִ֣ים סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translation: Glorious things are spoken of Thee, O city of God. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַזְכִּ֤יר  רַ֥הַב וּבָבֶ֗ל לְֽיֹ֫דְעָ֥י הִנֵּ֤ה פְלֶ֣שֶׁת וְצֹ֣ר עִם־כּ֑וּשׁ זֶ֝֗ה יֻלַּד־שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: 'zkhyr  rhb vbbl lyd'y hnh plsht vtsr 'mkhvsh zh yldshm
verses.translation: 'I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon as among them that know Me; behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this one was born there.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּ֥לְצִיּ֨וֹן  יֵאָמַ֗ר אִ֣ישׁ וְ֭אִישׁ יֻלַּד־בָּ֑הּ וְה֖וּא יְכוֹנְנֶ֣הָ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vltsyvn  y'mr 'ysh v'ysh yldbh vhv' ykhvnnh 'lyvn
verses.translation: But of Zion it shall be said: 'This man and that was born in her; And the Most High Himself doth establish her.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה יִ֭סְפֹּר בִּכְת֣וֹב עַמִּ֑ים זֶ֖ה יֻלַּד־שָׁ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: yhvh yspr bkhtvb 'mym zh yldshm slh
verses.translation: The LORD shall count in the register of the peoples: 'This one was born there.' Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁרִ֥ים כְּחֹלְלִ֑ים כׇּֽל־מַעְיָנַ֥י בָּֽךְ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: And whether they sing or dance, all my thoughts are in Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֥יר מִזְמ֗וֹר לִבְנֵ֫י־קֹ֥רַח לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ עַל־מָחֲלַ֣ת לְעַנּ֑וֹת מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל לְהֵימָ֥ן הָאֶזְרָחִֽי׃
verses.translit: shyr mzmvr lbnyqrch lmntsch 'lmchlt l'nvt mshkhyl lhymn h'zrchy
verses.translation: A Song, a Psalm of the sons of Korah; for the Leader; upon Mahalath Leannoth. Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְ֭הֹוָה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יְשׁוּעָתִ֑י יוֹם־צָעַ֖קְתִּי בַלַּ֣יְלָה נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: O LORD, God of my salvation, What time I cry in the night before Thee,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תָּב֣וֹא לְ֭פָנֶיךָ תְּפִלָּתִ֑י הַטֵּ֥ה אׇ֝זְנְךָ֗ לְרִנָּתִֽי׃
verses.translation: Let my prayer come before Thee, Incline Thine ear unto my cry.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־שָׂבְעָ֣ה בְרָע֣וֹת נַפְשִׁ֑י וְ֝חַיַּ֗י לִשְׁא֥וֹל הִגִּֽיעוּ׃
verses.translit: khyshb'h br'vt npshy vchyy lsh'vl hgy'v
verses.translation: For my soul is sated with troubles, And my life draweth nigh unto the grave.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֶ֭חְשַׁבְתִּי עִם־י֣וֹרְדֵי ב֑וֹר הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כְּגֶ֣בֶר אֵֽין־אֱיָֽל׃
verses.translation: I am counted with them that go down into the pit; I am become as a man that hath no help;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּמֵּתִ֗ים חׇ֫פְשִׁ֥י כְּמ֤וֹ חֲלָלִ֨ים  שֹׁ֥כְבֵי קֶ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹ֣א זְכַרְתָּ֣ם ע֑וֹד וְ֝הֵ֗מָּה מִיָּדְךָ֥ נִגְזָֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: bmtym chpshy khmv chllym  shkhby qbr 'shr l' zkhrtm 'vd vhmh mydkh ngzrv
verses.translation: Set apart among the dead, Like the slain that lie in the grave, Whom Thou rememberest no more; And they are cut off from Thy hand. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁ֭תַּנִי בְּב֣וֹר תַּחְתִּיּ֑וֹת בְּ֝מַחֲשַׁכִּ֗ים בִּמְצֹלֽוֹת׃
verses.translation: Thou hast laid me in the nether-most pit, In dark places, in the deeps.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָ֭לַי סָמְכָ֣ה חֲמָתֶ֑ךָ וְכׇל־מִ֝שְׁבָּרֶ֗יךָ עִנִּ֥יתָ סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.translation: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, And all Thy waves Thou pressest down. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִרְחַ֥קְתָּ מְיֻדָּעַ֗י מִ֫מֶּ֥נִּי שַׁתַּ֣נִי תוֹעֵב֣וֹת לָ֑מוֹ כָּ֝לֻ֗א וְלֹ֣א אֵצֵֽא׃
verses.translit: hrchqt myd'y mmny shtny tv'bvt lmv khl' vl' 'ts'
verses.translation: Thou hast put mine acquaintance far from me; Thou hast made me an abomination unto them; I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵינִ֥י דָאֲבָ֗ה מִנִּ֫י־עֹ֥נִי קְרָאתִ֣יךָ יְהֹוָ֣ה בְּכׇל־י֑וֹם שִׁטַּ֖חְתִּי אֵלֶ֣יךָ כַפָּֽי׃
verses.translit: 'yny d'bh mny'ny qr'tykh yhvh bkhlyvm shtchty 'lykh khpy
verses.translation: Mine eye languisheth by reason of affliction; I have called upon Thee, O LORD, every day, I have spread forth my hands unto Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלַמֵּתִ֥ים תַּעֲשֶׂה־פֶּ֑לֶא אִם־רְ֝פָאִ֗ים יָק֤וּמוּ  יוֹד֬וּךָ סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.translation: Wilt Thou work wonders for the dead? Or shall the shades arise and give Thee thanks? Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַיְסֻפַּ֣ר בַּקֶּ֣בֶר חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ אֱ֝מ֥וּנָתְךָ֗ בָּאֲבַדּֽוֹן׃
verses.translation: Shall Thy mercy be declared in the grave? Or Thy faithfulness in destruction?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיִוָּדַ֣ע בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ פִּלְאֶ֑ךָ וְ֝צִדְקָתְךָ֗ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ נְשִׁיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: hyvd' bchshkh pl'kh vtsdqtkh b'rts nshyh
verses.translation: Shall Thy wonders be known in the dark? And Thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י  אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְהֹוָ֣ה שִׁוַּ֑עְתִּי וּ֝בַבֹּ֗קֶר תְּֽפִלָּתִ֥י תְקַדְּמֶֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: v'ny  'lykh yhvh shv'ty vbbqr tplty tqdmkh
verses.translation: But as for me, unto Thee, O LORD, do I cry, And in the morning doth my prayer come to meet Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָמָ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה תִּזְנַ֣ח נַפְשִׁ֑י תַּסְתִּ֖יר פָּנֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: lmh yhvh tznch npshy tstyr pnykh mmny
verses.translation: LORD, why castest Thou off my soul? Why hidest Thou Thy face from me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָ֘נִ֤י אֲנִ֣י וְגֹוֵ֣עַ מִנֹּ֑עַר נָשָׂ֖אתִי אֵמֶ֣יךָ אָפֽוּנָה׃
verses.translation: I am afflicted and at the point of death from my youth up; I have borne Thy terrors, I am distracted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָ֭לַי עָבְר֣וּ חֲרוֹנֶ֑יךָ בִּ֝עוּתֶ֗יךָ צִמְּתוּתֻֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Thy fierce wrath is gone over me; Thy terrors have cut me off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סַבּ֣וּנִי כַ֭מַּיִם כׇּל־הַיּ֑וֹם הִקִּ֖יפוּ עָלַ֣י יָֽחַד׃
verses.translation: They came round about me like water all the day; They compassed me about together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִרְחַ֣קְתָּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי אֹהֵ֣ב וָרֵ֑עַ מְֽיֻדָּעַ֥י מַחְשָֽׁךְ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Friend and companion hast Thou put far from me, And mine acquaintance into darkness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל לְאֵיתָ֥ן הָאֶזְרָחִֽי׃
verses.translation: Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַֽסְדֵ֣י יְ֭הֹוָה עוֹלָ֣ם אָשִׁ֑ירָה לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֓ר  אוֹדִ֖יעַ אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ בְּפִֽי׃
verses.translation: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever; To all generations will I make known Thy faithfulness with my mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אָמַ֗רְתִּי ע֭וֹלָם חֶ֣סֶד יִבָּנֶ֑ה שָׁמַ֓יִם  תָּכִ֖ן אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ בָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khy'mrty 'vlm chsd ybnh shmym  tkhn 'mvntkh bhm
verses.translation: For I have said: 'For ever is mercy built; In the very heavens Thou dost establish Thy faithfulness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כָּרַ֣תִּי בְ֭רִית לִבְחִירִ֑י נִ֝שְׁבַּ֗עְתִּי לְדָוִ֥ד עַבְדִּֽי׃
verses.translation: I have made a covenant with My chosen, I have sworn unto David My servant:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־ע֭וֹלָם אָכִ֣ין זַרְעֶ֑ךָ וּבָנִ֨יתִי לְדֹר־וָד֖וֹר כִּסְאֲךָ֣ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translation: For ever will I establish thy seed, And build up thy throne to all generations.' Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְי֘וֹד֤וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם פִּלְאֲךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֑ה אַף־אֱ֝מ֥וּנָתְךָ֗ בִּקְהַ֥ל קְדֹשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vyvdv shmym pl'kh yhvh 'f'mvntkh bqhl qdshym
verses.translation: So shall the heavens praise Thy wonders, O LORD, Thy faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִ֣י בַ֭שַּׁחַק יַעֲרֹ֣ךְ לַיהֹוָ֑ה יִדְמֶ֥ה לַ֝יהֹוָ֗ה בִּבְנֵ֥י אֵלִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy my bshchq y'rkh lyhvh ydmh lyhvh bbny 'lym
verses.translation: For who in the skies can be compared unto the LORD, Who among the sons of might can be likened unto the LORD,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣ל נַ֭עֲרָץ בְּסוֹד־קְדֹשִׁ֣ים רַבָּ֑ה וְ֝נוֹרָ֗א עַל־כׇּל־סְבִיבָֽיו׃
verses.translation: A God dreaded in the great council of the holy ones, And feared of all them that are about Him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֤ה  אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צְבָא֗וֹת מִי־כָמ֖וֹךָֽ חֲסִ֥ין ׀ יָ֑הּ וֶ֝אֱמ֥וּנָתְךָ֗ סְבִיבוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: yhvh  'lhy tsb'vt mykhmvkh chsyn  yh v'mvntkh sbybvtykh
verses.translation: O LORD God of hosts, Who is a mighty one, like unto Thee, O LORD? And Thy faithfulness is round about Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה מ֭וֹשֵׁל בְּגֵא֣וּת הַיָּ֑ם בְּשׂ֥וֹא גַ֝לָּ֗יו אַתָּ֥ה תְשַׁבְּחֵֽם׃
verses.translit: 'th mvshl bg'vt hym bshv' glyv 'th tshbchm
verses.translation: Thou rulest the proud swelling of the sea; When the waves thereof arise, Thou stillest them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה דִכִּ֣אתָ כֶחָלָ֣ל רָ֑הַב בִּזְר֥וֹעַ עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ פִּזַּ֥רְתָּ אוֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: Thou didst crush Rahab, as one that is slain; Thou didst scattered Thine enemies with the arm of Thy strength.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְךָ֣ שָׁ֭מַיִם אַף־לְךָ֥ אָ֑רֶץ תֵּבֵ֥ל וּ֝מְלֹאָ֗הּ אַתָּ֥ה יְסַדְתָּֽם׃
verses.translation: Thine are the heavens, Thine also the earth; The world and the fulness thereof, Thou hast founded them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צָפ֣וֹן וְ֭יָמִין אַתָּ֣ה בְרָאתָ֑ם תָּב֥וֹר וְ֝חֶרְמ֗וֹן בְּשִׁמְךָ֥ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: tspvn vymyn 'th br'tm tbvr vchrmvn bshmkh yrnnv
verses.translation: The north and the south, Thou hast created them; Tabor and Hermon rejoice in Thy name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְךָ֣ זְ֭רוֹעַ עִם־גְּבוּרָ֑ה תָּעֹ֥ז יָ֝דְךָ֗ תָּר֥וּם יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: lkh zrv' 'mgbvrh t'z ydkh trvm ymynkh
verses.translation: Thine is an arm with might; Strong is Thy hand, and exalted is Thy right hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צֶ֣דֶק וּ֭מִשְׁפָּט מְכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֶ֑ךָ חֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת יְֽקַדְּמ֥וּ פָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: tsdq vmshpt mkhvn khs'kh chsd v'mt yqdmv pnykh
verses.translation: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Thy throne; Mercy and truth go before Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הָ֭עָם יֹדְעֵ֣י תְרוּעָ֑ה יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה בְּֽאוֹר־פָּנֶ֥יךָ יְהַלֵּכֽוּן׃
verses.translit: 'shry h'm yd'y trv'h yhvh b'vrpnykh yhlkhvn
verses.translation: Happy is the people that know the joyful shout; They walk, O LORD, in the light of Thy countenance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּ֭שִׁמְךָ יְגִיל֣וּן כׇּל־הַיּ֑וֹם וּבְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ יָרֽוּמוּ׃
verses.translation: In Thy name do they rejoice all the day; And through Thy righteousness are they exalted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־תִפְאֶ֣רֶת עֻזָּ֣מוֹ אָ֑תָּה וּ֝בִרְצוֹנְךָ֗ (תרים) [תָּר֥וּם] קַרְנֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translation: For Thou art the glory of their strength; And in Thy favour our horn is exalted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י לַ֭יהֹוָה מָגִנֵּ֑נוּ וְלִקְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מַלְכֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: khy lyhvh mgnnv vlqdvsh yshr'l mlkhnv
verses.translation: For of the LORD is our shield; And the Holy One of Israel is our king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֤ז דִּבַּ֥רְתָּֽ־בְחָז֡וֹן לַחֲסִידֶ֗יךָ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר שִׁוִּ֣יתִי עֵ֭זֶר עַל־גִּבּ֑וֹר הֲרִימ֖וֹתִי בָח֣וּר מֵעָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'z dbrtbchzvn lchsydykh vt'mr shvyty 'zr 'lgbvr hrymvty bchvr m'm
verses.translation: Then Thou spokest in vision to Thy godly ones, And saidst: 'I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָ֭צָאתִי דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֑י בְּשֶׁ֖מֶן קׇדְשִׁ֣י מְשַׁחְתִּֽיו׃
verses.translation: I have found David My servant; With My holy oil have I anointed him;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָ֭דִי תִּכּ֣וֹן עִמּ֑וֹ אַף־זְרוֹעִ֥י תְאַמְּצֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translation: With whom My hand shall be established; Mine arm also shall strengthen him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יַשִּׁ֣יא אוֹיֵ֣ב בּ֑וֹ וּבֶן־עַ֝וְלָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְעַנֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translation: The enemy shall not exact from him; Nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכַתּוֹתִ֣י מִפָּנָ֣יו צָרָ֑יו וּמְשַׂנְאָ֥יו אֶגּֽוֹף׃
verses.translation: And I will beat to pieces his adversaries before him, And smite them that hate him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וֶ֥אֱֽמוּנָתִ֣י וְחַסְדִּ֣י עִמּ֑וֹ וּ֝בִשְׁמִ֗י תָּר֥וּם קַרְנֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: But My faithfulness and My mercy shall be with him; And through My name shall his horn be exalted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י בַיָּ֣ם יָד֑וֹ וּֽבַנְּהָר֥וֹת יְמִינֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: I will set his hand also on the sea, And his right hand on the rivers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֣וּא יִ֭קְרָאֵנִי אָ֣בִי אָ֑תָּה אֵ֝לִ֗י וְצ֣וּר יְשׁוּעָתִֽי׃
verses.translation: He shall call unto Me: Thou art my Father, My God, and the rock of my salvation. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַף־אָ֭נִי בְּכ֣וֹר אֶתְּנֵ֑הוּ עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן לְמַלְכֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translation: I also will appoint him first-born, The highest of the kings of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֭עוֹלָם (אשמור) [אֶשְׁמׇר־]ל֣וֹ חַסְדִּ֑י וּ֝בְרִיתִ֗י נֶאֱמֶ֥נֶת לֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: For ever will I keep for him My mercy, And My covenant shall stand fast with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י לָעַ֣ד זַרְע֑וֹ וְ֝כִסְא֗וֹ כִּימֵ֥י שָׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vshmty l'd zr'v vkhs'v khymy shmym
verses.translation: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, And his throne as the days of heaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יַעַזְב֣וּ בָ֭נָיו תּוֹרָתִ֑י וּ֝בְמִשְׁפָּטַ֗י לֹ֣א יֵלֵכֽוּן׃
verses.translation: If his children forsake My law, And walk not in Mine ordinances; :
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־חֻקֹּתַ֥י יְחַלֵּ֑לוּ וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י לֹ֣א יִשְׁמֹֽרוּ׃
verses.translation: If they profane My statutes, And keep not My commandments;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפָקַדְתִּ֣י בְשֵׁ֣בֶט פִּשְׁעָ֑ם וּבִנְגָעִ֥ים עֲוֺנָֽם׃
verses.translation: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, And their iniquity with strokes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭חַסְדִּי לֹא־אָפִ֣יר מֵעִמּ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־אֲ֝שַׁקֵּ֗ר בֶּאֱמוּנָתִֽי׃
verses.translation: But My mercy will I not break off from him, Nor will I be false to My faithfulness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־אֲחַלֵּ֥ל בְּרִיתִ֑י וּמוֹצָ֥א שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י לֹ֣א אֲשַׁנֶּֽה׃
verses.translation: My covenant will I not profane, Nor alter that which is gone out of My lips.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֭חַת נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי בְקׇדְשִׁ֑י אִֽם־לְדָוִ֥ד אֲכַזֵּֽב׃
verses.translation: Once have I sworn by My holiness: Surely I will not be false unto David;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זַ֭רְעוֹ לְעוֹלָ֣ם יִהְיֶ֑ה וְכִסְא֖וֹ כַשֶּׁ֣מֶשׁ נֶגְדִּֽי׃
verses.translit: zr'v l'vlm yhyh vkhs'v khshmsh ngdy
verses.translation: His seed shall endure for ever, And his throne as the sun before Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּ֭יָרֵחַ יִכּ֣וֹן עוֹלָ֑ם וְעֵ֥ד בַּ֝שַּׁ֗חַק נֶאֱמָ֥ן סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: khyrch ykhvn 'vlm v'd bshchq n'mn slh
verses.translation: It shall be established for ever as the moon; And be stedfast as the witness in sky.' Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה זָ֭נַחְתָּ וַתִּמְאָ֑ס הִ֝תְעַבַּ֗רְתָּ עִם־מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: But Thou hast cast off and rejected, Thou hast been wroth with Thine anointed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֵ֭אַרְתָּה בְּרִ֣ית עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ חִלַּ֖לְתָּ לָאָ֣רֶץ נִזְרֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: Thou hast abhorred the covenant of Thy servant; Thou hast profaned his crown even to the ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּרַ֥צְתָּ כׇל־גְּדֵרֹתָ֑יו שַׂ֖מְתָּ מִבְצָרָ֣יו מְחִתָּֽה׃
verses.translation: Thou hast broken down all his fences; Thou hast brought his strongholds to ruin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁ֭סֻּהוּ כׇּל־עֹ֣בְרֵי דָ֑רֶךְ הָיָ֥ה חֶ֝רְפָּ֗ה לִשְׁכֵנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: shshv khl'bry drkh hyh chrph lshkhnyv
verses.translation: All that pass by the way spoil him; He is become a taunt to his neighbours.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲ֭רִימוֹתָ יְמִ֣ין צָרָ֑יו הִ֝שְׂמַ֗חְתָּ כׇּל־אוֹיְבָֽיו׃
verses.translation: Thou hast exalted the right hand of his adversaries; Thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַף־תָּ֭שִׁיב צ֣וּר חַרְבּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א הֲ֝קֵימֹת֗וֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translation: Yea, Thou turnest back the edge of his sword, And hast not made him to stand in the battle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִשְׁבַּ֥תָּ מִטְּהָר֑וֹ וְ֝כִסְא֗וֹ לָאָ֥רֶץ מִגַּֽרְתָּה׃
verses.translation: Thou hast made his brightness to cease, And cast his throne down to the ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִ֭קְצַרְתָּ יְמֵ֣י עֲלוּמָ֑יו הֶ֥עֱטִ֨יתָ עָלָ֖יו בּוּשָׁ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translation: The days of his youth hast Thou shortened; Thou hast covered him with shame. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־מָ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה תִּסָּתֵ֣ר לָנֶ֑צַח תִּבְעַ֖ר כְּמוֹ־אֵ֣שׁ חֲמָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: 'dmh yhvh tstr lntsch tb'r khmv'sh chmtkh
verses.translation: How long, O LORD, wilt Thou hide Thyself for ever? How long shall Thy wrath burn like fire?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְכׇר־אֲנִ֥י מֶה־חָ֑לֶד עַל־מַה־שָּׁ֝֗וְא בָּרָ֥אתָ כׇל־בְּנֵֽי־אָדָֽם׃
verses.translation: O remember how short my time is; For what vanity hast Thou created all the children of men!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֤י גֶ֣בֶר יִֽ֭חְיֶה וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֶה־מָּ֑וֶת יְמַלֵּ֨ט נַפְשׁ֖וֹ מִיַּד־שְׁא֣וֹל סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: my gbr ychyh vl' yr'hmvt ymlt npshv mydsh'vl slh
verses.translation: What man is he that liveth and shall not see death, That shall deliver his soul from the power of the grave? Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַיֵּ֤ה  חֲסָדֶ֖יךָ הָרִאשֹׁנִ֥ים ׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתָּ לְ֝דָוִ֗ד בֶּאֱמוּנָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Where are Thy former mercies, O Lord, Which Thou didst swear unto David in Thy faithfulness?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְכֹ֣ר אֲ֭דֹנָי חֶרְפַּ֣ת עֲבָדֶ֑יךָ שְׂאֵתִ֥י בְ֝חֵיקִ֗י כׇּל־רַבִּ֥ים עַמִּֽים׃
verses.translation: Remember, Lord, the taunt of Thy servants; How I do bear in my bosom [the taunt of] so many peoples;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר חֵרְפ֖וּ אוֹיְבֶ֥יךָ ׀ יְהֹוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר חֵ֝רְפ֗וּ עִקְּב֥וֹת מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Wherewith Thine enemies have taunted, O LORD, Wherewith they have taunted the footsteps of Thine anointed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּר֖וּךְ יְהֹוָ֥ה לְעוֹלָ֗ם אָ֘מֵ֥ן ׀ וְאָמֵֽן׃
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּפִלָּה֮ לְמֹשֶׁ֢ה אִֽישׁ־הָאֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים אֲֽדֹנָ֗י מָע֣וֹן אַ֭תָּה הָיִ֥יתָ לָּ֗נוּ בְּדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.translit: tplh lmshh 'yshh'lhym 'dny m'vn 'th hyyt lnv bdr vdr
verses.translation: A Prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, Thou hast been our dwelling-place in all generations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּטֶ֤רֶם  הָ֘רִ֤ים יֻלָּ֗דוּ וַתְּח֣וֹלֵֽל אֶ֣רֶץ וְתֵבֵ֑ל וּֽמֵעוֹלָ֥ם עַד־ע֝וֹלָ֗ם אַתָּ֥ה אֵֽל׃
verses.translit: btrm  hrym yldv vtchvll 'rts vtbl vm'vlm 'd'vlm 'th 'l
verses.translation: Before the mountains were brought forth, Or ever Thou hadst formed the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, Thou art God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תָּשֵׁ֣ב אֱ֭נוֹשׁ עַד־דַּכָּ֑א וַ֝תֹּ֗אמֶר שׁ֣וּבוּ בְנֵֽי־אָדָֽם׃
verses.translation: Thou turnest man to contrition; And sayest: 'Return, ye children of men.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֶ֪לֶף שָׁנִ֡ים בְּֽעֵינֶ֗יךָ כְּי֣וֹם אֶ֭תְמוֹל כִּ֣י יַעֲבֹ֑ר וְאַשְׁמוּרָ֥ה בַלָּֽיְלָה׃
verses.translit: khy 'lf shnym b'ynykh khyvm 'tmvl khy y'br v'shmvrh blylh
verses.translation: For a thousand years in Thy sight Are but as yesterday when it is past, And as a watch in the night.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְ֭רַמְתָּם שֵׁנָ֣ה יִהְי֑וּ בַּ֝בֹּ֗קֶר כֶּחָצִ֥יר יַחֲלֹֽף׃
verses.translit: zrmtm shnh yhyv bbqr khchtsyr ychlf
verses.translation: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep; In the morning they are like grass which groweth up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּ֭בֹּקֶר יָצִ֣יץ וְחָלָ֑ף לָ֝עֶ֗רֶב יְמוֹלֵ֥ל וְיָבֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: bbqr ytsyts vchlf l'rb ymvll vybsh
verses.translation: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; In the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־כָלִ֥ינוּ בְאַפֶּ֑ךָ וּֽבַחֲמָתְךָ֥ נִבְהָֽלְנוּ׃
verses.translation: For we are consumed in Thine anger, And by Thy wrath are we hurried away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁתָּ֣ עֲוֺנֹתֵ֣ינוּ לְנֶגְדֶּ֑ךָ עֲ֝לֻמֵ֗נוּ לִמְא֥וֹר פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: Thou hast set our iniquities before Thee, Our secret sins in the light of Thy countenance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כׇל־יָ֭מֵינוּ פָּנ֣וּ בְעֶבְרָתֶ֑ךָ כִּלִּ֖ינוּ שָׁנֵ֣ינוּ כְמוֹ־הֶֽגֶה׃
verses.translit: khy khlymynv pnv b'brtkh khlynv shnynv khmvhgh
verses.translation: For all our days are passed away in Thy wrath; We bring our years to an end as a tale that is told.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְמֵֽי־שְׁנוֹתֵ֨ינוּ בָהֶ֥ם שִׁבְעִ֪ים שָׁנָ֡ה וְאִ֤ם בִּגְבוּרֹ֨ת  שְׁמ֘וֹנִ֤ים שָׁנָ֗ה וְ֭רׇהְבָּם עָמָ֣ל וָאָ֑וֶן כִּי־גָ֥ז חִ֝֗ישׁ וַנָּעֻֽפָה׃
verses.translit: ymyshnvtynv bhm shb'ym shnh v'm bgbvrt  shmvnym shnh vrhbm 'ml v'vn khygz chysh vn'ph
verses.translation: The days of our years are threescore years and ten, Or even by reason of strength fourscore years; Yet is their pride but travail and vanity; For it is speedily gone, and we fly away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־י֭וֹדֵעַ עֹ֣ז אַפֶּ֑ךָ וּ֝כְיִרְאָתְךָ֗ עֶבְרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Who knoweth the power of Thine anger, And Thy wrath according to the fear that is due unto Thee?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִמְנ֣וֹת יָ֭מֵינוּ כֵּ֣ן הוֹדַ֑ע וְ֝נָבִ֗א לְבַ֣ב חׇכְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: lmnvt ymynv khn hvd' vnb' lbb chkhmh
verses.translation: So teach us to number our days, That we may get us a heart of wisdom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה עַד־מָתָ֑י וְ֝הִנָּחֵ֗ם עַל־עֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: Return, O LORD; how long? And let it repent Thee concerning Thy servants.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׂבְּעֵ֣נוּ בַבֹּ֣קֶר חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וּֽנְרַנְּנָ֥ה וְ֝נִשְׂמְחָ֗ה בְּכׇל־יָמֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: shb'nv bbqr chsdkh vnrnnh vnshmchh bkhlymynv
verses.translation: O satisfy us in the morning with Thy mercy; That we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׂ֭מְּחֵנוּ כִּימ֣וֹת עִנִּיתָ֑נוּ שְׁ֝נ֗וֹת רָאִ֥ינוּ רָעָֽה׃
verses.translation: Make us glad according to the days wherein Thou hast afflicted us, According to the years wherein we have seen evil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵרָאֶ֣ה אֶל־עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ פׇעֳלֶ֑ךָ וַ֝הֲדָרְךָ֗ עַל־בְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translation: Let Thy work appear unto Thy servants, And Thy glory upon their children.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִיהִ֤י  נֹ֤עַם אֲדֹנָ֥י אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עָ֫לֵ֥ינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָ֭דֵינוּ כּוֹנְנָ֥ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָ֝דֵ֗ינוּ כּוֹנְנֵֽהוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhy  n'm 'dny 'lhynv 'lynv vm'shh ydynv khvnnh 'lynv vm'shh ydynv khvnnhv {p}
verses.translation: And let the graciousness of the Lord our God be upon us; Establish Thou also upon us the work of our hands; Yea, the work of our hands establish Thou it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֹ֭שֵׁב בְּסֵ֣תֶר עֶלְי֑וֹן בְּצֵ֥ל שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יִתְלוֹנָֽן׃
verses.translation: O thou that dwellest in the covert of the Most High, And abidest in the shadow of the Almighty;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹמַ֗ר לַ֭יהֹוָה מַחְסִ֣י וּמְצוּדָתִ֑י אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אֶבְטַח־בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: I will say of the LORD, who is my refuge and my fortress, My God, in whom I trust,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא יַ֭צִּילְךָ מִפַּ֥ח יָק֗וּשׁ מִדֶּ֥בֶר הַוּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: khy hv' ytsylkh mpch yqvsh mdbr hvvt
verses.translation: That He will deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, And from the noisome pestilence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאֶבְרָת֨וֹ  יָ֣סֶךְ לָ֭ךְ וְתַחַת־כְּנָפָ֣יו תֶּחְסֶ֑ה צִנָּ֖ה וְסֹחֵרָ֣ה אֲמִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: b'brtv  yskh lkh vtchtkhnpyv tchsh tsnh vschrh 'mtv
verses.translation: He will cover thee with His pinions, And under His wings shalt thou take refuge; His truth is a shield and a buckler.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־תִ֭ירָא מִפַּ֣חַד לָ֑יְלָה מֵ֝חֵ֗ץ יָע֥וּף יוֹמָֽם׃
verses.translit: l'tyr' mpchd lylh mchts y'vf yvmm
verses.translation: Thou shalt not be afraid of the terror by night, Nor of the arrow that flieth by day;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֭דֶּבֶר בָּאֹ֣פֶל יַהֲלֹ֑ךְ מִ֝קֶּ֗טֶב יָשׁ֥וּד צׇהֳרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: mdbr b'pl yhlkh mqtb yshvd tshrym
verses.translation: Of the pestilence that walketh in darkness, Nor of the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִפֹּ֤ל מִצִּדְּךָ֨  אֶ֗לֶף וּרְבָבָ֥ה מִימִינֶ֑ךָ אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִגָּֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: ypl mtsdkh  'lf vrbbh mymynkh 'lykh l' ygsh
verses.translation: A thousand may fall at Thy side, And ten thousand at Thy right hand; It shall not come nigh thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֭ק בְּעֵינֶ֣יךָ תַבִּ֑יט וְשִׁלֻּמַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: rq b'ynykh tbyt vshlmt rsh'ym tr'h
verses.translation: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold, And see the recompense of the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן שַׂ֣מְתָּ מְעוֹנֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: For thou hast made the LORD who is my refuge, Even the Most High, thy habitation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־תְאֻנֶּ֣ה אֵלֶ֣יךָ רָעָ֑ה וְ֝נֶ֗גַע לֹא־יִקְרַ֥ב בְּאׇהֳלֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: There shall no evil befall thee, Neither shall any plague come nigh thy tent.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י מַ֭לְאָכָיו יְצַוֶּה־לָּ֑ךְ לִ֝שְׁמׇרְךָ֗ בְּכׇל־דְּרָכֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: For He will give His angels charge over thee, To keep thee in all thy ways.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כַּפַּ֥יִם יִשָּׂא֑וּנְךָ פֶּן־תִּגֹּ֖ף בָּאֶ֣בֶן רַגְלֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: They shall bear thee upon their hands, Lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־שַׁ֣חַל וָפֶ֣תֶן תִּדְרֹ֑ךְ תִּרְמֹ֖ס כְּפִ֣יר וְתַנִּֽין׃
verses.translation: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and asp; The young lion and the serpent shalt thou trample under feet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י בִ֣י חָ֭שַׁק וַאֲפַלְּטֵ֑הוּ אֲ֝שַׂגְּבֵ֗הוּ כִּֽי־יָדַ֥ע שְׁמִֽי׃
verses.translit: khy by chshq v'plthv 'shgbhv khyyd' shmy
verses.translation: 'Because he hath set his love upon Me, therefore will I deliver him; I will set him on high, because he hath known My name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִקְרָאֵ֨נִי  וְֽאֶעֱנֵ֗הוּ עִמּֽוֹ־אָנֹכִ֥י בְצָרָ֑ה אֲ֝חַלְּצֵ֗הוּ וַאֲכַבְּדֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translation: He shall call upon Me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble; I will rescue him, and bring him to honour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים אַשְׂבִּיעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝אַרְאֵ֗הוּ בִּישׁוּעָתִֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translation: With long life will I satisfy him, And make Him to behold My salvation.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִזְמ֥וֹר שִׁ֗יר לְי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃
verses.translation: A Psalm, a Song. For the sabbath day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֗וֹב לְהֹד֥וֹת לַיהֹוָ֑ה וּלְזַמֵּ֖ר לְשִׁמְךָ֣ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.translation: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, And to sing praises unto Thy name, O Most High;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְהַגִּ֣יד בַּבֹּ֣קֶר חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וֶ֝אֱמ֥וּנָתְךָ֗ בַּלֵּילֽוֹת׃
verses.translation: To declare Thy lovingkindness in the morning, And Thy faithfulness in the night seasons,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲֽלֵי־עָ֭שׂוֹר וַעֲלֵי־נָ֑בֶל עֲלֵ֖י הִגָּי֣וֹן בְּכִנּֽוֹר׃
verses.translation: With an instrument of ten strings, and with the psaltery; With a solemn sound upon the harp.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י שִׂמַּחְתַּ֣נִי יְהֹוָ֣ה בְּפׇעֳלֶ֑ךָ בְּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: khy shmchtny yhvh bp'lkh bm'shy ydykh 'rnn
verses.translation: For Thou, LORD, hast made me glad through Thy work; I will exult in the works of Thy hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־גָּדְל֣וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֣יךָ יְהֹוָ֑ה מְ֝אֹ֗ד עָמְק֥וּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: How great are Thy works, O LORD! Thy thoughts are very deep.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִֽישׁ־בַּ֭עַר לֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע וּ֝כְסִ֗יל לֹא־יָבִ֥ין אֶת־זֹֽאת׃
verses.translation: A brutish man knoweth not, Neither doth a fool understand this.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּפְרֹ֤חַ רְשָׁעִ֨ים  כְּמ֥וֹ־עֵ֗שֶׂב וַ֭יָּצִיצוּ כׇּל־פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן לְהִשָּׁמְדָ֥ם עֲדֵי־עַֽד׃
verses.translit: bprch rsh'ym  khmv'shb vytsytsv khlp'ly 'vn lhshmdm 'dy'd
verses.translation: When the wicked spring up as the grass, And when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; It is that they may be destroyed for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֥ה מָר֗וֹם לְעֹלָ֥ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translation: But Thou, O LORD, art on high for evermore.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה אֹיְבֶ֡יךָ יְֽהֹוָ֗ה כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֣ה אֹיְבֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ יִ֝תְפָּרְד֗וּ כׇּל־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.translit: khy hnh 'ybykh yhvh khyhnh 'ybykh y'bdv ytprdv khlp'ly 'vn
verses.translation: For, lo, Thine enemies, O LORD, For, lo, Thine enemies shall perish: All the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּ֣רֶם כִּרְאֵ֣ים קַרְנִ֑י בַּ֝לֹּתִ֗י בְּשֶׁ֣מֶן רַעֲנָֽן׃
verses.translit: vtrm khr'ym qrny blty bshmn r'nn
verses.translation: But my horn hast Thou exalted like the horn of the wild-ox; I am anointed with rich oil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּבֵּ֥ט עֵינִ֗י בְּשׁ֫וּרָ֥י בַּקָּמִ֖ים עָלַ֥י מְרֵעִ֗ים תִּשְׁמַ֥עְנָה אׇזְנָֽי׃
verses.translation: Mine eye also hath gazed on them that lie in wait for me, Mine ears have heard my desire of the evil-doers that rise up against me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צַ֭דִּיק כַּתָּמָ֣ר יִפְרָ֑ח כְּאֶ֖רֶז בַּלְּבָנ֣וֹן יִשְׂגֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: tsdyq khtmr yprch kh'rz blbnvn yshgh
verses.translation: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree; He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁ֭תוּלִים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה בְּחַצְר֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ יַפְרִֽיחוּ׃
verses.translation: Planted in the house of the LORD, They shall flourish in the courts of our God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ע֭וֹד יְנוּב֣וּן בְּשֵׂיבָ֑ה דְּשֵׁנִ֖ים וְֽרַעֲנַנִּ֣ים יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.translation: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; They shall be full of sap and richness;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֭הַגִּיד כִּֽי־יָשָׁ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה צ֝וּרִ֗י וְֽלֹא־[עַוְלָ֥תָה] (עלתה) בּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lhgyd khyyshr yhvh tsvry vl'['vlth] ('lth) bv {p}
verses.translation: To declare that the LORD is upright, My Rock, in whom there is no unrighteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֣ה מָלָךְ֮ גֵּא֢וּת לָ֫בֵ֥שׁ לָבֵ֣שׁ יְ֭הֹוָה עֹ֣ז הִתְאַזָּ֑ר אַף־תִּכּ֥וֹן תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל בַּל־תִּמּֽוֹט׃
verses.translit: yhvh mlkh g'vt lbsh lbsh yhvh 'z ht'zr 'ftkhvn tbl bltmvt
verses.translation: The LORD reigneth; He is clothed in majesty; The LORD is clothed, He hath girded Himself with strength; Yea, the world is established, that it cannot be moved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֲךָ֣ מֵאָ֑ז מֵעוֹלָ֣ם אָֽתָּה׃
verses.translation: Thy throne is established of old; Thou art from everlasting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָשְׂא֤וּ נְהָר֨וֹת  יְֽהֹוָ֗ה נָשְׂא֣וּ נְהָר֣וֹת קוֹלָ֑ם יִשְׂא֖וּ נְהָר֣וֹת דׇּכְיָֽם׃
verses.translit: nsh'v nhrvt  yhvh nsh'v nhrvt qvlm ysh'v nhrvt dkhym
verses.translation: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, The floods have lifted up their voice; The floods lift up their roaring.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִקֹּל֨וֹת  מַ֤יִם רַבִּ֗ים אַדִּירִ֣ים מִשְׁבְּרֵי־יָ֑ם אַדִּ֖יר בַּמָּר֣וֹם יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: mqlvt  mym rbym 'dyrym mshbryym 'dyr bmrvm yhvh
verses.translation: Above the voices of many waters, The mighty breakers of the sea, The LORD on high is mighty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵֽדֹתֶ֨יךָ  נֶאֶמְנ֬וּ מְאֹ֗ד לְבֵיתְךָ֥ נַאֲוָה־קֹ֑דֶשׁ יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה לְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'dtykh  n'mnv m'd lbytkh n'vhqdsh yhvh l'rkh ymym {p}
verses.translation: Thy testimonies are very sure, Holiness becometh Thy house, O LORD, for evermore.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵל־נְקָמ֥וֹת יְהֹוָ֑ה אֵ֖ל נְקָמ֣וֹת הוֹפִֽיעַ׃
verses.translation: O LORD, Thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, Thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, shine forth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִ֭נָּשֵׂא שֹׁפֵ֣ט הָאָ֑רֶץ הָשֵׁ֥ב גְּ֝מ֗וּל עַל־גֵּאִֽים׃
verses.translation: Lift up Thyself, Thou Judge of the earth; Render to the proud their recompense.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־מָתַ֖י רְשָׁעִ֥ים ׀ יְהֹוָ֑ה עַד־מָ֝תַ֗י רְשָׁעִ֥ים יַעֲלֹֽזוּ׃
verses.translation: LORD, how long shall the wicked, How long shall the wicked exult?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַבִּ֣יעוּ יְדַבְּר֣וּ עָתָ֑ק יִ֝תְאַמְּר֗וּ כׇּל־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.translation: They gush out, they speak arrogancy; All the workers of iniquity bear themselves loftily.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַמְּךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֣ה יְדַכְּא֑וּ וְֽנַחֲלָתְךָ֥ יְעַנּֽוּ׃
verses.translation: They crush Thy people, O LORD, And afflict Thy heritage.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַלְמָנָ֣ה וְגֵ֣ר יַהֲרֹ֑גוּ וִ֖יתוֹמִ֣ים יְרַצֵּֽחוּ׃
verses.translation: They slay the widow and the stranger, And murder the fatherless.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭יֹּ֣אמְרוּ לֹ֣א יִרְאֶה־יָּ֑הּ וְלֹא־יָ֝בִ֗ין אֱלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translation: And they say: 'The LORD will not see, Neither will the God of Jacob give heed.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּ֭ינוּ בֹּעֲרִ֣ים בָּעָ֑ם וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים מָתַ֥י תַּשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃
verses.translit: bynv b'rym b'm vkhsylym mty tshkhylv
verses.translation: Consider, ye brutish among the people; And ye fools, when will ye understand?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲנֹ֣טַֽע אֹ֭זֶן הֲלֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑ע אִֽם־יֹ֥צֵֽר עַ֝֗יִן הֲלֹ֣א יַבִּֽיט׃
verses.translation: He that planted the ear, shall He not hear? He that formed the eye, shall He not see?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיֹסֵ֣ר גּ֭וֹיִם הֲלֹ֣א יוֹכִ֑יחַ הַֽמְלַמֵּ֖ד אָדָ֣ם דָּֽעַת׃
verses.translit: hysr gvym hl' yvkhych hmlmd 'dm d't
verses.translation: He that instructeth nations, shall not He correct? Even He that teacheth man knowledge?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה יֹ֭דֵעַ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת אָדָ֑ם כִּי־הֵ֥מָּה הָֽבֶל׃
verses.translation: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, That they are vanity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֤י  הַגֶּ֣בֶר אֲשֶׁר־תְּיַסְּרֶ֣נּוּ יָּ֑הּ וּֽמִתּוֹרָתְךָ֥ תְלַמְּדֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translation: Happy is the man whom Thou instructest, O LORD, And teachest out of Thy law;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְהַשְׁקִ֣יט ל֭וֹ מִ֣ימֵי רָ֑ע עַ֤ד יִכָּרֶ֖ה לָרָשָׁ֣ע שָֽׁחַת׃
verses.translit: lhshqyt lv mymy r' 'd ykhrh lrsh' shcht
verses.translation: That Thou mayest give him rest from the days of evil, Until the pit be digged for the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י  לֹא־יִטֹּ֣שׁ יְהֹוָ֣ה עַמּ֑וֹ וְ֝נַחֲלָת֗וֹ לֹ֣א יַעֲזֹֽב׃
verses.translit: khy  l'ytsh yhvh 'mv vnchltv l' y'zb
verses.translation: For the LORD will not cast off His people, Neither will He forsake His inheritance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־עַד־צֶ֭דֶק יָשׁ֣וּב מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝אַחֲרָ֗יו כׇּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵֽב׃
verses.translation: For right shall return unto justice, And all the upright in heart shall follow it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־יָק֣וּם לִ֭י עִם־מְרֵעִ֑ים מִי־יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב לִ֝֗י עִם־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.translation: Who will rise up for me against the evil-doers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הֹוָה עֶזְרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י כִּמְעַ֓ט  שָׁכְנָ֖ה דוּמָ֣ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: lvly yhvh 'zrth ly khm't  shkhnh dvmh npshy
verses.translation: Unless the LORD had been my help, My soul had soon dwelt in silence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אָ֭מַרְתִּי מָ֣טָה רַגְלִ֑י חַסְדְּךָ֥ יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה יִסְעָדֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: If I say: 'My foot slippeth', Thy mercy, O LORD, holdeth me up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּרֹ֣ב שַׂרְעַפַּ֣י בְּקִרְבִּ֑י תַּ֝נְחוּמֶ֗יךָ יְֽשַׁעַשְׁע֥וּ נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: brb shr'py bqrby tnchvmykh ysh'sh'v npshy
verses.translation: When my cares are many within me, Thy comforts delight my soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽ֭יְחׇבְרְךָ כִּסֵּ֣א הַוּ֑וֹת יֹצֵ֖ר עָמָ֣ל עֲלֵי־חֹֽק׃
verses.translation: Shall the seat of wickedness have fellowship with Thee, Which frameth mischief by statute?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָ֭גוֹדּוּ עַל־נֶ֣פֶשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וְדָ֖ם נָקִ֣י יַרְשִֽׁיעוּ׃
verses.translation: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, And condemn innocent blood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֬י יְהֹוָ֣ה לִ֣י לְמִשְׂגָּ֑ב וֵ֝אלֹהַ֗י לְצ֣וּר מַחְסִֽי׃
verses.translit: vyhy yhvh ly lmshgb v'lhy ltsvr mchsy
verses.translation: But the LORD hath been my high tower, And my God the rock of my refuge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶ֨ם  אֶת־אוֹנָ֗ם וּבְרָעָתָ֥ם יַצְמִיתֵ֑ם יַ֝צְמִיתֵ֗ם יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: And He hath brought upon them their own iniquity, And will cut them off in their own evil; The LORD our God will cut them off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֭כוּ נְרַנְּנָ֣ה לַיהֹוָ֑ה נָ֝רִ֗יעָה לְצ֣וּר יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: lkhv nrnnh lyhvh nry'h ltsvr ysh'nv
verses.translation: O come, let us sing unto the LORD; Let us shout for joy to the Rock of our salvation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְקַדְּמָ֣ה פָנָ֣יו בְּתוֹדָ֑ה בִּ֝זְמִר֗וֹת נָרִ֥יעַֽ לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: nqdmh pnyv btvdh bzmrvt nry' lv
verses.translation: Let us come before His presence with thanksgiving, Let us shout for joy unto Him with psalms.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ל גָּד֣וֹל יְהֹוָ֑ה וּמֶ֥לֶךְ גָּ֝ד֗וֹל עַל־כׇּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translation: For the LORD is a great God, And a great King above all gods;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ֭יָדוֹ מֶחְקְרֵי־אָ֑רֶץ וְתוֹעֲפֹ֖ת הָרִ֣ים לֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: In whose hand are the depths of the earth; The heights of the mountains are His also.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ל֣וֹ הַ֭יָּם וְה֣וּא עָשָׂ֑הוּ וְ֝יַבֶּ֗שֶׁת יָדָ֥יו יָצָֽרוּ׃
verses.translation: The sea is His, and He made it; And His hands formed the dry land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֹּ֭אוּ נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֣ה וְנִכְרָ֑עָה נִ֝בְרְכָ֗ה לִֽפְנֵי־יְהֹוָ֥ה עֹשֵֽׂנוּ׃
verses.translation: O come, let us bow down and bend the knee; Let us kneel before the LORD our Maker;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֘י־ה֤וּא אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַ֣ם מַ֭רְעִיתוֹ וְצֹ֣אן יָד֑וֹ הַ֝יּ֗וֹם אִֽם־בְּקֹל֥וֹ תִשְׁמָֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: khyhv' 'lhynv v'nchnv 'm mr'ytv vts'n ydv hyvm 'mbqlv tshm'v
verses.translation: For He is our God, And we are the people of His pasture, and the flock of His hand. To-day, if ye would but hearken to His voice!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תַּקְשׁ֣וּ לְ֭בַבְכֶם כִּמְרִיבָ֑ה כְּי֥וֹם מַ֝סָּ֗ה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.translation: 'Harden not your heart, as at Meribah, As in the day of Massah in the wilderness;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֭סּוּנִי אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּ֝חָנ֗וּנִי גַּם־רָא֥וּ פׇעֳלִֽי׃
verses.translation: When your fathers tried Me, Proved Me, even though they saw My work.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַרְבָּ֘עִ֤ים שָׁנָ֨ה  אָ֘ק֤וּט בְּד֗וֹר וָאֹמַ֗ר עַ֤ם תֹּעֵ֣י לֵבָ֣ב הֵ֑ם וְ֝הֵ֗ם לֹא־יָדְע֥וּ דְרָכָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'rb'ym shnh  'qvt bdvr v'mr 'm t'y lbb hm vhm l'yd'v drkhy
verses.translation: For forty years was I wearied with that generation, And said: It is a people that do err in their heart, And they have not known My ways;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי בְאַפִּ֑י אִם־יְ֝בֹא֗וּן אֶל־מְנוּחָתִֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Wherefore I swore in My wrath, That they should not enter into My rest.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭יהֹוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ שִׁ֥ירוּ לַ֝יהֹוָ֗ה כׇּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: shyrv lyhvh shyr chdsh shyrv lyhvh khlh'rts
verses.translation: O sing unto the LORD a new song; Sing unto the LORD, all the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭יהֹוָה בָּרְכ֣וּ שְׁמ֑וֹ בַּשְּׂר֥וּ מִיּֽוֹם־לְ֝י֗וֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: shyrv lyhvh brkhv shmv bshrv myvmlyvm yshv'tv
verses.translation: Sing unto the LORD, bless His name; Proclaim His salvation from day to day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סַפְּר֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֣ם כְּבוֹד֑וֹ בְּכׇל־הָ֝עַמִּ֗ים נִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translation: Declare His glory among the nations, His marvellous works among all the peoples.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֥י־גָ֘ד֤וֹל יְהֹוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד נוֹרָ֥א ה֝֗וּא עַל־כׇּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: khygdvl yhvh vmhll m'd nvr' hv' 'lkhl'lhym
verses.translation: For great is the LORD, and highly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י  כׇּל־אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָעַמִּ֣ים אֱלִילִ֑ים וַ֝יהֹוָ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.translation: For all the gods of the peoples are things of nought; But the LORD made the heavens.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹד־וְהָדָ֥ר לְפָנָ֑יו עֹ֥ז וְ֝תִפְאֶ֗רֶת בְּמִקְדָּשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translation: Honour and majesty are before Him; Strength and beauty are in His sanctuary.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהֹוָה מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת עַמִּ֑ים הָב֥וּ לַ֝יהֹוָ֗ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃
verses.translit: hbv lyhvh mshpchvt 'mym hbv lyhvh khbvd v'z
verses.translation: Ascribe unto the LORD, ye kindreds of the peoples, Ascribe unto the LORD glory and strength.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהֹוָה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ שְׂאֽוּ־מִ֝נְחָ֗ה וּבֹ֥אוּ לְחַצְרוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: hbv lyhvh khbvd shmv sh'vmnchh vb'v lchtsrvtyv
verses.translation: Ascribe unto the LORD the glory due unto His name; Bring an offering, and come into His courts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לַ֭יהֹוָה בְּהַדְרַת־קֹ֑דֶשׁ חִ֥ילוּ מִ֝פָּנָ֗יו כׇּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: hshtchvv lyhvh bhdrtqdsh chylv mpnyv khlh'rts
verses.translation: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness; Tremble before Him, all the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִמְר֤וּ בַגּוֹיִ֨ם  יְ֘הֹוָ֤ה מָלָ֗ךְ אַף־תִּכּ֣וֹן תֵּ֭בֵל בַּל־תִּמּ֑וֹט יָדִ֥ין עַ֝מִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'mrv bgvym  yhvh mlkh 'ftkhvn tbl bltmvt ydyn 'mym bmyshrym
verses.translation: Say among the nations: 'The LORD reigneth.' The world also is established that it cannot be moved; He will judge the peoples with equity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׂמְח֣וּ הַ֭שָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ יִֽרְעַ֥ם הַ֝יָּ֗ם וּמְלֹאֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: yshmchv hshmym vtgl h'rts yr'm hym vml'v
verses.translation: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַעֲלֹ֣ז שָׂ֭דַי וְכׇל־אֲשֶׁר־בּ֑וֹ אָ֥ז יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ כׇּל־עֲצֵי־יָֽעַר׃
verses.translation: Let the field exult; and all that is therein; Then shall all the trees of the wood sing for joy;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִפְנֵ֤י יְהֹוָ֨ה  כִּ֬י בָ֗א כִּ֥י בָא֮ לִשְׁפֹּ֢ט הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ יִשְׁפֹּֽט־תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק וְ֝עַמִּ֗ים בֶּאֱמוּנָתֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lpny yhvh  khy b' khy b' lshpt h'rts yshpttbl btsdq v'mym b'mvntv {p}
verses.translation: Before the LORD, for He is come; For He is come to judge the earth; He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples in His faithfulness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ תָּגֵ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ יִ֝שְׂמְח֗וּ אִיִּ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: yhvh mlkh tgl h'rts yshmchv 'yym rbym
verses.translation: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; Let the multitude of isles be glad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָנָ֣ן וַעֲרָפֶ֣ל סְבִיבָ֑יו צֶ֥דֶק וּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט מְכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'nn v'rpl sbybyv tsdq vmshpt mkhvn khs'v
verses.translation: Clouds and darkness are round about Him; Righteousness and justice are the foundation of His throne.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֭שׁ לְפָנָ֣יו תֵּלֵ֑ךְ וּתְלַהֵ֖ט סָבִ֣יב צָרָֽיו׃
verses.translation: A fire goeth before Him, And burneth up His adversaries round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵאִ֣ירוּ בְרָקָ֣יו תֵּבֵ֑ל רָאֲתָ֖ה וַתָּחֵ֣ל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: h'yrv brqyv tbl r'th vtchl h'rts
verses.translation: His lightnings lighted up the world; The earth saw, and trembled.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָרִ֗ים כַּדּוֹנַ֗ג נָ֭מַסּוּ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה מִ֝לִּפְנֵ֗י אֲד֣וֹן כׇּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: hrym khdvng nmsv mlpny yhvh mlpny 'dvn khlh'rts
verses.translation: The mountains melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִגִּ֣ידוּ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם צִדְק֑וֹ וְרָא֖וּ כׇל־הָעַמִּ֣ים כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hgydv hshmym tsdqv vr'v khlh'mym khbvdv
verses.translation: The heavens declared His righteousness, And all the peoples saw His glory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ  כׇּל־עֹ֬בְדֵי פֶ֗סֶל הַמִּֽתְהַלְלִ֥ים בָּאֱלִילִ֑ים הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־ל֝֗וֹ כׇּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: ybshv  khl'bdy psl hmthllym b'lylym hshtchvvlv khl'lhym
verses.translation: Ashamed be all they that serve graven images, That boast themselves of things of nought; Bow down to Him, all ye gods.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁמְעָ֬ה וַתִּשְׂמַ֨ח  צִיּ֗וֹן וַ֭תָּגֵלְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה לְמַ֖עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: shm'h vtshmch  tsyvn vtglnh bnvt yhvdh lm'n mshptykh yhvh
verses.translation: Zion heard and was glad, And the daughters of Judah rejoiced; Because of Thy judgments, O LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֤ה יְהֹוָ֗ה עֶלְי֥וֹן עַל־כׇּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ מְאֹ֥ד נַ֝עֲלֵ֗יתָ עַל־כׇּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translation: For Thou, LORD, art most high above all the earth; Thou art exalted far above all gods.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹֽהֲבֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֗ה שִׂנְא֫וּ־רָ֥ע שֹׁ֭מֵר נַפְשׁ֣וֹת חֲסִידָ֑יו מִיַּ֥ד רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יַצִּילֵֽם׃
verses.translit: 'hby yhvh shn'vr' shmr npshvt chsydyv myd rsh'ym ytsylm
verses.translation: O ye that love the LORD, hate evil; He preserveth the souls of His saints; He delivered them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֭וֹר זָרֻ֣עַ לַצַּדִּ֑יק וּֽלְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵ֥ב שִׂמְחָֽה׃
verses.translation: Light is sown for the righteous, And gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׂמְח֣וּ צַ֭דִּיקִים בַּיהֹוָ֑ה וְ֝הוֹד֗וּ לְזֵ֣כֶר קׇדְשֽׁוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: shmchv tsdyqym byhvh vhvdv lzkhr qdshv {p}
verses.translation: Be glad in the LORD, ye righteous; And give thanks to His holy name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִזְמ֡וֹר שִׁ֤ירוּ לַיהֹוָ֨ה  שִׁ֣יר חָ֭דָשׁ כִּֽי־נִפְלָא֣וֹת עָשָׂ֑ה הוֹשִׁיעָה־לּ֥וֹ יְ֝מִינ֗וֹ וּזְר֥וֹעַ קׇדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: mzmvr shyrv lyhvh  shyr chdsh khynpl'vt 'shh hvshy'hlv ymynv vzrv' qdshv
verses.translation: A Psalm. O sing unto the LORD a new song; For He hath done marvellous things; His right hand, and His holy arm, hath wrought salvation for Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹדִ֣יעַ יְ֭הֹוָה יְשׁוּעָת֑וֹ לְעֵינֵ֥י הַ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם גִּלָּ֥ה צִדְקָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hvdy' yhvh yshv'tv l'yny hgvym glh tsdqtv
verses.translation: The LORD hath made known His salvation; His righteousness hath He revealed in the sight of the nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זָ֘כַ֤ר חַסְדּ֨וֹ  וֶ֥אֱֽמוּנָתוֹ֮ לְבֵ֢ית יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל רָא֥וּ כׇל־אַפְסֵי־אָ֑רֶץ אֵ֝֗ת יְשׁוּעַ֥ת אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: zkhr chsdv  v'mvntv lbyt yshr'l r'v khl'psy'rts 't yshv't 'lhynv
verses.translation: He hath remembered His mercy and His faithfulness toward the house of Israel; All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָרִ֣יעוּ לַ֭יהֹוָה כׇּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ פִּצְח֖וּ וְרַנְּנ֣וּ וְזַמֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: hry'v lyhvh khlh'rts ptschv vrnnv vzmrv
verses.translation: Shout unto the LORD, all the earth; Break forth and sing for joy, yea, sing praises.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זַמְּר֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה בְּכִנּ֑וֹר בְּ֝כִנּ֗וֹר וְק֣וֹל זִמְרָֽה׃
verses.translit: zmrv lyhvh bkhnvr bkhnvr vqvl zmrh
verses.translation: Sing praises unto the LORD with the harp; With the harp and the voice of melody.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּ֭חֲצֹ֣צְרוֹת וְק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָ֑ר הָ֝רִ֗יעוּ לִפְנֵ֤י  הַמֶּ֬לֶךְ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: bchtstsrvt vqvl shvpr hry'v lpny  hmlkh yhvh
verses.translation: With trumpets and sound of the horn Shout ye before the King, the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִרְעַ֣ם הַ֭יָּם וּמְלֹא֑וֹ תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל וְיֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: yr'm hym vml'v tbl vyshby bh
verses.translation: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְהָר֥וֹת יִמְחֲאוּ־כָ֑ף יַ֝֗חַד הָרִ֥ים יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.translation: Let the floods clap their hands; Let the mountains sing for joy together;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִ֥פְֽנֵי־יְהֹוָ֗ה כִּ֥י בָא֮ לִשְׁפֹּ֢ט הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ יִשְׁפֹּֽט־תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק וְ֝עַמִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lpnyyhvh khy b' lshpt h'rts yshpttbl btsdq v'mym bmyshrym {p}
verses.translation: Before the LORD, for He is come to judge the earth; He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with equity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ יִרְגְּז֣וּ עַמִּ֑ים יֹשֵׁ֥ב כְּ֝רוּבִ֗ים תָּנ֥וּט הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: yhvh mlkh yrgzv 'mym yshb khrvbym tnvt h'rts
verses.translation: The LORD reigneth; let the peoples tremble; He is enthroned upon the cherubim; let the earth quake.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְ֭הֹוָה בְּצִיּ֣וֹן גָּד֑וֹל וְרָ֥ם ה֝֗וּא עַל־כׇּל־הָעַמִּֽים׃
verses.translation: The LORD is great in Zion; And He is high above all the peoples.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּ שִׁ֭מְךָ גָּד֥וֹל וְנוֹרָ֗א קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: yvdv shmkh gdvl vnvr' qdvsh hv'
verses.translation: Let them praise Thy name as great and awful; Holy is He.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעֹ֥ז מֶלֶךְ֮ מִשְׁפָּ֢ט אָ֫הֵ֥ב אַ֭תָּה כּוֹנַ֣נְתָּ מֵישָׁרִ֑ים מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה בְּיַעֲקֹ֤ב  אַתָּ֬ה עָשִֽׂיתָ׃
verses.translit: v'z mlkh mshpt 'hb 'th khvnnt myshrym mshpt vtsdqh by'qb  'th 'shyt
verses.translation: The strength also of the king who loveth justice— Thou hast established equity, Thou hast executed justice and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רוֹמְמ֡וּ יְ֘הֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְֽ֭הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַהֲדֹ֥ם רַגְלָ֗יו קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: rvmmv yhvh 'lhynv vhshtchvv lhdm rglyv qdvsh hv'
verses.translation: Exalt ye the LORD our God, And prostrate yourselves at His footstool; Holy is He.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֹ֘שֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹ֨ן  בְּֽכֹהֲנָ֗יו וּ֭שְׁמוּאֵל בְּקֹרְאֵ֣י שְׁמ֑וֹ קֹרִ֥אים אֶל־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה וְה֣וּא יַעֲנֵֽם׃
verses.translit: mshh v'hrn  bkhhnyv vshmv'l bqr'y shmv qr'ym 'lyhvh vhv' y'nm
verses.translation: Moses and Aaron among His priests, And Samuel among them that call upon His name, Did call upon the LORD, and He answered them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּעַמּ֣וּד עָ֭נָן יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם שָׁמְר֥וּ עֵ֝דֹתָ֗יו וְחֹ֣ק נָֽתַן־לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translation: He spoke unto them in the pillar of cloud; They kept His testimonies, and the statute that He gave them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵינוּ֮ אַתָּ֢ה עֲנִ֫יתָ֥ם אֵ֣ל נֹ֭שֵׂא הָיִ֣יתָ לָהֶ֑ם וְ֝נֹקֵ֗ם עַל־עֲלִילוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translation: O LORD our God, Thou didst answer them; A forgiving God wast Thou unto them, Though Thou tookest vengeance of their misdeeds.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רוֹמְמ֡וּ יְ֘הֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְֽ֭הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְהַ֣ר קׇדְשׁ֑וֹ כִּי־קָ֝ד֗וֹשׁ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: rvmmv yhvh 'lhynv vhshtchvv lhr qdshv khyqdvsh yhvh 'lhynv {p}
verses.translation: Exalt ye the LORD our God, And worship at His holy hill; For the LORD our God is holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִזְמ֥וֹר לְתוֹדָ֑ה הָרִ֥יעוּ לַ֝יהֹוָ֗ה כׇּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translation: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout unto the LORD, all the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִבְד֣וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה בְּשִׂמְחָ֑ה בֹּ֥אוּ לְ֝פָנָ֗יו בִּרְנָנָֽה׃
verses.translation: Serve the LORD with gladness; come before His presence with singing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דְּע֗וּ כִּֽי־יְהֹוָה֮ ה֤וּא אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים הֽוּא־עָ֭שָׂנוּ (ולא) [וְל֣וֹ] אֲנַ֑חְנוּ עַ֝מּ֗וֹ וְצֹ֣אן מַרְעִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: d'v khyyhvh hv' 'lhym hv''shnv (vl') [vlv] 'nchnv 'mv vts'n mr'ytv
verses.translation: Know ye that the LORD He is God; it is He that hath made us, and we are His, His people, and the flock of His pasture.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֹּ֤אוּ שְׁעָרָ֨יו  בְּתוֹדָ֗ה חֲצֵרֹתָ֥יו בִּתְהִלָּ֑ה הוֹדוּ־ל֝֗וֹ בָּרְכ֥וּ שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: b'v sh'ryv  btvdh chtsrtyv bthlh hvdvlv brkhv shmv
verses.translation: Enter into His gates with thanksgiving, and into His courts with praise; give thanks unto Him, and bless His name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־ט֣וֹב יְ֭הֹוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְעַד־דֹּ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר אֱמוּנָתֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khytvb yhvh l'vlm chsdv v'ddr vdr 'mvntv {p}
verses.translation: For the LORD is good; His mercy endureth for ever; and His faithfulness unto all generations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר חֶֽסֶד־וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט אָשִׁ֑ירָה לְךָ֖ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֲזַמֵּֽרָה׃
verses.translation: A Psalm of David. I will sing of mercy and justice; unto Thee, O LORD, will I sing praises.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשְׂכִּ֤ילָה  בְּדֶ֬רֶךְ תָּמִ֗ים מָ֭תַי תָּב֣וֹא אֵלָ֑י אֶתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בְּתׇם־לְ֝בָבִ֗י בְּקֶ֣רֶב בֵּיתִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'shkhylh  bdrkh tmym mty tbv' 'ly 'thlkh btmlbby bqrb byty
verses.translation: I will give heed unto the way of integrity; oh when wilt Thou come unto me? I will walk within my house in the integrity of my heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־אָשִׁ֨ית  לְנֶ֥גֶד עֵינַ֗י דְּֽבַר־בְּלִ֫יָּ֥עַל עֲשֹֽׂה־סֵטִ֥ים שָׂנֵ֑אתִי לֹ֖א יִדְבַּ֣ק בִּֽי׃
verses.translit: l''shyt  lngd 'yny dbrbly'l 'shhstym shn'ty l' ydbq by
verses.translation: I will set no base thing before mine eyes; I hate the doing of things crooked; it shall not cleave unto me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵבָ֣ב עִ֭קֵּשׁ יָס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נִּי רָ֝֗ע לֹ֣א אֵדָֽע׃
verses.translation: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will know no evil thing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (מלושני) [מְלׇשְׁנִ֬י] בַסֵּ֨תֶר  רֵעֵהוּ֮ אוֹת֢וֹ אַ֫צְמִ֥ית גְּֽבַהּ־עֵ֭ינַיִם וּרְחַ֣ב לֵבָ֑ב אֹ֝ת֗וֹ לֹ֣א אוּכָֽל׃
verses.translit: (mlvshny) [mlshny] bstr  r'hv 'vtv 'tsmyt gbh'ynym vrchb lbb 'tv l' 'vkhl
verses.translation: Whoso slandereth his neighbour in secret, him will I destroy; Whoso is haughty of eye and proud of heart, him will I not suffer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵינַ֤י  בְּנֶֽאֶמְנֵי־אֶרֶץ֮ לָשֶׁ֢בֶת עִמָּ֫דִ֥י הֹ֭לֵךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ תָּמִ֑ים ה֝֗וּא יְשָׁרְתֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: 'yny  bn'mny'rts lshbt 'mdy hlkh bdrkh tmym hv' yshrtny
verses.translation: Mine eyes are upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he that walketh in a way of integrity, he shall minister unto me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־יֵשֵׁ֨ב  בְּקֶ֥רֶב בֵּיתִי֮ עֹשֵׂ֢ה רְמִ֫יָּ֥ה דֹּבֵ֥ר שְׁקָרִ֑ים לֹא־יִ֝כּ֗וֹן לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽי׃
verses.translit: l'yshb  bqrb byty 'shh rmyh dbr shqrym l'ykhvn lngd 'yny
verses.translation: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house; he that speaketh falsehood shall not be established before mine eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַבְּקָרִ֗ים אַצְמִ֥ית כׇּל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָ֑רֶץ לְהַכְרִ֥ית מֵעִיר־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה כׇּל־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Morning by morning will I destroy all the wicked of the land; to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the city of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּ֭פִלָּה לְעָנִ֣י כִֽי־יַעֲטֹ֑ף וְלִפְנֵ֥י יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ שִׂיחֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: tplh l'ny khyy'tf vlpny yhvh yshpkh shychv
verses.translation: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he fainteth, and poureth out his complaint before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְ֭הֹוָה שִׁמְעָ֣ה תְפִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י אֵלֶ֥יךָ תָבֽוֹא׃
verses.translation: O LORD, hear my prayer, and let my cry come unto Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨יךָ  מִמֶּנִּי֮ בְּי֢וֹם צַ֫ר־לִ֥י הַטֵּֽה־אֵלַ֥י אׇזְנֶ֑ךָ בְּי֥וֹם אֶ֝קְרָ֗א מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: 'ltstr pnykh  mmny byvm tsrly hth'ly 'znkh byvm 'qr' mhr 'nny
verses.translation: Hide not Thy face from me in the day of my distress; incline Thine ear unto me; in the day when I call answer me speedily.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־כָל֣וּ בְעָשָׁ֣ן יָמָ֑י וְ֝עַצְמוֹתַ֗י כְּמוֹקֵ֥ד נִחָֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: khykhlv b'shn ymy v'tsmvty khmvqd nchrv
verses.translation: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as a hearth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוּכָּה־כָעֵ֣שֶׂב וַיִּבַ֣שׁ לִבִּ֑י כִּֽי־שָׁ֝כַ֗חְתִּי מֵאֲכֹ֥ל לַחְמִֽי׃
verses.translit: hvkhhkh'shb vybsh lby khyshkhchty m'khl lchmy
verses.translation: My heart is smitten like grass, and withered; for I forget to eat my bread.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִקּ֥וֹל אַנְחָתִ֑י דָּבְקָ֥ה עַ֝צְמִ֗י לִבְשָׂרִֽי׃
verses.translation: By reason of the voice of my sighing My bones cleave to my flesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דָּ֭מִיתִי לִקְאַ֣ת מִדְבָּ֑ר הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כְּכ֣וֹס חֳרָבֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: dmyty lq't mdbr hyyty khkhvs chrbvt
verses.translation: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am become as an owl of the waste places.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁקַ֥דְתִּי וָאֶהְיֶ֑ה כְּ֝צִפּ֗וֹר בּוֹדֵ֥ד עַל־גָּֽג׃
verses.translation: I watch, and am become like a sparrow that is alone upon the housetop.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַ֭יּוֹם חֵרְפ֣וּנִי אוֹיְבָ֑י מְ֝הוֹלָלַ֗י בִּ֣י נִשְׁבָּֽעוּ׃
verses.translation: Mine enemies taunt me all the day; they that are mad against me do curse by me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־אֵ֭פֶר כַּלֶּ֣חֶם אָכָ֑לְתִּי וְ֝שִׁקֻּוַ֗י בִּבְכִ֥י מָסָֽכְתִּי׃
verses.translation: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
