verses.original: מִפְּנֵֽי־זַעַמְךָ֥ וְקִצְפֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י נְ֝שָׂאתַ֗נִי וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Because of Thine indignation and Thy wrath; for Thou hast taken me up, and cast me away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָ֭מַי כְּצֵ֣ל נָט֑וּי וַ֝אֲנִ֗י כָּעֵ֥שֶׂב אִיבָֽשׁ׃
verses.translation: My days are like a lengthening shadow; and I am withered like grass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תֵּשֵׁ֑ב וְ֝זִכְרְךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.translit: v'th yhvh l'vlm tshb vzkhrkh ldr vdr
verses.translation: But Thou, O LORD, sittest enthroned for ever; and Thy name is unto all generations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה תָ֭קוּם תְּרַחֵ֣ם צִיּ֑וֹן כִּי־עֵ֥ת לְ֝חֶֽנְנָ֗הּ כִּי־בָ֥א מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: 'th tqvm trchm tsyvn khy't lchnnh khyb' mv'd
verses.translation: Thou wilt arise, and have compassion upon Zion; for it is time to be gracious unto her, for the appointed time is come.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־רָצ֣וּ עֲ֭בָדֶיךָ אֶת־אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ וְֽאֶת־עֲפָרָ֥הּ יְחֹנֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translation: For Thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and love her dust.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִֽירְא֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה וְֽכׇל־מַלְכֵ֥י הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ אֶת־כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: So the nations will fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth Thy glory;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־בָנָ֣ה יְהֹוָ֣ה צִיּ֑וֹן נִ֝רְאָ֗ה בִּכְבוֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: When the LORD hath built up Zion, when He hath appeared in His glory;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּ֭נָה אֶל־תְּפִלַּ֣ת הָעַרְעָ֑ר וְלֹא־בָ֝זָ֗ה אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָֽם׃
verses.translation: When He hath regarded the prayer of the destitute, And hath not despised their prayer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּכָּ֣תֶב זֹ֭את לְד֣וֹר אַחֲר֑וֹן וְעַ֥ם נִ֝בְרָ֗א יְהַלֶּל־יָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: tkhtb z't ldvr 'chrvn v'm nbr' yhllyh
verses.translation: This shall be written for the generation to come; And a people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הִ֭שְׁקִיף מִמְּר֣וֹם קׇדְשׁ֑וֹ יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה מִשָּׁמַ֤יִם  אֶל־אֶ֬רֶץ הִבִּֽיט׃
verses.translit: khyhshqyf mmrvm qdshv yhvh mshmym  'l'rts hbyt
verses.translation: For He hath looked down from the height of His sanctuary; From heaven did the LORD behold the earth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִ֭שְׁמֹעַ אֶנְקַ֣ת אָסִ֑יר לְ֝פַתֵּ֗חַ בְּנֵ֣י תְמוּתָֽה׃
verses.translation: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; To loose those that are appointed to death;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְסַפֵּ֣ר בְּ֭צִיּוֹן שֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה וּ֝תְהִלָּת֗וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: lspr btsyvn shm yhvh vthltv byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: That men may tell of the name of the LORD in Zion, And His praise in Jerusalem; .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּהִקָּבֵ֣ץ עַמִּ֣ים יַחְדָּ֑ו וּ֝מַמְלָכ֗וֹת לַעֲבֹ֥ד אֶת־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translation: When the peoples are gathered together, And the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִנָּ֖ה בַדֶּ֥רֶךְ (כחו) [כֹּחִ֗י] קִצַּ֥ר יָמָֽי׃
verses.translation: He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹמַ֗ר אֵלִ֗י אַֽל־תַּ֭עֲלֵנִי בַּחֲצִ֣י יָמָ֑י בְּד֖וֹר דּוֹרִ֣ים שְׁנוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: I say: 'O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days, Thou whose years endure throughout all generations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֭פָנִים הָאָ֣רֶץ יָסַ֑דְתָּ וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ שָׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: lpnym h'rts ysdt vm'shh ydykh shmym
verses.translation: Of old Thou didst lay the foundation of the earth; And the heavens are the work of Thy hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֤מָּה  יֹאבֵדוּ֮ וְאַתָּ֢ה תַ֫עֲמֹ֥ד וְ֭כֻלָּם כַּבֶּ֣גֶד יִבְל֑וּ כַּלְּב֖וּשׁ תַּחֲלִיפֵ֣ם וְֽיַחֲלֹֽפוּ׃
verses.translit: hmh  y'bdv v'th t'md vkhlm khbgd yblv khlbvsh tchlypm vychlpv
verses.translation: They shall perish, but Thou shalt endure; Yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; As a vesture shalt Thou change them, and they shall pass away;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּה־ה֑וּא וּ֝שְׁנוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִתָּֽמּוּ׃
verses.translation: But Thou art the selfsame, And Thy years shall have no end.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵֽי־עֲבָדֶ֥יךָ יִשְׁכּ֑וֹנוּ וְ֝זַרְעָ֗ם לְפָנֶ֥יךָ יִכּֽוֹן׃ {פ}
verses.translation: The children of Thy servants shall dwell securely, And their seed shall be established before Thee.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְדָוִ֨ד  בָּרְכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְכׇל־קְ֝רָבַ֗י אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם קׇדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translation: [A Psalm] of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; And all that is within me, bless His holy name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּרְכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְאַל־תִּ֝שְׁכְּחִ֗י כׇּל־גְּמוּלָֽיו׃
verses.translation: Bless the LORD, O my soul, And forget not all His benefits;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַסֹּלֵ֥חַ לְכׇל־עֲוֺנֵ֑כִי הָ֝רֹפֵ֗א לְכׇל־תַּחֲלוּאָֽיְכִי׃
verses.translation: Who forgiveth all thine iniquity; Who healeth all Thy diseases;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַגּוֹאֵ֣ל מִשַּׁ֣חַת חַיָּ֑יְכִי הַֽ֝מְעַטְּרֵ֗כִי חֶ֣סֶד וְרַחֲמִֽים׃
verses.translit: hgv'l mshcht chyykhy hm'trkhy chsd vrchmym
verses.translation: Who redeemeth Thy life from the pit; Who encompasseth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַמַּשְׂבִּ֣יעַ בַּטּ֣וֹב עֶדְיֵ֑ךְ תִּתְחַדֵּ֖שׁ כַּנֶּ֣שֶׁר נְעוּרָֽיְכִי׃
verses.translation: Who satisfieth thine old age with good things; So that Thy youth is renewed like the eagle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹשֵׂ֣ה צְדָק֣וֹת יְהֹוָ֑ה וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטִ֗ים לְכׇל־עֲשׁוּקִֽים׃
verses.translation: The LORD executeth righteousness, And acts of justice for all that are oppressed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹדִ֣יעַ דְּרָכָ֣יו לְמֹשֶׁ֑ה לִבְנֵ֥י יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל עֲלִילוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translation: He made known His ways unto Moses, His doings unto the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַח֣וּם וְחַנּ֣וּן יְהֹוָ֑ה אֶ֖רֶךְ אַפַּ֣יִם וְרַב־חָֽסֶד׃
verses.translation: The LORD is full of compassion and gracious, Slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־לָנֶ֥צַח יָרִ֑יב וְלֹ֖א לְעוֹלָ֣ם יִטּֽוֹר׃
verses.translation: He will not always contend; Neither will He keep His anger for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א כַ֭חֲטָאֵינוּ עָ֣שָׂה לָ֑נוּ וְלֹ֥א כַ֝עֲוֺנֹתֵ֗ינוּ גָּמַ֥ל עָלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: l' khcht'ynv 'shh lnv vl' kh'vntynv gml 'lynv
verses.translation: He hath not dealt with us after our sins, Nor requited us according to our iniquities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י כִגְבֹ֣הַּ שָׁ֭מַיִם עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ גָּבַ֥ר חַ֝סְדּ֗וֹ עַל־יְרֵאָֽיו׃
verses.translation: For as the heaven is high above the earth, So great is His mercy toward them that fear Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּרְחֹ֣ק מִ֭זְרָח מִֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב הִֽרְחִ֥יק מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ אֶת־פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translation: As far as the east is from the west, So far hath He removed our transgressions from us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּרַחֵ֣ם אָ֭ב עַל־בָּנִ֑ים רִחַ֥ם יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה עַל־יְרֵאָֽיו׃
verses.translation: Like as a father hath compassion upon his children, So hath the LORD compassion upon them that fear Him. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־ה֭וּא יָדַ֣ע יִצְרֵ֑נוּ זָ֝כ֗וּר כִּי־עָפָ֥ר אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃
verses.translation: For He knoweth our frame; He remembereth that we are dust.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱ֭נוֹשׁ כֶּחָצִ֣יר יָמָ֑יו כְּצִ֥יץ הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה כֵּ֣ן יָצִֽיץ׃
verses.translit: 'nvsh khchtsyr ymyv khtsyts hshdh khn ytsyts
verses.translation: As for man, his days are as grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י ר֣וּחַ עָֽבְרָה־בּ֣וֹ וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ וְלֹֽא־יַכִּירֶ֖נּוּ ע֣וֹד מְקוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; And the place thereof knoweth it no more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחֶ֤סֶד יְהֹוָ֨ה  מֵעוֹלָ֣ם וְעַד־ע֭וֹלָם עַל־יְרֵאָ֑יו וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ לִבְנֵ֥י בָנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vchsd yhvh  m'vlm v'd'vlm 'lyr'yv vtsdqtv lbny bnym
verses.translation: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear Him, And His righteousness unto children's children;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י בְרִית֑וֹ וּלְזֹכְרֵ֥י פִ֝קֻּדָ֗יו לַעֲשׂוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translation: To such as keep His covenant, And to those that remember His precepts to do them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה בַּ֭שָּׁמַיִם הֵכִ֣ין כִּסְא֑וֹ וּ֝מַלְכוּת֗וֹ בַּכֹּ֥ל מָשָֽׁלָה׃
verses.translit: yhvh bshmym hkhyn khs'v vmlkhvtv bkhl mshlh
verses.translation: The LORD hath established His throne in the heavens; And His kingdom ruleth over all.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּרְכ֥וּ יְהֹוָ֗ה מַלְאָ֫כָ֥יו גִּבֹּ֣רֵי כֹ֭חַ עֹשֵׂ֣י דְבָר֑וֹ לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗עַ בְּק֣וֹל דְּבָרֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: brkhv yhvh ml'khyv gbry khch 'shy dbrv lshm' bqvl dbrv
verses.translation: Bless the LORD, ye angels of His, Ye mighty in strength, that fulfil His word, Hearkening unto the voice of His word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּרְכ֣וּ יְ֭הֹוָה כׇּל־צְבָאָ֑יו מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו עֹשֵׂ֥י רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: Bless the LORD, all ye His hosts; Ye ministers of His, that do His pleasure.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּרְכ֤וּ יְהֹוָ֨ה  כׇּֽל־מַעֲשָׂ֗יו בְּכׇל־מְקֹמ֥וֹת מֶמְשַׁלְתּ֑וֹ בָּרְכִ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י אֶת־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: brkhv yhvh  khlm'shyv bkhlmqmvt mmshltv brkhy npshy 'tyhvh {p}
verses.translation: Bless the LORD, all ye His works, In all places of His dominion; Bless the LORD, O my soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּרְכִ֥י נַפְשִׁ֗י אֶת־יְ֫הֹוָ֥ה יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי גָּדַ֣לְתָּ מְּאֹ֑ד ה֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר לָבָֽשְׁתָּ׃
verses.translit: brkhy npshy 'tyhvh yhvh 'lhy gdlt m'd hvd vhdr lbsht
verses.translation: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, Thou art very great; Thou art clothed with glory and majesty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹֽטֶה־א֭וֹר כַּשַּׂלְמָ֑ה נוֹטֶ֥ה שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם כַּיְרִיעָֽה׃
verses.translation: Who coverest Thyself with light as with a garment, who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֥מְקָרֶ֥ה בַמַּ֗יִם עֲֽלִיּ֫וֹתָ֥יו הַשָּׂם־עָבִ֥ים רְכוּב֑וֹ הַֽ֝מְהַלֵּ֗ךְ עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רֽוּחַ׃
verses.translation: Who layest the beams of Thine upper chambers in the waters, who makest the clouds Thy chariot, who walkest upon the wings of the wind;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹשֶׂ֣ה מַלְאָכָ֣יו רוּח֑וֹת מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו אֵ֣שׁ לֹהֵֽט׃
verses.translation: Who makest winds Thy messengers, the flaming fire Thy ministers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָֽסַד־אֶ֭רֶץ עַל־מְכוֹנֶ֑יהָ בַּל־תִּ֝מּ֗וֹט עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.translation: Who didst establish the earth upon its foundations, that it should not be moved for ever and ever;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּ֭הוֹם כַּלְּב֣וּשׁ כִּסִּית֑וֹ עַל־הָ֝רִ֗ים יַ֖עַמְדוּ־מָֽיִם׃
verses.translation: Thou didst cover it with the deep as with a vesture; the waters stood above the mountains.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִן־גַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְנוּס֑וּן מִן־ק֥וֹל רַ֝עַמְךָ֗ יֵחָפֵזֽוּן׃
verses.translation: At Thy rebuke they fled, at the voice of Thy thunder they hasted away—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַעֲל֣וּ הָ֭רִים יֵרְד֣וּ בְקָע֑וֹת אֶל־מְ֝ק֗וֹם זֶ֤ה  יָסַ֬דְתָּ לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: y'lv hrym yrdv bq'vt 'lmqvm zh  ysdt lhm
verses.translation: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down— Unto the place which Thou hadst founded for them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גְּֽבוּל־שַׂ֭מְתָּ בַּל־יַעֲבֹר֑וּן בַּל־יְ֝שֻׁב֗וּן לְכַסּ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translation: Thou didst set a bound which they should not pass over, That they might not return to cover the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽמְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ מַ֭עְיָנִים בַּנְּחָלִ֑ים בֵּ֥ין הָ֝רִ֗ים יְהַלֵּכֽוּן׃
verses.translit: hmshlch m'ynym bnchlym byn hrym yhlkhvn
verses.translation: Who sendest forth springs into the valleys; They run between the mountains;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֭שְׁקוּ כׇּל־חַיְת֣וֹ שָׂדָ֑י יִשְׁבְּר֖וּ פְרָאִ֣ים צְמָאָֽם׃
verses.translit: yshqv khlchytv shdy yshbrv pr'ym tsm'm
verses.translation: They give drink to every beast of the field, The wild asses quench their thirst. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲ֭לֵיהֶם עוֹף־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִשְׁכּ֑וֹן מִבֵּ֥ין עֳ֝פָאיִ֗ם יִתְּנוּ־קֽוֹל׃
verses.translation: Beside them dwell the fowl of the heaven, From among the branches they sing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשְׁקֶ֣ה הָ֭רִים מֵעֲלִיּוֹתָ֑יו מִפְּרִ֥י מַ֝עֲשֶׂ֗יךָ תִּשְׂבַּ֥ע הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: mshqh hrym m'lyvtyv mpry m'shykh tshb' h'rts
verses.translation: Who waterest the mountains from Thine upper chambers; The earth is full of the fruit of Thy works.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַצְמִ֤יחַ חָצִ֨יר  לַבְּהֵמָ֗ה וְ֭עֵשֶׂב לַעֲבֹדַ֣ת הָאָדָ֑ם לְה֥וֹצִיא לֶ֝֗חֶם מִן־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: mtsmych chtsyr  lbhmh v'shb l'bdt h'dm lhvtsy' lchm mnh'rts
verses.translation: Who causeth the grass to spring up for the cattle, And herb for the service of man; To bring forth bread out of the earth,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיַ֤יִן  יְשַׂמַּ֬ח לְֽבַב־אֱנ֗וֹשׁ לְהַצְהִ֣יל פָּנִ֣ים מִשָּׁ֑מֶן וְ֝לֶ֗חֶם לְֽבַב־אֱנ֥וֹשׁ יִסְעָֽד׃
verses.translit: vyyn  yshmch lbb'nvsh lhtshyl pnym mshmn vlchm lbb'nvsh ys'd
verses.translation: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, Making the face brighter than oil, And bread that stayeth man's heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֭שְׂבְּעוּ עֲצֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה אַֽרְזֵ֥י לְ֝בָנ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָטָֽע׃
verses.translation: The trees of the LORD have their fill, The cedars of Lebanon, which He hath planted;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־שָׁ֭ם צִפֳּרִ֣ים יְקַנֵּ֑נוּ חֲ֝סִידָ֗ה בְּרוֹשִׁ֥ים בֵּיתָֽהּ׃
verses.translation: Wherein the birds make their nests; As for the stork, the fir-trees are her house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָרִ֣ים הַ֭גְּבֹהִים לַיְּעֵלִ֑ים סְ֝לָעִ֗ים מַחְסֶ֥ה לַֽשְׁפַנִּֽים׃
verses.translit: hrym hgbhym ly'lym sl'ym mchsh lshpnym
verses.translation: The high mountains are for the wild goats; The rocks are a refuge for the conies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָשָׂ֣ה יָ֭רֵחַ לְמוֹעֲדִ֑ים שֶׁ֝֗מֶשׁ יָדַ֥ע מְבוֹאֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: Who appointedst the moon for seasons; The sun knoweth his going down.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תָּֽשֶׁת־חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וִ֣יהִי לָ֑יְלָה בּוֹ־תִ֝רְמֹ֗שׂ כׇּל־חַיְתוֹ־יָֽעַר׃
verses.translation: Thou makest darkness, and it is night, Wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֭כְּפִירִים שֹׁאֲגִ֣ים לַטָּ֑רֶף וּלְבַקֵּ֖שׁ מֵאֵ֣ל אׇכְלָֽם׃
verses.translation: The young lions roar after their prey, And seek their food from God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּזְרַ֣ח הַ֭שֶּׁמֶשׁ יֵאָסֵפ֑וּן וְאֶל־מְ֝עוֹנֹתָ֗ם יִרְבָּצֽוּן׃
verses.translation: The sun ariseth, they slink away, And couch in their dens.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵצֵ֣א אָדָ֣ם לְפׇעֳל֑וֹ וְֽלַעֲבֹ֖דָת֣וֹ עֲדֵי־עָֽרֶב׃
verses.translation: Man goeth forth unto his work And to his labour until the evening.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָה־רַבּ֬וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֨יךָ  יְֽהֹוָ֗ה כֻּ֭לָּם בְּחׇכְמָ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ מָלְאָ֥ה הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ קִנְיָנֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: mhrbv m'shykh  yhvh khlm bchkhmh 'shyt ml'h h'rts qnynkh
verses.translation: How manifold are Thy works, O LORD! In wisdom hast Thou made them all; The earth is full of Thy creatures.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֤ה  הַיָּ֥ם גָּדוֹל֮ וּרְחַ֢ב יָ֫דָ֥יִם שָֽׁם־רֶ֭מֶשׂ וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר חַיּ֥וֹת קְ֝טַנּ֗וֹת עִם־גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: zh  hym gdvl vrchb ydym shmrmsh v'yn mspr chyvt qtnvt 'mgdlvt
verses.translation: Yonder sea, great and wide, Therein are creeping things innumerable, Living creatures, both small and great.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֭ם אֳנִיּ֣וֹת יְהַלֵּכ֑וּן לִ֝וְיָתָ֗ן זֶֽה־יָצַ֥רְתָּ לְשַֽׂחֶק־בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: There go the ships; There is leviathan, whom Thou hast formed to sport therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֻּ֭לָּם אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְשַׂבֵּר֑וּן לָתֵ֖ת אׇכְלָ֣ם בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: All of them wait for Thee, That Thou mayest give them their food in due season.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם יִלְקֹט֑וּן תִּפְתַּ֥ח יָ֝דְךָ֗ יִשְׂבְּע֥וּן טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: ttn lhm ylqtvn tptch ydkh yshb'vn tvb
verses.translation: Thou givest it unto them, they gather it; Thou openest Thy hand, they are satisfied with good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּסְתִּ֥יר פָּנֶיךָ֮ יִֽבָּהֵ֫ל֥וּן תֹּסֵ֣ף ר֭וּחָם יִגְוָע֑וּן וְֽאֶל־עֲפָרָ֥ם יְשׁוּבֽוּן׃
verses.translit: tstyr pnykh ybhlvn tsf rvchm ygv'vn v'l'prm yshvbvn
verses.translation: Thou hidest Thy face, they vanish; Thou withdrawest their breath, they perish, And return to their dust.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּשַׁלַּ֣ח ר֭וּחֲךָ יִבָּרֵא֑וּן וּ֝תְחַדֵּ֗שׁ פְּנֵ֣י אֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.translation: Thou sendest forth Thy spirit, they are created; and Thou renewest the face of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהִ֤י כְב֣וֹד יְהֹוָ֣ה לְעוֹלָ֑ם יִשְׂמַ֖ח יְהֹוָ֣ה בְּמַעֲשָֽׂיו׃
verses.translit: yhy khbvd yhvh l'vlm yshmch yhvh bm'shyv
verses.translation: May the glory of the LORD endure for ever; let the LORD rejoice in His works!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַמַּבִּ֣יט לָ֭אָרֶץ וַתִּרְעָ֑ד יִגַּ֖ע בֶּהָרִ֣ים וְֽיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ׃
verses.translit: hmbyt l'rts vtr'd yg' bhrym vy'shnv
verses.translation: Who looketh on the earth, and it trembleth; He toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָשִׁ֣ירָה לַיהֹוָ֣ה בְּחַיָּ֑י אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה לֵאלֹהַ֣י בְּעוֹדִֽי׃
verses.translation: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live; I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֶעֱרַ֣ב עָלָ֣יו שִׂיחִ֑י אָ֝נֹכִ֗י אֶשְׂמַ֥ח בַּיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translation: Let my musing be sweet unto Him; as for me, I will rejoice in the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִתַּ֤מּוּ חַטָּאִ֨ים  מִן־הָאָ֡רֶץ וּרְשָׁעִ֤ים  ע֤וֹד אֵינָ֗ם בָּרְכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־יְהֹוָ֗ה הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: ytmv cht'ym  mnh'rts vrsh'ym  'vd 'ynm brkhy npshy 'tyhvh hllvyh {p}
verses.translation: Let sinners cease out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Hallelujah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַ֭יהֹוָה קִרְא֣וּ בִשְׁמ֑וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָ֝עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִילוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: hvdv lyhvh qr'v bshmv hvdy'v b'mym 'lylvtyv
verses.translation: O give thanks unto the LORD, call upon His name; Make known His doings among the peoples.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִֽׁירוּ־ל֭וֹ זַמְּרוּ־ל֑וֹ שִׂ֝֗יחוּ בְּכׇל־נִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translation: Sing unto Him, sing praises unto Him; Speak ye of all His marvellous works.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִֽ֭תְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם קׇדְשׁ֑וֹ יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח לֵ֤ב  מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: hthllv bshm qdshv yshmch lb  mbqshy yhvh
verses.translation: Glory ye in His holy name; Let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּרְשׁ֣וּ יְהֹוָ֣ה וְעֻזּ֑וֹ בַּקְּשׁ֖וּ פָנָ֣יו תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.translit: drshv yhvh v'zv bqshv pnyv tmyd
verses.translation: Seek ye the LORD and His strength; Seek His face continually.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זִכְר֗וּ נִפְלְאוֹתָ֥יו אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֑ה מֹ֝פְתָ֗יו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי־פִֽיו׃
verses.translation: Remember His marvellous works that He hath done, His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֭רַע אַבְרָהָ֣ם עַבְדּ֑וֹ בְּנֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב בְּחִירָֽיו׃
verses.translation: O ye seed of Abraham His servant, Ye children of Jacob, His chosen ones.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֭וּא יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ בְּכׇל־הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָֽיו׃
verses.translation: He is the LORD our God; His judgments are in all the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זָכַ֣ר לְעוֹלָ֣ם בְּרִית֑וֹ דָּבָ֥ר צִ֝וָּ֗ה לְאֶ֣לֶף דּֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: zkhr l'vlm brytv dbr tsvh l'lf dvr
verses.translation: He hath remembered His covenant for ever, The word which He commanded to a thousand generations;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּ֭רַת אֶת־אַבְרָהָ֑ם וּשְׁב֖וּעָת֣וֹ לְיִשְׂחָֽק׃
verses.translation: [The covenant] which He made with Abraham, And His oath unto Isaac;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמִידֶ֣הָ לְיַעֲקֹ֣ב לְחֹ֑ק לְ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translation: And He established it unto Jacob for a statute, To Israel for an everlasting covenant;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵאמֹ֗ר לְךָ֗ אֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת־אֶֽרֶץ־כְּנָ֑עַן חֶ֝֗בֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translation: Saying: 'Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּֽ֭הְיוֹתָם מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֑ר כִּ֝מְעַ֗ט וְגָרִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: bhyvtm mty mspr khm't vgrym bh
verses.translation: When they were but a few men in number. Yea, very few, and sojourners in it,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭יִּֽתְהַלְּכוּ מִגּ֣וֹי אֶל־גּ֑וֹי מִ֝מַּמְלָכָ֗ה אֶל־עַ֥ם אַחֵֽר׃
verses.translation: And when they went about from nation to nation, From one kingdom to another people,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־הִנִּ֣יחַ אָדָ֣ם לְעׇשְׁקָ֑ם וַיּ֖וֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מְלָכִֽים׃
verses.translation: He suffered no man to do them wrong, Yea, for their sake He reproved kings:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַֽל־תִּגְּע֥וּ בִמְשִׁיחָ֑י וְ֝לִנְבִיאַ֗י אַל־תָּרֵֽעוּ׃
verses.translation: 'Touch not Mine anointed ones, And do My prophets no harm.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א רָ֭עָב עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ כׇּֽל־מַטֵּה־לֶ֥חֶם שָׁבָֽר׃
verses.translation: And He called a famine upon the land; He broke the whole staff of bread.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁלַ֣ח לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם אִ֑ישׁ לְ֝עֶ֗בֶד נִמְכַּ֥ר יוֹסֵֽף׃
verses.translation: He sent a man before them; Joseph was sold for a servant;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִנּ֣וּ בַכֶּ֣בֶל (רגליו) [רַגְל֑וֹ] בַּ֝רְזֶ֗ל בָּ֣אָה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translation: His feet they hurt with fetters, His person was laid in iron;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־עֵ֥ת בֹּא־דְבָר֑וֹ אִמְרַ֖ת יְהֹוָ֣ה צְרָפָֽתְהוּ׃
verses.translation: Until the time that his word came to pass, The word of the LORD tested him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֣לַח מֶ֭לֶךְ וַיַּתִּירֵ֑הוּ מֹשֵׁ֥ל עַ֝מִּ֗ים וַֽיְפַתְּחֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translation: The king sent and loosed him; Even the ruler of the peoples, and set him free.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׂמ֣וֹ אָד֣וֹן לְבֵית֑וֹ וּ֝מֹשֵׁ֗ל בְּכׇל־קִנְיָנֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: He made him lord of his house, And ruler of all his possessions;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֶאְסֹ֣ר שָׂרָ֣יו בְּנַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּזְקֵנָ֥יו יְחַכֵּֽם׃
verses.translation: To bind his princes at his pleasure, And teach his elders wisdom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ֝יַעֲקֹ֗ב גָּ֣ר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־חָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyb' yshr'l mtsrym vy'qb gr b'rtschm
verses.translation: Israel also came into Egypt; And Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֶּ֣פֶר אֶת־עַמּ֣וֹ מְאֹ֑ד וַ֝יַּעֲצִמֵ֗הוּ מִצָּרָֽיו׃
verses.translation: And He increased His people greatly, And made them too mighty for their adversaries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָפַ֣ךְ לִ֭בָּם לִשְׂנֹ֣א עַמּ֑וֹ לְ֝הִתְנַכֵּ֗ל בַּעֲבָדָֽיו׃
verses.translation: He turned their heart to hate His people, To deal craftily with His servants.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֭לַח מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדּ֑וֹ אַ֝הֲרֹ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַר־בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: He sent Moses His servant, And Aaron whom He had chosen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָֽׂמוּ־בָ֭ם דִּבְרֵ֣י אֹתוֹתָ֑יו וּ֝מֹפְתִ֗ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חָֽם׃
verses.translation: They wrought among them His manifold signs, And wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֣לַֽח חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וַיַּחְשִׁ֑ךְ וְלֹא־מָ֝ר֗וּ אֶת־[דְּבָרֽוֹ] (דבריו)׃
verses.translation: He sent darkness, and it was dark; And they rebelled not against His word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָפַ֣ךְ אֶת־מֵימֵיהֶ֣ם לְדָ֑ם וַ֝יָּ֗מֶת אֶת־דְּגָתָֽם׃
verses.translation: He turned their waters into blood, And slew their fish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁרַ֣ץ אַרְצָ֣ם צְפַרְדְּעִ֑ים בְּ֝חַדְרֵ֗י מַלְכֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translation: Their land swarmed with frogs, In the chambers of their kings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֭מַר וַיָּבֹ֣א עָרֹ֑ב כִּ֝נִּ֗ים בְּכׇל־גְּבוּלָֽם׃
verses.translation: He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, And gnats in all their borders.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָתַ֣ן גִּשְׁמֵיהֶ֣ם בָּרָ֑ד אֵ֖שׁ לֶהָב֣וֹת בְּאַרְצָֽם׃
verses.translation: He gave them hail for rain, And flaming fire in their land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣ךְ גַּ֭פְנָם וּתְאֵנָתָ֑ם וַ֝יְשַׁבֵּ֗ר עֵ֣ץ גְּבוּלָֽם׃
verses.translation: He smote their vines also and their fig-trees; And broke the trees of their borders.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֭מַר וַיָּבֹ֣א אַרְבֶּ֑ה וְ֝יֶ֗לֶק וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.translation: He spoke, and the locust came, And the canker-worm without number,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אכַל כׇּל־עֵ֣שֶׂב בְּאַרְצָ֑ם וַ֝יֹּ֗אכַל פְּרִ֣י אַדְמָתָֽם׃
verses.translation: And did eat up every herb in their land, And did eat up the fruit of their ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣ךְ כׇּל־בְּכ֣וֹר בְּאַרְצָ֑ם רֵ֝אשִׁ֗ית לְכׇל־אוֹנָֽם׃
verses.translation: He smote also all the first-born in their land, The first-fruits of all their strength.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽ֭יּוֹצִיאֵם בְּכֶ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב וְאֵ֖ין בִּשְׁבָטָ֣יו כּוֹשֵֽׁל׃
verses.translit: vyvtsy'm bkhsf vzhb v'yn bshbtyv khvshl
verses.translation: And He brought them forth with silver and gold; And there was none that stumbled among His tribes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׂמַ֣ח מִצְרַ֣יִם בְּצֵאתָ֑ם כִּֽי־נָפַ֖ל פַּחְדָּ֣ם עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translation: Egypt was glad when they departed; For the fear of them had fallen upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּרַ֣שׂ עָנָ֣ן לְמָסָ֑ךְ וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ לְהָאִ֥יר לָֽיְלָה׃
verses.translation: He spread a cloud for a screen; And fire to give light in the night.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֭אַל וַיָּבֵ֣א שְׂלָ֑ו וְלֶ֥חֶם שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם יַשְׂבִּיעֵֽם׃
verses.translit: sh'l vyb' shlv vlchm shmym yshby'm
verses.translation: They asked, and He brought quails, And gave them in plenty the bread of heaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּ֣תַח צ֭וּר וַיָּז֣וּבוּ מָ֑יִם הָ֝לְכ֗וּ בַּצִּיּ֥וֹת נָהָֽר׃
verses.translit: ptch tsvr vyzvbv mym hlkhv btsyvt nhr
verses.translation: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out; They ran, a river in the dry places.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־זָ֭כַר אֶת־דְּבַ֣ר קׇדְשׁ֑וֹ אֶֽת־אַבְרָהָ֥ם עַבְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: For He remembered His holy word Unto Abraham His servant;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּוֹצִ֣א עַמּ֣וֹ בְשָׂשׂ֑וֹן בְּ֝רִנָּ֗ה אֶת־בְּחִירָֽיו׃
verses.translation: And He brought forth His people with joy, His chosen ones with singing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם אַרְצ֣וֹת גּוֹיִ֑ם וַעֲמַ֖ל לְאֻמִּ֣ים יִירָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.translit: vytn lhm 'rtsvt gvym v'ml l'mym yyrshv
verses.translation: And He gave them the lands of the nations, And they took the labour of the peoples in possession;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּעֲב֤וּר  יִשְׁמְר֣וּ חֻ֭קָּיו וְתוֹרֹתָ֥יו יִנְצֹ֗רוּ הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: b'bvr  yshmrv chqyv vtvrtyv yntsrv hllvyh {p}
verses.translation: That they might keep His statutes, And observe His laws. Hallelujah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ־יָ֨הּ  הוֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hllvyh  hvdv lyhvh khytvb khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: Hallelujah. O give thanks unto the LORD; for He is good; for His mercy endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֗י יְ֭מַלֵּל גְּבוּר֣וֹת יְהֹוָ֑ה יַ֝שְׁמִ֗יעַ כׇּל־תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: my ymll gbvrvt yhvh yshmy' khlthltv
verses.translation: Who can express the mighty acts of the LORD, or make all His praise to be heard?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֭שְׁרֵי שֹׁמְרֵ֣י מִשְׁפָּ֑ט עֹשֵׂ֖ה צְדָקָ֣ה בְכׇל־עֵֽת׃
verses.translation: Happy are they that keep justice, that do righteousness at all times.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זׇכְרֵ֣נִי יְ֭הֹוָה בִּרְצ֣וֹן עַמֶּ֑ךָ פׇּ֝קְדֵ֗נִי בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Remember me, O LORD, when Thou favourest Thy people; O think of me at Thy salvation;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִרְא֤וֹת  בְּט֘וֹבַ֤ת בְּחִירֶ֗יךָ לִ֭שְׂמֹחַ בְּשִׂמְחַ֣ת גּוֹיֶ֑ךָ לְ֝הִתְהַלֵּ֗ל עִם־נַחֲלָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: lr'vt  btvbt bchyrykh lshmch bshmcht gvykh lhthll 'mnchltkh
verses.translation: That I may behold the prosperity of Thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of Thy nation, that I may glory with Thine inheritance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָטָ֥אנוּ עִם־אֲבוֹתֵ֗ינוּ הֶעֱוִ֥ינוּ הִרְשָֽׁעְנוּ׃
verses.translation: We have sinned with our fathers, we have done iniquitously, we have dealt wickedly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲב֘וֹתֵ֤ינוּ בְמִצְרַ֨יִם  לֹא־הִשְׂכִּ֬ילוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א זָ֭כְרוּ אֶת־רֹ֣ב חֲסָדֶ֑יךָ וַיַּמְר֖וּ עַל־יָ֣ם בְּיַם־סֽוּף׃
verses.translit: 'bvtynv bmtsrym  l'hshkhylv npl'vtykh l' zkhrv 'trb chsdykh vymrv 'lym bymsvf
verses.translation: Our fathers in Egypt gave no heed unto Thy wonders; they remembered not the multitude of Thy mercies; but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽ֭יּוֹשִׁיעֵם לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמ֑וֹ לְ֝הוֹדִ֗יעַ אֶת־גְּבוּרָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: Nevertheless He saved them for His name's sake, that He might make His mighty power to be known.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגְעַ֣ר בְּיַם־ס֭וּף וַֽיֶּחֱרָ֑ב וַיּוֹלִיכֵ֥ם בַּ֝תְּהֹמ֗וֹת כַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.translit: vyg'r bymsvf vychrb vyvlykhm bthmvt khmdbr
verses.translation: And He rebuked the Red Sea, and it was dried up; and He led them through the depths, as through a wilderness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽ֭יּוֹשִׁיעֵם מִיַּ֣ד שׂוֹנֵ֑א וַ֝יִּגְאָלֵ֗ם מִיַּ֥ד אוֹיֵֽב׃
verses.translation: And He saved them from the hand of him that hated them, And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְכַסּוּ־מַ֥יִם צָרֵיהֶ֑ם אֶחָ֥ד מֵ֝הֶ֗ם לֹ֣א נוֹתָֽר׃
verses.translation: And the waters covered their adversaries; There was not one of them left.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּאֲמִ֥ינוּ בִדְבָרָ֑יו יָ֝שִׁ֗ירוּ תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: Then believed they His words; They sang His praise.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֭הֲרוּ שָׁכְח֣וּ מַעֲשָׂ֑יו לֹא־חִ֝כּ֗וּ לַעֲצָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: They soon forgot His works; They waited not for His counsel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְאַוּ֣וּ תַ֭אֲוָה בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַיְנַסּוּ־אֵ֝֗ל בִּישִׁימֽוֹן׃
verses.translation: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, And tried God in the desert.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם שֶׁאֱלָתָ֑ם וַיְשַׁלַּ֖ח רָז֣וֹן בְּנַפְשָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vytn lhm sh'ltm vyshlch rzvn bnpshm
verses.translation: And He gave them their request; But sent leanness into their soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְקַנְא֣וּ לְ֭מֹשֶׁה בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה לְ֝אַהֲרֹ֗ן קְד֣וֹשׁ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqn'v lmshh bmchnh l'hrn qdvsh yhvh
verses.translation: They were jealous also of Moses in the camp, And of Aaron the holy one of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּפְתַּח־אֶ֭רֶץ וַתִּבְלַ֣ע דָּתָ֑ן וַ֝תְּכַ֗ס עַל־עֲדַ֥ת אֲבִירָֽם׃
verses.translation: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, And covered the company of Abiram.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּבְעַר־אֵ֥שׁ בַּעֲדָתָ֑ם לֶ֝הָבָ֗ה תְּלַהֵ֥ט רְשָׁעִֽים׃
verses.translation: And a fire was kindled in their company; The flame burned up the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַעֲשׂוּ־עֵ֥גֶל בְּחֹרֵ֑ב וַ֝יִּשְׁתַּחֲו֗וּ לְמַסֵּכָֽה׃
verses.translation: They made a calf in Horeb, And worshipped a molten image.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּמִ֥ירוּ אֶת־כְּבוֹדָ֑ם בְּתַבְנִ֥ית שׁ֝֗וֹר אֹכֵ֥ל עֵֽשֶׂב׃
verses.translation: Thus they exchanged their glory For the likeness of an ox that eateth grass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֭כְחוּ אֵ֣ל מוֹשִׁיעָ֑ם עֹשֶׂ֖ה גְדֹל֣וֹת בְּמִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translation: They forgot God their saviour, Who had done great things in Egypt;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִ֭פְלָאוֹת בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חָ֑ם נ֝וֹרָא֗וֹת עַל־יַם־סֽוּף׃
verses.translation: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, Terrible things by the Red Sea.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לְֽהַשְׁמִ֫ידָ֥ם לוּלֵ֡י מֹ֘שֶׁ֤ה בְחִיר֗וֹ עָמַ֣ד בַּפֶּ֣רֶץ לְפָנָ֑יו לְהָשִׁ֥יב חֲ֝מָת֗וֹ מֵהַשְׁחִֽית׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lhshmydm lvly mshh bchyrv 'md bprts lpnyv lhshyb chmtv mhshchyt
verses.translation: Therefore He said that He would destroy them, Had not Moses His chosen stood before Him in the breach, To turn back His wrath, lest He should destroy them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽ֭יִּמְאֲסוּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חֶמְדָּ֑ה לֹא־הֶ֝אֱמִ֗ינוּ לִדְבָרֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: Moreover, they scorned the desirable land, They believed not His word;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּרָגְנ֥וּ בְאׇהֳלֵיהֶ֑ם לֹ֥א שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ בְּק֣וֹל יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyrgnv b'hlyhm l' shm'v bqvl yhvh
verses.translation: And they murmured in their tents, They hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֣א יָד֣וֹ לָהֶ֑ם לְהַפִּ֥יל א֝וֹתָ֗ם בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.translation: Therefore He swore concerning them, That He would overthrow them in the wilderness;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְהַפִּ֣יל זַ֭רְעָם בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וּ֝לְזָרוֹתָ֗ם בָּאֲרָצֽוֹת׃
verses.translation: And that He would cast out their seed among the nations, And scatter them in the lands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭יִּצָּ֣מְדוּ לְבַ֣עַל פְּע֑וֹר וַ֝יֹּאכְל֗וּ זִבְחֵ֥י מֵתִֽים׃
verses.translit: vytsmdv lb'l p'vr vy'khlv zbchy mtym
verses.translation: They joined themselves also unto Baal of Peor, And ate the sacrifices of the dead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭יַּכְעִיסוּ בְּמַ֥עַלְלֵיהֶ֑ם וַתִּפְרׇץ־בָּ֝֗ם מַגֵּפָֽה׃
verses.translation: Thus they provoked Him with their doings, And the plague broke in upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד פִּֽ֭ינְחָס וַיְפַלֵּ֑ל וַ֝תֵּעָצַ֗ר הַמַּגֵּפָֽה׃
verses.translation: Then stood up Phinehas, and wrought judgment, And so the plague was stayed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּחָ֣שֶׁב ל֭וֹ לִצְדָקָ֑ה לְדֹ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translation: And that was counted unto him for righteousness, Unto all generations for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭יַּקְצִיפוּ עַל־מֵ֥י מְרִיבָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥רַע לְ֝מֹשֶׁ֗ה בַּעֲבוּרָֽם׃
verses.translation: They angered Him also at the waters of Meribah, And it went ill with Moses because of them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־הִמְר֥וּ אֶת־רוּח֑וֹ וַ֝יְבַטֵּ֗א בִּשְׂפָתָֽיו׃
verses.translation: For they embittered his spirit, And he spoke rashly with his lips.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־הִ֭שְׁמִידוּ אֶת־הָעַמִּ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֣ה לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translation: They did not destroy the peoples, As the LORD commanded them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְעָרְב֥וּ בַגּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽ֝יִּלְמְד֗וּ מַעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם׃
verses.translation: But mingled themselves with the nations, And learned their works;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעַבְד֥וּ אֶת־עֲצַבֵּיהֶ֑ם וַיִּהְי֖וּ לָהֶ֣ם לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translation: And they served their idols, Which became a snare unto them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּזְבְּח֣וּ אֶת־בְּ֭נֵיהֶם וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם לַשֵּׁדִֽים׃
verses.translation: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto demons,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֥שְׁפְּכ֨וּ דָ֪ם נָקִ֡י דַּם־בְּנֵ֘יהֶ֤ם וּֽבְנוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר זִ֭בְּחוּ לַעֲצַבֵּ֣י כְנָ֑עַן וַתֶּחֱנַ֥ף הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ בַּדָּמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyshpkhv dm nqy dmbnyhm vbnvtyhm 'shr zbchv l'tsby khn'n vtchnf h'rts bdmym
verses.translation: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, Whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan; And the land was polluted with blood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּטְמְא֥וּ בְמַעֲשֵׂיהֶ֑ם וַ֝יִּזְנ֗וּ בְּמַ֥עַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translation: Thus were they defiled with their works, And went astray in their doings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּחַר־אַ֣ף יְהֹוָ֣ה בְּעַמּ֑וֹ וַ֝יְתָעֵ֗ב אֶת־נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against His people, And He abhorred His inheritance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם בְּיַד־גּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽיִּמְשְׁל֥וּ בָ֝הֶ֗ם שֹׂנְאֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translation: And He gave them into the hand of the nations; And they that hated them ruled over them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּלְחָצ֥וּם אוֹיְבֵיהֶ֑ם וַ֝יִּכָּנְע֗וּ תַּ֣חַת יָדָֽם׃
verses.translation: Their enemies also oppressed them, And they were subdued under their hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּעָמִ֥ים רַבּ֗וֹת יַצִּ֫ילֵ֥ם וְ֭הֵמָּה יַמְר֣וּ בַעֲצָתָ֑ם וַ֝יָּמֹ֗כּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָֽם׃
verses.translit: p'mym rbvt ytsylm vhmh ymrv b'tstm vymkhv b'vnm
verses.translation: Many times did He deliver them; But they were rebellious in their counsel, And sank low through their iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭יַּרְא בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם בְּ֝שׇׁמְע֗וֹ אֶת־רִנָּתָֽם׃
verses.translation: Nevertheless He looked upon their distress, When He heard their cry;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּזְכֹּ֣ר לָהֶ֣ם בְּרִית֑וֹ וַ֝יִּנָּחֵ֗ם כְּרֹ֣ב חֲסָדָֽו׃
verses.translit: vyzkhr lhm brytv vynchm khrb chsdv
verses.translation: And He remembered for them His covenant, And repented according to the multitude of His mercies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אוֹתָ֣ם לְרַחֲמִ֑ים לִ֝פְנֵ֗י כׇּל־שׁוֹבֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translation: He made them also to be pitied Of all those that carried them captive.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֨נוּ  יְ֘הֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְקַבְּצֵנוּ֮ מִֽן־הַגּ֫וֹיִ֥ם לְ֭הֹדוֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם קׇדְשֶׁ֑ךָ לְ֝הִשְׁתַּבֵּ֗חַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: hvshy'nv  yhvh 'lhynv vqbtsnv mnhgvym lhdvt lshm qdshkh lhshtbch bthltkh
verses.translation: Save us, O LORD our God, And gather us from among the nations, That we may give thanks unto Thy holy name, That we may triumph in Thy praise.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּ֤רֽוּךְ־יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֪י יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל מִן־הָ֤עוֹלָ֨ם  וְעַ֬ד הָעוֹלָ֗ם וְאָמַ֖ר כׇּל־הָעָ֥ם אָמֵ֗ן הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: brvkhyhvh 'lhy yshr'l mnh'vlm  v'd h'vlm v'mr khlh'm 'mn hllvyh
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting, and let all the people say: 'Amen.' Hallelujah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hdv lyhvh khytvb khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: 'O give thanks unto the LORD, for He is good, For His mercy endureth for ever.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֹ֭אמְרוּ גְּאוּלֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר גְּ֝אָלָ֗ם מִיַּד־צָֽר׃
verses.translation: So let the redeemed of the LORD say, Whom He hath redeemed from the hand of the adversary;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽמֵאֲרָצ֗וֹת קִ֫בְּצָ֥ם מִמִּזְרָ֥ח וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב מִצָּפ֥וֹן וּמִיָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vm'rtsvt qbtsm mmzrch vmm'rb mtspvn vmym
verses.translation: And gathered them out of the lands, From the east and from the west, From the north and from the sea.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תָּע֣וּ בַ֭מִּדְבָּר בִּישִׁימ֣וֹן דָּ֑רֶךְ עִ֥יר מ֝וֹשָׁ֗ב לֹ֣א מָצָֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: t'v bmdbr byshymvn drkh 'yr mvshb l' mts'v
verses.translation: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way; They found no city of habitation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְעֵבִ֥ים גַּם־צְמֵאִ֑ים נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בָּהֶ֥ם תִּתְעַטָּֽף׃
verses.translation: Hungry and thirsty, Their soul fainted in them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הֹוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצ֥וּקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יַצִּילֵֽם׃
verses.translation: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, And He delivered them out of their distresses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽ֭יַּדְרִיכֵם בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יְשָׁרָ֑ה לָ֝לֶ֗כֶת אֶל־עִ֥יר מוֹשָֽׁב׃
verses.translation: And He led them by a straight way, That they might go to a city of habitation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.translation: Let them give thanks unto the LORD for His mercy, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הִ֭שְׂבִּיעַ נֶ֣פֶשׁ שֹׁקֵקָ֑ה וְנֶ֥פֶשׁ רְ֝עֵבָ֗ה מִלֵּא־טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: khyhshby' npsh shqqh vnpsh r'bh ml'tvb
verses.translation: For He hath satisfied the longing soul, And the hungry soul He hath filled with good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֹ֭שְׁבֵי חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָ֑וֶת אֲסִירֵ֖י עֳנִ֣י וּבַרְזֶֽל׃
verses.translation: Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, Being bound in affliction and iron—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הִמְר֥וּ אִמְרֵי־אֵ֑ל וַעֲצַ֖ת עֶלְי֣וֹן נָאָֽצוּ׃
verses.translation: Because they rebelled against the words of God, And contemned the counsel of the Most High.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּכְנַ֣ע בֶּעָמָ֣ל לִבָּ֑ם כָּ֝שְׁל֗וּ וְאֵ֣ין עֹזֵֽר׃
verses.translation: Therefore He humbled their heart with travail, They stumbled, and there was none to help—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הֹוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֻ֥קוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃
verses.translation: They cried unto the LORD in their trouble, And He saved them out of their distresses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: י֭וֹצִיאֵם מֵחֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָ֑וֶת וּמוֹסְר֖וֹתֵיהֶ֣ם יְנַתֵּֽק׃
verses.translation: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, And broke their bands in sunder. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.translation: Let them give thanks unto the LORD for His mercy, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־שִׁ֭בַּר דַּלְת֣וֹת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וּבְרִיחֵ֖י בַרְזֶ֣ל גִּדֵּֽעַ׃
verses.translit: khyshbr dltvt nchsht vbrychy brzl gd'
verses.translation: For He hath broken the gates of brass, And cut the bars of iron in sunder.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱ֭וִלִים מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ פִּשְׁעָ֑ם וּֽ֝מֵעֲוֺ֥נֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יִתְעַנּֽוּ׃
verses.translation: Crazed because of the way of their transgression, And afflicted because of their iniquities—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־אֹ֭כֶל תְּתַעֵ֣ב נַפְשָׁ֑ם וַ֝יַּגִּ֗יעוּ עַד־שַׁ֥עֲרֵי מָֽוֶת׃
verses.translation: Their soul abhorred all manner of food, And they drew near unto the gates of death—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הֹוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֻ֥קוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃
verses.translation: They cried unto the LORD in their trouble, And He saved them out of their distresses;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׁלַ֣ח דְּ֭בָרוֹ וְיִרְפָּאֵ֑ם וִ֝ימַלֵּ֗ט מִשְּׁחִֽיתוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translation: He sent His word, and healed them, And delivered them from their graves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.translation: Let them give thanks unto the LORD for His mercy, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭יִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵ֣י תוֹדָ֑ה וִיסַפְּר֖וּ מַעֲשָׂ֣יו בְּרִנָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vyzbchv zbchy tvdh vysprv m'shyv brnh
verses.translation: And let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, And declare His works with singing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ׆ יוֹרְדֵ֣י הַ֭יָּם בׇּאֳנִיּ֑וֹת עֹשֵׂ֥י מְ֝לָאכָ֗ה בְּמַ֣יִם רַבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: yvrdy hym b'nyvt 'shy ml'khh bmym rbym
verses.translation: They that go down to the sea in ships, That do business in great waters—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ׆ הֵ֣מָּה רָ֭אוּ מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו בִּמְצוּלָֽה׃
verses.translit: hmh r'v m'shy yhvh vnpl'vtyv bmtsvlh
verses.translation: These saw the works of the LORD, And His wonders in the deep;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ׆ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר וַֽ֭יַּעֲמֵד ר֣וּחַ סְעָרָ֑ה וַתְּרוֹמֵ֥ם גַּלָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'mr vy'md rvch s'rh vtrvmm glyv
verses.translation: For He commanded, and raised the stormy wind, Which lifted up the waves thereof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ׆ יַעֲל֣וּ שָׁ֭מַיִם יֵרְד֣וּ תְהוֹמ֑וֹת נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בְּרָעָ֥ה תִתְמוֹגָֽג׃
verses.translit: y'lv shmym yrdv thvmvt npshm br'h ttmvgg
verses.translation: They mounted up to the heaven, they went down to the deeps; Their soul melted away because of trouble;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ׆ יָח֣וֹגּוּ וְ֭יָנוּעוּ כַּשִּׁכּ֑וֹר וְכׇל־חׇ֝כְמָתָ֗ם תִּתְבַּלָּֽע׃
verses.translation: They reeled to and fro, and staggered like a drunken man, And all their wisdom was swallowed up—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ׆ וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הֹוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם וּֽ֝מִמְּצ֥וּקֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹצִיאֵֽם׃
verses.translation: They cried unto the LORD in their trouble, And He brought them out of their distresses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָקֵ֣ם סְ֭עָרָה לִדְמָמָ֑ה וַ֝יֶּחֱשׁ֗וּ גַּלֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.translation: He made the storm a calm, So that the waves thereof were still.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂמְח֥וּ כִֽי־יִשְׁתֹּ֑קוּ וַ֝יַּנְחֵ֗ם אֶל־מְח֥וֹז חֶפְצָֽם׃
verses.translation: Then were they glad because they were quiet, And He led them unto their desired haven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.translation: Let them give thanks unto the LORD for His mercy, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִֽ֭ירוֹמְמוּהוּ בִּקְהַל־עָ֑ם וּבְמוֹשַׁ֖ב זְקֵנִ֣ים יְהַלְלֽוּהוּ׃
verses.translation: Let them exalt Him also in the assembly of the people, And praise Him in the seat of the elders.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָשֵׂ֣ם נְהָר֣וֹת לְמִדְבָּ֑ר וּמֹצָ֥אֵי מַ֝֗יִם לְצִמָּאֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: yshm nhrvt lmdbr vmts'y mym ltsm'vn
verses.translation: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, And watersprings into a thirsty ground;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֣רֶץ פְּ֭רִי לִמְלֵחָ֑ה מֵ֝רָעַ֗ת י֣וֹשְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃
verses.translation: A fruitful land into a salt waste, For the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָשֵׂ֣ם מִ֭דְבָּר לַאֲגַם־מַ֑יִם וְאֶ֥רֶץ צִ֝יָּ֗ה לְמֹצָ֥אֵי מָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: yshm mdbr l'gmmym v'rts tsyh lmts'y mym
verses.translation: He turneth a wilderness into a pool of water, And a dry land into watersprings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּ֣וֹשֶׁב שָׁ֣ם רְעֵבִ֑ים וַ֝יְכוֹנְנ֗וּ עִ֣יר מוֹשָֽׁב׃
verses.translation: And there He maketh the hungry to dwell, And they establish a city of habitation;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּזְרְע֣וּ שָׂ֭דוֹת וַיִּטְּע֣וּ כְרָמִ֑ים וַ֝יַּעֲשׂ֗וּ פְּרִ֣י תְבוּאָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyzr'v shdvt vyt'v khrmym vy'shv pry tbv'h
verses.translation: And sow fields, and plant vineyards, Which yield fruits of increase.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְבָרְכֵ֣ם וַיִּרְבּ֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וּ֝בְהֶמְתָּ֗ם לֹ֣א יַמְעִֽיט׃
verses.translit: vybrkhm vyrbv m'd vbhmtm l' ym'yt
verses.translation: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly, And suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּמְעֲט֥וּ וַיָּשֹׁ֑חוּ מֵעֹ֖צֶר רָעָ֣ה וְיָגֽוֹן׃
verses.translation: Again, they are minished and dwindle away Through oppression of evil and sorrow.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ׆ שֹׁפֵ֣ךְ בּ֭וּז עַל־נְדִיבִ֑ים וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם בְּתֹ֣הוּ לֹא־דָֽרֶךְ׃
verses.translation: He poureth contempt upon princes, And causeth them to wander in the waste, where there is no way.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְשַׂגֵּ֣ב אֶבְי֣וֹן מֵע֑וֹנִי וַיָּ֥שֶׂם כַּ֝צֹּ֗אן מִשְׁפָּחֽוֹת׃
verses.translation: Yet setteth He the needy on high from affliction, And maketh his families like a flock.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִרְא֣וּ יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ וְכׇל־עַ֝וְלָ֗ה קָ֣פְצָה פִּֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: yr'v yshrym vyshmchv vkhl'vlh qptsh pyh
verses.translation: The upright see it, and are glad; And all iniquity stoppeth her mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִי־חָכָ֥ם וְיִשְׁמׇר־אֵ֑לֶּה וְ֝יִתְבּוֹנְנ֗וּ חַֽסְדֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Whoso is wise, let him observe these things, And let them consider the mercies of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֖יר מִזְמ֣וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translation: A Song, a Psalm of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָכ֣וֹן לִבִּ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָשִׁ֥ירָה וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה אַף־כְּבוֹדִֽי׃
verses.translation: My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises, even with my glory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ע֭וּרָֽה הַנֵּ֥בֶל וְכִנּ֗וֹר אָעִ֥ירָה שָּֽׁחַר׃
verses.translation: Awake, psaltery and harp; I will awake the dawn.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוֹדְךָ֖ בָעַמִּ֥ים ׀ יְהֹוָ֑ה וַ֝אֲזַמֶּרְךָ֗ בַּלְאֻמִּֽים׃
verses.translation: I will give thanks unto Thee, O LORD, among the peoples; And I will sing praises unto Thee among the nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־גָד֣וֹל מֵעַל־שָׁמַ֣יִם חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְֽעַד־שְׁחָקִ֥ים אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: For Thy mercy is great above the heavens, And Thy truth reacheth unto the skies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ר֣וּמָה עַל־שָׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעַ֖ל כׇּל־הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; And Thy glory be above all the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֭מַעַן יֵחָלְצ֣וּן יְדִידֶ֑יךָ הוֹשִׁ֖יעָה יְמִֽינְךָ֣ וַעֲנֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: lm'n ychltsvn ydydykh hvshy'h ymynkh v'nny
verses.translation: That Thy beloved may be delivered, Save with Thy right hand, and answer me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֤ים  דִּבֶּ֥ר בְּקׇדְשׁ֗וֹ אֶ֫עְלֹ֥זָה אֲחַלְּקָ֥ה שְׁכֶ֑ם וְעֵ֖מֶק סֻכּ֣וֹת אֲמַדֵּֽד׃
verses.translation: God spoke in His holiness, that I would exult; That I would divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִ֤י גִלְעָ֨ד  לִ֤י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה וְ֭אֶפְרַיִם מָע֣וֹז רֹאשִׁ֑י יְ֝הוּדָ֗ה מְחֹקְקִֽי׃
verses.translit: ly gl'd  ly mnshh v'prym m'vz r'shy yhvdh mchqqy
verses.translation: Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מוֹאָ֤ב  סִ֬יר רַחְצִ֗י עַל־אֱ֭דוֹם אַשְׁלִ֣יךְ נַעֲלִ֑י עֲלֵי־פְ֝לֶ֗שֶׁת אֶתְרוֹעָֽע׃
verses.translation: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom do I cast my shoe; Over Philistia do I cry aloud.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֣י יֹ֭בִלֵנִי עִ֣יר מִבְצָ֑ר מִ֖י נָחַ֣נִי עַד־אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.translation: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me unto Edom?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹֽא־אֱלֹהִ֥ים זְנַחְתָּ֑נוּ וְֽלֹא־תֵצֵ֥א אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בְּצִבְאֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translation: Hast not Thou cast us off, O God? And Thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָבָה־לָּ֣נוּ עֶזְרָ֣ת מִצָּ֑ר וְ֝שָׁ֗וְא תְּשׁוּעַ֥ת אָדָֽם׃
verses.translation: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּאלֹהִ֥ים נַֽעֲשֶׂה־חָ֑יִל וְ֝ה֗וּא יָב֥וּס צָרֵֽינוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Through God we shall do valiantly; For He it is that will tread down our adversaries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִ֣ד מִזְמ֑וֹר אֱלֹהֵ֥י תְ֝הִלָּתִ֗י אַֽל־תֶּחֱרַֽשׁ׃
verses.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, keep not silence;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י פִ֪י רָשָׁ֡ע וּֽפִי־מִ֭רְמָה עָלַ֣י פָּתָ֑חוּ דִּבְּר֥וּ אִ֝תִּ֗י לְשׁ֣וֹן שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.translit: khy py rsh' vpymrmh 'ly ptchv dbrv 'ty lshvn shqr
verses.translation: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit have they opened against me; They have spoken unto me with a lying tongue.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדִבְרֵ֣י שִׂנְאָ֣ה סְבָב֑וּנִי וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֥וּנִי חִנָּֽם׃
verses.translation: They compassed me about also with words of hatred, And fought against me without a cause.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּֽחַת־אַהֲבָתִ֥י יִשְׂטְנ֗וּנִי וַאֲנִ֥י תְפִלָּֽה׃
verses.translation: In return for my love they are my adversaries; But I am all prayer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֘שִׂ֤ימוּ עָלַ֣י רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה וְ֝שִׂנְאָ֗ה תַּ֣חַת אַהֲבָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: vyshymv 'ly r'h tcht tvbh vshn'h tcht 'hbty
verses.translation: And they have laid upon me evil for good, And hatred for my love:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַפְקֵ֣ד עָלָ֣יו רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝שָׂטָ֗ן יַעֲמֹ֥ד עַל־יְמִינֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: ’Set Thou a wicked man over him; And let an adversary stand at his right hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּ֭הִשָּׁ֣פְטוֹ יֵצֵ֣א רָשָׁ֑ע וּ֝תְפִלָּת֗וֹ תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה לַחֲטָאָֽה׃
verses.translit: bhshptv yts' rsh' vtpltv thyh lcht'h
verses.translation: When he is judged, let him go forth condemned; And let his prayer be turned into sin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִֽהְיוּ־יָמָ֥יו מְעַטִּ֑ים פְּ֝קֻדָּת֗וֹ יִקַּ֥ח אַחֵֽר׃
verses.translation: Let his days be few; Let another take his charge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִֽהְיוּ־בָנָ֥יו יְתוֹמִ֑ים וְ֝אִשְׁתּ֗וֹ אַלְמָנָֽה׃
verses.translation: Let his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנ֤וֹעַ יָנ֣וּעוּ בָנָ֣יו וְשִׁאֵ֑לוּ וְ֝דָרְשׁ֗וּ מֵחׇרְבֽוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vnv' ynv'v bnyv vsh'lv vdrshv mchrbvtyhm
verses.translation: Let his children be vagabonds, and beg; And let them seek their bread out of their desolate places.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְנַקֵּ֣שׁ נ֭וֹשֶׁה לְכׇל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֑וֹ וְיָבֹ֖זּוּ זָרִ֣ים יְגִיעֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: ynqsh nvshh lkhl'shrlv vybzv zrym ygy'v
verses.translation: Let the creditor distrain all that he hath; And let strangers make spoil of his labour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־יְהִי־ל֭וֹ מֹשֵׁ֣ךְ חָ֑סֶד וְֽאַל־יְהִ֥י ח֝וֹנֵ֗ן לִֽיתוֹמָֽיו׃
verses.translation: Let there be none to extend kindness unto him; Neither let there be any to be gracious unto his fatherless children.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהִי־אַחֲרִית֥וֹ לְהַכְרִ֑ית בְּד֥וֹר אַ֝חֵ֗ר יִמַּ֥ח שְׁמָֽם׃
verses.translation: Let his posterity be cut off; In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִזָּכֵ֤ר  עֲוֺ֣ן אֲ֭בֹתָיו אֶל־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְחַטַּ֥את אִ֝מּ֗וֹ אַל־תִּמָּֽח׃
verses.translation: Let the iniquity of his fathers be brought to remembrance unto the LORD; And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִהְי֣וּ נֶגֶד־יְהֹוָ֣ה תָּמִ֑יד וְיַכְרֵ֖ת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ זִכְרָֽם׃
verses.translit: yhyv ngdyhvh tmyd vykhrt m'rts zkhrm
verses.translation: Let them be before the LORD continually, That He may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר  לֹ֥א זָכַר֮ עֲשׂ֢וֹת חָ֥֫סֶד וַיִּרְדֹּ֡ף אִישׁ־עָנִ֣י וְ֭אֶבְיוֹן וְנִכְאֵ֨ה לֵבָ֬ב לְמוֹתֵֽת׃
verses.translit: y'n 'shr  l' zkhr 'shvt chsd vyrdf 'ysh'ny v'byvn vnkh'h lbb lmvtt
verses.translation: Because that he remembered not to do kindness, But persecuted the poor and needy man, And the broken in heart he was ready to slay.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֶּאֱהַ֣ב קְ֭לָלָה וַתְּבוֹאֵ֑הוּ וְֽלֹא־חָפֵ֥ץ בִּ֝בְרָכָ֗ה וַתִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'hb qllh vtbv'hv vl'chpts bbrkhh vtrchq mmnv
verses.translation: Yea, he loved cursing, and it came unto him; And he delighted not in blessing, and it is far from him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּלְבַּ֥שׁ קְלָלָ֗ה כְּמַ֫דּ֥וֹ וַתָּבֹ֣א כַמַּ֣יִם בְּקִרְבּ֑וֹ וְ֝כַשֶּׁ֗מֶן בְּעַצְמוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vylbsh qllh khmdv vtb' khmym bqrbv vkhshmn b'tsmvtyv
verses.translation: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his raiment, And it is come into his inward parts like water, And like oil into his bones.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּהִי־ל֭וֹ כְּבֶ֣גֶד יַעְטֶ֑ה וּ֝לְמֵ֗זַח תָּמִ֥יד יַחְגְּרֶֽהָ׃
verses.translit: thylv khbgd y'th vlmzch tmyd ychgrh
verses.translation: Let it be unto him as the garment which he putteth on, And for the girdle wherewith he is girded continually.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֤את פְּעֻלַּ֣ת שֹׂ֭טְנַי מֵאֵ֣ת יְהֹוָ֑ה וְהַדֹּבְרִ֥ים רָ֝֗ע עַל־נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: z't p'lt shtny m't yhvh vhdbrym r' 'lnpshy
verses.translation: This would mine adversaries effect from the LORD, And they that speak evil against my soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֤ה  יֱ֘הֹוִ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֗י עֲֽשֵׂה־אִ֭תִּי לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּי־ט֥וֹב חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗ הַצִּילֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: v'th  yhvh 'dny 'shh'ty lm'n shmkh khytvb chsdkh htsylny
verses.translation: But Thou, O GOD the Lord, deal with me for Thy name's sake; Because Thy mercy is good, deliver Thou me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֣וֹן אָנֹ֑כִי וְ֝לִבִּ֗י חָלַ֥ל בְּקִרְבִּֽי׃
verses.translation: For I am poor and needy, And my heart is wounded within me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּצֵל־כִּנְטוֹת֥וֹ נֶהֱלָ֑כְתִּי נִ֝נְעַ֗רְתִּי כָּאַרְבֶּֽה׃
verses.translation: I am gone like the shadow when it lengtheneth; I am shaken off as the locust.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּ֭רְכַּי כָּשְׁל֣וּ מִצּ֑וֹם וּ֝בְשָׂרִ֗י כָּחַ֥שׁ מִשָּֽׁמֶן׃
verses.translit: brkhy khshlv mtsvm vbshry khchsh mshmn
verses.translation: My knees totter through fasting; And my flesh is lean, and hath no fatness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י  הָיִ֣יתִי חֶרְפָּ֣ה לָהֶ֑ם יִ֝רְא֗וּנִי יְנִיע֥וּן רֹאשָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: v'ny  hyyty chrph lhm yr'vny yny'vn r'shm
verses.translation: I am become also a taunt unto them; When they see me, they shake their head.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עׇ֭זְרֵנִי יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י ה֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי כְחַסְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Help me, O LORD my God; O save me according to Thy mercy;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽ֭יֵדְעוּ כִּי־יָ֣דְךָ זֹּ֑את אַתָּ֖ה יְהֹוָ֣ה עֲשִׂיתָֽהּ׃
verses.translation: That they may know that this is Thy hand; That Thou, LORD, hast done it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְקַֽלְלוּ־הֵמָּה֮ וְאַתָּ֢ה תְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ קָ֤מוּ  וַיֵּבֹ֗שׁוּ וְֽעַבְדְּךָ֥ יִשְׂמָֽח׃
verses.translit: yqllvhmh v'th tbrkh qmv  vybshv v'bdkh yshmch
verses.translation: Let them curse, but bless Thou; When they arise, they shall be put to shame, but Thy servant shall rejoice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִלְבְּשׁ֣וּ שׂוֹטְנַ֣י כְּלִמָּ֑ה וְיַעֲט֖וּ כַמְעִ֣יל בׇּשְׁתָּֽם׃
verses.translit: ylbshv shvtny khlmh vy'tv khm'yl bshtm
verses.translation: Mine adversaries shall be clothed with confusion, And shall put on their own shame as a robe.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֘וֹדֶ֤ה יְהֹוָ֣ה מְאֹ֣ד בְּפִ֑י וּבְת֖וֹךְ רַבִּ֣ים אֲהַלְלֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translation: I will give great thanks unto the LORD with my mouth; Yea, I will praise Him among the multitude;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יַ֭עֲמֹד לִימִ֣ין אֶבְי֑וֹן לְ֝הוֹשִׁ֗יעַ מִשֹּׁפְטֵ֥י נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Because He standeth at the right hand of the needy, To save him from them that judge his soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר נְאֻ֤ם יְהֹוָ֨ה  לַֽאדֹנִ֗י שֵׁ֥ב לִֽימִינִ֑י עַד־אָשִׁ֥ית אֹ֝יְבֶ֗יךָ הֲדֹ֣ם לְרַגְלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: ldvd mzmvr n'm yhvh  l'dny shb lymyny 'd'shyt 'ybykh hdm lrglykh
verses.translation: A Psalm of David. The LORD saith unto my lord: ‘Sit thou at My right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַטֵּֽה־עֻזְּךָ֗ יִשְׁלַ֣ח יְ֭הֹוָה מִצִּיּ֑וֹן רְ֝דֵ֗ה בְּקֶ֣רֶב אֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: mth'zkh yshlch yhvh mtsyvn rdh bqrb 'ybykh
verses.translation: The rod of Thy strength the LORD will send out of Zion: 'Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַמְּךָ֣ נְדָבֹת֮ בְּי֢וֹם חֵ֫ילֶ֥ךָ בְּֽהַדְרֵי־קֹ֭דֶשׁ מֵרֶ֣חֶם מִשְׁחָ֑ר לְ֝ךָ֗ טַ֣ל יַלְדֻתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'mkh ndbt byvm chylkh bhdryqdsh mrchm mshchr lkh tl yldtykh
verses.translation: Thy people offer themselves willingly in the day of thy warfare; in adornments of holiness, from the womb of the dawn, Thine is the dew of thy youth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהֹוָ֨ה  וְלֹ֥א יִנָּחֵ֗ם אַתָּֽה־כֹהֵ֥ן לְעוֹלָ֑ם עַל־דִּ֝בְרָתִ֗י מַלְכִּי־צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.translit: nshb' yhvh  vl' ynchm 'thkhhn l'vlm 'ldbrty mlkhytsdq
verses.translation: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent: 'Thou art a priest for ever After the manner of Melchizedek.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֥י עַל־יְמִֽינְךָ֑ מָחַ֖ץ בְּיוֹם־אַפּ֣וֹ מְלָכִֽים׃
verses.translation: The Lord at thy right hand Doth crush kings in the day of His wrath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָדִ֣ין בַּ֭גּוֹיִם מָלֵ֣א גְוִיּ֑וֹת מָ֥חַץ רֹ֝֗אשׁ עַל־אֶ֥רֶץ רַבָּֽה׃
verses.translit: ydyn bgvym ml' gvyvt mchts r'sh 'l'rts rbh
verses.translation: He will judge among the nations; He filleth it with the dead bodies, He crusheth the head over a wide land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֭נַּחַל בַּדֶּ֣רֶךְ יִשְׁתֶּ֑ה עַל־כֵּ֝֗ן יָרִ֥ים רֹֽאשׁ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: He will drink of the brook in the way; Therefore will he lift up the head.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ־יָ֨הּ  אוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה בְּכׇל־לֵבָ֑ב בְּס֖וֹד יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְעֵדָֽה׃
verses.translit: hllvyh  'vdh yhvh bkhllbb bsvd yshrym v'dh
verses.translation: Hallelujah. I will give thanks unto the LORD with my whole heart, . In the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גְּ֭דֹלִים מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה דְּ֝רוּשִׁ֗ים לְכׇל־חֶפְצֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translation: The works of the LORD are great, Sought out of all them that have delight therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹד־וְהָדָ֥ר פׇּעֳל֑וֹ וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד׃
verses.translation: His work is glory and majesty; And His righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֵ֣כֶר עָ֭שָׂה לְנִפְלְאוֹתָ֑יו חַנּ֖וּן וְרַח֣וּם יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translation: He hath made a memorial for His wonderful works; The LORD is gracious and full of compassion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טֶ֭רֶף נָתַ֣ן לִירֵאָ֑יו יִזְכֹּ֖ר לְעוֹלָ֣ם בְּרִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: trf ntn lyr'yv yzkhr l'vlm brytv
verses.translation: He hath given food unto them that fear Him; He will ever be mindful of His covenant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣חַ מַ֭עֲשָׂיו הִגִּ֣יד לְעַמּ֑וֹ לָתֵ֥ת לָ֝הֶ֗ם נַחֲלַ֥ת גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: khch m'shyv hgyd l'mv ltt lhm nchlt gvym
verses.translation: He hath declared to His people the power of His works, In giving them the heritage of the nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָ֭דָיו אֱמֶ֣ת וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט נֶ֝אֱמָנִ֗ים כׇּל־פִּקּוּדָֽיו׃
verses.translation: The works of His hands are truth and justice; All His precepts are sure.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סְמוּכִ֣ים לָעַ֣ד לְעוֹלָ֑ם עֲ֝שׂוּיִ֗ם בֶּאֱמֶ֥ת וְיָשָֽׁר׃
verses.translation: They are established for ever and ever, They are done in truth and uprightness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּד֤וּת  שָׁ֘לַ֤ח לְעַמּ֗וֹ צִוָּֽה־לְעוֹלָ֥ם בְּרִית֑וֹ קָד֖וֹשׁ וְנוֹרָ֣א שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: pdvt  shlch l'mv tsvhl'vlm brytv qdvsh vnvr' shmv
verses.translation: He hath sent redemption unto His people; He hath commanded His covenant for ever; Holy and awful is His name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֵ֘אשִׁ֤ית חׇכְמָ֨ה  יִרְאַ֬ת יְהֹוָ֗ה שֵׂ֣כֶל ט֭וֹב לְכׇל־עֹֽשֵׂיהֶ֑ם תְּ֝הִלָּת֗וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: r'shyt chkhmh  yr't yhvh shkhl tvb lkhl'shyhm thltv 'mdt l'd {p}
verses.translation: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; A good understanding have all they that do thereafter; His praise endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ־יָ֨הּ  אַשְׁרֵי־אִ֭ישׁ יָרֵ֣א אֶת־יְהֹוָ֑ה בְּ֝מִצְוֺתָ֗יו חָפֵ֥ץ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translation: Hallelujah. Happy is the man that feareth the LORD, That delighteth greatly in His commandments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גִּבּ֣וֹר בָּ֭אָרֶץ יִהְיֶ֣ה זַרְע֑וֹ דּ֖וֹר יְשָׁרִ֣ים יְבֹרָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: gbvr b'rts yhyh zr'v dvr yshrym ybrkh
verses.translation: His seed shall be mighty upon earth; The generation of the upright shall be blessed.
