verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹן־וָעֹ֥שֶׁר בְּבֵית֑וֹ וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד׃
verses.translation: Wealth and riches are in his house; And his merit endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זָ֘רַ֤ח בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ א֭וֹר לַיְשָׁרִ֑ים חַנּ֖וּן וְרַח֣וּם וְצַדִּֽיק׃
verses.translit: zrch bchshkh 'vr lyshrym chnvn vrchvm vtsdyq
verses.translation: Unto the upright He shineth as a light in the darkness, Gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טֽוֹב־אִ֭ישׁ חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה יְכַלְכֵּ֖ל דְּבָרָ֣יו בְּמִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: tvb'ysh chvnn vmlvh ykhlkhl dbryv bmshpt
verses.translation: Well is it with the man that dealeth graciously and lendeth, That ordereth his affairs rightfully.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־לְעוֹלָ֥ם לֹֽא־יִמּ֑וֹט לְזֵ֥כֶר ע֝וֹלָ֗ם יִהְיֶ֥ה צַדִּֽיק׃
verses.translation: For he shall never be moved; The righteous shall be had in everlasting remembrance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִשְּׁמוּעָ֣ה רָ֭עָה לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א נָכ֥וֹן לִ֝בּ֗וֹ בָּטֻ֥חַ בַּיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: mshmv'h r'h l' yyr' nkhvn lbv btch byhvh
verses.translation: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings; His heart is stedfast, trusting in the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סָמ֣וּךְ לִ֭בּוֹ לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א עַ֖ד אֲשֶׁר־יִרְאֶ֣ה בְצָרָֽיו׃
verses.translation: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, Until he gaze upon his adversaries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פִּזַּ֤ר  נָ֘תַ֤ן לָאֶבְיוֹנִ֗ים צִ֭דְקָתוֹ עֹמֶ֣דֶת לָעַ֑ד קַ֝רְנ֗וֹ תָּר֥וּם בְּכָבֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: pzr  ntn l'byvnym tsdqtv 'mdt l'd qrnv trvm bkhbvd
verses.translation: He hath scattered abroad, he hath given to the needy; His righteousness endureth for ever; His horn shall be exalted in honour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָ֘שָׁ֤ע יִרְאֶ֨ה  וְכָעָ֗ס שִׁנָּ֣יו יַחֲרֹ֣ק וְנָמָ֑ס תַּאֲוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: rsh' yr'h  vkh's shnyv ychrq vnms t'vt rsh'ym t'bd {p}
verses.translation: The wicked shall see it, and be vexed; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away; the desire of the wicked shall perish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ־יָ֨הּ  הַ֭לְלוּ עַבְדֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה הַֽ֝לְל֗וּ אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translation: Hallelujah. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, Praise the name of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהִ֤י שֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֣ה מְבֹרָ֑ךְ מֵ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: yhy shm yhvh mbrkh m'th v'd'vlm
verses.translation: Blessed be the name of the LORD From this time forth and for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ עַד־מְבוֹא֑וֹ מְ֝הֻלָּ֗ל שֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translation: From the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof The LORD'S name is to be praised.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָ֖ם עַל־כׇּל־גּוֹיִ֥ם ׀ יְהֹוָ֑ה עַ֖ל הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: The LORD is high above all nations, His glory is above the heavens.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֭י כַּיהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ הַֽמַּגְבִּיהִ֥י לָשָֽׁבֶת׃
verses.translation: Who is like unto the LORD our God, That is enthroned on high,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽמַּשְׁפִּילִ֥י לִרְא֑וֹת בַּשָּׁמַ֥יִם וּבָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translation: That looketh down low Upon heaven and upon the earth?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְקִ֥ימִ֣י מֵעָפָ֣ר דָּ֑ל מֵ֝אַשְׁפֹּ֗ת יָרִ֥ים אֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.translation: Who raiseth up the poor out of the dust, And lifteth up the needy out of the dunghill;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְהוֹשִׁיבִ֥י עִם־נְדִיבִ֑ים עִ֝֗ם נְדִיבֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: That He may set him with princes, Even with the princes of His people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֽוֹשִׁיבִ֨י  עֲקֶ֬רֶת הַבַּ֗יִת אֵֽם־הַבָּנִ֥ים שְׂמֵחָ֗ה הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Who maketh the barren woman to dwell in her house As a joyful mother of children. Hallelujah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּצֵ֣את יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם בֵּ֥ית יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב מֵעַ֥ם לֹעֵֽז׃
verses.translit: bts't yshr'l mmtsrym byt y'qb m'm l'z
verses.translation: When Israel came forth out of Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָיְתָ֣ה יְהוּדָ֣ה לְקׇדְשׁ֑וֹ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל מַמְשְׁלוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translation: Judah became His sanctuary, Israel His dominion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַיָּ֣ם רָ֭אָה וַיָּנֹ֑ס הַ֝יַּרְדֵּ֗ן יִסֹּ֥ב לְאָחֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: hym r'h vyns hyrdn ysb l'chvr
verses.translation: The sea saw it, and fled; The Jordan turned backward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶ֭הָרִים רָקְד֣וּ כְאֵילִ֑ים גְּ֝בָע֗וֹת כִּבְנֵי־צֹֽאן׃
verses.translation: The mountains skipped like rams, The hills like young sheep.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־לְּךָ֣ הַ֭יָּם כִּ֣י תָנ֑וּס הַ֝יַּרְדֵּ֗ן תִּסֹּ֥ב לְאָחֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: mhlkh hym khy tnvs hyrdn tsb l'chvr
verses.translation: What aileth thee, O thou sea, that thou fleest? Thou Jordan, that thou turnest backward?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶ֭הָרִים תִּרְקְד֣וּ כְאֵילִ֑ים גְּ֝בָע֗וֹת כִּבְנֵי־צֹֽאן׃
verses.translation: Ye mountains, that ye skip like rams; Ye hills, like young sheep?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִלִּפְנֵ֣י אָ֭דוֹן ח֣וּלִי אָ֑רֶץ מִ֝לִּפְנֵ֗י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translation: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, At the presence of the God of Jacob;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַהֹפְכִ֣י הַצּ֣וּר אֲגַם־מָ֑יִם חַ֝לָּמִ֗ישׁ לְמַעְיְנוֹ־מָֽיִם׃
verses.translation: Who turned the rock into a pool of water, The flint into a fountain of waters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֤א לָ֥נוּ יְהֹוָ֗ה לֹ֫א־לָ֥נוּ כִּֽי־לְ֭שִׁמְךָ תֵּ֣ן כָּב֑וֹד עַל־חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗ עַל־אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: l' lnv yhvh l'lnv khylshmkh tn khbvd 'lchsdkh 'l'mtkh
verses.translation: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, But unto Thy name give glory, For Thy mercy, and for Thy truth's sake.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֭מָּה יֹאמְר֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם אַיֵּה־נָ֝֗א אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translation: Wherefore should the nations say: 'Where is now their God?'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וֵאלֹהֵ֥ינוּ בַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־חָפֵ֣ץ עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.translation: But our God is in the heavens; Whatsoever pleased Him He hath done.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲֽ֭צַבֵּיהֶם כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃
verses.translation: Their idols are silver and gold, The work of men's hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּֽה־לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ עֵינַ֥יִם לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֽוּ׃
verses.translit: phlhm vl' ydbrv 'ynym lhm vl' yr'v
verses.translation: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אׇזְנַ֣יִם לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑עוּ אַ֥ף לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יְרִיחֽוּן׃
verses.translit: 'znym lhm vl' yshm'v 'f lhm vl' yrychvn
verses.translation: They have ears, but they hear not; Noses have they, but they smell not;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְדֵיהֶ֤ם  וְלֹ֬א יְמִישׁ֗וּן רַ֭גְלֵיהֶם וְלֹ֣א יְהַלֵּ֑כוּ לֹא־יֶ֝הְגּ֗וּ בִּגְרוֹנָֽם׃
verses.translit: ydyhm  vl' ymyshvn rglyhm vl' yhlkhv l'yhgv bgrvnm
verses.translation: They have hands, but they handle not; Feet have they, but they walk not; Neither speak they with their throat. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּ֭מוֹהֶם יִהְי֣וּ עֹשֵׂיהֶ֑ם כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־בֹּטֵ֣חַ בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translation: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל בְּטַ֣ח בַּיהֹוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא׃
verses.translation: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD! He is their help and their shield!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית אַ֭הֲרֹן בִּטְח֣וּ בַיהֹוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא׃
verses.translation: O house of Aaron, trust ye in the LORD! He is their help and their shield!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִרְאֵ֣י יְ֭הֹוָה בִּטְח֣וּ בַיהֹוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: yr'y yhvh btchv byhvh 'zrm vmgnm hv'
verses.translation: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָה֮ זְכָרָ֢נוּ יְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ יְ֭בָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְ֝בָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת־בֵּ֥ית אַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.translit: yhvh zkhrnv ybrkh ybrkh 'tbyt yshr'l ybrkh 'tbyt 'hrn
verses.translation: The LORD hath been mindful of us, He will bless— He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְ֭בָרֵךְ יִרְאֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה הַ֝קְּטַנִּ֗ים עִם־הַגְּדֹלִֽים׃
verses.translation: He will bless them that fear the LORD, Both small and great.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֹסֵ֣ף יְהֹוָ֣ה עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם עֲ֝לֵיכֶ֗ם וְעַל־בְּנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translation: The LORD increase you more and more, You and your children.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּרוּכִ֣ים אַ֭תֶּם לַיהֹוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translation: Blessed be ye of the LORD Who made heaven and earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם שָׁ֭מַיִם לַיהֹוָ֑ה וְ֝הָאָ֗רֶץ נָתַ֥ן לִבְנֵי־אָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: hshmym shmym lyhvh vh'rts ntn lbny'dm
verses.translation: The heavens are the heavens of the LORD; But the earth hath He given to the children of men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א הַ֭מֵּתִים יְהַֽלְלוּ־יָ֑הּ וְ֝לֹ֗א כׇּל־יֹרְדֵ֥י דוּמָֽה׃
verses.translit: l' hmtym yhllvyh vl' khlyrdy dvmh
verses.translation: The dead praise not the LORD, Neither any that go down into silence;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ  נְבָ֘רֵ֤ךְ יָ֗הּ מֵעַתָּ֥ה וְעַד־עוֹלָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'nchnv  nbrkh yh m'th v'd'vlm hllvyh {p}
verses.translation: But we will bless the LORD From this time forth and for ever. Hallelujah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֭הַבְתִּי כִּי־יִשְׁמַ֥ע ׀ יְהֹוָ֑ה אֶת־ק֝וֹלִ֗י תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃
verses.translation: I love that the LORD should hear my voice and my supplications.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הִטָּ֣ה אׇזְנ֣וֹ לִ֑י וּבְיָמַ֥י אֶקְרָֽא׃
verses.translation: Because He hath inclined His ear unto me, Therefore will I call upon Him all my days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲפָפ֤וּנִי  חֶבְלֵי־מָ֗וֶת וּמְצָרֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל מְצָא֑וּנִי צָרָ֖ה וְיָג֣וֹן אֶמְצָֽא׃
verses.translit: 'ppvny  chblymvt vmtsry sh'vl mts'vny tsrh vygvn 'mts'
verses.translation: The cords of death compassed me, And the straits of the nether-world got hold upon me; I found trouble and sorrow.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְשֵֽׁם־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֶקְרָ֑א אָנָּ֥ה יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה מַלְּטָ֥ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translation: But I called upon the name of the LORD: 'I beseech thee, O LORD, deliver my soul.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַנּ֣וּן יְהֹוָ֣ה וְצַדִּ֑יק וֵ֖אלֹהֵ֣ינוּ מְרַחֵֽם׃
verses.translation: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; Yea, our God is compassionate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פְּתָאיִ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה דַּ֝לֹּתִ֗י וְלִ֣י יְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.translit: shmr pt'ym yhvh dlty vly yhvshy'
verses.translation: The LORD preserveth the simple; I was brought low, and He saved me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁוּבִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָ֑יְכִי כִּֽי־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה גָּמַ֥ל עָלָֽיְכִי׃
verses.translation: Return, O my soul, unto Thy rest; For the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י חִלַּ֥צְתָּ נַפְשִׁ֗י מִ֫מָּ֥וֶת אֶת־עֵינִ֥י מִן־דִּמְעָ֑ה אֶת־רַגְלִ֥י מִדֶּֽחִי׃
verses.translit: khy chltst npshy mmvt 't'yny mndm'h 'trgly mdchy
verses.translation: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, Mine eyes from tears, And my feet from stumbling.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֭תְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה בְּ֝אַרְצ֗וֹת הַחַיִּֽים׃
verses.translation: I shall walk before the LORD In the lands of the living.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אֲ֝נִ֗י עָנִ֥יתִי מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translation: I trusted even when I spoke: 'I am greatly afflicted.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲ֭נִי אָמַ֣רְתִּי בְחׇפְזִ֑י כׇּֽל־הָאָדָ֥ם כֹּזֵֽב׃
verses.translation: I said in my haste: 'All men are liars.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָה־אָשִׁ֥יב לַיהֹוָ֑ה כׇּֽל־תַּגְמוּל֥וֹהִי עָלָֽי׃
verses.translation: How can I repay unto the LORD All His bountiful dealings toward me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כּוֹס־יְשׁוּע֥וֹת אֶשָּׂ֑א וּבְשֵׁ֖ם יְהֹוָ֣ה אֶקְרָֽא׃
verses.translation: I will lift up the cup of salvation, And call upon the name of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְ֭דָרַי לַיהֹוָ֣ה אֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם נֶגְדָה־נָּ֝֗א לְכׇל־עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: My vows will I pay unto the LORD, Yea, in the presence of all His people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָ֭קָר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה הַ֝מָּ֗וְתָה לַחֲסִידָֽיו׃
verses.translation: Precious in the sight of the LORD Is the death of His saints.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָנָּ֣ה יְהֹוָה֮ כִּי־אֲנִ֢י עַ֫בְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲֽנִי־עַ֭בְדְּךָ בֶּן־אֲמָתֶ֑ךָ פִּ֝תַּ֗חְתָּ לְמֽוֹסֵרָֽי׃
verses.translation: I beseech Thee, O LORD, for I am Thy servant; I am Thy servant, the son of Thy handmaid; Thou hast loosed my bands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְֽךָ־אֶ֭זְבַּח זֶ֣בַח תּוֹדָ֑ה וּבְשֵׁ֖ם יְהֹוָ֣ה אֶקְרָֽא׃
verses.translation: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, And will call upon the name of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְ֭דָרַי לַיהֹוָ֣ה אֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם נֶגְדָה־נָּ֝֗א לְכׇל־עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: I will pay my vows unto the LORD, Yea, in the presence of all His people;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּחַצְר֤וֹת  בֵּ֤ית יְהֹוָ֗ה בְּֽת֘וֹכֵ֤כִי יְֽרוּשָׁלָ֗͏ִם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: bchtsrvt  byt yhvh btvkhkhy yrvshl͏m hllvyh {p}
verses.translation: In the courts of the LORD’S house, In the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת־יְ֭הֹוָה כׇּל־גּוֹיִ֑ם שַׁ֝בְּח֗וּהוּ כׇּל־הָאֻמִּֽים׃
verses.translation: O praise the LORD, all ye nations; Laud Him, all ye peoples.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֥י־גָ֘בַ֤ר עָלֵ֨ינוּ  חַסְדּ֗וֹ וֶאֱמֶת־יְהֹוָ֥ה לְעוֹלָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: For His mercy is great toward us; And the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Hallelujah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hvdv lyhvh khytvb khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: 'O give thanks unto the LORD, for He is good, For His mercy endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֹאמַר־נָ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: So let Israel now say, For His mercy endureth for ever,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֹאמְרוּ־נָ֥א בֵֽית־אַהֲרֹ֑ן כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: So let the house of Aaron now say, For His mercy endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֹאמְרוּ־נָ֭א יִרְאֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: y'mrvn' yr'y yhvh khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: So let them now that fear the LORD say, For His mercy endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽן־הַ֭מֵּצַר קָרָ֣אתִי יָּ֑הּ עָנָ֖נִי בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב יָֽהּ׃
verses.translation: Out of my straits I called upon the LORD; He answered me with great enlargement.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֣ה לִ֭י לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִ֣י אָדָֽם׃
verses.translation: The LORD is for me; I will not fear; What can man do unto me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֣ה לִ֭י בְּעֹזְרָ֑י וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶרְאֶ֥ה בְשֹׂנְאָֽי׃
verses.translation: The LORD is for me as my helper; And I shall gaze upon them that hate me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהֹוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בָּאָדָֽם׃
verses.translation: It is better to take refuge in the LORD Than to trust in man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהֹוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בִּנְדִיבִֽים׃
verses.translation: It is better to take refuge in the LORD Than to trust in princes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־גּוֹיִ֥ם סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃
verses.translation: All nations compass me about; Verily, in the name of the LORD I will cut them off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סַבּ֥וּנִי גַם־סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃
verses.translation: They compass me about, yea, they compass me about; Verily, in the name of the LORD I will cut them off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סַבּ֤וּנִי כִדְבוֹרִ֗ים דֹּ֭עֲכוּ כְּאֵ֣שׁ קוֹצִ֑ים בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃
verses.translit: sbvny khdbvrym d'khv kh'sh qvtsym bshm yhvh khy 'mylm
verses.translation: They compass me about like bees; They are quenched as the fire of thorns; Verily, in the name of the LORD I will cut them off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּחֹ֣ה דְחִיתַ֣נִי לִנְפֹּ֑ל וַ֖יהֹוָ֣ה עֲזָרָֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Thou didst thrust sore at me that I might fall; But the LORD helped me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עׇזִּ֣י וְזִמְרָ֣ת יָ֑הּ וַֽיְהִי־לִ֝֗י לִישׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.translation: The LORD is my strength and song; And He is become my salvation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֤וֹל  רִנָּ֬ה וִישׁוּעָ֗ה בְּאׇהֳלֵ֥י צַדִּיקִ֑ים יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל׃
verses.translit: qvl  rnh vyshv'h b'hly tsdyqym ymyn yhvh 'shh chyl
verses.translation: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous; The right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְמִ֣ין יְ֭הֹוָה רוֹמֵמָ֑ה יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל׃
verses.translit: ymyn yhvh rvmmh ymyn yhvh 'shh chyl
verses.translation: The right hand of the LORD is exalted; The right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־אָמ֥וּת כִּֽי־אֶחְיֶ֑ה וַ֝אֲסַפֵּ֗ר מַעֲשֵׂ֥י יָֽהּ׃
verses.translation: I shall not die, but live, And declare the works of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַסֹּ֣ר יִסְּרַ֣נִּי יָּ֑הּ וְ֝לַמָּ֗וֶת לֹ֣א נְתָנָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: ysr ysrny yh vlmvt l' ntnny
verses.translation: The LORD hath chastened me sore; But He hath not given me over unto death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פִּתְחוּ־לִ֥י שַׁעֲרֵי־צֶ֑דֶק אָבֹא־בָ֝֗ם אוֹדֶ֥ה יָֽהּ׃
verses.translation: Open to me the gates of righteousness; I will enter into them, I will give thanks unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶה־הַשַּׁ֥עַר לַיהֹוָ֑ה צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים יָבֹ֥אוּ בֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: This is the gate of the LORD; The righteous shall enter into it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֭וֹדְךָ כִּ֣י עֲנִיתָ֑נִי וַתְּהִי־לִ֝֗י לִישׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.translation: I will give thanks unto Thee, for Thou hast answered me, And art become my salvation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֭בֶן מָאֲס֣וּ הַבּוֹנִ֑ים הָ֝יְתָ֗ה לְרֹ֣אשׁ פִּנָּֽה׃
verses.translation: The stone which the builders rejected Is become the chief corner-stone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵאֵ֣ת יְ֭הֹוָה הָ֣יְתָה זֹּ֑את הִ֖יא נִפְלָ֣את בְּעֵינֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: m't yhvh hyth z't hy' npl't b'ynynv
verses.translation: This is the LORD’S doing; It is marvellous in our eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶה־הַ֭יּוֹם עָשָׂ֣ה יְהֹוָ֑ה נָגִ֖ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָ֣ה בֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: This is the day which the LORD hath made; We will rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָנָּ֣א יְ֭הֹוָה הוֹשִׁ֘יעָ֥ה נָּ֑א אָנָּ֥א יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה הַצְלִ֘יחָ֥ה נָּֽא׃
verses.translit: 'n' yhvh hvshy'h n' 'n' yhvh htslychh n'
verses.translation: We beseech Thee, O LORD, save now! We beseech Thee, O LORD, make us now to prosper!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּר֣וּךְ הַ֭בָּא בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה בֵּ֝רַ֥כְנוּכֶ֗ם מִבֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: brvkh hb' bshm yhvh brkhnvkhm mbyt yhvh
verses.translation: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD; We bless you out of the house of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֤ל  יְהֹוָה֮ וַיָּ֢אֶ֫ר לָ֥נוּ אִסְרוּ־חַ֥ג בַּעֲבֹתִ֑ים עַד־קַ֝רְנ֗וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translation: The LORD is God, and hath given us light; Order the festival procession with boughs, even unto the horns of the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵלִ֣י אַתָּ֣ה וְאוֹדֶ֑ךָּ אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אֲרוֹמְמֶֽךָּ׃
verses.translation: Thou art my God, and I will give thanks unto Thee; Thou art my God, I will exalt Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hvdv lyhvh khytvb khy l'vlm chsdv {p}
verses.translation: O give thanks unto the LORD, for He is good, For His mercy endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֥י תְמִֽימֵי־דָ֑רֶךְ הַ֝הֹלְכִ֗ים בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translation: ALEPH. Happy are they that are upright in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֭שְׁרֵי נֹצְרֵ֥י עֵדֹתָ֗יו בְּכׇל־לֵ֥ב יִדְרְשֽׁוּהוּ׃
verses.translation: Happy are they that keep His testimonies, that seek Him with the whole heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֭ף לֹא־פָעֲל֣וּ עַוְלָ֑ה בִּדְרָכָ֥יו הָלָֽכוּ׃
verses.translation: Yea, they do no unrighteousness; they walk in His ways.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֭תָּה צִוִּ֥יתָה פִקֻּדֶ֗יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֥ר מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translation: Thou hast ordained Thy precepts, that we should observe them diligently.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֭חֲלַי יִכֹּ֥נוּ דְרָכָ֗י לִשְׁמֹ֥ר חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: Oh that my ways were directed to observe Thy statutes!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֥ז לֹא־אֵב֑וֹשׁ בְּ֝הַבִּיטִ֗י אֶל־כׇּל־מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: Then should I not be ashamed, when I have regard unto all Thy commandments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֭וֹדְךָ בְּיֹ֣שֶׁר לֵבָ֑ב בְּ֝לׇמְדִ֗י מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: I will give thanks unto Thee with uprightness of heart, when I learn Thy righteous ordinances. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־חֻקֶּ֥יךָ אֶשְׁמֹ֑ר אַֽל־תַּעַזְבֵ֥נִי עַד־מְאֹֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translation: I will observe Thy statutes; O forsake me not utterly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּמֶּ֣ה יְזַכֶּה־נַּ֭עַר אֶת־אׇרְח֑וֹ לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: BETH. Wherewithal shall a young man keep his way pure? By taking heed thereto according to Thy word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּכׇל־לִבִּ֥י דְרַשְׁתִּ֑יךָ אַל־תַּ֝שְׁגֵּ֗נִי מִמִּצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: With my whole heart have I sought Thee; O let me not err from Thy commandments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּ֭לִבִּי צָפַ֣נְתִּי אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֶחֱטָא־לָֽךְ׃
verses.translation: Thy word have I laid up in my heart, that I might not sin against Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּר֖וּךְ אַתָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֗ה לַמְּדֵ֥נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: Blessed art Thou, O LORD; Teach me Thy statutes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּשְׂפָתַ֥י סִפַּ֑רְתִּי כֹּ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵי־פִֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: With my lips have I told All the ordinances of Thy mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּדֶ֖רֶךְ עֵדְוֺתֶ֥יךָ שַּׂ֗שְׂתִּי כְּעַ֣ל כׇּל־הֽוֹן׃
verses.translation: I have rejoiced in the way of Thy testimonies, As much as in all riches.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּפִקּוּדֶ֥יךָ אָשִׂ֑יחָה וְ֝אַבִּ֗יטָה אֹֽרְחֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: I will meditate in Thy precepts, And have respect unto Thy ways.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.translation: I will delight myself in Thy statutes; I will not forget Thy word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גְּמֹ֖ל עַל־עַבְדְּךָ֥ אֶחְיֶ֗ה וְאֶשְׁמְרָ֥ה דְבָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: GIMEL. Deal bountifully with Thy servant that I may live, and I will observe Thy word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּל־עֵינַ֥י וְאַבִּ֑יטָה נִ֝פְלָא֗וֹת מִתּוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Open Thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of Thy law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גֵּ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י בָאָ֑רֶץ אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֥ר מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: I am a sojourner in the earth; hide not Thy commandments from me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גָּרְסָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֣י לְתַאֲבָ֑ה אֶֽל־מִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ בְכׇל־עֵֽת׃
verses.translation: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto Thine ordinances at all times.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גָּ֭עַרְתָּ זֵדִ֣ים אֲרוּרִ֑ים הַ֝שֹּׁגִ֗ים מִמִּצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, that do err from Thy commandments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֣ל מֵ֭עָלַי חֶרְפָּ֣ה וָב֑וּז כִּ֖י עֵדֹתֶ֣יךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי׃
verses.translit: gl m'ly chrph vbvz khy 'dtykh ntsrty
verses.translation: Take away from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept Thy testimonies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֤ם יָשְׁב֣וּ שָׂ֭רִים בִּ֣י נִדְבָּ֑רוּ עַ֝בְדְּךָ֗ יָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּחֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: gm yshbv shrym by ndbrv 'bdkh yshych bchqykh
verses.translation: Even though princes sit and talk against me, Thy servant doth meditate in Thy statutes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּֽם־עֵ֭דֹתֶיךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָ֗י אַנְשֵׁ֥י עֲצָתִֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Yea, Thy testimonies are my delight, they are my counsellors. DALETH.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דָּבְקָ֣ה לֶעָפָ֣ר נַפְשִׁ֑י חַ֝יֵּ֗נִי כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: My soul cleaveth unto the dust; quicken Thou me according to Thy word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דְּרָכַ֣י סִ֭פַּרְתִּי וַֽתַּעֲנֵ֗נִי לַמְּדֵ֥נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: I told of my ways, and Thou didst answer me; teach me Thy statutes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דֶּרֶךְ־פִּקּוּדֶ֥יךָ הֲבִינֵ֑נִי וְ֝אָשִׂ֗יחָה בְּנִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: Make me to understand the way of Thy precepts, that I may talk of Thy wondrous works.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דָּלְפָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִתּוּגָ֑ה קַ֝יְּמֵ֗נִי כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: My soul melteth away for heaviness; sustain me according unto Thy word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דֶּֽרֶךְ־שֶׁ֭קֶר הָסֵ֣ר מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְֽתוֹרָתְךָ֥ חׇנֵּֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Remove from me the way of falsehood; and grant me Thy law graciously.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דֶּֽרֶךְ־אֱמוּנָ֥ה בָחָ֑רְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ שִׁוִּֽיתִי׃
verses.translation: I have chosen the way of faithfulness; Thine ordinances have I set [before me].
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דָּבַ֥קְתִּי בְעֵדְוֺתֶ֑יךָ יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה אַל־תְּבִישֵֽׁנִי׃
verses.translation: I cleave unto Thy testimonies; O LORD, put me not to shame.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דֶּֽרֶךְ־מִצְוֺתֶ֥יךָ אָר֑וּץ כִּ֖י תַרְחִ֣יב לִבִּֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translation: I will run the way of Thy commandments, For Thou dost enlarge my heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹרֵ֣נִי יְ֭הֹוָה דֶּ֥רֶךְ חֻקֶּ֗יךָ וְאֶצְּרֶ֥נָּה עֵֽקֶב׃
verses.translation: HE. Teach me, O LORD, the way of Thy statutes; And I will keep it at every step.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲ֭בִינֵנִי וְאֶצְּרָ֥ה תוֹרָתֶ֗ךָ וְאֶשְׁמְרֶ֥נָּה בְכׇל־לֵֽב׃
verses.translation: Give me understanding, that I keep Thy law and observe it with my whole heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֭דְרִיכֵנִי בִּנְתִ֣יב מִצְוֺתֶ֑יךָ כִּי־ב֥וֹ חָפָֽצְתִּי׃
verses.translation: Make me to tread in the path of Thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַט־לִ֭בִּי אֶל־עֵדְוֺתֶ֗יךָ וְאַ֣ל אֶל־בָּֽצַע׃
verses.translation: Incline my heart unto Thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַעֲבֵ֣ר עֵ֭ינַי מֵרְא֣וֹת שָׁ֑וְא בִּדְרָכֶ֥ךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity, and quicken me in Thy ways.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָקֵ֣ם לְ֭עַבְדְּךָ אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ אֲ֝שֶׁ֗ר לְיִרְאָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Confirm Thy word unto Thy servant, which pertaineth unto the fear of Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַעֲבֵ֣ר חֶ֭רְפָּתִי אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָגֹ֑רְתִּי כִּ֖י מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ טוֹבִֽים׃
verses.translit: h'br chrpty 'shr ygrty khy mshptykh tvbym
verses.translation: Turn away my reproach which I dread; for Thine ordinances are good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִ֭נֵּה תָּאַ֣בְתִּי לְפִקֻּדֶ֑יךָ בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֥ חַיֵּֽנִי׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Behold, I have longed after Thy precepts; quicken me in Thy righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִיבֹאֻ֣נִי חֲסָדֶ֣ךָ יְהֹוָ֑ה תְּ֝שׁ֥וּעָתְךָ֗ כְּאִמְרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: VAV. Let Thy mercies also come unto me, O LORD, even Thy salvation, according to Thy word;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶעֱנֶ֣ה חֹרְפִ֣י דָבָ֑ר כִּֽי־בָ֝טַ֗חְתִּי בִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: That I may have an answer for him that taunteth me; for I trust in Thy word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאַל־תַּצֵּ֬ל מִפִּ֣י דְבַר־אֱמֶ֣ת עַד־מְאֹ֑ד כִּ֖י לְמִשְׁפָּטֶ֣ךָ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.translit: v'lttsl mpy dbr'mt 'dm'd khy lmshptkh ychlty
verses.translation: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I hope in Thine ordinances;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶשְׁמְרָ֖ה תוֹרָתְךָ֥ תָמִ֗יד לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.translation: So shall I observe Thy law continually for ever and ever;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶתְהַלְּכָ֥ה בָרְחָבָ֑ה כִּ֖י פִקֻּדֶ֣יךָ דָרָֽשְׁתִּי׃
verses.translation: And I will walk at ease, for I have sought Thy precepts;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה בְ֭עֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶ֥גֶד מְלָכִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.translation: I will also speak of Thy testimonies before kings, and will not be ashamed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶשְׁתַּעֲשַׁ֥ע בְּמִצְוֺתֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהָֽבְתִּי׃
verses.translation: And I will delight myself in Thy commandments, which I have loved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶשָּֽׂא־כַפַּ֗י אֶֽל־מִ֭צְוֺתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָהָ֗בְתִּי וְאָשִׂ֥יחָה בְחֻקֶּֽיךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: I will lift up my hands also unto Thy commandments, which I have loved; And I will meditate in Thy statutes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְכֹר־דָּבָ֥ר לְעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ עַ֝֗ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִחַלְתָּֽנִי׃
verses.translation: ZAIN. Remember the word unto Thy servant, Because Thou hast made me to hope.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֣את נֶחָמָתִ֣י בְעׇנְיִ֑י כִּ֖י אִמְרָתְךָ֣ חִיָּֽתְנִי׃
verses.translation: This is my comfort in my affliction, that Thy word hath quickened me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֵ֭דִים הֱלִיצֻ֣נִי עַד־מְאֹ֑ד מִ֝תּ֥וֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א נָטִֽיתִי׃
verses.translation: The proud have had me greatly in derision; yet have I not turned aside from Thy law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶ֖יךָ מֵעוֹלָ֥ם ׀ יְהֹוָ֗ה וָאֶתְנֶחָֽם׃
verses.translation: I have remembered Thine ordinances which are of old, O LORD, and have comforted myself. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זַלְעָפָ֣ה אֲ֭חָזַתְנִי מֵרְשָׁעִ֑ים עֹ֝זְבֵ֗י תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Burning indignation hath taken hold upon me, because of the wicked that forsake Thy law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְ֭מִרוֹת הָיוּ־לִ֥י חֻקֶּ֗יךָ בְּבֵ֣ית מְגוּרָֽי׃
verses.translation: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי בַלַּ֣יְלָה שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֑ה וָ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: zkhrty blylh shmkh yhvh v'shmrh tvrtkh
verses.translation: I have remembered Thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have observed Thy law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֥את הָיְתָה־לִּ֑י כִּ֖י פִקֻּדֶ֣יךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי׃ {פ}
verses.translation: This I have had, that I have kept Thy precepts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶלְקִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אָמַ֗רְתִּי לִשְׁמֹ֥ר דְּבָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: HETH. My portion is the LORD, I have said that I would observe Thy words.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חִלִּ֣יתִי פָנֶ֣יךָ בְכׇל־לֵ֑ב חׇ֝נֵּ֗נִי כְּאִמְרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: I have entreated Thy favour with my whole heart; be gracious unto me according to Thy word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חִשַּׁ֥בְתִּי דְרָכָ֑י וָאָשִׁ֥יבָה רַ֝גְלַ֗י אֶל־עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: I considered my ways, and turned my feet unto Thy testimonies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַ֭שְׁתִּי וְלֹ֣א הִתְמַהְמָ֑הְתִּי לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: I made haste, and delayed not, to observe Thy commandments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶבְלֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים עִוְּדֻ֑נִי תּ֥֝וֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
verses.translation: The bands of the wicked have enclosed me; but I have not forgotten Thy law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲצֽוֹת־לַ֗יְלָה אָ֭קוּם לְהוֹד֣וֹת לָ֑ךְ עַ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto Thee because of Thy righteous ordinances.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָבֵ֣ר אָ֭נִי לְכׇל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְרֵא֑וּךָ וּ֝לְשֹׁמְרֵ֗י פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: I am a companion of all them that fear Thee, and of them that observe Thy precepts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְ֭הֹוָה מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָ֗רֶץ חֻקֶּ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: chsdkh yhvh ml'h h'rts chqykh lmdny {p}
verses.translation: The earth, O LORD, is full of Thy mercy; teach me Thy statutes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֭וֹב עָשִׂ֣יתָ עִֽם־עַבְדְּךָ֑ יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: TETH. Thou hast dealt well with Thy servant, O LORD, according unto Thy word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֤וּב טַ֣עַם וָדַ֣עַת לַמְּדֵ֑נִי כִּ֖י בְמִצְוֺתֶ֣יךָ הֶאֱמָֽנְתִּי׃
verses.translit: tvb t'm vd't lmdny khy bmtsvtykh h'mnty
verses.translation: Teach me good discernment and knowledge; for I have believed in Thy commandments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טֶ֣רֶם אֶ֭עֱנֶה אֲנִ֣י שֹׁגֵ֑ג וְ֝עַתָּ֗ה אִמְרָתְךָ֥ שָׁמָֽרְתִּי׃
verses.translation: Before I was afflicted, I did err; But now I observe Thy word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טוֹב־אַתָּ֥ה וּמֵטִ֗יב לַמְּדֵ֥נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: Thou art good, and doest good; Teach me Thy statutes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טָפְל֬וּ עָלַ֣י שֶׁ֣קֶר זֵדִ֑ים אֲ֝נִ֗י בְּכׇל־לֵ֤ב  אֶצֹּ֬ר פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: The proud have forged a lie against me; But I with my whole heart will keep Thy precepts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טָפַ֣שׁ כַּחֵ֣לֶב לִבָּ֑ם אֲ֝נִ֗י תּוֹרָתְךָ֥ שִׁעֲשָֽׁעְתִּי׃
verses.translation: Their heart is gross like fat; But I delight in Thy law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טֽוֹב־לִ֥י כִי־עֻנֵּ֑יתִי לְ֝מַ֗עַן אֶלְמַ֥ד חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, In order that I might learn Thy statutes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טֽוֹב־לִ֥י תוֹרַת־פִּ֑יךָ מֵ֝אַלְפֵ֗י זָהָ֥ב וָכָֽסֶף׃ {פ}
verses.translation: The law of Thy mouth is better unto me Than thousands of gold and silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָדֶ֣יךָ עָ֭שׂוּנִי וַֽיְכוֹנְנ֑וּנִי הֲ֝בִינֵ֗נִי וְאֶלְמְדָ֥ה מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: JOD. Thy hands have made me and fashioned me; Give me understanding, that I may learn Thy commandments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְ֭רֵאֶיךָ יִרְא֣וּנִי וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ כִּ֖י לִדְבָרְךָ֣ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.translit: yr'ykh yr'vny vyshmchv khy ldbrkh ychlty
verses.translation: They that fear Thee shall see me and be glad, because I have hope in Thy word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָדַ֣עְתִּי יְ֭הֹוָה כִּי־צֶ֣דֶק מִשְׁפָּטֶ֑יךָ וֶ֝אֱמוּנָ֗ה עִנִּיתָֽנִי׃
verses.translation: I know, O LORD, that Thy judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness Thou hast afflicted me. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהִי־נָ֣א חַסְדְּךָ֣ לְנַחֲמֵ֑נִי כְּאִמְרָתְךָ֥ לְעַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Let, I pray Thee, Thy lovingkindness be ready to comfort me, According to Thy promise unto Thy servant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְבֹא֣וּנִי רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ וְאֶחְיֶ֑ה כִּי־ת֥֝וֹרָתְךָ֗ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָֽי׃
verses.translation: Let Thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live; for Thy law is my delight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ זֵ֭דִים כִּי־שֶׁ֣קֶר עִוְּת֑וּנִי אֲ֝נִ֗י אָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּפִקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: Let the proud be put to shame, for they have distorted my cause with falsehood; but I will meditate in Thy precepts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָשׁ֣וּבוּ לִ֣י יְרֵאֶ֑יךָ (וידעו) [וְ֝יֹדְעֵ֗י] עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: Let those that fear Thee return unto me, and they that know Thy testimonies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהִי־לִבִּ֣י תָמִ֣ים בְּחֻקֶּ֑יךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Let my heart be undivided in Thy statutes, in order that I may not be put to shame.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כָּלְתָ֣ה לִתְשׁוּעָתְךָ֣ נַפְשִׁ֑י לִדְבָרְךָ֥ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.translation: CAPH. My soul pineth for Thy salvation; in Thy word do I hope.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כָּל֣וּ עֵ֭ינַי לְאִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לֵ֝אמֹ֗ר מָתַ֥י תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Mine eyes fail for Thy word, Saying: 'When wilt Thou comfort me?'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הָ֭יִיתִי כְּנֹ֣אד בְּקִיט֑וֹר חֻ֝קֶּ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
verses.translit: khyhyyty khn'd bqytvr chqykh l' shkhchty
verses.translation: For I am become like a wine-skin in the smoke; yet do I not forget Thy statutes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּמָּ֥ה יְמֵֽי־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ מָתַ֬י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בְרֹדְפַ֣י מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: khmh ymy'bdkh mty t'shh brdpy mshpt
verses.translation: How many are the days of Thy servant? When wilt Thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כָּרוּ־לִ֣י זֵדִ֣ים שִׁיח֑וֹת אֲ֝שֶׁ֗ר לֹ֣א כְתוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: The proud have digged pits for me, which is not according to Thy law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־מִצְוֺתֶ֥יךָ אֱמוּנָ֑ה שֶׁ֖קֶר רְדָפ֣וּנִי עׇזְרֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: All Thy commandments are faithful; they persecute me for nought; help Thou me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֭מְעַט כִּלּ֣וּנִי בָאָ֑רֶץ וַ֝אֲנִ֗י לֹא־עָזַ֥בְתִּי פִקֻּדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: khm't khlvny b'rts v'ny l''zbty pqdykh
verses.translation: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but as for me, I forsook not Thy precepts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּחַסְדְּךָ֥ חַיֵּ֑נִי וְ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה עֵד֥וּת פִּֽיךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Quicken me after Thy lovingkindness, and I will observe the testimony of Thy mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְעוֹלָ֥ם יְהֹוָ֑ה דְּ֝בָרְךָ֗ נִצָּ֥ב בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translation: LAMED. For ever, O LORD, Thy word standeth fast in heaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְדֹ֣ר וָ֭דֹר אֱמוּנָתֶ֑ךָ כּוֹנַ֥נְתָּֽ אֶ֝֗רֶץ וַֽתַּעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.translation: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations; Thou hast established the earth, and it standeth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְֽ֭מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ עָמְד֣וּ הַיּ֑וֹם כִּ֖י הַכֹּ֣ל עֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: They stand this day according to Thine ordinances; for all things are Thy servants.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לוּלֵ֣י ת֭וֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָ֑י אָ֝֗ז אָבַ֥דְתִּי בְעׇנְיִֽי׃
verses.translation: Unless Thy law had been my delight, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֭עוֹלָם לֹא־אֶשְׁכַּ֣ח פִּקּוּדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֥י בָ֝֗ם חִיִּיתָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: l'vlm l''shkhch pqvdykh khy bm chyytny
verses.translation: I will never forget Thy precepts; for with them Thou hast quickened me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְֽךָ־אֲ֭נִי הוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי כִּ֖י פִקּוּדֶ֣יךָ דָרָֽשְׁתִּי׃
verses.translation: I am Thine, save me; for I have sought Thy precepts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִ֤י קִוּ֣וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים לְאַבְּדֵ֑נִי עֵ֝דֹתֶ֗יךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָֽן׃
verses.translation: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me; but I will consider Thy testimonies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְֽכׇל־תִּ֭כְלָה רָאִ֣יתִי קֵ֑ץ רְחָבָ֖ה מִצְוָתְךָ֣ מְאֹֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lkhltkhlh r'yty qts rchbh mtsvtkh m'd {p}
verses.translation: I have seen an end to every purpose; but Thy commandment is exceeding broad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָה־אָהַ֥בְתִּי תוֹרָתֶ֑ךָ כׇּל־הַ֝יּ֗וֹם הִ֣יא שִׂיחָתִֽי׃
verses.translation: MEM. O how love I Thy law! It is my meditation all the day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵֽ֭אֹיְבַי תְּחַכְּמֵ֣נִי מִצְוֺתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם הִיא־לִֽי׃
verses.translit: m'yby tchkhmny mtsvtkh khy l'vlm hy'ly
verses.translation: Thy commandments make me wiser than mine enemies: For they are ever with me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִכׇּל־מְלַמְּדַ֥י הִשְׂכַּ֑לְתִּי כִּ֥י עֵ֝דְוֺתֶ֗יךָ שִׂ֣יחָה לִֽי׃
verses.translation: I have more understanding than all my teachers; For Thy testimonies are my meditation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִזְּקֵנִ֥ים אֶתְבּוֹנָ֑ן כִּ֖י פִקּוּדֶ֣יךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי׃
verses.translation: I understand more than mine elders, because I have keep Thy precepts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִכׇּל־אֹ֣רַח רָ֭ע כָּלִ֣אתִי רַגְלָ֑י לְ֝מַ֗עַן אֶשְׁמֹ֥ר דְּבָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: mkhl'rch r' khl'ty rgly lm'n 'shmr dbrkh
verses.translation: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, in order that I might observe Thy word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִמִּשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ לֹא־סָ֑רְתִּי כִּי־אַ֝תָּ֗ה הוֹרֵתָֽנִי׃
verses.translation: I have not turned aside from Thine ordinances; For Thou hast instructed me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־נִּמְלְצ֣וּ לְ֭חִכִּי אִמְרָתֶ֗ךָ מִדְּבַ֥שׁ לְפִֽי׃
verses.translation: How sweet are Thy words unto my palate! Yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִפִּקּוּדֶ֥יךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָ֑ן עַל־כֵּ֝֗ן שָׂנֵ֤אתִי  כׇּל־אֹ֬רַח שָֽׁקֶר׃ {פ}
verses.translation: From Thy precepts I get understanding; Therefore I hate every false way.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֵר־לְרַגְלִ֥י דְבָרֶ֑ךָ וְ֝א֗וֹר לִנְתִיבָתִֽי׃
verses.translation: NUN. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, And a light unto my path.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי וָאֲקַיֵּ֑מָה לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, To observe Thy righteous ordinances.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַעֲנֵ֥יתִי עַד־מְאֹ֑ד יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה חַיֵּ֥נִי כִדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: I am afflicted very much; Quicken me, O LORD, according unto Thy word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִדְב֣וֹת פִּ֭י רְצֵה־נָ֣א יְהֹוָ֑ה וּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: ndbvt py rtshn' yhvh vmshptykh lmdny
verses.translation: Accept, I beseech Thee, the freewill-offerings of my mouth, O LORD, And teach me Thine ordinances.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַפְשִׁ֣י בְכַפִּ֣י תָמִ֑יד וְ֝ת֥וֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
verses.translit: npshy bkhpy tmyd vtvrtkh l' shkhchty
verses.translation: My soul is continually in my hand; yet have I not forgotten Thy law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָתְנ֬וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים פַּ֣ח לִ֑י וּ֝מִפִּקּוּדֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א תָעִֽיתִי׃
verses.translit: ntnv rsh'ym pch ly vmpqvdykh l' t'yty
verses.translation: The wicked have laid a snare for me; yet went I not astray from Thy precepts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָחַ֣לְתִּי עֵדְוֺתֶ֣יךָ לְעוֹלָ֑ם כִּֽי־שְׂשׂ֖וֹן לִבִּ֣י הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.translation: Thy testimonies have I taken as a heritage for ever; for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָטִ֣יתִי לִ֭בִּי לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת חֻקֶּ֗יךָ לְעוֹלָ֥ם עֵֽקֶב׃ {פ}
verses.translation: I have inclined my heart to perform Thy statutes, for ever, at every step.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סֵעֲפִ֥ים שָׂנֵ֑אתִי וְֽתוֹרָתְךָ֥ אָהָֽבְתִּי׃
verses.translation: SAMECH. I hate them that are of a double mind; but Thy law do I love.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סִתְרִ֣י וּמָגִנִּ֣י אָ֑תָּה לִדְבָרְךָ֥ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.translation: Thou art my covert and my shield; in Thy word do I hope.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סוּרוּ־מִמֶּ֥נִּי מְרֵעִ֑ים וְ֝אֶצְּרָ֗ה מִצְוֺ֥ת אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.translation: Depart from me, ye evildoers; that I may keep the commandments of my God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סׇמְכֵ֣נִי כְאִמְרָתְךָ֣ וְאֶחְיֶ֑ה וְאַל־תְּ֝בִישֵׁ֗נִי מִשִּׂבְרִֽי׃
verses.translation: Uphold me according unto Thy word, that I may live; and put me not to shame in my hope.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סְעָדֵ֥נִי וְאִוָּשֵׁ֑עָה וְאֶשְׁעָ֖ה בְחֻקֶּ֣יךָ תָמִֽיד׃
verses.translation: Support Thou me, and I shall be saved; and I will occupy myself with Thy statutes continually.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סָ֭לִיתָ כׇּל־שׁוֹגִ֣ים מֵחֻקֶּ֑יךָ כִּי־שֶׁ֝֗קֶר תַּרְמִיתָֽם׃
verses.translation: Thou hast made light of all them that err from Thy statutes; for their deceit is vain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סִגִ֗ים הִשְׁבַּ֥תָּ כׇל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָ֑רֶץ לָ֝כֵ֗ן אָהַ֥בְתִּי עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross; therefore I love Thy testimonies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סָמַ֣ר מִפַּחְדְּךָ֣ בְשָׂרִ֑י וּֽמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ יָרֵֽאתִי׃ {פ}
verses.translation: My flesh shuddereth for fear of Thee; And I am afraid of Thy judgments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָ֭שִׂיתִי מִשְׁפָּ֣ט וָצֶ֑דֶק בַּל־תַּ֝נִּיחֵ֗נִי לְעֹשְׁקָֽי׃
verses.translation: AIN. I have done justice and righteousness; Leave me not to mine oppressors.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲרֹ֣ב עַבְדְּךָ֣ לְט֑וֹב אַֽל־יַעַשְׁקֻ֥נִי זֵדִֽים׃
verses.translation: Be surety for Thy servant for good; Let not the proud oppress me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵ֭ינַי כָּל֣וּ לִישׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ וּלְאִמְרַ֥ת צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Mine eyes fail for Thy salvation, and for Thy righteous word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲשֵׂ֖ה עִם־עַבְדְּךָ֥ כְחַסְדֶּ֗ךָ וְחֻקֶּ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Deal with Thy servant according unto Thy mercy, and teach me Thy statutes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַבְדְּךָ־אָ֥נִי הֲבִינֵ֑נִי וְ֝אֵדְעָ֗ה עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: I am Thy servant, give me understanding, that I may know Thy testimonies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵ֭ת לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לַיהֹוָ֑ה הֵ֝פֵ֗רוּ תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: It is time for the LORD to work; They have made void Thy law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֭ן אָהַ֣בְתִּי מִצְוֺתֶ֑יךָ מִזָּהָ֥ב וּמִפָּֽז׃
verses.translation: Therefore I love Thy commandments Above gold, yea, above fine gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֤ן  כׇּל־פִּקּ֣וּדֵי כֹ֣ל יִשָּׁ֑רְתִּי כׇּל־אֹ֖רַח שֶׁ֣קֶר שָׂנֵֽאתִי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lkhn  khlpqvdy khl yshrty khl'rch shqr shn'ty {p}
verses.translation: Therefore I esteem all [Thy] precepts concerning all things to be right; Every false way I hate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּלָא֥וֹת עֵדְוֺתֶ֑יךָ עַל־כֵּ֝֗ן נְצָרָ֥תַם נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translation: PE. Thy testimonies are wonderful; Therefore doth my soul keep them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֵּ֖תַח דְּבָרֶ֥יךָ יָאִ֗יר מֵבִ֥ין פְּתָיִֽים׃
verses.translation: The opening of Thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פִּֽי־פָ֭עַרְתִּי וָאֶשְׁאָ֑פָה כִּ֖י לְמִצְוֺתֶ֣יךָ יָאָֽבְתִּי׃
verses.translation: I opened wide my mouth, and panted; For I longed for Thy commandments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּנֵה־אֵלַ֥י וְחׇנֵּ֑נִי כְּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט לְאֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Turn Thee towards me, and be gracious unto me, As is Thy wont to do unto those that love Thy name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּ֭עָמַי הָכֵ֣ן בְּאִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ וְֽאַל־תַּשְׁלֶט־בִּ֥י כׇל־אָֽוֶן׃
verses.translation: Order my footsteps by Thy word; And let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּ֭דֵנִי מֵעֹ֣שֶׁק אָדָ֑ם וְ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: Redeem me from the oppression of man, And I will observe Thy precepts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּ֭נֶיךָ הָאֵ֣ר בְּעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝לַמְּדֵ֗נִי אֶת־חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: Make Thy face to shine upon Thy servant; And teach me Thy statutes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פַּלְגֵי־מַ֭יִם יָרְד֣וּ עֵינָ֑י עַ֝֗ל לֹא־שָׁמְר֥וּ תוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Mine eyes run down with rivers of water, Because they observe not Thy law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צַדִּ֣יק אַתָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֑ה וְ֝יָשָׁ֗ר מִשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: TZADE. Righteous art Thou, O LORD, And upright are Thy judgments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צִ֭וִּיתָ צֶ֣דֶק עֵדֹתֶ֑יךָ וֶאֱמוּנָ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translation: Thou hast commanded Thy testimonies in righteousness and exceeding faithfulness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צִמְּתַ֥תְנִי קִנְאָתִ֑י כִּֽי־שָׁכְח֖וּ דְבָרֶ֣יךָ צָרָֽי׃
verses.translation: My zeal hath undone me, because mine adversaries have forgotten Thy words.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צְרוּפָ֖ה אִמְרָתְךָ֥ מְאֹ֗ד וְֽעַבְדְּךָ֥ אֲהֵבָֽהּ׃
verses.translation: Thy word is tried to the uttermost, and Thy servant loveth it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צָעִ֣יר אָנֹכִ֣י וְנִבְזֶ֑ה פִּ֝קֻּדֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
verses.translation: I am small and despised; yet have I not forgotten Thy precepts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צִדְקָתְךָ֣ צֶ֣דֶק לְעוֹלָ֑ם וְֽתוֹרָתְךָ֥ אֱמֶֽת׃
verses.translation: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and Thy law is truth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צַר־וּמָצ֥וֹק מְצָא֑וּנִי מִ֝צְוֺתֶ֗יךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָֽי׃
verses.translation: Trouble and anguish have overtaken me; yet Thy commandments are my delight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צֶ֖דֶק עֵדְוֺתֶ֥יךָ לְעוֹלָ֗ם הֲבִינֵ֥נִי וְאֶחְיֶֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Thy testimonies are righteous for ever; give me understanding, and I shall live.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָרָ֣אתִי בְכׇל־לֵ֭ב עֲנֵ֥נִי יְהֹוָ֗ה חֻקֶּ֥יךָ אֶצֹּֽרָה׃
verses.translation: KOPH. I have called with my whole heart; answer me, O LORD; I will keep Thy statutes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קְרָאתִ֥יךָ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי וְ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: I have called Thee, save me, and I will observe Thy testimonies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קִדַּ֣מְתִּי בַ֭נֶּשֶׁף וָאֲשַׁוֵּ֑עָה (לדבריך) [לִדְבָרְךָ֥] יִחָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.translation: I rose early at dawn, and cried; I hoped in Thy word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קִדְּמ֣וּ עֵ֭ינַי אַשְׁמֻר֑וֹת לָ֝שִׂ֗יחַ בְּאִמְרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Mine eyes forestalled the night-watches, that I might meditate in Thy word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֭וֹלִי שִׁמְעָ֣ה כְחַסְדֶּ֑ךָ יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה כְּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥ךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: qvly shm'h khchsdkh yhvh khmshptkh chyny
verses.translation: Hear my voice according unto Thy lovingkindness; Quicken me, O LORD, as Thou art wont.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָ֭רְבוּ רֹדְפֵ֣י זִמָּ֑ה מִתּוֹרָתְךָ֥ רָחָֽקוּ׃
verses.translation: They draw nigh that follow after wickedness; they are far from Thy law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָר֣וֹב אַתָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֑ה וְֽכׇל־מִצְוֺתֶ֥יךָ אֱמֶֽת׃
verses.translation: Thou art nigh, O LORD; and all Thy commandments are truth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קֶ֣דֶם יָ֭דַעְתִּי מֵעֵדֹתֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם יְסַדְתָּֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: qdm yd'ty m'dtykh khy l'vlm ysdtm {p}
verses.translation: Of old have I known from Thy testimonies that Thou hast founded them for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְאֵה־עׇנְיִ֥י וְחַלְּצֵ֑נִי כִּי־ת֥֝וֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃
verses.translation: RESH. O see mine affliction, and rescue me; For I do not forget Thy law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רִיבָ֣ה רִ֭יבִי וּגְאָלֵ֑נִי לְאִמְרָתְךָ֥ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Plead Thou my cause, and redeem me; Quicken me according to Thy word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָח֣וֹק מֵרְשָׁעִ֣ים יְשׁוּעָ֑ה כִּי־חֻ֝קֶּ֗יךָ לֹ֣א דָרָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.translit: rchvq mrsh'ym yshv'h khychqykh l' drshv
verses.translation: Salvation is far from the wicked; For they seek not Thy statutes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַחֲמֶ֖יךָ רַבִּ֥ים ׀ יְהֹוָ֑ה כְּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Great are Thy compassions, O LORD; Quicken me as Thou art wont.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֭בִּים רֹדְפַ֣י וְצָרָ֑י מֵ֝עֵדְוֺתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א נָטִֽיתִי׃
verses.translit: rbym rdpy vtsry m'dvtykh l' ntyty
verses.translation: Many are my persecutors and mine adversaries; Yet have I not turned aside from Thy testimonies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָאִ֣יתִי בֹ֭גְדִים וָאֶתְקוֹטָ֑טָה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִ֝מְרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁמָֽרוּ׃
verses.translation: I beheld them that were faithless, and strove with them; Because they observed not Thy word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְ֭אֵה כִּי־פִקּוּדֶ֣יךָ אָהָ֑בְתִּי יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה כְּֽחַסְדְּךָ֥ חַיֵּֽנִי׃
verses.translation: O see how I love Thy precepts; Quicken me, O LORD, according to Thy lovingkindness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֹאשׁ־דְּבָרְךָ֥ אֱמֶ֑ת וּ֝לְעוֹלָ֗ם כׇּל־מִשְׁפַּ֥ט צִדְקֶֽךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: The beginning of Thy word is truth; And all Thy righteous ordinance endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׂ֭רִים רְדָפ֣וּנִי חִנָּ֑ם (ומדבריך) [וּ֝מִדְּבָרְךָ֗] פָּחַ֥ד לִבִּֽי׃
verses.translation: SCHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause; But my heart standeth in awe of Thy words.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׂ֣שׂ אָ֭נֹכִי עַל־אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ כְּ֝מוֹצֵ֗א שָׁלָ֥ל רָֽב׃
verses.translation: I rejoice at Thy word, As one that findeth great spoil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֶׁ֣קֶר שָׂ֭נֵאתִי וַאֲתַעֵ֑בָה תּוֹרָתְךָ֥ אָהָֽבְתִּי׃
verses.translation: I hate and abhor falsehood; Thy law do I love. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֶׁ֣בַע בַּ֭יּוֹם הִלַּלְתִּ֑יךָ עַ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Seven times a day do I praise Thee, because of Thy righteous ordinances.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁל֣וֹם רָ֭ב לְאֹהֲבֵ֣י תוֹרָתֶ֑ךָ וְאֵֽין־לָ֥מוֹ מִכְשֽׁוֹל׃
verses.translit: shlvm rb l'hby tvrtkh v'ynlmv mkhshvl
verses.translation: Great peace have they that love Thy law; And there is no stumbling for them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׂבַּ֣רְתִּי לִישׁוּעָתְךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֑ה וּֽמִצְוֺתֶ֥יךָ עָשִֽׂיתִי׃
verses.translation: I have hoped for Thy salvation, O LORD, And have done Thy commandments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָֽׁמְרָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי עֵדֹתֶ֑יךָ וָאֹהֲבֵ֥ם מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translation: My soul hath observed Thy testimonies; And I love them exceedingly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣רְתִּי פִ֭קּוּדֶיךָ וְעֵדֹתֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י כׇל־דְּרָכַ֣י נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: shmrty pqvdykh v'dtykh khy khldrkhy ngdkh {p}
verses.translation: I have observed Thy precepts and Thy testimonies; For all my ways are before Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּקְרַ֤ב רִנָּתִ֣י לְפָנֶ֣יךָ יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּדְבָרְךָ֥ הֲבִינֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: tqrb rnty lpnykh yhvh khdbrkh hbynny
verses.translation: TAV. Let my cry come near before Thee, O LORD; Give me understanding according to Thy word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תָּב֣וֹא תְחִנָּתִ֣י לְפָנֶ֑יךָ כְּ֝אִמְרָתְךָ֗ הַצִּילֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Let my supplication come before Thee; deliver me according to Thy word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּבַּ֣עְנָה שְׂפָתַ֣י תְּהִלָּ֑ה כִּ֖י תְלַמְּדֵ֣נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: tb'nh shpty thlh khy tlmdny chqykh
verses.translation: Let my lips utter praise: Because Thou teachest me Thy statutes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּ֣עַן לְ֭שׁוֹנִי אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֖י כׇל־מִצְוֺתֶ֣יךָ צֶּֽדֶק׃
verses.translation: Let my tongue sing of Thy word; For all Thy commandments are righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּהִי־יָדְךָ֥ לְעׇזְרֵ֑נִי כִּ֖י פִקּוּדֶ֣יךָ בָחָֽרְתִּי׃
verses.translation: Let Thy hand be ready to help me; For I have chosen Thy precepts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תָּאַ֣בְתִּי לִישׁוּעָתְךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֑ה וְ֝ת֥וֹרָתְךָ֗ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָֽי׃
verses.translation: I have longed for Thy salvation, O LORD; And Thy law is my delight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּֽחִי־נַ֭פְשִׁי וּֽתְהַלְלֶ֑ךָּ וּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥ךָ יַעְזְרֻֽנִי׃
verses.translation: Let my soul live, and it shall praise Thee; And let Thine ordinances help me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תָּעִ֗יתִי כְּשֶׂ֣ה אֹ֭בֵד בַּקֵּ֣שׁ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י מִ֝צְוֺתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: t'yty khshh 'bd bqsh 'bdkh khy mtsvtykh l' shkhchty {p}
verses.translation: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek Thy servant; For I have not forgotten Thy commandments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֶל־יְ֭הֹוָה בַּצָּרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י קָ֝רָ֗אתִי וַֽיַּעֲנֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt 'lyhvh btsrth ly qr'ty vy'nny
verses.translation: A Song of Ascents. In my distress I called unto the LORD, And He answered me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה הַצִּ֣ילָה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִשְּׂפַת־שֶׁ֑קֶר מִלָּשׁ֥וֹן רְמִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: yhvh htsylh npshy mshptshqr mlshvn rmyh
verses.translation: O LORD, deliver my soul from lying lips, From a deceitful tongue.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־יִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭ךָ וּמַה־יֹּסִ֥יף לָ֗ךְ לָשׁ֥וֹן רְמִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: mhytn lkh vmhysyf lkh lshvn rmyh
verses.translation: What shall be given unto thee, and what shall be done more unto thee, Thou deceitful tongue?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חִצֵּ֣י גִבּ֣וֹר שְׁנוּנִ֑ים עִ֝֗ם גַּחֲלֵ֥י רְתָמִֽים׃
verses.translation: Sharp arrows of the mighty, With coals of broom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֽוֹיָה־לִ֭י כִּי־גַ֣רְתִּי מֶ֑שֶׁךְ שָׁ֝כַ֗נְתִּי עִֽם־אׇהֳלֵ֥י קֵדָֽר׃
verses.translation: Woe is me, that I sojourn with Meshech, That I dwell beside the tents of Kedar!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֭בַּת שָֽׁכְנָה־לָּ֣הּ נַפְשִׁ֑י עִ֝֗ם שׂוֹנֵ֥א שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.translation: My soul hath full long had her dwelling With him that hateth peace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲֽנִי־שָׁ֭לוֹם וְכִ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר הֵ֝֗מָּה לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translation: I am all peace; But when I speak, they are for war.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֗יר לַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֶשָּׂ֣א עֵ֭ינַי אֶל־הֶהָרִ֑ים מֵ֝אַ֗יִן יָבֹ֥א עֶזְרִֽי׃
verses.translation: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up mine eyes unto the mountains: From whence shall my help come?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֶ֭זְרִי מֵעִ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translation: My help cometh from the LORD, Who made heaven and earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־יִתֵּ֣ן לַמּ֣וֹט רַגְלֶ֑ךָ אַל־יָ֝נ֗וּם שֹׁמְרֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved; He that keepeth thee will not slumber.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה לֹֽא־יָ֭נוּם וְלֹ֣א יִישָׁ֑ן שׁ֝וֹמֵ֗ר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: hnh l'ynvm vl' yyshn shvmr yshr'l
verses.translation: Behold, He that keepeth Israel Doth neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֥ה שֹׁמְרֶ֑ךָ יְהֹוָ֥ה צִ֝לְּךָ֗ עַל־יַ֥ד יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: The LORD is thy keeper; The LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹמָ֗ם הַשֶּׁ֥מֶשׁ לֹֽא־יַכֶּ֗כָּה וְיָרֵ֥חַ בַּלָּֽיְלָה׃
verses.translation: The sun shall not smite thee by day, Nor the moon by night.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה יִשְׁמׇרְךָ֥ מִכׇּל־רָ֑ע יִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת־נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.translation: The LORD shall keep thee from all evil; He shall keep thy soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה יִשְׁמׇר־צֵאתְךָ֥ וּבוֹאֶ֑ךָ מֵ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translation: The LORD shall guard thy going out and thy coming in, From this time forth and for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד שָׂ֭מַחְתִּי בְּאֹמְרִ֣ים לִ֑י בֵּ֖ית יְהֹוָ֣ה נֵלֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt ldvd shmchty b'mrym ly byt yhvh nlkh
verses.translation: A Song of Ascents; of David. I rejoiced when they said unto me: 'Let us go unto the house of the LORD.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹ֭מְדוֹת הָי֣וּ רַגְלֵ֑ינוּ בִּ֝שְׁעָרַ֗יִךְ יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translation: Our feet are standing within thy gates, O Jerusalem;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְרוּשָׁלַ֥͏ִם הַבְּנוּיָ֑ה כְּ֝עִ֗יר שֶׁחֻבְּרָה־לָּ֥הּ יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.translation: Jerusalem, that art builded as a city that is compact together;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֶׁשָּׁ֨ם עָל֪וּ שְׁבָטִ֡ים שִׁבְטֵי־יָ֭הּ עֵד֣וּת לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְ֝הֹד֗וֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: shshm 'lv shbtym shbtyyh 'dvt lyshr'l lhdvt lshm yhvh
verses.translation: Whither the tribes went up, even the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony unto Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י שָׁ֨מָּה  יָשְׁב֣וּ כִסְא֣וֹת לְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּ֝סְא֗וֹת לְבֵ֣ית דָּוִֽד׃
verses.translit: khy shmh  yshbv khs'vt lmshpt khs'vt lbyt dvd
verses.translation: For there were set thrones for judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁ֭אֲלוּ שְׁל֣וֹם יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם יִ֝שְׁלָ֗יוּ אֹהֲבָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translation: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem; May they prosper that love thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהִי־שָׁל֥וֹם בְּחֵילֵ֑ךְ שַׁ֝לְוָ֗ה בְּאַרְמְנוֹתָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translation: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֭מַעַן אַחַ֣י וְרֵעָ֑י אֲדַבְּרָה־נָּ֖א שָׁל֣וֹם בָּֽךְ׃
verses.translation: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say: 'Peace be within thee.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֭מַעַן בֵּית־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ אֲבַקְשָׁ֖ה ט֣וֹב לָֽךְ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֵ֭לֶיךָ נָשָׂ֣אתִי אֶת־עֵינַ֑י הַ֝יֹּשְׁבִ֗י בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translation: A Song of Ascents. Unto Thee I lift up mine eyes, O Thou that art enthroned in the heavens.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה כְעֵינֵ֪י עֲבָדִ֡ים אֶל־יַ֤ד אֲֽדוֹנֵיהֶ֗ם כְּעֵינֵ֣י שִׁפְחָה֮ אֶל־יַ֢ד גְּבִ֫רְתָּ֥הּ כֵּ֣ן עֵ֭ינֵינוּ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ עַ֝֗ד שֶׁיְּחׇנֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: hnh kh'yny 'bdym 'lyd 'dvnyhm kh'yny shpchh 'lyd gbrth khn 'ynynv 'lyhvh 'lhynv 'd shychnnv
verses.translation: Behold, as the eyes of servants unto the hand of their master, As the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; So our eyes look unto the LORD our God, Until He be gracious unto us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חׇנֵּ֣נוּ יְהֹוָ֣ה חׇנֵּ֑נוּ כִּי־רַ֝֗ב שָׂבַ֥עְנוּ בֽוּז׃
verses.translit: chnnv yhvh chnnv khyrb shb'nv bvz
verses.translation: Be gracious unto us, O LORD, be gracious unto us; For we are full sated with contempt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַבַּת֮ שָֽׂבְעָה־לָּ֢הּ נַ֫פְשֵׁ֥נוּ הַלַּ֥עַג הַשַּֽׁאֲנַנִּ֑ים הַ֝בּ֗וּז (לגאיונים) [לִגְאֵ֥י יוֹנִֽים]׃ {פ}
verses.translit: rbt shb'hlh npshnv hl'g hsh'nnym hbvz (lg'yvnym) [lg'y yvnym] {p}
verses.translation: Our soul is full sated With the scorning of those that are at ease, And with the contempt of the proud oppressors.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הֹוָה שֶׁהָ֣יָה לָ֑נוּ יֹאמַר־נָ֝֗א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt ldvd lvly yhvh shhyh lnv y'mrn' yshr'l
verses.translation: A Song of Ascents; of David. 'If it had not been the LORD who was for us', Let Israel now say;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הֹוָה שֶׁהָ֣יָה לָ֑נוּ בְּק֖וּם עָלֵ֣ינוּ אָדָֽם׃
verses.translation: 'If it had not been the LORD who was for us, When men rose up against us,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲ֭זַי חַיִּ֣ים בְּלָע֑וּנוּ בַּחֲר֖וֹת אַפָּ֣ם בָּֽנוּ׃
