verses.translation: Then they had swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲ֭זַי הַמַּ֣יִם שְׁטָפ֑וּנוּ נַ֝֗חְלָה עָבַ֥ר עַל־נַפְשֵֽׁנוּ׃
verses.translation: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲ֭זַי עָבַ֣ר עַל־נַפְשֵׁ֑נוּ הַ֝מַּ֗יִם הַזֵּידוֹנִֽים׃
verses.translation: Then the proud waters Had gone over our soul.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהֹוָ֑ה שֶׁלֹּ֥א נְתָנָ֥נוּ טֶ֝֗רֶף לְשִׁנֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: brvkh yhvh shl' ntnnv trf lshnyhm
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַפְשֵׁ֗נוּ כְּצִפּ֥וֹר נִמְלְטָה֮ מִפַּ֢ח י֫וֹקְשִׁ֥ים הַפַּ֥ח נִשְׁבָּ֗ר וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ נִמְלָֽטְנוּ׃
verses.translit: npshnv khtspvr nmlth mpch yvqshym hpch nshbr v'nchnv nmltnv
verses.translation: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers; The snare is broken, and we are escaped.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֶ֭זְרֵנוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Our help is in the name of the LORD, Who made heaven and earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת הַבֹּטְחִ֥ים בַּיהֹוָ֑ה כְּֽהַר־צִיּ֥וֹן לֹא־יִ֝מּ֗וֹט לְעוֹלָ֥ם יֵשֵֽׁב׃
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt hbtchym byhvh khhrtsyvn l'ymvt l'vlm yshb
verses.translation: A Song of Ascents. They that trust in the LORD Are as mount Zion, which cannot be moved, but abideth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽרוּשָׁלַ֗͏ִם הָרִים֮ סָבִ֢יב לָ֥֫הּ וַ֭יהֹוָה סָבִ֣יב לְעַמּ֑וֹ מֵ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: yrvshl͏m hrym sbyb lh vyhvh sbyb l'mv m'th v'd'vlm
verses.translation: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, So the LORD is round about His people, From this time forth and for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֪א יָנ֡וּחַ שֵׁ֤בֶט הָרֶ֗שַׁע עַל֮ גּוֹרַ֢ל הַֽצַּדִּ֫יקִ֥ים לְמַ֡עַן לֹא־יִשְׁלְח֖וּ הַצַּדִּיקִ֨ים בְּעַוְלָ֬תָה יְדֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khy l' ynvch shbt hrsh' 'l gvrl htsdyqym lm'n l'yshlchv htsdyqym b'vlth ydyhm
verses.translation: For the rod of wickedness shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; That the righteous put not forth their hands unto iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵיטִ֣יבָה יְ֭הֹוָה לַטּוֹבִ֑ים וְ֝לִישָׁרִ֗ים בְּלִבּוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translation: Do good, O LORD, unto the good, And to them that are upright in their hearts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַמַּטִּ֤ים עֲֽקַלְקַלּוֹתָ֗ם יוֹלִיכֵ֣ם יְ֭הֹוָה אֶת־פֹּעֲלֵ֣י הָאָ֑וֶן שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translation: But as for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, The LORD will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be upon Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת בְּשׁ֣וּב יְ֭הֹוָה אֶת־שִׁיבַ֣ת צִיּ֑וֹן הָ֝יִ֗ינוּ כְּחֹלְמִֽים׃
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt bshvb yhvh 'tshybt tsyvn hyynv khchlmym
verses.translation: A Song of Ascents. When the LORD brought back those that returned to Zion, We were like unto them that dream.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֤ז יִמָּלֵ֪א שְׂח֡וֹק פִּינוּ֮ וּלְשׁוֹנֵ֢נוּ רִ֫נָּ֥ה אָ֭ז יֹאמְר֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֑ם הִגְדִּ֥יל יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עִם־אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: 'z yml' shchvq pynv vlshvnnv rnh 'z y'mrv bgvym hgdyl yhvh l'shvt 'm'lh
verses.translation: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing; then said they among the nations: 'The LORD hath done great things with these.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִגְדִּ֣יל יְ֭הֹוָה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עִמָּ֗נוּ הָיִ֥ינוּ שְׂמֵחִֽים׃
verses.translation: The LORD hath done great things with us; we are rejoiced.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה אֶת־[שְׁבִיתֵ֑נוּ] (שבותנו) כַּאֲפִיקִ֥ים בַּנֶּֽגֶב׃
verses.translation: Turn our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the dry land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַזֹּרְעִ֥ים בְּדִמְעָ֗ה בְּרִנָּ֥ה יִקְצֹֽרוּ׃
verses.translation: They that sow in tears Shall reap in joy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָ֘ל֤וֹךְ יֵלֵ֨ךְ  וּבָכֹה֮ נֹשֵׂ֢א מֶשֶׁךְ־הַ֫זָּ֥רַע בֹּא־יָבֹ֥א בְרִנָּ֑ה נֹ֝שֵׂ֗א אֲלֻמֹּתָֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hlvkh ylkh  vbkhh nsh' mshkhhzr' b'yb' brnh nsh' 'lmtyv {p}
verses.translation: Though he goeth on his way weeping that beareth the measure of seed, He shall come home with joy, bearing his sheaves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לִשְׁלֹ֫מֹ֥ה אִם־יְהֹוָ֤ה  לֹא־יִבְנֶ֬ה בַ֗יִת שָׁ֤וְא עָמְל֣וּ בוֹנָ֣יו בּ֑וֹ אִם־יְהֹוָ֥ה לֹא־יִשְׁמׇר־עִ֝֗יר שָׁ֤וְא  שָׁקַ֬ד שׁוֹמֵֽר׃
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt lshlmh 'myhvh  l'ybnh byt shv' 'mlv bvnyv bv 'myhvh l'yshmr'yr shv'  shqd shvmr
verses.translation: A Song of Ascents; of Solomon. Except the LORD build the house, They labour in vain that build it; Except the LORD keep the city, The watchman waketh but in vain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֤וְא לָכֶ֨ם מַשְׁכִּ֪ימֵֽי ק֡וּם מְאַחֲרֵי־שֶׁ֗בֶת אֹ֭כְלֵי לֶ֣חֶם הָעֲצָבִ֑ים כֵּ֤ן יִתֵּ֖ן לִידִיד֣וֹ שֵׁנָֽא׃
verses.translit: shv' lkhm mshkhymy qvm m'chryshbt 'khly lchm h'tsbym khn ytn lydydv shn'
verses.translation: It is vain for you that ye rise early, and sit up late, Ye that eat the bread of toil; So He giveth unto His beloved in sleep.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה נַחֲלַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֣ה בָּנִ֑ים שָׂ֝כָ֗ר פְּרִ֣י הַבָּֽטֶן׃
verses.translit: hnh nchlt yhvh bnym shkhr pry hbtn
verses.translation: Lo, children are a heritage of the LORD; The fruit of the womb is a reward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּחִצִּ֥ים בְּיַד־גִּבּ֑וֹר כֵּ֝֗ן בְּנֵ֣י הַנְּעוּרִֽים׃
verses.translation: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, So are the children of one's youth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֤י הַגֶּ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִלֵּ֥א אֶת־אַשְׁפָּת֗וֹ מֵ֫הֶ֥ם לֹֽא־יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ כִּֽי־יְדַבְּר֖וּ אֶת־אוֹיְבִ֣ים בַּשָּֽׁעַר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'shry hgbr 'shr ml' 't'shptv mhm l'ybshv khyydbrv 't'vybym bsh'r {p}
verses.translation: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them; They shall not be put to shame, When they speak with their enemies in the gate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אַ֭שְׁרֵי כׇּל־יְרֵ֣א יְהֹוָ֑ה הַ֝הֹלֵ֗ךְ בִּדְרָכָֽיו׃
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt 'shry khlyr' yhvh hhlkh bdrkhyv
verses.translation: A Song of Ascents. Happy is every one that feareth the LORD, That walketh in His ways.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְגִ֣יעַ כַּ֭פֶּיךָ כִּ֣י תֹאכֵ֑ל אַ֝שְׁרֶ֗יךָ וְט֣וֹב לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: ygy' khpykh khy t'khl 'shrykh vtvb lkh
verses.translation: When thou eatest the labour of thy hands, Happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶשְׁתְּךָ֤  כְּגֶ֥פֶן פֹּרִיָּה֮ בְּיַרְכְּתֵ֢י בֵ֫יתֶ֥ךָ בָּ֭נֶיךָ כִּשְׁתִלֵ֣י זֵיתִ֑ים סָ֝בִ֗יב לְשֻׁלְחָנֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: 'shtkh  khgpn pryh byrkhty bytkh bnykh khshtly zytym sbyb lshlchnkh
verses.translation: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine, in the innermost parts of thy house; Thy children like olive plants, round about thy table.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה כִי־כֵ֭ן יְבֹ֥רַךְ גָּ֗בֶר יְרֵ֣א יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: hnh khykhn ybrkh gbr yr' yhvh
verses.translation: Behold, surely thus shall the man be blessed That feareth the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְבָרֶכְךָ֥ יְהֹוָ֗ה מִצִּ֫יּ֥וֹן וּ֭רְאֵה בְּט֣וּב יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם כֹּ֝֗ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: ybrkhkh yhvh mtsyvn vr'h btvb yrvshl͏m khl ymy chyykh
verses.translation: The LORD bless thee out of Zion; And see thou the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּרְאֵֽה־בָנִ֥ים לְבָנֶ֑יךָ שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translation: And see thy children's children. Peace be upon Israel!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת רַ֭בַּת צְרָר֣וּנִי מִנְּעוּרַ֑י יֹאמַר־נָ֝֗א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt rbt tsrrvny mn'vry y'mrn' yshr'l
verses.translation: A Song of Ascents. 'Much have they afflicted me from my youth up', Let Israel now say;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֭בַּת צְרָר֣וּנִי מִנְּעוּרָ֑י גַּ֝֗ם לֹא־יָ֥כְלוּ לִֽי׃
verses.translit: rbt tsrrvny mn'vry gm l'ykhlv ly
verses.translation: 'Much have they afflicted me from my youth up; But they have not prevailed against me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־גַּ֭בִּי חָרְשׁ֣וּ חֹרְשִׁ֑ים הֶ֝אֱרִ֗יכוּ (למענותם) [לְמַעֲנִיתָֽם]׃
verses.translation: The plowers plowed upon my back; They made long their furrows.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֥ה צַדִּ֑יק קִ֝צֵּ֗ץ עֲב֣וֹת רְשָׁעִֽים׃
verses.translation: The LORD is righteous; He hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵ֭בֹשׁוּ וְיִסֹּ֣גוּ אָח֑וֹר כֹּ֝֗ל שֹׂנְאֵ֥י צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.translation: Let them be ashamed and turned backward, All they that hate Zion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֭הְיוּ כַּחֲצִ֣יר גַּגּ֑וֹת שֶׁקַּדְמַ֖ת שָׁלַ֣ף יָבֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: yhyv khchtsyr ggvt shqdmt shlf ybsh
verses.translation: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, Which withereth afore it springeth up;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֶׁלֹּ֤א מִלֵּ֖א כַפּ֥וֹ קוֹצֵ֗ר וְחִצְנ֥וֹ מְעַמֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: shl' ml' khpv qvtsr vchtsnv m'mr
verses.translation: Wherewith the reaper filleth not his hand, Nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א אָמְר֨וּ  הָעֹבְרִ֗ים בִּרְכַּֽת־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם בֵּרַ֥כְנוּ אֶ֝תְכֶ֗ם בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vl' 'mrv  h'brym brkhtyhvh 'lykhm brkhnv 'tkhm bshm yhvh {p}
verses.translation: Neither do they that go by say: ‘The blessing of the LORD be upon you; We bless you in the name of the LORD.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֑וֹת מִמַּעֲמַקִּ֖ים קְרָאתִ֣יךָ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translation: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths have I called Thee, O LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲדֹנָי֮ שִׁמְעָ֢ה בְק֫וֹלִ֥י תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה אׇ֭זְנֶיךָ קַשֻּׁב֑וֹת לְ֝ק֗וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'dny shm'h bqvly thyynh 'znykh qshbvt lqvl tchnvny
verses.translation: Lord, hearken unto my voice; let Thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־עֲוֺנ֥וֹת תִּשְׁמׇר־יָ֑הּ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י מִ֣י יַעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.translation: If Thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־עִמְּךָ֥ הַסְּלִיחָ֑ה לְ֝מַ֗עַן תִּוָּרֵֽא׃
verses.translation: For with Thee there is forgiveness, that Thou mayest be feared.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קִוִּ֣יתִי יְ֭הֹוָה קִוְּתָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י וְֽלִדְבָר֥וֹ הוֹחָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.translit: qvyty yhvh qvth npshy vldbrv hvchlty
verses.translation: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in His word do I hope.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַפְשִׁ֥י לַאדֹנָ֑י מִשֹּׁמְרִ֥ים לַ֝בֹּ֗קֶר שֹׁמְרִ֥ים לַבֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.translit: npshy l'dny mshmrym lbqr shmrym lbqr
verses.translation: My soul waiteth for the Lord, more than watchmen for the morning; yea, more than watchmen for the morning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַחֵ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל־יְ֫הֹוָ֥ה כִּֽי־עִם־יְהֹוָ֥ה הַחֶ֑סֶד וְהַרְבֵּ֖ה עִמּ֣וֹ פְדֽוּת׃
verses.translit: ychl yshr'l 'lyhvh khy'myhvh hchsd vhrbh 'mv pdvt
verses.translation: O Israel, hope in the LORD; for with the LORD there is mercy, and with Him is plenteous redemption.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭הוּא יִפְדֶּ֣ה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ֝כֹּ֗ל עֲוֺנֹתָֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translation: And He will redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְהֹוָ֤ה  לֹא־גָבַ֣הּ לִ֭בִּי וְלֹא־רָמ֣וּ עֵינַ֑י וְלֹֽא־הִלַּ֓כְתִּי  בִּגְדֹל֖וֹת וּבְנִפְלָא֣וֹת מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt ldvd yhvh  l'gbh lby vl'rmv 'yny vl'hlkhty  bgdlvt vbnpl'vt mmny
verses.translation: A Song of Ascents; of David. LORD, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty; Neither do I exercise myself in things too great, or in things too wonderful for me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־לֹ֤א שִׁוִּ֨יתִי  וְדוֹמַ֗מְתִּי נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י כְּ֭גָמֻל עֲלֵ֣י אִמּ֑וֹ כַּגָּמֻ֖ל עָלַ֣י נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: 'ml' shvyty  vdvmmty npshy khgml 'ly 'mv khgml 'ly npshy
verses.translation: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; Like a weaned child with his mother; My soul is with me like a weaned child.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַחֵ֣ל יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהֹוָ֑ה מֵ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translation: O Israel, hope in the LORD From this time forth and for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת זְכוֹר־יְהֹוָ֥ה לְדָוִ֑ד אֵ֝֗ת כׇּל־עֻנּוֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: A Song of Ascents. LORD, remember unto David All his affliction;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֭שְׁבַּע לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה נָ֝דַ֗ר לַאֲבִ֥יר יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translation: How he swore unto the LORD, And vowed unto the Mighty One of Jacob:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אָ֭בֹא בְּאֹ֣הֶל בֵּיתִ֑י אִם־אֶ֝עֱלֶ֗ה עַל־עֶ֥רֶשׂ יְצוּעָֽי׃
verses.translation: ‘Surely I will not come into the tent of my house, Nor go up into the bed that is spread for me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אֶתֵּ֣ן שְׁנַ֣ת לְעֵינָ֑י לְֽעַפְעַפַּ֥י תְּנוּמָֽה׃
verses.translation: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, Nor slumber to mine eyelids;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־אֶמְצָ֣א מָ֭קוֹם לַיהֹוָ֑ה מִ֝שְׁכָּנ֗וֹת לַאֲבִ֥יר יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translation: Until I find out a place for the LORD, A dwelling-place for the Mighty One of Jacob.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּֽה־שְׁמַעֲנ֥וּהָ בְאֶפְרָ֑תָה מְ֝צָאנ֗וּהָ בִּשְׂדֵי־יָֽעַר׃
verses.translation: Lo, we heard of it as being in Ephrath; We found it in the field of athe wood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָב֥וֹאָה לְמִשְׁכְּנוֹתָ֑יו נִ֝שְׁתַּחֲוֶ֗ה לַהֲדֹ֥ם רַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.translation: Let us go into His dwelling-place; Let us worship at His footstool. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קוּמָ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה לִמְנוּחָתֶ֑ךָ אַ֝תָּ֗ה וַאֲר֥וֹן עֻזֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Arise, O LORD, unto Thy resting-place; Thou, and the ark of Thy strength.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּהֲנֶ֥יךָ יִלְבְּשׁוּ־צֶ֑דֶק וַחֲסִידֶ֥יךָ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.translation: Let Thy priests be clothed with righteousness; And let Thy saints shout for joy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּ֭עֲבוּר דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ אַל־תָּ֝שֵׁ֗ב פְּנֵ֣י מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: For Thy servant David's sake Turn not away the face of Thine anointed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּֽע־יְהֹוָ֨ה  לְדָוִ֡ד אֱמֶת֮ לֹא־יָשׁ֢וּב מִ֫מֶּ֥נָּה מִפְּרִ֥י בִטְנְךָ֑ אָ֝שִׁ֗ית לְכִסֵּא־לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: nshb'yhvh  ldvd 'mt l'yshvb mmnh mpry btnkh 'shyt lkhs'lkh
verses.translation: The LORD swore unto David in truth; He will not turn back from it: 'Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִֽם־יִשְׁמְר֬וּ בָנֶ֨יךָ  בְּרִיתִי֮ וְעֵדֹתִ֥י ז֗וֹ אֲלַ֫מְּדֵ֥ם גַּם־בְּנֵיהֶ֥ם עֲדֵי־עַ֑ד יֵ֝שְׁב֗וּ לְכִסֵּא־לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: 'myshmrv bnykh  bryty v'dty zv 'lmdm gmbnyhm 'dy'd yshbv lkhs'lkh
verses.translation: If thy children keep My covenant And My testimony that I shall teach them, Their children also for ever shall sit upon thy throne.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־בָחַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֣ה בְּצִיּ֑וֹן אִ֝וָּ֗הּ לְמוֹשָׁ֥ב לֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; He hath desired it for His habitation:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹאת־מְנוּחָתִ֥י עֲדֵי־עַ֑ד פֹּה־אֵ֝שֵׁ֗ב כִּ֣י אִוִּתִֽיהָ׃
verses.translation: 'This is My resting-place for ever; Here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צֵ֭ידָהּ בָּרֵ֣ךְ אֲבָרֵ֑ךְ אֶ֝בְיוֹנֶ֗יהָ אַשְׂבִּ֥יעַֽ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.translation: I will abundantly bless her provision; I will give her needy bread in plenty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽ֭כֹהֲנֶיהָ אַלְבִּ֣ישׁ יֶ֑שַׁע וַ֝חֲסִידֶ֗יהָ רַנֵּ֥ן יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.translation: Her priests also will I clothe with salvation; And her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֤ם אַצְמִ֣יחַ קֶ֣רֶן לְדָוִ֑ד עָרַ֥כְתִּי נֵ֝֗ר לִמְשִׁיחִֽי׃
verses.translation: There will I make a horn to shoot up unto David, There have I ordered a lamp for Mine anointed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֭וֹיְבָיו אַלְבִּ֣ישׁ בֹּ֑שֶׁת וְ֝עָלָ֗יו יָצִ֥יץ נִזְרֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: His enemies will I clothe with shame; But upon himself shall his crown shine.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הִנֵּ֣ה מַה־טּ֭וֹב וּמַה־נָּעִ֑ים שֶׁ֖בֶת אַחִ֣ים גַּם־יָֽחַד׃
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt ldvd hnh mhtvb vmhn'ym shbt 'chym gmychd
verses.translation: A Song of Ascents; of David. Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brethren to dwell together in unity!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּשֶּׁ֤מֶן הַטּ֨וֹב  עַל־הָרֹ֗אשׁ יֹרֵ֗ד עַֽל־הַזָּקָ֥ן זְקַֽן־אַהֲרֹ֑ן שֶׁ֝יֹּרֵ֗ד עַל־פִּ֥י מִדּוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: khshmn htvb  'lhr'sh yrd 'lhzqn zqn'hrn shyrd 'lpy mdvtyv
verses.translation: It is like the precious oil upon the head, Coming down upon the beard; Even Aaron's beard, That cometh down upon the collar of his garments;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּטַל־חֶרְמ֗וֹן שֶׁיֹּרֵד֮ עַל־הַרְרֵ֢י צִ֫יּ֥וֹן כִּ֤י שָׁ֨ם  צִוָּ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה אֶת־הַבְּרָכָ֑ה חַ֝יִּ֗ים עַד־הָעוֹלָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khtlchrmvn shyrd 'lhrry tsyvn khy shm  tsvh yhvh 'thbrkhh chyym 'dh'vlm {p}
verses.translation: Like the dew of Hermon, That cometh down upon the mountains of Zion; For there the LORD commanded the blessing, Even life for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת הִנֵּ֤ה  בָּרְכ֣וּ אֶת־יְ֭הֹוָה כׇּל־עַבְדֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה הָעֹמְדִ֥ים בְּבֵית־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה בַּלֵּילֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt hnh  brkhv 'tyhvh khl'bdy yhvh h'mdym bbytyhvh blylvt
verses.translation: A Song of Ascents. Behold, bless ye the LORD, all ye servants of the LORD, That stand in the house of the LORD in the night seasons.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂאֽוּ־יְדֵכֶ֥ם קֹ֑דֶשׁ וּ֝בָרְכ֗וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translation: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary, And bless ye the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְבָרֶכְךָ֣ יְ֭הֹוָה מִצִּיּ֑וֹן עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: The LORD bless thee out of Zion; Even He that made heaven and earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ־יָ֨הּ  הַֽ֭לְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה הַֽ֝לְל֗וּ עַבְדֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translation: Hallelujah. Praise ye the name of the LORD; Give praise, O ye servants of the LORD,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֶׁ֣֭עֹמְדִים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה בְּ֝חַצְר֗וֹת בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translation: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD, In the courts of the house of our God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽלְלוּ־יָ֭הּ כִּֽי־ט֣וֹב יְהֹוָ֑ה זַמְּר֥וּ לִ֝שְׁמ֗וֹ כִּ֣י נָעִֽים׃
verses.translit: hllvyh khytvb yhvh zmrv lshmv khy n'ym
verses.translation: Praise ye the LORD, for the LORD is good; Sing praises unto His name, for it is pleasant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יַעֲקֹ֗ב בָּחַ֣ר ל֣וֹ יָ֑הּ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִסְגֻלָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khyy'qb bchr lv yh yshr'l lsgltv
verses.translation: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto Himself, And Israel for His own treasure.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֲנִ֣י יָ֭דַעְתִּי כִּֽי־גָד֣וֹל יְהֹוָ֑ה וַ֝אֲדֹנֵ֗ינוּ מִכׇּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy 'ny yd'ty khygdvl yhvh v'dnynv mkhl'lhym
verses.translation: For I know that the LORD is great, And that our Lord is above all gods.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־חָפֵ֥ץ יְהֹוָ֗ה עָ֫שָׂ֥ה בַּשָּׁמַ֥יִם וּבָאָ֑רֶץ בַּ֝יַּמִּ֗ים וְכׇל־תְּהֹמֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: khl 'shrchpts yhvh 'shh bshmym vb'rts bymym vkhlthmvt
verses.translation: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that hath He done, In heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַעֲלֶ֣ה נְשִׂאִים֮ מִקְצֵ֢ה הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ בְּרָקִ֣ים לַמָּטָ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה מֽוֹצֵא־ר֝֗וּחַ מֵאֽוֹצְרוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: m'lh nsh'ym mqtsh h'rts brqym lmtr 'shh mvts'rvch m'vtsrvtyv
verses.translation: Who causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; He maketh lightnings for the rain; He bringeth forth the wind out of His treasuries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֶׁ֭הִכָּה בְּכוֹרֵ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם מֵ֝אָדָ֗ם עַד־בְּהֵמָֽה׃
verses.translation: Who smote the first-born of Egypt, Both of man and beast.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁלַ֤ח  אוֹתֹ֣ת וּ֭מֹפְתִים בְּתוֹכֵ֣כִי מִצְרָ֑יִם בְּ֝פַרְעֹ֗ה וּבְכׇל־עֲבָדָֽיו׃
verses.translit: shlch  'vtt vmptym btvkhkhy mtsrym bpr'h vbkhl'bdyv
verses.translation: He sent signs and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, Upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֶׁ֭הִכָּה גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝הָרַ֗ג מְלָכִ֥ים עֲצוּמִֽים׃
verses.translation: Who smote many nations, And slew mighty kings:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְסִיח֤וֹן  מֶ֤לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֗י וּ֭לְעוֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֑ן וּ֝לְכֹ֗ל מַמְלְכ֥וֹת כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.translit: lsychvn  mlkh h'mry vl'vg mlkh hbshn vlkhl mmlkhvt khn'n
verses.translation: Sihon king of the Amorites, And Og king of Bashan, And all the kingdoms of Canaan;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַ֣ן אַרְצָ֣ם נַחֲלָ֑ה נַ֝חֲלָ֗ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: And gave their land for a heritage, A heritage unto Israel His people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְ֭הֹוָה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְעוֹלָ֑ם יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה זִכְרְךָ֥ לְדֹר־וָדֹֽר׃
verses.translit: yhvh shmkh l'vlm yhvh zkhrkh ldrvdr
verses.translation: O LORD, Thy name endureth for ever; Thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יָדִ֣ין יְהֹוָ֣ה עַמּ֑וֹ וְעַל־עֲ֝בָדָ֗יו יִתְנֶחָֽם׃
verses.translation: For the LORD will judge His people, And repent Himself for His servants.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲצַבֵּ֣י הַ֭גּוֹיִם כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃
verses.translation: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, The work of men's hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּֽה־לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ עֵינַ֥יִם לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֽוּ׃
verses.translit: phlhm vl' ydbrv 'ynym lhm vl' yr'v
verses.translation: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אׇזְנַ֣יִם לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יַאֲזִ֑ינוּ אַ֝֗ף אֵין־יֶשׁ־ר֥וּחַ בְּפִיהֶֽם׃
verses.translation: They have ears, but they hear not; Neither is there any breath in their mouths.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּ֭מוֹהֶם יִהְי֣וּ עֹשֵׂיהֶ֑ם כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־בֹּטֵ֣חַ בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translation: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל בָּרְכ֣וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֑ה בֵּ֥ית אַ֝הֲרֹ֗ן בָּרְכ֥וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translation: O house of Israel, bless ye the LORD; O house of Aaron, bless ye the LORD;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית הַ֭לֵּוִי בָּרְכ֣וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֑ה יִֽרְאֵ֥י יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה בָּרְכ֥וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: byt hlvy brkhv 'tyhvh yr'y yhvh brkhv 'tyhvh
verses.translation: O house of Levi, bless ye the LORD; Ye that fear the LORD, bless ye the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּ֘ר֤וּךְ יְהֹוָ֨ה  מִצִּיּ֗וֹן שֹׁ֘כֵ֤ן יְֽרוּשָׁלָ֗͏ִם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: brvkh yhvh  mtsyvn shkhn yrvshl͏m hllvyh {p}
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, Who dwelleth at Jerusalem. Hallelujah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hvdv lyhvh khytvb khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: O give thanks unto the LORD, for He is good, For His mercy endureth for ever. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֭וֹדוּ לֵאלֹהֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hvdv l'lhy h'lhym khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: O give thanks unto the God of gods, For His mercy endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֭וֹדוּ לַאֲדֹנֵ֣י הָאֲדֹנִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hvdv l'dny h'dnym khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: O give thanks unto the Lord of lords, For His mercy endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְעֹ֘שֵׂ֤ה נִפְלָא֣וֹת גְּדֹל֣וֹת לְבַדּ֑וֹ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: l'shh npl'vt gdlvt lbdv khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: To Him who alone doeth great wonders, For His mercy endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְעֹשֵׂ֣ה הַ֭שָּׁמַיִם בִּתְבוּנָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: l'shh hshmym btbvnh khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: To Him that by understanding made the heavens, for His mercy endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְרֹקַ֣ע הָ֭אָרֶץ עַל־הַמָּ֑יִם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: To Him that spread forth the earth above the waters, For His mercy endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֭עֹשֵׂה אוֹרִ֣ים גְּדֹלִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: To Him that made great lights, For His mercy endureth for ever;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־הַ֭שֶּׁמֶשׁ לְמֶמְשֶׁ֣לֶת בַּיּ֑וֹם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: The sun to rule by day, For His mercy endureth for ever;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־הַיָּרֵ֣חַ וְ֭כוֹכָבִים לְמֶמְשְׁל֣וֹת בַּלָּ֑יְלָה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'thyrch vkhvkhbym lmmshlvt blylh khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: The moon and stars to rule by night, For His mercy endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַכֵּ֣ה מִ֭צְרַיִם בִּבְכוֹרֵיהֶ֑ם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: lmkhh mtsrym bbkhvryhm khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: To Him that smote Egypt in their first-born, For His mercy endureth for ever;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּוֹצֵ֣א יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל מִתּוֹכָ֑ם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyvts' yshr'l mtvkhm khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: And brought out Israel from among them, For His mercy endureth for ever;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּיָ֣ד חֲ֭זָקָה וּבִזְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: byd chzqh vbzrv' ntvyh khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: With a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, For His mercy endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְגֹזֵ֣ר יַם־ס֭וּף לִגְזָרִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: lgzr ymsvf lgzrym khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: To Him who divided the Red Sea in sunder, For His mercy endureth for ever;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֶעֱבִ֣יר יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל בְּתוֹכ֑וֹ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vh'byr yshr'l btvkhv khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it, For His mercy endureth for ever;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִ֘עֵ֤ר פַּרְעֹ֣ה וְחֵיל֣וֹ בְיַם־ס֑וּף כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vn'r pr'h vchylv bymsvf khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red Sea, For His mercy endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמוֹלִ֣יךְ עַ֭מּוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: To Him that led His people through the wilderness, For His mercy endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֭מַכֵּה מְלָכִ֣ים גְּדֹלִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: lmkhh mlkhym gdlym khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: To Him that smote great kings; For His mercy endureth for ever;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽ֭יַּהֲרֹג מְלָכִ֣ים אַדִּירִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: And slew mighty kings, For His mercy endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֭סִיחוֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֑י כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: lsychvn mlkh h'mry khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: Sihon king of the Amorites, For His mercy endureth for ever;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּ֭לְעוֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֑ן כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vl'vg mlkh hbshn khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: And Og king of Bashan, For His mercy endureth for ever;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַ֣ן אַרְצָ֣ם לְנַחֲלָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: And gave their land for a heritage, For His mercy endureth for ever;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַ֭חֲלָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עַבְדּ֑וֹ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: Even a heritage unto Israel His servant, For His mercy endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֶׁ֭בְּשִׁפְלֵנוּ זָ֣כַר לָ֑נוּ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: shbshplnv zkhr lnv khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: Who remembered us in our low estate, For His mercy endureth for ever;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפְרְקֵ֥נוּ מִצָּרֵ֑ינוּ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: And hath delivered us from our adversaries, For His mercy endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֹתֵ֣ן לֶ֭חֶם לְכׇל־בָּשָׂ֑ר כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: ntn lchm lkhlbshr khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: Who giveth food to all flesh, For His mercy endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֭וֹדוּ לְאֵ֣ל הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hvdv l'l hshmym khy l'vlm chsdv {p}
verses.translation: O give thanks unto the God of heaven, For His mercy endureth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֥ל־נַהֲר֨וֹת  בָּבֶ֗ל שָׁ֣ם יָ֭שַׁבְנוּ גַּם־בָּכִ֑ינוּ בְּ֝זׇכְרֵ֗נוּ אֶת־צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.translation: By the rivers of Babylon, There we sat down, yea, we wept, When we remembered Zion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַֽל־עֲרָבִ֥ים בְּתוֹכָ֑הּ תָּ֝לִ֗ינוּ כִּנֹּרוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translation: Upon the willows in the midst thereof We hanged up our harps.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י שָׁ֨ם שְֽׁאֵל֪וּנוּ שׁוֹבֵ֡ינוּ דִּבְרֵי־שִׁ֭יר וְתוֹלָלֵ֣ינוּ שִׂמְחָ֑ה שִׁ֥ירוּ לָ֝֗נוּ מִשִּׁ֥יר צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: khy shm sh'lvnv shvbynv dbryshyr vtvllynv shmchh shyrv lnv mshyr tsyvn
verses.translation: For there they that led us captive asked of us words of song, And our tormentors asked of us mirth: ‘Sing us one of the songs of Zion.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֗יךְ נָשִׁ֥יר אֶת־שִׁיר־יְהֹוָ֑ה עַ֝֗ל אַדְמַ֥ת נֵכָֽר׃
verses.translation: How shall we sing the LORD’S song In a foreign land?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִֽם־אֶשְׁכָּחֵ֥ךְ יְֽרוּשָׁלָ֗͏ִם תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח יְמִינִֽי׃
verses.translation: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, Let my right hand forget her cunning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּדְבַּֽק־לְשׁוֹנִ֨י  לְחִכִּי֮ אִם־לֹ֢א אֶ֫זְכְּרֵ֥כִי אִם־לֹ֣א אַ֭עֲלֶה אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ֑͏ִם עַ֝֗ל רֹ֣אשׁ שִׂמְחָתִֽי׃
verses.translation: Let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth, If I remember thee not; If I set not Jerusalem Above my chiefest joy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְכֹ֤ר יְהֹוָ֨ה  לִבְנֵ֬י אֱד֗וֹם אֵת֮ י֤וֹם יְֽר֫וּשָׁלָ֥͏ִם הָ֭אֹ֣מְרִים עָ֤רוּ  עָ֑רוּ עַ֝֗ד הַיְס֥וֹד בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: zkhr yhvh  lbny 'dvm 't yvm yrvshl͏m h'mrym 'rv  'rv 'd hysvd bh
verses.translation: Remember, O LORD, against the children of Edom The day of Jerusalem; Who said: 'Rase it, rase it, Even to the foundation thereof.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּת־בָּבֶ֗ל הַשְּׁד֫וּדָ֥ה אַשְׁרֵ֥י שֶׁיְשַׁלֶּם־לָ֑ךְ אֶת־גְּ֝מוּלֵ֗ךְ שֶׁגָּמַ֥לְתְּ לָֽנוּ׃
verses.translation: O daughter of Babylon, that art to be destroyed; Happy shall he be, that repayeth thee As thou hast served us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֤י  שֶׁיֹּאחֵ֓ז וְנִפֵּ֬ץ אֶֽת־עֹלָלַ֗יִךְ אֶל־הַסָּֽלַע׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones Against the rock.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְדָוִ֨ד  אוֹדְךָ֥ בְכׇל־לִבִּ֑י נֶ֖גֶד אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲזַמְּרֶֽךָּ׃
verses.translation: [A Psalm] of David. I will give Thee thanks with my whole heart, In the presence of the mighty will I sing praises unto Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֨ה אֶל־הֵיכַ֪ל קׇדְשְׁךָ֡ וְא֘וֹדֶ֤ה אֶת־שְׁמֶ֗ךָ עַל־חַסְדְּךָ֥ וְעַל־אֲמִתֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־הִגְדַּ֥לְתָּ עַל־כׇּל־שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ אִמְרָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: I will bow down toward Thy holy temple, And give thanks unto Thy name for Thy mercy and for Thy truth; For Thou hast magnified Thy word above all Thy name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּי֣וֹם קָ֭רָֽאתִי וַֽתַּעֲנֵ֑נִי תַּרְהִבֵ֖נִי בְנַפְשִׁ֣י עֹֽז׃
verses.translation: In the day that I called, Thou didst answer me; Thou didst encourage me in my soul with strength.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּךָ יְ֭הֹוָה כׇּל־מַלְכֵי־אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ אִמְרֵי־פִֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: All the kings of the earth shall give Thee thanks, O LORD, For they have heard the words of Thy mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭יָשִׁירוּ בְּדַרְכֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּֽי־גָ֝ד֗וֹל כְּב֣וֹד יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyshyrv bdrkhy yhvh khygdvl khbvd yhvh
verses.translation: Yea, they shall sing of the ways of the LORD; For great is the glory of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־רָ֣ם יְ֭הֹוָה וְשָׁפָ֣ל יִרְאֶ֑ה וְ֝גָבֹ֗הַּ מִמֶּרְחָ֥ק יְיֵדָֽע׃
verses.translit: khyrm yhvh vshpl yr'h vgbh mmrchq yyd'
verses.translation: For though the LORD be high, yet regardeth He the lowly, And the haughty He knoweth from afar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אֵלֵ֤ךְ  בְּקֶ֥רֶב צָרָ֗ה תְּחַ֫יֵּ֥נִי עַ֤ל אַ֣ף אֹ֭יְבַי תִּשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֑ךָ וְת֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: 'm'lkh  bqrb tsrh tchyny 'l 'f 'yby tshlch ydkh vtvshy'ny ymynkh
verses.translation: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, Thou quickenest me; Thou stretchest forth Thy hand against the wrath of mine enemies, And Thy right hand doth save me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָה֮ יִגְמֹ֢ר בַּ֫עֲדִ֥י יְ֭הֹוָה חַסְדְּךָ֣ לְעוֹלָ֑ם מַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ אַל־תֶּֽרֶף׃ {פ}
verses.translit: yhvh ygmr b'dy yhvh chsdkh l'vlm m'shy ydykh 'ltrf {p}
verses.translation: The LORD will accomplish that which concerneth me; Thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever; Forsake not the work of Thine own hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִ֣ד מִזְמ֑וֹר יְהֹוָ֥ה חֲ֝קַרְתַּ֗נִי וַתֵּדָֽע׃
verses.translit: lmntsch ldvd mzmvr yhvh chqrtny vtd'
verses.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David. O LORD, Thou hast searched me, and known me. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה יָ֭דַעְתָּ שִׁבְתִּ֣י וְקוּמִ֑י בַּ֥נְתָּה לְ֝רֵעִ֗י מֵרָחֽוֹק׃
verses.translit: 'th yd't shbty vqvmy bnth lr'y mrchvq
verses.translation: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, Thou understandest my thought afar off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אׇרְחִ֣י וְרִבְעִ֣י זֵרִ֑יתָ וְֽכׇל־דְּרָכַ֥י הִסְכַּֽנְתָּה׃
verses.translation: Thou measurest my going about and my lying down, And art acquainted with all my ways.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין מִ֭לָּה בִּלְשׁוֹנִ֑י הֵ֥ן יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה יָדַ֥עְתָּ כֻלָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: khy 'yn mlh blshvny hn yhvh yd't khlh
verses.translation: For there is not a word in my tongue, But, lo, O LORD, Thou knowest it altogether.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָח֣וֹר וָקֶ֣דֶם צַרְתָּ֑נִי וַתָּ֖שֶׁת עָלַ֣י כַּפֶּֽכָה׃
verses.translation: Thou hast hemmed me in behind and before, And laid Thy hand upon me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (פלאיה) [פְּלִ֣יאָֽה] דַ֣עַת מִמֶּ֑נִּי נִ֝שְׂגְּבָ֗ה לֹא־א֥וּכַֽל לָֽהּ׃
verses.translation: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; Too high, I cannot attain unto it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֭נָֽה אֵלֵ֣ךְ מֵרוּחֶ֑ךָ וְ֝אָ֗נָה מִפָּנֶ֥יךָ אֶבְרָֽח׃
verses.translation: Whither shall I go from Thy spirit? Or whither shall I flee from Thy presence?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־אֶסַּ֣ק שָׁ֭מַיִם שָׁ֣ם אָ֑תָּה וְאַצִּ֖יעָה שְּׁא֣וֹל הִנֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.translation: If I ascend up into heaven, Thou art there; If I make my bed in the nether-world, behold, Thou art there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶשָּׂ֥א כַנְפֵי־שָׁ֑חַר אֶ֝שְׁכְּנָ֗ה בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית יָֽם׃
verses.translation: If I take the wings of the morning, And dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־שָׁ֭ם יָדְךָ֣ תַנְחֵ֑נִי וְֽתֹאחֲזֵ֥נִי יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Even there would Thy hand lead me, And Thy right hand would hold me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָ֭אֹמַר אַךְ־חֹ֣שֶׁךְ יְשׁוּפֵ֑נִי וְ֝לַ֗יְלָה א֣וֹר בַּעֲדֵֽנִי׃
verses.translation: And if I say: ‘Surely the darkness shall envelop me, And the light about me shall be night';
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־חֹשֶׁךְ֮ לֹא־יַחְשִׁ֢יךְ מִ֫מֶּ֥ךָּ וְ֭לַיְלָה כַּיּ֣וֹם יָאִ֑יר כַּ֝חֲשֵׁיכָ֗ה כָּאוֹרָֽה׃
verses.translit: gmchshkh l'ychshykh mmkh vlylh khyvm y'yr khchshykhh kh'vrh
verses.translation: Even the darkness is not too dark for Thee, But the night shineth as the day; The darkness is even as the light.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה קָנִ֣יתָ כִלְיֹתָ֑י תְּ֝סֻכֵּ֗נִי בְּבֶ֣טֶן אִמִּֽי׃
verses.translation: For Thou hast made my reins; Thou hast knit me together in my mother's womb.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוֹדְךָ֗ עַ֤ל כִּ֥י נוֹרָא֗וֹת נִ֫פְלֵ֥יתִי נִפְלָאִ֥ים מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י יֹדַ֥עַת מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: 'vdkh 'l khy nvr'vt nplyty npl'ym m'shykh vnpshy yd't m'd
verses.translation: I will give thanks unto Thee, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made; Wonderful are Thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־נִכְחַ֥ד עׇצְמִ֗י מִ֫מֶּ֥ךָּ אֲשֶׁר־עֻשֵּׂ֥יתִי בַסֵּ֑תֶר רֻ֝קַּ֗מְתִּי בְּֽתַחְתִּיּ֥וֹת אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translation: My frame was not hidden from Thee, When I was made in secret, And curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גׇּלְמִ֤י  רָ֘א֤וּ עֵינֶ֗יךָ וְעַֽל־סִפְרְךָ֮ כֻּלָּ֢ם יִכָּ֫תֵ֥בוּ יָמִ֥ים יֻצָּ֑רוּ (ולא) [וְל֖וֹ] אֶחָ֣ד בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: glmy  r'v 'ynykh v'lsprkh khlm ykhtbv ymym ytsrv (vl') [vlv] 'chd bhm
verses.translation: Thine eyes did see mine unformed substance, And in Thy book they were all written— Even the days that were fashioned, When as yet there was none of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִ֗י מַה־יָּקְר֣וּ רֵעֶ֣יךָ אֵ֑ל מֶ֥ה עָ֝צְמ֗וּ רָאשֵׁיהֶֽם׃
verses.translation: How weighty also are Thy thoughts unto me, O God! How great is the sum of them!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֭סְפְּרֵם מֵח֣וֹל יִרְבּ֑וּן הֱ֝קִיצֹ֗תִי וְעוֹדִ֥י עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.translation: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand; Were I to come to the end of them, I would still be with Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־תִּקְטֹ֖ל אֱל֥וֹהַּ ׀ רָשָׁ֑ע וְאַנְשֵׁ֥י דָ֝מִ֗ים ס֣וּרוּ מֶֽנִּי׃
verses.translation: If Thou but wouldest slay the wicked, O God— Depart from me therefore, ye men of blood;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֹ֭מְרוּךָ לִמְזִמָּ֑ה נָשׂ֖וּא לַשָּׁ֣וְא עָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: Who utter Thy name with wicked thought, They take it for falsehood, even Thine enemies— .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֽוֹא־מְשַׂנְאֶ֖יךָ יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ אֶשְׂנָ֑א וּ֝בִתְקוֹמְמֶ֗יךָ אֶתְקוֹטָֽט׃
verses.translation: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate Thee? And do not I strive with those that rise up against Thee?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּכְלִ֣ית שִׂנְאָ֣ה שְׂנֵאתִ֑ים לְ֝אוֹיְבִ֗ים הָ֣יוּ לִֽי׃
verses.translit: tkhlyt shn'h shn'tym l'vybym hyv ly
verses.translation: I hate them with utmost hatred; I count them mine enemies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חׇקְרֵ֣נִי אֵ֭ל וְדַ֣ע לְבָבִ֑י בְּ֝חָנֵ֗נִי וְדַ֣ע שַׂרְעַפָּֽי׃
verses.translit: chqrny 'l vd' lbby bchnny vd' shr'py
verses.translation: Search me, O God, and know my heart, Try me, and know my thoughts;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּרְאֵ֗ה אִם־דֶּֽרֶךְ־עֹ֥צֶב בִּ֑י וּ֝נְחֵ֗נִי בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ עוֹלָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translation: And see if there be any way in me that is grievous, And lead me in the way everlasting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַלְּצֵ֣נִי יְ֭הֹוָה מֵאָדָ֣ם רָ֑ע מֵאִ֖ישׁ חֲמָסִ֣ים תִּנְצְרֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: chltsny yhvh m'dm r' m'ysh chmsym tntsrny
verses.translation: Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man; Preserve me from the violent man;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָשְׁב֣וּ רָע֣וֹת בְּלֵ֑ב כׇּל־י֝֗וֹם יָג֥וּרוּ מִלְחָמֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: 'shr chshbv r'vt blb khlyvm ygvrv mlchmvt
verses.translation: Who devise evil things in their heart; Every day do they stir up wars.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֥נְנ֣וּ לְשׁוֹנָם֮ כְּֽמוֹ־נָ֫חָ֥שׁ חֲמַ֥ת עַכְשׁ֑וּב תַּ֖חַת שְׂפָתֵ֣ימוֹ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: shnnv lshvnm khmvnchsh chmt 'khshvb tcht shptymv slh
verses.translation: They have sharpened their tongue like a serpent; Vipers' venom is under their lips. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׇׁמְרֵ֤נִי יְהֹוָ֨ה  מִ֘ידֵ֤י רָשָׁ֗ע מֵאִ֣ישׁ חֲמָסִ֣ים תִּנְצְרֵ֑נִי אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָ֝שְׁב֗וּ לִדְח֥וֹת פְּעָמָֽי׃
verses.translit: shmrny yhvh  mydy rsh' m'ysh chmsym tntsrny 'shr chshbv ldchvt p'my
verses.translation: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; Preserve me from the violent man; Who have purposed to make my steps slip.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טָ֥מְנֽוּ־גֵאִ֨ים  פַּ֡ח לִ֗י וַחֲבָלִ֗ים פָּ֣רְשׂוּ רֶ֭שֶׁת לְיַד־מַעְגָּ֑ל מֹקְשִׁ֖ים שָׁתוּ־לִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: tmnvg'ym  pch ly vchblym prshv rsht lydm'gl mqshym shtvly slh
verses.translation: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; They have spread a net by the wayside; They have set gins for me. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמַ֣רְתִּי לַ֭יהֹוָה אֵ֣לִי אָ֑תָּה הַאֲזִ֥ינָה יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה ק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃
verses.translation: I have said unto the LORD: 'Thou art my God'; Give ear, O LORD, unto the voice of my supplications.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֱהֹוִ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי עֹ֣ז יְשׁוּעָתִ֑י סַכֹּ֥תָה לְ֝רֹאשִׁ֗י בְּי֣וֹם נָֽשֶׁק׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'dny 'z yshv'ty skhth lr'shy byvm nshq
verses.translation: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, Who hast screened my head in the day of battle,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּתֵּ֣ן יְ֭הֹוָה מַאֲוַיֵּ֣י רָשָׁ֑ע זְמָמ֥וֹ אַל־תָּ֝פֵ֗ק יָר֥וּמוּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: 'lttn yhvh m'vyy rsh' zmmv 'ltpq yrvmv slh
verses.translation: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; Further not his evil device, so that they exalt themselves. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֹ֥אשׁ מְסִבָּ֑י עֲמַ֖ל שְׂפָתֵ֣ימוֹ (יכסומו) [יְכַסֵּֽימוֹ]׃
verses.translation: As for the head of those that compass me about, Let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (ימיטו) [יִמּ֥וֹטוּ] עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם גֶּחָ֫לִ֥ים בָּאֵ֥שׁ יַפִּלֵ֑ם בְּ֝מַהֲמֹר֗וֹת בַּל־יָקֽוּמוּ׃
verses.translation: Let burning coals fall upon them; Let them be cast into the fire, Into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֥ישׁ לָשׁוֹן֮ בַּל־יִכּ֢וֹן בָּ֫אָ֥רֶץ אִישׁ־חָמָ֥ס רָ֑ע יְ֝צוּדֶ֗נּוּ לְמַדְחֵפֹֽת׃
verses.translit: 'ysh lshvn blykhvn b'rts 'yshchms r' ytsvdnv lmdchpt
verses.translation: A slanderer shall not be established in the earth; The violent and evil man shall be hunted with thrust upon thrust.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (ידעת) [יָדַ֗עְתִּי] כִּֽי־יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה דִּ֣ין עָנִ֑י מִ֝שְׁפַּ֗ט אֶבְיֹנִֽים׃
verses.translation: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the poor, And the right of the needy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ צַ֭דִּיקִים יוֹד֣וּ לִשְׁמֶ֑ךָ יֵשְׁב֥וּ יְ֝שָׁרִ֗ים אֶת־פָּנֶֽיךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto Thy name; The upright shall dwell in Thy presence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְהֹוָ֣ה קְ֭רָאתִיךָ ח֣וּשָׁה לִּ֑י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה ק֝וֹלִ֗י בְּקׇרְאִי־לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: mzmvr ldvd yhvh qr'tykh chvshh ly h'zynh qvly bqr'ylkh
verses.translation: A Psalm of David. LORD, I have called Thee; make haste unto me; Give ear unto my voice, when I call unto Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּכּ֤וֹן תְּפִלָּתִ֣י קְטֹ֣רֶת לְפָנֶ֑יךָ מַֽשְׂאַ֥ת כַּ֝פַּ֗י מִנְחַת־עָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: tkhvn tplty qtrt lpnykh msh't khpy mncht'rb
verses.translation: Let my prayer be set forth as incense before Thee, The lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁיתָ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה שׇׁמְרָ֣ה לְפִ֑י נִ֝צְּרָ֗ה עַל־דַּ֥ל שְׂפָתָֽי׃
verses.translit: shyth yhvh shmrh lpy ntsrh 'ldl shpty
verses.translation: Set a guard, O LORD, to my mouth; Keep watch at the door of my lips.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תַּט־לִבִּ֨י לְדָבָ֪ר ׀ רָ֡ע לְהִתְע֘וֹלֵ֤ל עֲלִל֨וֹת  בְּרֶ֗שַׁע אֶת־אִישִׁ֥ים פֹּעֲלֵי־אָ֑וֶן וּבַל־אֶ֝לְחַ֗ם בְּמַנְעַמֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lttlby ldbr  r' lht'vll 'llvt  brsh' 't'yshym p'ly'vn vbl'lchm bmn'myhm
verses.translation: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, To be occupied in deeds of wickedness With men that work iniquity; And let me not eat of their dainties.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֶ֥הֶלְמֵֽנִי־צַדִּ֨יק  חֶ֡סֶד וְֽיוֹכִיחֵ֗נִי שֶׁ֣מֶן רֹ֭אשׁ אַל־יָנִ֣י רֹאשִׁ֑י כִּי־ע֥וֹד וּ֝תְפִלָּתִ֗י בְּרָעוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: yhlmnytsdyq  chsd vyvkhychny shmn r'sh 'lyny r'shy khy'vd vtplty br'vtyhm
verses.translation: Let the righteous smite me in kindness, and correct me; Oil so choice let not my head refuse; For still is my prayer because of their wickedness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִשְׁמְט֣וּ בִֽידֵי־סֶ֭לַע שֹׁפְטֵיהֶ֑ם וְשָׁמְע֥וּ אֲ֝מָרַ֗י כִּ֣י נָעֵֽמוּ׃
verses.translit: nshmtv bydysl' shptyhm vshm'v 'mry khy n'mv
verses.translation: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock; And they shall hear my words, that they are sweet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּמ֤וֹ פֹלֵ֣חַ וּבֹקֵ֣עַ בָּאָ֑רֶץ נִפְזְר֥וּ עֲ֝צָמֵ֗ינוּ לְפִ֣י שְׁאֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: khmv plch vbq' b'rts npzrv 'tsmynv lpy sh'vl
verses.translation: As when one cleaveth and breaketh up the earth, Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵלֶ֨יךָ  יֱהֹוִ֣ה אֲדֹנָ֣י עֵינָ֑י בְּכָ֥ה חָ֝סִ֗יתִי אַל־תְּעַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translation: For mine eyes are unto Thee, O GOD the Lord; In Thee have I taken refuge, O pour not out my soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׇׁמְרֵ֗נִי מִ֣ידֵי פַ֭ח יָ֣קְשׁוּ לִ֑י וּ֝מֹקְשׁ֗וֹת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.translit: shmrny mydy pch yqshv ly vmqshvt p'ly 'vn
verses.translation: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, And from the gins of the workers of iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִפְּל֣וּ בְמַכְמֹרָ֣יו רְשָׁעִ֑ים יַ֥חַד אָ֝נֹכִ֗י עַֽד־אֶעֱבֽוֹר׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, Whilst I withal escape.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִ֑ד בִּֽהְיוֹת֖וֹ בַמְּעָרָ֣ה תְפִלָּֽה׃
verses.translation: Maschil of David, when he was in the cave; a Prayer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֭וֹלִי אֶל־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֶזְעָ֑ק ק֝וֹלִ֗י אֶל־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֶתְחַנָּֽן׃
verses.translation: With my voice I cry unto the LORD; With my voice I make supplication unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶשְׁפֹּ֣ךְ לְפָנָ֣יו שִׂיחִ֑י צָ֝רָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֥יו אַגִּֽיד׃
verses.translation: I pour out my complaint before Him, I declare before Him my trouble;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּהִתְעַטֵּ֬ף עָלַ֨י  רוּחִ֗י וְאַתָּה֮ יָדַ֢עְתָּ נְֽתִיבָ֫תִ֥י בְּאֹֽרַח־ז֥וּ אֲהַלֵּ֑ךְ טָמְנ֖וּ פַ֣ח לִֽי׃
verses.translit: bht'tf 'ly  rvchy v'th yd't ntybty b'rchzv 'hlkh tmnv pch ly
verses.translation: When my spirit fainteth within me— Thou knowest my path— In the way wherein I walk Have they hidden a snare for me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַבֵּ֤יט יָמִ֨ין  וּרְאֵה֮ וְאֵֽין־לִ֢י מַ֫כִּ֥יר אָבַ֣ד מָנ֣וֹס מִמֶּ֑נִּי אֵ֖ין דּוֹרֵ֣שׁ לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: hbyt ymyn  vr'h v'ynly mkhyr 'bd mnvs mmny 'yn dvrsh lnpshy
verses.translation: Look on my right hand, and see, For there is no man that knoweth me; I have no way to flee; No man careth for my soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זָעַ֥קְתִּי אֵלֶ֗יךָ יְ֫הֹוָ֥ה אָ֭מַרְתִּי אַתָּ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י חֶ֝לְקִ֗י בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַחַיִּֽים׃
verses.translit: z'qty 'lykh yhvh 'mrty 'th mchsy chlqy b'rts hchyym
verses.translation: I have cried unto Thee, O LORD; I have said: 'Thou art my refuge, My portion in the land of the living.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַקְשִׁ֤יבָה  אֶֽל־רִנָּתִי֮ כִּֽי־דַלּ֢וֹתִ֫י מְאֹ֥ד הַצִּילֵ֥נִי מֵרֹדְפַ֑י כִּ֖י אָמְצ֣וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: hqshybh  'lrnty khydlvty m'd htsylny mrdpy khy 'mtsv mmny
verses.translation: Attend unto my cry; For I am brought very low; Deliver me from my persecutors; For they are too strong for me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֘וֹצִ֤יאָה מִמַּסְגֵּ֨ר  נַפְשִׁי֮ לְהוֹד֢וֹת אֶת־שְׁ֫מֶ֥ךָ בִּ֭י יַכְתִּ֣רוּ צַדִּיקִ֑ים כִּ֖י תִגְמֹ֣ל עָלָֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hvtsy'h mmsgr  npshy lhvdvt 'tshmkh by ykhtrv tsdyqym khy tgml 'ly {p}
verses.translation: Bring my soul out of prison, That I may give thanks unto Thy name; The righteous shall crown themselves because of me; For Thou wilt deal bountifully with me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְהֹוָ֤ה  שְׁמַ֬ע תְּפִלָּתִ֗י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה אֶל־תַּחֲנוּנַ֑י בֶּאֱמֻנָתְךָ֥ עֲ֝נֵ֗נִי בְּצִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: mzmvr ldvd yhvh  shm' tplty h'zynh 'ltchnvny b'mntkh 'nny btsdqtkh
verses.translation: A Psalm of David. O LORD, hear my prayer, give ear to my supplications; In Thy faithfulness answer me, and in Thy righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַל־תָּב֣וֹא בְ֭מִשְׁפָּט אֶת־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹֽא־יִצְדַּ֖ק לְפָנֶ֣יךָ כׇל־חָֽי׃
verses.translit: v'ltbv' bmshpt 't'bdkh khy l'ytsdq lpnykh khlchy
verses.translation: And enter not into judgment with Thy servant; For in Thy sight shall no man living be justified.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֥י רָ֘דַ֤ף אוֹיֵ֨ב  נַפְשִׁ֗י דִּכָּ֣א לָ֭אָרֶץ חַיָּתִ֑י הוֹשִׁבַ֥נִי בְ֝מַחֲשַׁכִּ֗ים כְּמֵתֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: khy rdf 'vyb  npshy dkh' l'rts chyty hvshbny bmchshkhym khmty 'vlm
verses.translation: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; He hath crushed my life down to the ground; He hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּתְעַטֵּ֣ף עָלַ֣י רוּחִ֑י בְּ֝תוֹכִ֗י יִשְׁתּוֹמֵ֥ם לִבִּֽי׃
verses.translation: And my spirit fainteth within me; My heart within me is appalled.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי יָמִ֨ים  מִקֶּ֗דֶם הָגִ֥יתִי בְכׇל־פׇּעֳלֶ֑ךָ בְּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ אֲשׂוֹחֵֽחַ׃
verses.translit: zkhrty ymym  mqdm hgyty bkhlp'lkh bm'shh ydykh 'shvchch
verses.translation: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Thy doing; I muse on the work of Thy hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֵּרַ֣שְׂתִּי יָדַ֣י אֵלֶ֑יךָ נַפְשִׁ֓י  כְּאֶרֶץ־עֲיֵפָ֖ה לְךָ֣ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: prshty ydy 'lykh npshy  kh'rts'yph lkh slh
verses.translation: I spread forth my hands unto Thee; My soul [thirsteth] after Thee, as a weary land. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַ֘הֵ֤ר עֲנֵ֨נִי  יְהֹוָה֮ כָּלְתָ֢ה ר֫וּחִ֥י אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֣ר פָּנֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְ֝נִמְשַׁ֗לְתִּי עִם־יֹ֥רְדֵי בֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: mhr 'nny  yhvh khlth rvchy 'ltstr pnykh mmny vnmshlty 'myrdy bvr
verses.translation: Answer me speedily, O LORD, My spirit faileth; Hide not Thy face from me; Lest I become like them that go down into the pit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשְׁמִ֘יעֵ֤נִי בַבֹּ֨קֶר  חַסְדֶּךָ֮ כִּֽי־בְךָ֢ בָ֫טָ֥חְתִּי הוֹדִיעֵ֗נִי דֶּרֶךְ־ז֥וּ אֵלֵ֑ךְ כִּי־אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ נָשָׂ֥אתִי נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: hshmy'ny bbqr  chsdkh khybkh btchty hvdy'ny drkhzv 'lkh khy'lykh nsh'ty npshy
verses.translation: Cause me to hear Thy lovingkindness in the morning, For in Thee do I trust; Cause me to know the way wherein I should walk, For unto Thee have I lifted up my soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַצִּילֵ֖נִי מֵאֹיְבַ֥י ׀ יְהֹוָ֗ה אֵלֶ֥יךָ כִסִּֽתִי׃
verses.translation: Deliver me from mine enemies, O LORD; With Thee have I hidden myself.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְּדֵ֤נִי  לַ֥עֲשׂ֣וֹת רְצוֹנֶךָ֮ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֢ה אֱל֫וֹהָ֥י רוּחֲךָ֥ טוֹבָ֑ה תַּ֝נְחֵ֗נִי בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִישֽׁוֹר׃
verses.translit: lmdny  l'shvt rtsvnkh khy'th 'lvhy rvchkh tvbh tnchny b'rts myshvr
verses.translation: Teach me to do Thy will, For Thou art my God; Let Thy good spirit Lead me in an even land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַעַן־שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֣ה תְּחַיֵּ֑נִי בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֓  תּוֹצִ֖יא מִצָּרָ֣ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: lm'nshmkh yhvh tchyny btsdqtkh  tvtsy' mtsrh npshy
verses.translation: For Thy name's sake, O LORD, quicken me; In Thy righteousness bring my soul out of trouble.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽבְחַסְדְּךָ֮ תַּצְמִ֢ית אֹ֫יְבָ֥י וְֽ֭הַאֲבַדְתָּ כׇּל־צֹרְרֵ֣י נַפְשִׁ֑י כִּ֝֗י אֲנִ֣י עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vbchsdkh ttsmyt 'yby vh'bdt khltsrry npshy khy 'ny 'bdkh {p}
verses.translation: And in Thy mercy cut off mine enemies, And destroy all them that harass my soul; For I am Thy servant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְדָוִ֨ד  בָּ֘ר֤וּךְ יְהֹוָ֨ה  צוּרִ֗י הַֽמְלַמֵּ֣ד יָדַ֣י לַקְרָ֑ב אֶ֝צְבְּעוֹתַ֗י לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: ldvd  brvkh yhvh  tsvry hmlmd ydy lqrb 'tsb'vty lmlchmh
verses.translation: [A Psalm] of David. Blessed be the LORD my Rock, Who traineth my hands for war, And my fingers for battle;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַסְדִּ֥י וּמְצוּדָתִי֮ מִשְׂגַּבִּ֢י וּֽמְפַלְטִ֫י־לִ֥י מָ֭גִנִּי וּב֣וֹ חָסִ֑יתִי הָרוֹדֵ֖ד עַמִּ֣י תַחְתָּֽי׃
verses.translit: chsdy vmtsvdty mshgby vmpltyly mgny vbv chsyty hrvdd 'my tchty
verses.translation: My lovingkindness, and my fortress, My high tower, and my deliverer; My shield, and He in whom I take refuge; Who subdueth my people under me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה מָֽה־אָ֭דָם וַתֵּדָעֵ֑הוּ בֶּן־אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ וַֽתְּחַשְּׁבֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translation: LORD, what is man, that Thou takest knowledge of him? Or the son of man, that Thou makest account of him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֭דָם לַהֶ֣בֶל דָּמָ֑ה יָ֝מָ֗יו כְּצֵ֣ל עוֹבֵֽר׃
verses.translation: Man is like unto a breath; His days are as a shadow that passeth away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְ֭הֹוָה הַט־שָׁמֶ֣יךָ וְתֵרֵ֑ד גַּ֖ע בֶּהָרִ֣ים וְֽיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ׃
verses.translit: yhvh htshmykh vtrd g' bhrym vy'shnv
verses.translation: O LORD, bow Thy heavens, and come down; Touch the mountains, that they may smoke.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּר֣וֹק בָּ֭רָק וּתְפִיצֵ֑ם שְׁלַ֥ח חִ֝צֶּ֗יךָ וּתְהֻמֵּֽם׃
verses.translit: brvq brq vtpytsm shlch chtsykh vthmm
verses.translation: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them; Send out Thine arrows, and discomfit them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁלַ֥ח יָדֶ֗יךָ מִ֫מָּר֥וֹם פְּצֵ֣נִי וְ֭הַצִּילֵנִי מִמַּ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים מִ֝יַּ֗ד בְּנֵ֣י נֵכָֽר׃
verses.translit: shlch ydykh mmrvm ptsny vhtsylny mmym rbym myd bny nkhr
verses.translation: Stretch forth Thy hands from on high; Rescue me, and deliver me out of many waters, Out of the hand of strangers;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר פִּ֭יהֶם דִּבֶּר־שָׁ֑וְא וִ֝ימִינָ֗ם יְמִ֣ין שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.translation: Whose mouth speaketh falsehood, And their right hand is a right hand of lying.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים שִׁ֣יר חָ֭דָשׁ אָשִׁ֣ירָה לָּ֑ךְ בְּנֵ֥בֶל עָ֝שׂ֗וֹר אֲזַמְּרָה־לָּֽךְ׃
verses.translation: O God, I will sing a new song unto Thee, Upon a psaltery of ten strings will I sing praises unto Thee;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַנּוֹתֵ֥ן תְּשׁוּעָ֗ה לַמְּלָ֫כִ֥ים הַ֭פּוֹצֶה אֶת־דָּוִ֥ד עַבְדּ֗וֹ מֵחֶ֥רֶב רָעָֽה׃
verses.translit: hnvtn tshv'h lmlkhym hpvtsh 'tdvd 'bdv mchrb r'h
verses.translation: Who givest salvation unto kings, Who rescuest David Thy servant from the hurtful sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּצֵ֥נִי וְהַצִּילֵנִי֮ מִיַּ֢ד בְּֽנֵי־נֵ֫כָ֥ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר פִּ֭יהֶם דִּבֶּר־שָׁ֑וְא וִ֝ימִינָ֗ם יְמִ֣ין שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.translit: ptsny vhtsylny myd bnynkhr 'shr pyhm dbrshv' vymynm ymyn shqr
verses.translation: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hand of strangers, Whose mouth speaketh falsehood, And their right hand is a right hand of lying.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּנֵ֨ינוּ  כִּנְטִעִים֮ מְגֻדָּלִ֢ים בִּֽנְעוּרֵ֫יהֶ֥ם בְּנוֹתֵ֥ינוּ כְזָוִיֹּ֑ת מְ֝חֻטָּב֗וֹת תַּבְנִ֥ית הֵיכָֽל׃
verses.translit: 'shr bnynv  khnt'ym mgdlym bn'vryhm bnvtynv khzvyt mchtbvt tbnyt hykhl
verses.translation: We whose sons are as plants grown up in their youth; Whose daughters are as corner-pillars carved after the fashion of a palace;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְזָוֵ֣ינוּ מְלֵאִים֮ מְפִיקִ֥ים מִזַּ֗ן אֶ֫ל־זַ֥ן צֹאונֵ֣נוּ מַ֭אֲלִיפוֹת מְרֻבָּב֗וֹת בְּחוּצוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: mzvynv ml'ym mpyqym mzn 'lzn ts'vnnv m'lypvt mrbbvt bchvtsvtynv
verses.translation: Whose garners are full, affording all manner of store; Whose sheep increase by thousands and ten thousands in our fields;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַלּוּפֵ֗ינוּ מְֽסֻבָּ֫לִ֥ים אֵֽין־פֶּ֭רֶץ וְאֵ֣ין יוֹצֵ֑את וְאֵ֥ין צְ֝וָחָ֗ה בִּרְחֹבֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: 'lvpynv msblym 'ynprts v'yn yvts't v'yn tsvchh brchbtynv
verses.translation: Whose oxen are well laden; With no breach, and no going forth, And no outcry in our broad places;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הָ֭עָם שֶׁכָּ֣כָה לּ֑וֹ אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י הָ֝עָ֗ם שֱׁיְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Happy is the people that is in such a case. Yea, happy is the people whose God is the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּהִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲרוֹמִמְךָ֣ אֱלוֹהַ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַאֲבָרְכָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.translit: thlh ldvd 'rvmmkh 'lvhy hmlkh v'brkhh shmkh l'vlm v'd
verses.translation: [A Psalm of] praise; of David. I will extol Thee, my God, O King; And I will bless Thy name for ever and ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּכׇל־י֥וֹם אֲבָרְכֶ֑ךָּ וַאֲהַלְלָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.translation: Every day will I bless Thee; And I will praise Thy name for ever and ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גָּ֘ד֤וֹל יְהֹוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד וְ֝לִגְדֻלָּת֗וֹ אֵ֣ין חֵֽקֶר׃
verses.translit: gdvl yhvh vmhll m'd vlgdltv 'yn chqr
verses.translation: Great is the LORD, and highly to be praised; And His greatness is unsearchable.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דּ֣וֹר לְ֭דוֹר יְשַׁבַּ֣ח מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וּגְב֖וּרֹתֶ֣יךָ יַגִּֽידוּ׃
verses.translit: dvr ldvr yshbch m'shykh vgbvrtykh ygydv
verses.translation: One generation shall laud Thy works to another, And shall declare Thy mighty acts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲ֭דַר כְּב֣וֹד הוֹדֶ֑ךָ וְדִבְרֵ֖י נִפְלְאֹתֶ֣יךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה׃
verses.translation: The glorious splendour of Thy majesty, And Thy wondrous works, will I rehearse.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וֶעֱז֣וּז נֽוֹרְאֹתֶ֣יךָ יֹאמֵ֑רוּ (וגדלותיך) [וּגְדֻלָּתְךָ֥] אֲסַפְּרֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translation: And men shall speak of the might of Thy tremendous acts; And I will tell of Thy greatness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֵ֣כֶר רַב־טוּבְךָ֣ יַבִּ֑יעוּ וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.translation: They shall utter the fame of Thy great goodness, And shall sing of Thy righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַנּ֣וּן וְרַח֣וּם יְהֹוָ֑ה אֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם וּגְדׇל־חָֽסֶד׃
verses.translation: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; Slow to anger, and of great mercy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טוֹב־יְהֹוָ֥ה לַכֹּ֑ל וְ֝רַחֲמָ֗יו עַל־כׇּל־מַעֲשָֽׂיו׃
verses.translation: The LORD is good to all; And His tender mercies are over all His works.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּךָ יְ֭הֹוָה כׇּל־מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וַ֝חֲסִידֶ֗יךָ יְבָרְכֽוּכָה׃
verses.translation: All Thy works shall praise Thee, O LORD; And Thy saints shall bless Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּב֣וֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ֣ יֹאמֵ֑רוּ וּגְבוּרָתְךָ֥ יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.translation: They shall speak of the glory of Thy kingdom, And talk of Thy might;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְהוֹדִ֤יעַ  לִבְנֵ֣י הָ֭אָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָ֑יו וּ֝כְב֗וֹד הֲדַ֣ר מַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: lhvdy'  lbny h'dm gbvrtyv vkhbvd hdr mlkhvtv
verses.translation: To make known to the sons of men His mighty acts, And the glory of the majesty of His kingdom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַֽלְכוּתְךָ֗ מַלְכ֥וּת כׇּל־עֹלָמִ֑ים וּ֝מֶֽמְשַׁלְתְּךָ֗ בְּכׇל־דּ֥וֹר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.translit: mlkhvtkh mlkhvt khl'lmym vmmshltkh bkhldvr vdr
verses.translation: Thy kingdom is a kingdom for all ages, And Thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סוֹמֵ֣ךְ יְ֭הֹוָה לְכׇל־הַנֹּפְלִ֑ים וְ֝זוֹקֵ֗ף לְכׇל־הַכְּפוּפִֽים׃
verses.translation: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, And raiseth up all those that are bowed down.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵֽינֵי־כֹ֭ל אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְשַׂבֵּ֑רוּ וְאַתָּ֤ה נֽוֹתֵן־לָהֶ֖ם אֶת־אׇכְלָ֣ם בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: The eyes of all wait for Thee, And Thou givest them their food in due season.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פּוֹתֵ֥חַ אֶת־יָדֶ֑ךָ וּמַשְׂבִּ֖יעַ לְכׇל־חַ֣י רָצֽוֹן׃
verses.translation: Thou openest Thy hand, And satisfiest every living thing with favour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צַדִּ֣יק יְ֭הֹוָה בְּכׇל־דְּרָכָ֑יו וְ֝חָסִ֗יד בְּכׇל־מַעֲשָֽׂיו׃
verses.translation: The LORD is righteous in all His ways, And gracious in all His works.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הֹוָה לְכׇל־קֹרְאָ֑יו לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִקְרָאֻ֣הוּ בֶאֱמֶֽת׃
verses.translit: qrvb yhvh lkhlqr'yv lkhl 'shr yqr'hv b'mt
verses.translation: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon Him, To all that call upon Him in truth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְצוֹן־יְרֵאָ֥יו יַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְֽאֶת־שַׁוְעָתָ֥ם יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע וְיוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃
verses.translation: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear Him; He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁוֹמֵ֣ר יְ֭הֹוָה אֶת־כׇּל־אֹהֲבָ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת כׇּל־הָרְשָׁעִ֣ים יַשְׁמִֽיד׃
verses.translation: The LORD preserveth all them that love Him; But all the wicked will He destroy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּהִלַּ֥ת יְהֹוָ֗ה יְֽדַבֶּ֫ר־פִּ֥י וִיבָרֵ֣ךְ כׇּל־בָּ֭שָׂר שֵׁ֥ם קׇדְשׁ֗וֹ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: thlt yhvh ydbrpy vybrkh khlbshr shm qdshv l'vlm v'd {p}
verses.translation: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD; And let all flesh bless His holy name for ever and ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽלְלוּ־יָ֡הּ הַֽלְלִ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י אֶת־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translation: Hallelujah. Praise the LORD, O my soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲהַלְלָ֣ה יְהֹוָ֣ה בְּחַיָּ֑י אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה לֵאלֹהַ֣י בְּעוֹדִֽי׃
verses.translation: I will praise the LORD while I live; I will sing praises unto my God while I have my being.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּבְטְח֥וּ בִנְדִיבִ֑ים בְּבֶן־אָדָ֓ם  שֶׁ֤אֵ֖ין ל֥וֹ תְשׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.translation: Put not your trust in princes, Nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תֵּצֵ֣א ר֭וּחוֹ יָשֻׁ֣ב לְאַדְמָת֑וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַ֝ה֗וּא אָבְד֥וּ עֶשְׁתֹּנֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: tts' rvchv yshb l'dmtv byvm hhv' 'bdv 'shtntyv
verses.translation: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his dust; In that very day his thoughts perish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֗י שֶׁ֤אֵ֣ל יַעֲקֹ֣ב בְּעֶזְר֑וֹ שִׂ֝בְר֗וֹ עַל־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.translation: Happy is he whose help is the God of Jacob, Whose hope is in the LORD his God,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹשֶׂ֤ה  שָׁ֘מַ֤יִם וָאָ֗רֶץ אֶת־הַיָּ֥ם וְאֶת־כׇּל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֑ם הַשֹּׁמֵ֖ר אֱמֶ֣ת לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translation: Who made heaven and earth, The sea, and all that in them is; Who keepeth truth for ever;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹשֶׂ֤ה מִשְׁפָּ֨ט  לָעֲשׁוּקִ֗ים נֹתֵ֣ן לֶ֭חֶם לָרְעֵבִ֑ים יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה מַתִּ֥יר אֲסוּרִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'shh mshpt  l'shvqym ntn lchm lr'bym yhvh mtyr 'svrym
verses.translation: Who executeth justice for the oppressed; Who giveth bread to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֤ה  פֹּ֘קֵ֤חַ עִוְרִ֗ים יְ֭הֹוָה זֹקֵ֣ף כְּפוּפִ֑ים יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה אֹהֵ֥ב צַדִּיקִֽים׃
verses.translit: yhvh  pqch 'vrym yhvh zqf khpvpym yhvh 'hb tsdyqym
verses.translation: The LORD openeth the eyes of the blind; The LORD raiseth up them that are bowed down; The LORD loveth the righteous;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֤ה  שֹׁ֘מֵ֤ר אֶת־גֵּרִ֗ים יָת֣וֹם וְאַלְמָנָ֣ה יְעוֹדֵ֑ד וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים יְעַוֵּֽת׃
verses.translit: yhvh  shmr 'tgrym ytvm v'lmnh y'vdd vdrkh rsh'ym y'vt
verses.translation: The LORD preserveth the strangers; He upholdeth the fatherless and the widow; But the way of the wicked He maketh crooked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִמְלֹ֤ךְ יְהֹוָ֨ה  לְעוֹלָ֗ם אֱלֹהַ֣יִךְ צִ֭יּוֹן לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֗ר הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: ymlkh yhvh  l'vlm 'lhykh tsyvn ldr vdr hllvyh {p}
verses.translation: The LORD will reign for ever, Thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Hallelujah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ־יָ֨הּ  כִּי־ט֭וֹב זַמְּרָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ כִּי־נָ֝עִ֗ים נָאוָ֥ה תְהִלָּֽה׃
verses.translit: hllvyh  khytvb zmrh 'lhynv khyn'ym n'vh thlh
verses.translation: Hallelujah; For it is good to sing praises unto our God; For it is pleasant, and praise is comely.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בּוֹנֵ֣ה יְרוּשָׁלַ֣͏ִם יְהֹוָ֑ה נִדְחֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל יְכַנֵּֽס׃
verses.translit: bvnh yrvshl͏m yhvh ndchy yshr'l ykhns
verses.translation: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem, He gathereth together the dispersed of Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָ֭רֹפֵא לִשְׁב֣וּרֵי לֵ֑ב וּ֝מְחַבֵּ֗שׁ לְעַצְּבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translation: Who healeth the broken in heart, And bindeth up their wounds.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מוֹנֶ֣ה מִ֭סְפָּר לַכּוֹכָבִ֑ים לְ֝כֻלָּ֗ם שֵׁמ֥וֹת יִקְרָֽא׃
verses.translit: mvnh mspr lkhvkhbym lkhlm shmvt yqr'
verses.translation: He counteth the number of the stars; He giveth them all their names.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גָּד֣וֹל אֲדוֹנֵ֣ינוּ וְרַב־כֹּ֑חַ לִ֝תְבוּנָת֗וֹ אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.translation: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding is infinite.
