verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְעוֹדֵ֣ד עֲנָוִ֣ים יְהֹוָ֑ה מַשְׁפִּ֖יל רְשָׁעִ֣ים עֲדֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translation: The LORD upholdeth the humble; He bringeth the wicked down to the ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֱנ֣וּ לַֽיהֹוָ֣ה בְּתוֹדָ֑ה זַמְּר֖וּ לֵאלֹהֵ֣ינוּ בְכִנּֽוֹר׃
verses.translation: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving, Sing praises upon the harp unto our God;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽמְכַסֶּ֬ה שָׁמַ֨יִם  בְּעָבִ֗ים הַמֵּכִ֣ין לָאָ֣רֶץ מָטָ֑ר הַמַּצְמִ֖יחַ הָרִ֣ים חָצִֽיר׃
verses.translit: hmkhsh shmym  b'bym hmkhyn l'rts mtr hmtsmych hrym chtsyr
verses.translation: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, Who prepareth rain for the earth, Who maketh the mountains to spring with grass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נוֹתֵ֣ן לִבְהֵמָ֣ה לַחְמָ֑הּ לִבְנֵ֥י עֹ֝רֵ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִקְרָֽאוּ׃
verses.translation: He giveth to the beast his food, And to the young ravens which cry.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֤א בִגְבוּרַ֣ת הַסּ֣וּס יֶחְפָּ֑ץ לֹא־בְשׁוֹקֵ֖י הָאִ֣ישׁ יִרְצֶֽה׃
verses.translit: l' bgbvrt hsvs ychpts l'bshvqy h'ysh yrtsh
verses.translation: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse; He taketh no pleasure in the legs of a man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רוֹצֶ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה אֶת־יְרֵאָ֑יו אֶת־הַֽמְיַחֲלִ֥ים לְחַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear Him, In those that wait for His mercy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁבְּחִ֣י יְ֭רוּשָׁלַ͏ִם אֶת־יְהֹוָ֑ה הַֽלְלִ֖י אֱלֹהַ֣יִךְ צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.translation: Glorify the LORD, O Jerusalem; Praise thy God, O Zion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־חִ֭זַּק בְּרִיחֵ֣י שְׁעָרָ֑יִךְ בֵּרַ֖ךְ בָּנַ֣יִךְ בְּקִרְבֵּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khychzq brychy sh'rykh brkh bnykh bqrbkh
verses.translation: For He hath made strong the bars of thy gates; He hath blessed thy children within thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשָּׂם־גְּבוּלֵ֥ךְ שָׁל֑וֹם חֵ֥לֶב חִ֝טִּ֗ים יַשְׂבִּיעֵֽךְ׃
verses.translation: He maketh thy borders peace; He giveth thee in plenty the fat of wheat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשֹּׁלֵ֣חַ אִמְרָת֣וֹ אָ֑רֶץ עַד־מְ֝הֵרָ֗ה יָר֥וּץ דְּבָרֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: He sendeth out His commandment upon earth; His word runneth very swiftly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַנֹּתֵ֣ן שֶׁ֣לֶג כַּצָּ֑מֶר כְּ֝פ֗וֹר כָּאֵ֥פֶר יְפַזֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: hntn shlg khtsmr khpvr kh'pr ypzr
verses.translation: He giveth snow like wool; He scattereth the hoar-frost like ashes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשְׁלִ֣יךְ קַֽרְח֣וֹ כְפִתִּ֑ים לִפְנֵ֥י קָ֝רָת֗וֹ מִ֣י יַעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.translit: mshlykh qrchv khptym lpny qrtv my y'md
verses.translation: He casteth forth His ice like crumbs; Who can stand before His cold?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׁלַ֣ח דְּבָר֣וֹ וְיַמְסֵ֑ם יַשֵּׁ֥ב ר֝וּח֗וֹ יִזְּלוּ־מָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: yshlch dbrv vymsm yshb rvchv yzlvmym
verses.translation: He sendeth forth His word, and melteth them; He causeth His wind to blow, and the waters flow.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַגִּ֣יד דְּבָרָ֣ו לְיַעֲקֹ֑ב חֻקָּ֥יו וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטָ֗יו לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: mgyd dbrv ly'qb chqyv vmshptyv lyshr'l
verses.translation: He declareth His word unto Jacob, His statutes and His ordinances unto Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֘א־עָ֤שָׂה כֵ֨ן  לְכׇל־גּ֗וֹי וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֥ים בַּל־יְדָע֗וּם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: l''shh khn  lkhlgvy vmshptym blyd'vm hllvyh {p}
verses.translation: He hath not dealt so with any nation; And as for His ordinances, they have not known them. Hallelujah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ־יָ֨הּ  הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת־יְ֭הֹוָה מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֑יִם הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בַּמְּרוֹמִֽים׃
verses.translation: Hallelujah. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens; Praise Him in the heights.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽלְל֥וּהוּ כׇל־מַלְאָכָ֑יו הַ֝לְל֗וּהוּ כׇּל־צְבָאָֽו׃
verses.translation: Praise ye Him, all His angels; Praise ye Him, all His hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ שֶׁ֣מֶשׁ וְיָרֵ֑חַ הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ כׇּל־כּ֥וֹכְבֵי אֽוֹר׃
verses.translation: Praise ye Him, sun and moon; Praise Him, all ye stars of light.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ שְׁמֵ֣י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ֝הַמַּ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר  מֵעַ֬ל הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: hllvhv shmy hshmym vhmym 'shr  m'l hshmym
verses.translation: Praise Him, ye heavens of heavens, And ye waters that are above the heavens.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽ֭הַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּ֤י ה֖וּא צִוָּ֣ה וְנִבְרָֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: yhllv 'tshm yhvh khy hv' tsvh vnbr'v
verses.translation: Let them praise the name of the LORD; For He commanded, and they were created.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמִידֵ֣ם לָעַ֣ד לְעוֹלָ֑ם חׇק־נָ֝תַ֗ן וְלֹ֣א יַעֲבֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vy'mydm l'd l'vlm chqntn vl' y'bvr
verses.translation: He hath also established them for ever and ever; He hath made a decree which shall not be transgressed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת־יְ֭הֹוָה מִן־הָאָ֑רֶץ תַּ֝נִּינִ֗ים וְכׇל־תְּהֹמֽוֹת׃
verses.translation: Praise the LORD from the earth, Ye sea-monsters, and all deeps;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣שׁ וּ֭בָרָד שֶׁ֣לֶג וְקִיט֑וֹר ר֥וּחַ סְ֝עָרָ֗ה עֹשָׂ֥ה דְבָרֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'sh vbrd shlg vqytvr rvch s'rh 'shh dbrv
verses.translation: Fire and hail, snow and vapour, Stormy wind, fulfilling His word;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶהָרִ֥ים וְכׇל־גְּבָע֑וֹת עֵ֥ץ פְּ֝רִ֗י וְכׇל־אֲרָזִֽים׃
verses.translation: Mountains and all hills, Fruitful trees and all cedars;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַחַיָּ֥ה וְכׇל־בְּהֵמָ֑ה רֶ֝֗מֶשׂ וְצִפּ֥וֹר כָּנָֽף׃
verses.translation: Beasts and all cattle, Creeping things and winged fowl;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַלְכֵי־אֶ֭רֶץ וְכׇל־לְאֻמִּ֑ים שָׂ֝רִ֗ים וְכׇל־שֹׁ֥פְטֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translation: Kings of the earth and all peoples, Princes and all judges of the earth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּחוּרִ֥ים וְגַם־בְּתוּל֑וֹת זְ֝קֵנִ֗ים עִם־נְעָרִֽים׃
verses.translation: Both young men and maidens, Old men and children;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהַלְל֤וּ  אֶת־שֵׁ֬ם יְהֹוָ֗ה כִּֽי־נִשְׂגָּ֣ב שְׁמ֣וֹ לְבַדּ֑וֹ ה֝וֹד֗וֹ עַל־אֶ֥רֶץ וְשָׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: yhllv  'tshm yhvh khynshgb shmv lbdv hvdv 'l'rts vshmym
verses.translation: Let them praise the name of the LORD, For His name alone is exalted; His glory is above the earth and heaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֤רֶם קֶ֨רֶן  לְעַמּ֡וֹ תְּהִלָּ֤ה לְֽכׇל־חֲסִידָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֣י יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל עַ֥ם קְרֹב֗וֹ הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyrm qrn  l'mv thlh lkhlchsydyv lbny yshr'l 'm qrbv hllvyh {p}
verses.translation: And He hath lifted up a horn for His people, A praise for all His saints, Even for the children of Israel, a people near unto Him. Hallelujah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ־יָ֨הּ  שִׁ֣ירוּ לַֽ֭יהֹוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ תְּ֝הִלָּת֗וֹ בִּקְהַ֥ל חֲסִידִֽים׃
verses.translit: hllvyh  shyrv lyhvh shyr chdsh thltv bqhl chsydym
verses.translation: Hallelujah. Sing unto the LORD a new song, And His praise in the assembly of the saints.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׂמַ֣ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל בְּעֹשָׂ֑יו בְּנֵֽי־צִ֝יּ֗וֹן יָגִ֥ילוּ בְמַלְכָּֽם׃
verses.translit: yshmch yshr'l b'shyv bnytsyvn ygylv bmlkhm
verses.translation: Let Israel rejoice in his Maker; Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהַלְל֣וּ שְׁמ֣וֹ בְמָח֑וֹל בְּתֹ֥ף וְ֝כִנּ֗וֹר יְזַמְּרוּ־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: yhllv shmv bmchvl btf vkhnvr yzmrvlv
verses.translation: Let them praise His name in the dance; Let them sing praises unto Him with the timbrel and harp.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־רוֹצֶ֣ה יְהֹוָ֣ה בְּעַמּ֑וֹ יְפָאֵ֥ר עֲ֝נָוִ֗ים בִּישׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.translation: For the LORD taketh pleasure in His people; He adorneth the humble with salvation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַעְלְז֣וּ חֲסִידִ֣ים בְּכָב֑וֹד יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ עַל־מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translation: Let the saints exult in glory; Let them sing for joy upon their beds.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רוֹמְמ֣וֹת אֵ֭ל בִּגְרוֹנָ֑ם וְחֶ֖רֶב פִּיפִיּ֣וֹת בְּיָדָֽם׃
verses.translation: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, And a two-edged sword in their hand;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת נְ֭קָמָה בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם תּ֝וֹכֵח֗וֹת בַּלְאֻמִּֽים׃
verses.translation: To execute vengeance upon the nations, And chastisements upon the peoples;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֶאְסֹ֣ר מַלְכֵיהֶ֣ם בְּזִקִּ֑ים וְ֝נִכְבְּדֵיהֶ֗ם בְּכַבְלֵ֥י בַרְזֶֽל׃
verses.translit: l'sr mlkhyhm bzqym vnkhbdyhm bkhbly brzl
verses.translation: To bind their kings with chains, And their nobles with fetters of iron;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַעֲשׂ֤וֹת בָּהֶ֨ם  מִשְׁפָּ֬ט כָּת֗וּב הָדָ֣ר ה֭וּא לְכׇל־חֲסִידָ֗יו הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: l'shvt bhm  mshpt khtvb hdr hv' lkhlchsydyv hllvyh {p}
verses.translation: To execute upon them the judgment written; He is the glory of all His saints. Hallelujah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ־יָ֨הּ  הַֽלְלוּ־אֵ֥ל בְּקׇדְשׁ֑וֹ הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בִּרְקִ֥יעַ עֻזּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: Hallelujah. Praise God in His sanctuary; Praise Him in the firmament of His power.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַלְל֥וּהוּ בִגְבוּרֹתָ֑יו הַ֝לְל֗וּהוּ כְּרֹ֣ב גֻּדְלֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: Praise Him for His mighty acts; Praise Him according to His abundant greatness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֭לְלוּהוּ בְּתֵ֣קַע שׁוֹפָ֑ר הַ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּנֵ֣בֶל וְכִנּֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: hllvhv btq' shvpr hllvhv bnbl vkhnvr
verses.translation: Praise Him with the blast of the horn; Praise Him with the psaltery and harp.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֭לְלוּהוּ בְּתֹ֣ף וּמָח֑וֹל הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּמִנִּ֥ים וְעֻגָֽב׃
verses.translit: hllvhv btf vmchvl hllvhv bmnym v'gb
verses.translation: Praise Him with the timbrel and dance; Praise Him with stringed instruments and the pipe.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַלְל֥וּהוּ בְצִלְצְלֵי־שָׁ֑מַע הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּֽצִלְצְלֵ֥י תְרוּעָֽה׃
verses.translation: Praise Him with the loud-sounding cymbals; Praise Him with the clanging cymbals.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ל הַ֭נְּשָׁמָה תְּהַלֵּ֥ל יָ֗הּ הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃
verses.translation: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Hallelujah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֭שְׁלֵי שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בֶן־דָּוִ֑ד מֶ֝֗לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translation: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָדַ֣עַת חׇכְמָ֣ה וּמוּסָ֑ר לְ֝הָבִ֗ין אִמְרֵ֥י בִינָֽה׃
verses.translation: To know wisdom and instruction; To comprehend the words of understanding;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֭קַחַת מוּסַ֣ר הַשְׂכֵּ֑ל צֶ֥דֶק וּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט וּמֵשָׁרִֽים׃
verses.translit: lqcht mvsr hshkhl tsdq vmshpt vmshrym
verses.translation: To receive the discipline of wisdom, Justice, and right, and equity;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָתֵ֣ת לִפְתָאיִ֣ם עׇרְמָ֑ה לְ֝נַ֗עַר דַּ֣עַת וּמְזִמָּֽה׃
verses.translation: To give prudence to the simple, To the young man knowledge and discretion;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׁמַ֣ע חָ֭כָם וְי֣וֹסֶף לֶ֑קַח וְ֝נָב֗וֹן תַּחְבֻּל֥וֹת יִקְנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: yshm' chkhm vyvsf lqch vnbvn tchblvt yqnh
verses.translation: That the wise man may hear, and increase in learning, And the man of understanding may attain unto wise counsels;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְהָבִ֣ין מָ֭שָׁל וּמְלִיצָ֑ה דִּבְרֵ֥י חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים וְחִידֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: lhbyn mshl vmlytsh dbry chkhmym vchydtm
verses.translation: To understand a proverb, and a figure; The words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הֹוָה רֵאשִׁ֣ית דָּ֑עַת חׇכְמָ֥ה וּ֝מוּסָ֗ר אֱוִילִ֥ים בָּֽזוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: yr't yhvh r'shyt d't chkhmh vmvsr 'vylym bzv {p}
verses.translation: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge; But the foolish despise wisdom and discipline.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע בְּ֭נִי מוּסַ֣ר אָבִ֑יךָ וְאַל־תִּ֝טֹּ֗שׁ תּוֹרַ֥ת אִמֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Hear, my son, the instruction of thy father, And forsake not the teaching of thy mother;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י  לִוְיַ֤ת חֵ֓ן הֵ֬ם לְרֹאשֶׁ֑ךָ וַ֝עֲנָקִ֗ים לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: khy  lvyt chn hm lr'shkh v'nqym lgrgrtkh
verses.translation: For they shall be a chaplet of grace unto thy head, And chains about thy neck.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנִ֡י אִם־יְפַתּ֥וּךָ חַ֝טָּאִ֗ים אַל־תֹּבֵֽא׃
verses.translation: My son, if sinners entice thee, Consent thou not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יֹאמְרוּ֮ לְכָ֢ה אִ֫תָּ֥נוּ נֶאֶרְבָ֥ה לְדָ֑ם נִצְפְּנָ֖ה לְנָקִ֣י חִנָּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'my'mrv lkhh 'tnv n'rbh ldm ntspnh lnqy chnm
verses.translation: If they say: ‘Come with us, Let us lie in wait for blood, Let us lurk for the innocent without cause;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִ֭בְלָעֵם כִּשְׁא֣וֹל חַיִּ֑ים וּ֝תְמִימִ֗ים כְּי֣וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: nbl'm khsh'vl chyym vtmymym khyvrdy bvr
verses.translation: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave, and whole, as those that go down into the pit;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־ה֣וֹן יָקָ֣ר נִמְצָ֑א נְמַלֵּ֖א בָתֵּ֣ינוּ שָׁלָֽל׃
verses.translit: khlhvn yqr nmts' nml' btynv shll
verses.translation: We shall find all precious substance, We shall fill our houses with spoil;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גּ֭וֹרָ֣לְךָ תַּפִּ֣יל בְּתוֹכֵ֑נוּ כִּ֥יס אֶ֝חָ֗ד יִהְיֶ֥ה לְכֻלָּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: gvrlkh tpyl btvkhnv khys 'chd yhyh lkhlnv
verses.translation: Cast in thy lot among us; Let us all have one purse’—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנִ֗י אַל־תֵּלֵ֣ךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ אִתָּ֑ם מְנַ֥ע רַ֝גְלְךָ֗ מִנְּתִיבָתָֽם׃
verses.translation: My son, walk not thou in the way with them, restrain thy foot from their path;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י רַ֭גְלֵיהֶם לָרַ֣ע יָר֑וּצוּ וִ֝ימַהֲר֗וּ לִשְׁפׇּךְ־דָּֽם׃
verses.translit: khy rglyhm lr' yrvtsv vymhrv lshpkhdm
verses.translation: For their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed blood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־חִ֭נָּם מְזֹרָ֣ה הָרָ֑שֶׁת בְּ֝עֵינֵ֗י כׇּל־בַּ֥עַל כָּנָֽף׃
verses.translit: khychnm mzrh hrsht b'yny khlb'l khnf
verses.translation: For in vain the net is spread in the eyes of any bird;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭הֵם לְדָמָ֣ם יֶאֱרֹ֑בוּ יִ֝צְפְּנ֗וּ לְנַפְשֹׁתָֽם׃
verses.translation: And these lie in wait for their own blood, they lurk for their own lives.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֵּ֗ן אׇ֭רְחוֹת כׇּל־בֹּ֣צֵֽעַ בָּ֑צַע אֶת־נֶ֖פֶשׁ בְּעָלָ֣יו יִקָּֽח׃ {פ}
verses.translation: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; it taketh away the life of the owners thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חׇ֭כְמוֹת בַּח֣וּץ תָּרֹ֑נָּה בָּ֝רְחֹב֗וֹת תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: chkhmvt bchvts trnh brchbvt ttn qvlh
verses.translation: Wisdom crieth aloud in the streets, she uttereth her voice in the broad places;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּרֹ֥אשׁ הֹמִיּ֗וֹת תִּ֫קְרָ֥א בְּפִתְחֵ֖י שְׁעָרִ֥ים בָּעִ֗יר אֲמָרֶ֥יהָ תֹאמֵֽר׃
verses.translit: br'sh hmyvt tqr' bptchy sh'rym b'yr 'mryh t'mr
verses.translation: She calleth at the head of the noisy streets, at the entrances of the gates, in the city, she uttereth her words:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־מָתַ֣י ׀ פְּתָיִם֮ תְּֽאֵהֲב֫וּ־פֶ֥תִי וְלֵצִ֗ים לָ֭צוֹן חָמְד֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים יִשְׂנְאוּ־דָֽעַת׃
verses.translit: 'dmty  ptym t'hbvpty vltsym ltsvn chmdv lhm vkhsylym yshn'vd't
verses.translation: ’How long, ye thoughtless, will ye love thoughtlessness? And how long will scorners delight them in scorning, And fools hate knowledge?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תָּשׁ֗וּבוּ לְֽת֫וֹכַחְתִּ֥י הִנֵּ֤ה אַבִּ֣יעָה לָכֶ֣ם רוּחִ֑י אוֹדִ֖יעָה דְבָרַ֣י אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: tshvbv ltvkhchty hnh 'by'h lkhm rvchy 'vdy'h dbry 'tkhm
verses.translation: Turn you at my reproof; behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֣עַן קָ֭רָאתִי וַתְּמָאֵ֑נוּ נָטִ֥יתִי יָ֝דִ֗י וְאֵ֣ין מַקְשִֽׁיב׃
verses.translit: y'n qr'ty vtm'nv ntyty ydy v'yn mqshyb
verses.translation: Because I have called, and ye refused, I have stretched out my hand, and no man attended,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּפְרְע֥וּ כׇל־עֲצָתִ֑י וְ֝תוֹכַחְתִּ֗י לֹ֣א אֲבִיתֶֽם׃
verses.translation: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־אֲ֭נִי בְּאֵידְכֶ֣ם אֶשְׂחָ֑ק אֶ֝לְעַ֗ג בְּבֹ֣א פַחְדְּכֶֽם׃
verses.translation: I also, in your calamity, will laugh, I will mock when your dread cometh;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּבֹ֤א (כשאוה) [כְשׁוֹאָ֨ה ] פַּחְדְּכֶ֗ם וְֽ֭אֵידְכֶם כְּסוּפָ֣ה יֶאֱתֶ֑ה בְּבֹ֥א עֲ֝לֵיכֶ֗ם צָרָ֥ה וְצוּקָֽה׃
verses.translit: bb' (khsh'vh) [khshv'h ] pchdkhm v'ydkhm khsvph y'th bb' 'lykhm tsrh vtsvqh
verses.translation: When your dread cometh as a storm, and your calamity cometh on as a whirlwind; When trouble and distress come upon you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֣ז יִ֭קְרָאֻנְנִי וְלֹ֣א אֶעֱנֶ֑ה יְ֝שַׁחֲרֻ֗נְנִי וְלֹ֣א יִמְצָאֻֽנְנִי׃
verses.translation: Then will they call me, but I will not answer, they will seek me earnestly, but they shall not find me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּ֭חַת כִּֽי־שָׂ֣נְאוּ דָ֑עַת וְיִרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה לֹ֣א בָחָֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: tcht khyshn'v d't vyr't yhvh l' bchrv
verses.translation: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the LORD;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־אָב֥וּ לַעֲצָתִ֑י נָ֝אֲצ֗וּ כׇּל־תּוֹכַחְתִּֽי׃
verses.translation: They would none of my counsel, they despised all my reproof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽ֭יֹאכְלוּ מִפְּרִ֣י דַרְכָּ֑ם וּֽמִמֹּעֲצֹ֖תֵיהֶ֣ם יִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃
verses.translation: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י מְשׁוּבַ֣ת פְּתָיִ֣ם תַּהַרְגֵ֑ם וְשַׁלְוַ֖ת כְּסִילִ֣ים תְּאַבְּדֵֽם׃
verses.translit: khy mshvbt ptym thrgm vshlvt khsylym t'bdm
verses.translation: For the waywardness of the thoughtless shall slay them, and the confidence of fools shall destroy them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֹׁמֵ֣עַֽ לִ֭י יִשְׁכׇּן־בֶּ֑טַח וְ֝שַׁאֲנַ֗ן מִפַּ֥חַד רָעָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vshm' ly yshkhnbtch vsh'nn mpchd r'h {p}
verses.translation: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell securely, and shall be quiet without fear of evil.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּ֭נִי אִם־תִּקַּ֣ח אֲמָרָ֑י וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י תִּצְפֹּ֥ן אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.translation: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, And lay up my commandments with thee;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְהַקְשִׁ֣יב לַחׇכְמָ֣ה אׇזְנֶ֑ךָ תַּטֶּ֥ה לִ֝בְּךָ֗ לַתְּבוּנָֽה׃
verses.translation: So that thou make thine ear attend unto wisdom, And thy heart incline to discernment;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִ֣ם לַבִּינָ֣ה תִקְרָ֑א לַ֝תְּבוּנָ֗ה תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: khy 'm lbynh tqr' ltbvnh ttn qvlkh
verses.translation: Yea, if thou call for understanding, And lift up thy voice for discernment;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־תְּבַקְשֶׁ֥נָּה כַכָּ֑סֶף וְֽכַמַּטְמוֹנִ֥ים תַּחְפְּשֶֽׂנָּה׃
verses.translation: If thou seek her as silver, And search for her as for hid treasures;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֗ז תָּ֭בִין יִרְאַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת אֱלֹהִ֣ים תִּמְצָֽא׃
verses.translation: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, And find the knowledge of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יְ֭הֹוָה יִתֵּ֣ן חׇכְמָ֑ה מִ֝פִּ֗יו דַּ֣עַת וּתְבוּנָֽה׃
verses.translit: khyyhvh ytn chkhmh mpyv d't vtbvnh
verses.translation: For the LORD giveth wisdom, Out of His mouth cometh knowledge and discernment;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (וצפן) [יִצְפֹּ֣ן] לַ֭יְשָׁרִים תּוּשִׁיָּ֑ה מָ֝גֵ֗ן לְהֹ֣לְכֵי תֹֽם׃
verses.translation: He layeth up sound wisdom for the upright, He is a shield to them that walk in integrity;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִ֭נְצֹר אׇרְח֣וֹת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְדֶ֖רֶךְ חֲסִידָ֣ו יִשְׁמֹֽר׃
verses.translation: That He may guard the paths of justice, And preserve the way of His godly ones. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֗ז תָּ֭בִין צֶ֣דֶק וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝מֵישָׁרִ֗ים כׇּל־מַעְגַּל־טֽוֹב׃
verses.translation: Then shalt thou understand righteousness and justice, And equity, yea, every good path.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־תָב֣וֹא חׇכְמָ֣ה בְלִבֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝דַ֗עַת לְֽנַפְשְׁךָ֥ יִנְעָֽם׃
verses.translit: khytbv' chkhmh blbkh vd't lnpshkh yn'm
verses.translation: For wisdom shall enter into thy heart, And knowledge shall be pleasant unto thy soul;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְ֭זִמָּה תִּשְׁמֹ֥ר עָלֶ֗יךָ תְּבוּנָ֥ה תִנְצְרֶֽכָּה׃
verses.translation: Discretion shall watch over thee, Discernment shall guard thee;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֭הַצִּ֣ילְךָ מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ רָ֑ע מֵ֝אִ֗ישׁ מְדַבֵּ֥ר תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: lhtsylkh mdrkh r' m'ysh mdbr thpkhvt
verses.translation: To deliver thee from the way of evil, From the men that speak froward things;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֭עֹ֣זְבִים אׇרְח֣וֹת יֹ֑שֶׁר לָ֝לֶ֗כֶת בְּדַרְכֵי־חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.translation: Who leave the paths of uprightness, To walk in the ways of darkness;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֭שְּׂמֵחִים לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת רָ֑ע יָ֝גִ֗ילוּ בְּֽתַהְפֻּכ֥וֹת רָֽע׃
verses.translit: hshmchym l'shvt r' ygylv bthpkhvt r'
verses.translation: Who rejoice to do evil, And delight in the frowardness of evil;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אׇרְחֹתֵיהֶ֣ם עִקְּשִׁ֑ים וּ֝נְלוֹזִ֗ים בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translation: Who are crooked in their ways, And perverse in their paths;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֭הַצִּ֣ילְךָ מֵאִשָּׁ֣ה זָרָ֑ה מִ֝נׇּכְרִיָּ֗ה אֲמָרֶ֥יהָ הֶחֱלִֽיקָה׃
verses.translation: To deliver thee from the strange woman, Even from the alien woman that maketh smooth her words;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֭עֹזֶבֶת אַלּ֣וּף נְעוּרֶ֑יהָ וְאֶת־בְּרִ֖ית אֱלֹהֶ֣יהָ שָׁכֵֽחָה׃
verses.translation: That forsaketh the lord of her youth, And forgetteth the covenant of her God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י שָׁ֣חָה אֶל־מָ֣וֶת בֵּיתָ֑הּ וְאֶל־רְ֝פָאִ֗ים מַעְגְּלֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translation: For her house sinketh down unto death, And her paths unto the shades;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־בָּ֭אֶיהָ לֹ֣א יְשׁוּב֑וּן וְלֹֽא־יַ֝שִּׂ֗יגוּ אׇרְח֥וֹת חַיִּֽים׃
verses.translation: None that go unto her return, Neither do they attain unto the paths of life;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֗עַן תֵּ֭לֵךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ טוֹבִ֑ים וְאׇרְח֖וֹת צַדִּיקִ֣ים תִּשְׁמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: lm'n tlkh bdrkh tvbym v'rchvt tsdyqym tshmr
verses.translation: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, And keep the paths of the righteous.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יְשָׁרִ֥ים יִשְׁכְּנוּ־אָ֑רֶץ וּ֝תְמִימִ֗ים יִוָּ֥תְרוּ בָֽהּ׃
verses.translation: For the upright shall dwell in the land, And the whole-hearted shall remain in it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּ֭רְשָׁעִים מֵאֶ֣רֶץ יִכָּרֵ֑תוּ וּ֝בוֹגְדִ֗ים יִסְּח֥וּ מִמֶּֽנָּה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vrsh'ym m'rts ykhrtv vbvgdym yschv mmnh {p}
verses.translation: But the wicked shall be cut off from the land, And the faithless shall be plucked up out of it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּ֭נִי תּוֹרָתִ֣י אַל־תִּשְׁכָּ֑ח וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י יִצֹּ֥ר לִבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: My son, forget not my teaching; But let thy heart keep my commandments;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים וּשְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּ֑ים וְ֝שָׁל֗וֹם יוֹסִ֥יפוּ לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khy 'rkh ymym vshnvt chyym vshlvm yvsypv lkh
verses.translation: For length of days, and years of life, And peace, will they add to thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֗ת אַֽל־יַ֫עַזְבֻ֥ךָ קׇשְׁרֵ֥ם עַל־גַּרְגְּרוֹתֶ֑יךָ כׇּ֝תְבֵ֗ם עַל־ל֥וּחַ לִבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Let not kindness and truth forsake thee; Bind them about thy neck, write them upon the table of thy heart;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמְצָא־חֵ֥ן וְשֵֽׂכֶל־ט֑וֹב בְּעֵינֵ֖י אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאָדָֽם׃
verses.translation: So shalt thou find grace and good favour In the sight of God and man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּטַ֣ח אֶל־יְ֭הֹוָה בְּכׇל־לִבֶּ֑ךָ וְאֶל־בִּ֥֝ינָתְךָ֗ אַל־תִּשָּׁעֵֽן׃
verses.translation: Trust in the LORD with all thy heart, And lean not upon thine own understanding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּכׇל־דְּרָכֶ֥יךָ דָעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝ה֗וּא יְיַשֵּׁ֥ר אֹֽרְחֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: In all thy ways acknowledge Him, And He will direct thy paths.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תְּהִ֣י חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ יְרָ֥א אֶת־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה וְס֣וּר מֵרָֽע׃
verses.translation: Be not wise in thine own eyes; Fear the LORD, and depart from evil;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רִ֭פְאוּת תְּהִ֣י לְשׇׁרֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝שִׁקּ֗וּי לְעַצְמוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: It shall be health to thy navel, And marrow to thy bones.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּבֵּ֣ד אֶת־יְ֭הֹוָה מֵהוֹנֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מֵרֵאשִׁ֗ית כׇּל־תְּבוּאָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Honour the LORD with thy substance, And with the first-fruits of all thine increase;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִמָּלְא֣וּ אֲסָמֶ֣יךָ שָׂבָ֑ע וְ֝תִיר֗וֹשׁ יְקָבֶ֥יךָ יִפְרֹֽצוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translation: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, And thy vats shall overflow with new wine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מוּסַ֣ר יְ֭הֹוָה בְּנִ֣י אַל־תִּמְאָ֑ס וְאַל־תָּ֝קֹ֗ץ בְּתוֹכַחְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD, Neither spurn thou His correction;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֶ֥ת־אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶאֱהַ֣ב יְהֹוָ֣ה יוֹכִ֑יחַ וּ֝כְאָ֗ב אֶת־בֵּ֥ן יִרְצֶֽה׃
verses.translit: khy 't'shr y'hb yhvh yvkhych vkh'b 'tbn yrtsh
verses.translation: For whom the LORD loveth He correcteth, Even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם מָצָ֣א חׇכְמָ֑ה וְ֝אָדָ֗ם יָפִ֥יק תְּבוּנָֽה׃
verses.translation: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, And the man that obtaineth understanding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י ט֣וֹב סַ֭חְרָהּ מִסְּחַר־כָּ֑סֶף וּ֝מֵחָר֗וּץ תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: khy tvb schrh mschrkhsf vmchrvts tbv'th
verses.translation: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, And the gain thereof than fine gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְקָ֣רָה הִ֭יא (מפניים) [מִפְּנִינִ֑ים] וְכׇל־חֲ֝פָצֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִֽשְׁווּ־בָֽהּ׃
verses.translation: She is more precious than rubies; And all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים בִּֽימִינָ֑הּ בִּ֝שְׂמֹאולָ֗הּ עֹ֣שֶׁר וְכָבֽוֹד׃
verses.translation: Length of days is in her right hand; In her left hand are riches and honour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דְּרָכֶ֥יהָ דַרְכֵי־נֹ֑עַם וְֽכׇל־נְתִ֖יבוֹתֶ֣יהָ שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.translation: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, And all her paths are peace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵץ־חַיִּ֣ים הִ֭יא לַמַּחֲזִיקִ֣ים בָּ֑הּ וְֽתֹמְכֶ֥יהָ מְאֻשָּֽׁר׃ {פ}
verses.translation: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her, And happy is every one that holdest her fast.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה בְּחׇכְמָ֥ה יָסַד־אָ֑רֶץ כּוֹנֵ֥ן שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם בִּתְבוּנָֽה׃
verses.translit: yhvh bchkhmh ysd'rts khvnn shmym btbvnh
verses.translation: The LORD by wisdom founded the earth; By understanding He established the heavens.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּ֭דַעְתּוֹ תְּהוֹמ֣וֹת נִבְקָ֑עוּ וּ֝שְׁחָקִ֗ים יִרְעֲפוּ־טָֽל׃
verses.translation: By His knowledge the depths were broken up, And the skies drop down the dew.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּ֭נִי אַל־יָלֻ֣זוּ מֵעֵינֶ֑יךָ נְצֹ֥ר תֻּ֝שִׁיָּ֗ה וּמְזִמָּֽה׃
verses.translation: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes; Keep sound wisdom and discretion;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִֽהְי֣וּ חַיִּ֣ים לְנַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ וְ֝חֵ֗ן לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: So shall they be life unto thy soul, And grace to thy neck.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֤ז תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לָבֶ֣טַח דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝רַגְלְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תִגּֽוֹף׃
verses.translit: 'z tlkh lbtch drkhkh vrglkh l' tgvf
verses.translation: Then shalt thou walk in thy way securely, And thou shalt not dash thy foot.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־תִּשְׁכַּ֥ב לֹֽא־תִפְחָ֑ד וְ֝שָׁכַבְתָּ֗ וְֽעָרְבָ֥ה שְׁנָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid; Yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּ֭ירָא מִפַּ֣חַד פִּתְאֹ֑ם וּמִשֹּׁאַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים כִּ֣י תָבֹֽא׃
verses.translit: 'ltyr' mpchd pt'm vmsh't rsh'ym khy tb'
verses.translation: Be not afraid of sudden terror, Neither of the destruction of the wicked, when it cometh;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יְ֭הֹוָה יִֽהְיֶ֣ה בְכִסְלֶ֑ךָ וְשָׁמַ֖ר רַגְלְךָ֣ מִלָּֽכֶד׃
verses.translit: khyyhvh yhyh bkhslkh vshmr rglkh mlkhd
verses.translation: For the LORD will be thy confidence, And will keep thy foot from being caught.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּמְנַע־ט֥וֹב מִבְּעָלָ֑יו בִּֽהְי֨וֹת לְאֵ֖ל (ידיך) [יָדְךָ֣] לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
verses.translation: Withhold not good from him to whom it is due, When it is in the power of thy hand to do it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תֹּ֘אמַ֤ר (לרעיך) [לְרֵעֲךָ֨ ] לֵ֣ךְ וָ֭שׁוּב וּמָחָ֥ר אֶתֵּ֗ן וְיֵ֣שׁ אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.translation: Say not unto thy neighbour: ‘Go, and come again, And to-morrow I will give’; when thou hast it by thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תַּחֲרֹ֣שׁ עַל־רֵעֲךָ֣ רָעָ֑ה וְהֽוּא־יוֹשֵׁ֖ב לָבֶ֣טַח אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.translation: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, Seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־[תָּרִ֣יב] (תרוב) עִם־אָדָ֣ם חִנָּ֑ם אִם־לֹ֖א גְמָלְךָ֣ רָעָֽה׃
verses.translation: Strive not with a man without cause, If he have done thee no harm.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תְּ֭קַנֵּא בְּאִ֣ישׁ חָמָ֑ס וְאַל־תִּ֝בְחַ֗ר בְּכׇל־דְּרָכָֽיו׃
verses.translation: Envy thou not the man of violence, And choose none of his ways.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י תוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֣ה נָל֑וֹז וְֽאֶת־יְשָׁרִ֥ים סוֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy tv'bt yhvh nlvz v'tyshrym svdv
verses.translation: For the perverse is an abomination to the LORD; But His counsel is with the upright.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְאֵרַ֣ת יְ֭הֹוָה בְּבֵ֣ית רָשָׁ֑ע וּנְוֵ֖ה צַדִּיקִ֣ים יְבָרֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: m'rt yhvh bbyt rsh' vnvh tsdyqym ybrkh
verses.translation: The curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked; But He blesseth the habitation of the righteous.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־לַלֵּצִ֥ים הֽוּא־יָלִ֑יץ (ולעניים) [וְ֝לַעֲנָוִ֗ים] יִתֶּן־חֵֽן׃
verses.translation: If it concerneth the scorners, He scorneth them, But unto the humble He giveth grace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כָּ֭בוֹד חֲכָמִ֣ים יִנְחָ֑לוּ וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים מֵרִ֥ים קָלֽוֹן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khbvd chkhmym ynchlv vkhsylym mrym qlvn {p}
verses.translation: The wise shall inherit honour; But as for the fools, they carry away shame.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְע֣וּ בָ֭נִים מ֣וּסַר אָ֑ב וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבוּ לָדַ֥עַת בִּינָֽה׃
verses.translit: shm'v bnym mvsr 'b vhqshybv ld't bynh
verses.translation: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, And attend to know understanding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֶ֣קַח ט֭וֹב נָתַ֣תִּי לָכֶ֑ם תּ֝וֹרָתִ֗י אַֽל־תַּעֲזֹֽבוּ׃
verses.translit: khy lqch tvb ntty lkhm tvrty 'lt'zbv
verses.translation: For I give you a good taking; Forsake ye not my teaching.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־בֵ֭ן הָיִ֣יתִי לְאָבִ֑י רַ֥ךְ וְ֝יָחִ֗יד לִפְנֵ֥י אִמִּֽי׃
verses.translit: khybn hyyty l'by rkh vychyd lpny 'my
verses.translation: For I was a son unto my father, Tender and an only one in front of my mother.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּרֵ֗נִי וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לִ֗י יִֽתְמׇךְ־דְּבָרַ֥י לִבֶּ֑ךָ שְׁמֹ֖ר מִצְוֺתַ֣י וֶחְיֵֽה׃
verses.translit: vyrny vy'mr ly ytmkhdbry lbkh shmr mtsvty vchyh
verses.translation: And he taught me, and said unto me: ‘Let thy heart hold fast my words, Keep my commandments, and live;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קְנֵ֣ה חׇ֭כְמָה קְנֵ֣ה בִינָ֑ה אַל־תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח וְאַל־תֵּ֝֗ט מֵאִמְרֵי־פִֽי׃
verses.translit: qnh chkhmh qnh bynh 'ltshkhch v'ltt m'mrypy
verses.translation: Get wisdom, get understanding; Forget not, neither decline from the words of my mouth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תַּעַזְבֶ֥הָ וְתִשְׁמְרֶ֑ךָּ אֱהָבֶ֥הָ וְתִצְּרֶֽךָּ׃
verses.translation: Forsake her not, and she will preserve thee; Love her, and she will keep thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֵאשִׁ֣ית חׇ֭כְמָה קְנֵ֣ה חׇכְמָ֑ה וּבְכׇל־קִ֝נְיָנְךָ֗ קְנֵ֣ה בִינָֽה׃
verses.translit: r'shyt chkhmh qnh chkhmh vbkhlqnynkh qnh bynh
verses.translation: The beginning of wisdom is: Get wisdom; Yea, with all thy getting get understanding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סַלְסְלֶ֥הָ וּֽתְרוֹמְמֶ֑ךָּ תְּ֝כַבֵּ֗דְךָ כִּ֣י תְחַבְּקֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translation: Extol her, and she will exalt thee; She will bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭רֹאשְׁךָ לִוְיַת־חֵ֑ן עֲטֶ֖רֶת תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת תְּמַגְּנֶֽךָּ׃
verses.translation: She will give to thy head a chaplet of grace; A crown of glory will she bestow on thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע בְּ֭נִי וְקַ֣ח אֲמָרָ֑י וְיִרְבּ֥וּ לְ֝ךָ֗ שְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּֽים׃
verses.translit: shm' bny vqch 'mry vyrbv lkh shnvt chyym
verses.translation: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; And the years of thy life shall be many.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ חׇ֭כְמָה הֹרֵיתִ֑יךָ הִ֝דְרַכְתִּ֗יךָ בְּמַעְגְּלֵי־יֹֽשֶׁר׃
verses.translation: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in paths of uprightness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּֽ֭לֶכְתְּךָ לֹא־יֵצַ֣ר צַעֲדֶ֑ךָ וְאִם־תָּ֝ר֗וּץ לֹ֣א תִכָּשֵֽׁל׃
verses.translit: blkhtkh l'ytsr ts'dkh v'mtrvts l' tkhshl
verses.translation: When thou goest, thy step shall not be straitened; And if thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַחֲזֵ֣ק בַּמּוּסָ֣ר אַל־תֶּ֑רֶף נִ֝צְּרֶ֗הָ כִּי־הִ֥יא חַיֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: Take fast hold of instruction, let her not go; Keep her, for she is thy life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאֹ֣רַח רְ֭שָׁעִים אַל־תָּבֹ֑א וְאַל־תְּ֝אַשֵּׁ֗ר בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ רָעִֽים׃
verses.translation: Enter not into the path of the wicked, And walk not in the way of evil men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּרָעֵ֥הוּ אַל־תַּעֲבׇר־בּ֑וֹ שְׂטֵ֖ה מֵעָלָ֣יו וַעֲבֹֽר׃
verses.translation: Avoid it, pass not by it; Turn from it, and pass on.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א יִֽ֭שְׁנוּ אִם־לֹ֣א יָרֵ֑עוּ וְֽנִגְזְלָ֥ה שְׁ֝נָתָ֗ם אִם־לֹ֥א (יכשולו) [יַכְשִֽׁילוּ]׃
verses.translit: khy l' yshnv 'ml' yr'v vngzlh shntm 'ml' (ykhshvlv) [ykhshylv]
verses.translation: For they sleep not, except they have done evil; And their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י לָ֭חֲמוּ לֶ֣חֶם רֶ֑שַׁע וְיֵ֖ין חֲמָסִ֣ים יִשְׁתּֽוּ׃
verses.translit: khy lchmv lchm rsh' vyyn chmsym yshtv
verses.translation: For they eat the bread of wickedness, And drink the wine of violence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֹ֣רַח צַ֭דִּיקִים כְּא֣וֹר נֹ֑גַהּ הוֹלֵ֥ךְ וָ֝א֗וֹר עַד־נְכ֥וֹן הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: v'rch tsdyqym kh'vr ngh hvlkh v'vr 'dnkhvn hyvm
verses.translation: But the path of the righteous is as the light of dawn, That shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דֶּ֣רֶךְ רְ֭שָׁעִים כָּאֲפֵלָ֑ה לֹ֥א יָ֝דְע֗וּ בַּמֶּ֥ה יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: drkh rsh'ym kh'plh l' yd'v bmh ykhshlv {p}
verses.translation: The way of the wicked is as darkness; They know not at what they stumble.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּ֭נִי לִדְבָרַ֣י הַקְשִׁ֑יבָה לַ֝אֲמָרַ֗י הַט־אׇזְנֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: My son, attend to my words; Incline thine ear unto my sayings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־יַלִּ֥יזוּ מֵעֵינֶ֑יךָ שׇׁ֝מְרֵ֗ם בְּת֣וֹךְ לְבָבֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Let them not depart from thine eyes; Keep them in the midst of thy heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־חַיִּ֣ים הֵ֭ם לְמֹצְאֵיהֶ֑ם וּֽלְכׇל־בְּשָׂר֥וֹ מַרְפֵּֽא׃
verses.translation: For they are life unto those that find them, And health to all their flesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽכׇּל־מִ֭שְׁמָר נְצֹ֣ר לִבֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ תּוֹצְא֥וֹת חַיִּֽים׃
verses.translit: mkhlmshmr ntsr lbkh khymmnv tvts'vt chyym
verses.translation: Above all that thou guardest keep thy heart; For out of it are the issues of life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָסֵ֣ר מִ֭מְּךָ עִקְּשׁ֣וּת פֶּ֑ה וּלְז֥וּת שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם הַרְחֵ֥ק מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: hsr mmkh 'qshvt ph vlzvt shptym hrchq mmkh
verses.translation: Put away from thee a froward mouth, And perverse lips put far from thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵ֭ינֶיךָ לְנֹ֣כַח יַבִּ֑יטוּ וְ֝עַפְעַפֶּ֗יךָ יַיְשִׁ֥רוּ נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Let thine eyes look right on, And let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פַּ֭לֵּס מַעְגַּ֣ל רַגְלֶ֑ךָ וְֽכׇל־דְּרָכֶ֥יךָ יִכֹּֽנוּ׃
verses.translation: Make plain the path of thy feet, And let all thy ways be established.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַֽל־תֵּט־יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול הָסֵ֖ר רַגְלְךָ֣ מֵרָֽע׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left; Remove thy foot from evil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּ֭נִי לְחׇכְמָתִ֣י הַקְשִׁ֑יבָה לִ֝תְבוּנָתִ֗י הַט־אׇזְנֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: My son, attend unto my wisdom; Incline thine ear to my understanding;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִשְׁמֹ֥ר מְזִמּ֑וֹת וְ֝דַ֗עַת שְׂפָתֶ֥יךָ יִנְצֹֽרוּ׃
verses.translation: That thou mayest preserve discretion, And that thy lips may keep knowledge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י נֹ֣פֶת תִּ֭טֹּפְנָה שִׂפְתֵ֣י זָרָ֑ה וְחָלָ֖ק מִשֶּׁ֣מֶן חִכָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: khy npt ttpnh shpty zrh vchlq mshmn chkhh
verses.translation: For the lips of a strange woman drop honey, And her mouth is smoother than oil;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽ֭אַחֲרִיתָהּ מָרָ֣ה כַֽלַּעֲנָ֑ה חַ֝דָּ֗ה כְּחֶ֣רֶב פִּיּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'chryth mrh khl'nh chdh khchrb pyvt
verses.translation: But her end is bitter as wormwood, Sharp as a two-edged sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֭גְלֶיהָ יֹרְד֣וֹת מָ֑וֶת שְׁ֝א֗וֹל צְעָדֶ֥יהָ יִתְמֹֽכוּ׃
verses.translit: rglyh yrdvt mvt sh'vl ts'dyh ytmkhv
verses.translation: Her feet go down to death; Her steps take hold on the nether-world;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹ֣רַח חַ֭יִּים פֶּן־תְּפַלֵּ֑ס נָע֥וּ מַ֝עְגְּלֹתֶ֗יהָ לֹ֣א תֵדָֽע׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'rch chyym pntpls n'v m'gltyh l' td' {p}
verses.translation: Lest she should walk the even path of life, Her ways wander, but she knoweth it not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִ֑י וְאַל־תָּ֝ס֗וּרוּ מֵאִמְרֵי־פִֽי׃
verses.translation: Now therefore, O ye children, hearken unto me, And depart not from the words of my mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַרְחֵ֣ק מֵעָלֶ֣יהָ דַרְכֶּ֑ךָ וְאַל־תִּ֝קְרַ֗ב אֶל־פֶּ֥תַח בֵּיתָֽהּ׃
verses.translation: Remove thy way far from her, And come not nigh the door of her house;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּן־תִּתֵּ֣ן לַאֲחֵרִ֣ים הוֹדֶ֑ךָ וּ֝שְׁנֹתֶ֗יךָ לְאַכְזָרִֽי׃
verses.translation: Lest thou give thy vigour unto others, And thy years unto the cruel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּֽן־יִשְׂבְּע֣וּ זָרִ֣ים כֹּחֶ֑ךָ וַ֝עֲצָבֶ֗יךָ בְּבֵ֣ית נׇכְרִֽי׃
verses.translit: pnyshb'v zrym khchkh v'tsbykh bbyt nkhry
verses.translation: Lest strangers be filled with thy strength, And thy labours be in the house of an alien;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָהַמְתָּ֥ בְאַחֲרִיתֶ֑ךָ בִּכְל֥וֹת בְּ֝שָׂרְךָ֗ וּשְׁאֵרֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: And thou moan, when thine end cometh, When thy flesh and thy body are consumed,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאָמַרְתָּ֗ אֵ֭יךְ שָׂנֵ֣אתִי מוּסָ֑ר וְ֝תוֹכַ֗חַת נָאַ֥ץ לִבִּֽי׃
verses.translit: v'mrt 'ykh shn'ty mvsr vtvkhcht n'ts lby
verses.translation: And say: ‘How have I hated instruction, And my heart despised reproof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽלֹא־שָׁ֭מַעְתִּי בְּק֣וֹל מוֹרָ֑י וְ֝לִֽמְלַמְּדַ֗י לֹא־הִטִּ֥יתִי אׇזְנִֽי׃
verses.translation: Neither have I hearkened to the voice of my teachers, Nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֭מְעַט הָיִ֣יתִי בְכׇל־רָ֑ע בְּת֖וֹךְ קָהָ֣ל וְעֵדָֽה׃
verses.translit: khm't hyyty bkhlr' btvkh qhl v'dh
verses.translation: I was well nigh in all evil In the midst of the congregation and assembly.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁתֵה־מַ֥יִם מִבּוֹרֶ֑ךָ וְ֝נֹזְלִ֗ים מִתּ֥וֹךְ בְּאֵרֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, And running waters out of thine own well.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָפ֣וּצוּ מַעְיְנֹתֶ֣יךָ ח֑וּצָה בָּ֝רְחֹב֗וֹת פַּלְגֵי־מָֽיִם׃
verses.translation: Let thy springs be dispersed abroad, And courses of water in the streets.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִֽהְיוּ־לְךָ֥ לְבַדֶּ֑ךָ וְאֵ֖ין לְזָרִ֣ים אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.translation: Let them be only thine own, And not strangers’with thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהִֽי־מְקוֹרְךָ֥ בָר֑וּךְ וּ֝שְׂמַ֗ח מֵאֵ֥שֶׁת נְעוּרֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Let thy fountain be blessed; And have joy of the wife of thy youth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַיֶּ֥לֶת אֲהָבִ֗ים וְֽיַ֫עֲלַת־חֵ֥ן דַּ֭דֶּיהָ יְרַוֻּ֣ךָ בְכׇל־עֵ֑ת בְּ֝אַהֲבָתָ֗הּ תִּשְׁגֶּ֥ה תָמִֽיד׃
verses.translit: 'ylt 'hbym vy'ltchn ddyh yrvkh bkhl't b'hbth tshgh tmyd
verses.translation: A lovely hind and a graceful doe, Let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; With her love be thou ravished always.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָ֤מָּה תִשְׁגֶּ֣ה בְנִ֣י בְזָרָ֑ה וּ֝תְחַבֵּ֗ק חֵ֣ק נׇכְרִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vlmh tshgh bny bzrh vtchbq chq nkhryh
verses.translation: Why then wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, And embrace the bosom of an alien?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י נֹ֨כַח  עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הֹוָה דַּרְכֵי־אִ֑ישׁ וְֽכׇל־מַעְגְּלֹתָ֥יו מְפַלֵּֽס׃
verses.translit: khy nkhch  'yny yhvh drkhy'ysh vkhlm'gltyv mpls
verses.translation: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the LORD, And He maketh even all his paths.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲֽווֹנֹתָ֗יו יִלְכְּדֻנ֥וֹ אֶת־הָרָשָׁ֑ע וּבְחַבְלֵ֥י חַ֝טָּאת֗וֹ יִתָּמֵֽךְ׃
verses.translation: His own iniquities shall ensnare the wicked, And he shall be holden with the cords of his sin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֗וּא יָ֭מוּת בְּאֵ֣ין מוּסָ֑ר וּבְרֹ֖ב אִוַּלְתּ֣וֹ יִשְׁגֶּֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hv' ymvt b'yn mvsr vbrb 'vltv yshgh {p}
verses.translation: He shall die for lack of instruction; And in the greatness of his folly he shall reel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּ֭נִי אִם־עָרַ֣בְתָּ לְרֵעֶ֑ךָ תָּקַ֖עְתָּ לַזָּ֣ר כַּפֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: My son, if thou art become surety for thy neighbour, If thou hast struck thy hands for a stranger—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נוֹקַ֥שְׁתָּ בְאִמְרֵי־פִ֑יךָ נִ֝לְכַּ֗דְתָּ בְּאִמְרֵי־פִֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: Thou art snared by the words of thy mouth, Thou art caught by the words of thy mouth—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲשֵׂ֨ה זֹ֥את אֵפ֪וֹא ׀ בְּנִ֡י וְֽהִנָּצֵ֗ל כִּ֘י־בָ֤אתָ בְכַף־רֵעֶ֑ךָ לֵ֥ךְ הִ֝תְרַפֵּ֗ס וּרְהַ֥ב רֵעֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'shh z't 'pv'  bny vhntsl khyb't bkhfr'kh lkh htrps vrhb r'ykh
verses.translation: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, Seeing thou art come into the hand of thy neighbour; Go, humble thyself, and urge thy neighbour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּתֵּ֣ן שֵׁנָ֣ה לְעֵינֶ֑יךָ וּ֝תְנוּמָ֗ה לְעַפְעַפֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִ֭נָּצֵל כִּצְבִ֣י מִיָּ֑ד וּ֝כְצִפּ֗וֹר מִיַּ֥ד יָקֽוּשׁ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hntsl khtsby myd vkhtspvr myd yqvsh {p}
verses.translation: Deliver thyself as a gazelle from the hand [of the hunter], And as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵֽךְ־אֶל־נְמָלָ֥ה עָצֵ֑ל רְאֵ֖ה דְרָכֶ֣יהָ וַחֲכָֽם׃
verses.translation: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; Consider her ways, and be wise;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֵֽין־לָ֥הּ קָצִ֗ין שֹׁטֵ֥ר וּמֹשֵֽׁל׃
verses.translation: Which having no chief, Overseer, or ruler,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תָּכִ֣ין בַּקַּ֣יִץ לַחְמָ֑הּ אָגְרָ֥ה בַ֝קָּצִ֗יר מַאֲכָלָֽהּ׃
verses.translation: Provideth her bread in the summer, And gatherest her food in the harvest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־מָתַ֖י עָצֵ֥ל ׀ תִּשְׁכָּ֑ב מָ֝תַ֗י תָּק֥וּם מִשְּׁנָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? When wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְעַ֣ט שֵׁ֭נוֹת מְעַ֣ט תְּנוּמ֑וֹת מְעַ֓ט  חִבֻּ֖ק יָדַ֣יִם לִשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.translit: m't shnvt m't tnvmvt m't  chbq ydym lshkhb
verses.translation: ’Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to sleep’—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָֽא־כִמְהַלֵּ֥ךְ רֵאשֶׁ֑ךָ וּ֝מַחְסֹרְךָ֗ כְּאִ֣ישׁ מָגֵֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translation: So shall thy poverty come as a runner, And thy want as an armed man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָדָ֣ם בְּ֭לִיַּעַל אִ֣ישׁ אָ֑וֶן ה֝וֹלֵ֗ךְ עִקְּשׁ֥וּת פֶּֽה׃
verses.translation: A base person, a man of iniquity, Is he that walketh with a froward mouth; .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קֹרֵ֣ץ בְּ֭עֵינָו מֹלֵ֣ל בְּרַגְלָ֑ו מֹ֝רֶ֗ה בְּאֶצְבְּעֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: qrts b'ynv mll brglv mrh b'tsb'tyv
verses.translation: That winketh with his eyes, that scrapeth with his feet, That pointeth with his fingers;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּ֥הְפֻּכ֨וֹת  בְּלִבּ֗וֹ חֹרֵ֣שׁ רָ֣ע בְּכׇל־עֵ֑ת (מדנים) [מִדְיָנִ֥ים] יְשַׁלֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: thpkhvt  blbv chrsh r' bkhl't (mdnym) [mdynym] yshlch
verses.translation: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth evil continually; He soweth discord.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֗ן פִּ֭תְאֹם יָב֣וֹא אֵיד֑וֹ פֶּ֥תַע יִ֝שָּׁבֵ֗ר וְאֵ֣ין מַרְפֵּֽא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lkhn pt'm ybv' 'ydv pt' yshbr v'yn mrp' {p}
verses.translation: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; On a sudden shall he be broken, and that without remedy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֶׁשׁ־הֵ֭נָּה שָׂנֵ֣א יְהֹוָ֑ה וְ֝שֶׁ֗בַע (תועבות) [תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת] נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translation: There are six things which the LORD hateth, Yea, seven which are an abomination unto Him:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵינַ֣יִם רָ֭מוֹת לְשׁ֣וֹן שָׁ֑קֶר וְ֝יָדַ֗יִם שֹׁפְכ֥וֹת דָּם־נָקִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'ynym rmvt lshvn shqr vydym shpkhvt dmnqy
verses.translation: Haughty eyes, a lying tongue, And hands that shed innocent blood;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵ֗ב חֹ֭רֵשׁ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת אָ֑וֶן רַגְלַ֥יִם מְ֝מַהֲר֗וֹת לָר֥וּץ לָרָעָֽה׃
verses.translit: lb chrsh mchshbvt 'vn rglym mmhrvt lrvts lr'h
verses.translation: A heart that deviseth wicked thoughts, Feet that are swift in running to evil;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָפִ֣יחַ כְּ֭זָבִים עֵ֣ד שָׁ֑קֶר וּמְשַׁלֵּ֥חַ מְ֝דָנִ֗ים בֵּ֣ין אַחִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: ypych khzbym 'd shqr vmshlch mdnym byn 'chym {p}
verses.translation: A false witness that breatheth out lies, And he that soweth discord among brethren.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְצֹ֣ר בְּ֭נִי מִצְוַ֣ת אָבִ֑יךָ וְאַל־תִּ֝טֹּ֗שׁ תּוֹרַ֥ת אִמֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: My son, keep the commandment of thy father, And forsake not the teaching of thy mother;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קׇשְׁרֵ֣ם עַל־לִבְּךָ֣ תָמִ֑יד עׇ֝נְדֵ֗ם עַל־גַּרְגְּרֹתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Bind them continually upon thy heart, Tie them about thy neck.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּהִתְהַלֶּכְךָ֨  תַּנְחֶ֬ה אֹתָ֗ךְ בְּֽ֭שׇׁכְבְּךָ תִּשְׁמֹ֣ר עָלֶ֑יךָ וַ֝הֲקִיצ֗וֹתָ הִ֣יא תְשִׂיחֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: bhthlkhkh  tnchh 'tkh bshkhbkh tshmr 'lykh vhqytsvt hy' tshychkh
verses.translation: When thou walkest, it shall lead thee, When thou liest down, it shall watch over thee; And when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י נֵ֣ר מִ֭צְוָה וְת֣וֹרָה א֑וֹר וְדֶ֥רֶךְ חַ֝יִּ֗ים תּוֹכְח֥וֹת מוּסָֽר׃
verses.translit: khy nr mtsvh vtvrh 'vr vdrkh chyym tvkhchvt mvsr
verses.translation: For the commandment is a lamp, and the teaching is light, And reproofs of instruction are the way of life;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִ֭שְׁמׇרְךָ מֵאֵ֣שֶׁת רָ֑ע מֵ֝חֶלְקַ֗ת לָשׁ֥וֹן נׇכְרִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: lshmrkh m'sht r' mchlqt lshvn nkhryh
verses.translation: To keep thee from the evil woman, From the smoothness of the alien tongue.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תַּחְמֹ֣ד יׇ֭פְיָהּ בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ וְאַל־תִּ֝קָּחֲךָ֗ בְּעַפְעַפֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.translation: Lust not after her beauty in thy heart; Neither let her captivate thee with her eyelids.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י בְעַד־אִשָּׁ֥ה זוֹנָ֗ה עַֽד־כִּכַּ֫ר־לָ֥חֶם וְאֵ֥שֶׁת אִ֑ישׁ נֶ֖פֶשׁ יְקָרָ֣ה תָצֽוּד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy b'd'shh zvnh 'dkhkhrlchm v'sht 'ysh npsh yqrh ttsvd {p}
verses.translation: For on account of a harlot a man is brought to a loaf of bread, But the adulteress hunteth for the precious life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיַחְתֶּ֤ה אִ֓ישׁ אֵ֬שׁ בְּחֵיק֑וֹ וּ֝בְגָדָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִשָּׂרַֽפְנָה׃
verses.translation: Can a man take fire in his bosom, And his clothes not be burned?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יְהַלֵּ֣ךְ אִ֭ישׁ עַל־הַגֶּחָלִ֑ים וְ֝רַגְלָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִכָּוֶֽינָה׃
verses.translation: Or can one walk upon hot coals, And his feet not be scorched?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֵּ֗ן הַ֭בָּא אֶל־אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֑הוּ לֹ֥א יִ֝נָּקֶ֗ה כׇּֽל־הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: khn hb' 'l'sht r'hv l' ynqh khlhng' bh
verses.translation: So he that goeth in to his neighbour’s wife; Whosoever toucheth her shall not go unpunished.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יָב֣וּזוּ לַ֭גַּנָּב כִּ֣י יִגְנ֑וֹב לְמַלֵּ֥א נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ כִּ֣י יִרְעָֽב׃
verses.translit: l'ybvzv lgnb khy ygnvb lml' npshv khy yr'b
verses.translation: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal To satisfy his soul when he is hungry;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭נִמְצָא יְשַׁלֵּ֣ם שִׁבְעָתָ֑יִם אֶת־כׇּל־ה֖וֹן בֵּית֣וֹ יִתֵּֽן׃
verses.translation: But if he be found, he must restore sevenfold, He must give all the substance of his house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֹאֵ֣ף אִשָּׁ֣ה חֲסַר־לֵ֑ב מַֽשְׁחִ֥ית נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ ה֣וּא יַעֲשֶֽׂנָּה׃
verses.translit: n'f 'shh chsrlb mshchyt npshv hv' y'shnh
verses.translation: He that committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding; He doeth it that would destroy his own soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֶגַע־וְקָל֥וֹן יִמְצָ֑א וְ֝חֶרְפָּת֗וֹ לֹ֣א תִמָּחֶֽה׃
verses.translation: Wounds and dishonour shall he get, And his reproach shall not be wiped away. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־קִנְאָ֥ה חֲמַת־גָּ֑בֶר וְלֹא־יַ֝חְמ֗וֹל בְּי֣וֹם נָקָֽם׃
verses.translation: For jealousy is the rage of a man, And he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־יִ֭שָּׂא פְּנֵ֣י כׇל־כֹּ֑פֶר וְלֹא־יֹ֝אבֶ֗ה כִּ֣י תַרְבֶּה־שֹּֽׁחַד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: l'ysh' pny khlkhpr vl'y'bh khy trbhshchd {p}
verses.translation: He will not regard any ransom; Neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּ֭נִי שְׁמֹ֣ר אֲמָרָ֑י וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י תִּצְפֹּ֥ן אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.translation: My son, keep my words, And lay up my commandments with thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁמֹ֣ר מִצְוֺתַ֣י וֶחְיֵ֑ה וְ֝תוֹרָתִ֗י כְּאִישׁ֥וֹן עֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translation: Keep my commandments and live, And my teaching as the apple of thine eye.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קׇשְׁרֵ֥ם עַל־אֶצְבְּעֹתֶ֑יךָ כׇּ֝תְבֵ֗ם עַל־ל֥וּחַ לִבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translation: Bind them upon thy fingers, Write them upon the table of thy heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱמֹ֣ר לַ֭חׇכְמָה אֲחֹ֣תִי אָ֑תְּ וּ֝מֹדָ֗ע לַבִּינָ֥ה תִקְרָֽא׃
verses.translation: Say unto wisdom: ‘Thou art my sister’, And call understanding thy kinswoman;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִ֭שְׁמׇרְךָ מֵאִשָּׁ֣ה זָרָ֑ה מִ֝נׇּכְרִיָּ֗ה אֲמָרֶ֥יהָ הֶחֱלִֽיקָה׃
verses.translation: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, From the alien woman that maketh smooth her words.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֭י בְּחַלּ֣וֹן בֵּיתִ֑י בְּעַ֖ד אֶשְׁנַבִּ֣י נִשְׁקָֽפְתִּי׃
verses.translation: For at the window of my house I looked forth through my lattice;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֵ֤רֶא בַפְּתָאיִ֗ם אָ֘בִ֤ינָה בַבָּנִ֗ים נַ֣עַר חֲסַר־לֵֽב׃
verses.translation: And I beheld among the thoughtless ones, I discerned among the youths, A young man void of understanding,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹבֵ֣ר בַּ֭שּׁוּק אֵ֣צֶל פִּנָּ֑הּ וְדֶ֖רֶךְ בֵּיתָ֣הּ יִצְעָֽד׃
verses.translation: Passing through the street near her corner, And he went the way to her house;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֶֽשֶׁף־בְּעֶ֥רֶב י֑וֹם בְּאִישׁ֥וֹן לַ֝֗יְלָה וַאֲפֵלָֽה׃
verses.translation: In the twilight, in the evening of the day, In the blackness of night and the darkness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה אִ֭שָּׁה לִקְרָאת֑וֹ שִׁ֥ית ז֝וֹנָ֗ה וּנְצֻ֥רַת לֵֽב׃
verses.translit: vhnh 'shh lqr'tv shyt zvnh vntsrt lb
verses.translation: And, behold, there met him a woman With the attire of a harlot, and wily of heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֹמִיָּ֣ה הִ֣יא וְסֹרָ֑רֶת בְּ֝בֵיתָ֗הּ לֹא־יִשְׁכְּנ֥וּ רַגְלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: hmyh hy' vsrrt bbyth l'yshkhnv rglyh
verses.translation: She is riotous and rebellious, Her feet abide not in her house;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פַּ֤עַם  בַּח֗וּץ פַּ֥עַם בָּרְחֹב֑וֹת וְאֵ֖צֶל כׇּל־פִּנָּ֣ה תֶאֱרֹֽב׃
verses.translit: p'm  bchvts p'm brchbvt v'tsl khlpnh t'rb
verses.translation: Now she is in the streets, now in the broad places, And lieth in wait at every corner.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֶחֱזִ֣יקָה בּ֭וֹ וְנָ֣שְׁקָה לּ֑וֹ הֵעֵ֥זָה פָ֝נֶ֗יהָ וַתֹּ֣אמַר לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhchzyqh bv vnshqh lv h'zh pnyh vt'mr lv
verses.translation: So she caught him, and kissed him, And with an impudent face she said unto him:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זִבְחֵ֣י שְׁלָמִ֣ים עָלָ֑י הַ֝יּ֗וֹם שִׁלַּ֥מְתִּי נְדָרָֽי׃
verses.translation: ’Sacrifices of peace-offerings were due from me; This day have I paid my vows.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֭ן יָצָ֣אתִי לִקְרָאתֶ֑ךָ לְשַׁחֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וָאֶמְצָאֶֽךָּ׃
verses.translation: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, To seek thy face, and I have found thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַ֭רְבַדִּים רָבַ֣דְתִּי עַרְשִׂ֑י חֲ֝טֻב֗וֹת אֵט֥וּן מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translation: I have decked my couch with coverlets, With striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַ֥פְתִּי מִשְׁכָּבִ֑י מֹ֥ר אֲ֝הָלִ֗ים וְקִנָּמֽוֹן׃
verses.translation: I have perfumed my bed With myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְכָ֤ה נִרְוֶ֣ה דֹ֭דִים עַד־הַבֹּ֑קֶר נִ֝תְעַלְּסָ֗ה בׇּאֳהָבִֽים׃
verses.translation: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning; Let us solace ourselves with loves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין הָאִ֣ישׁ בְּבֵית֑וֹ הָ֝לַ֗ךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ מֵרָחֽוֹק׃
verses.translit: khy 'yn h'ysh bbytv hlkh bdrkh mrchvq
verses.translation: For my husband is not at home, He is gone a long journey;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צְֽרוֹר־הַ֭כֶּסֶף לָקַ֣ח בְּיָד֑וֹ לְי֥וֹם הַ֝כֵּ֗סֶא יָבֹ֥א בֵיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: tsrvrhkhsf lqch bydv lyvm hkhs' yb' bytv
verses.translation: He hath taken the bag of money with him; He will come home at the full moon.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִ֭טַּתּוּ בְּרֹ֣ב לִקְחָ֑הּ בְּחֵ֥לֶק שְׂ֝פָתֶ֗יהָ תַּדִּיחֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: httv brb lqchh bchlq shptyh tdychnv
verses.translation: With her much fair speech she causeth him to yield, With the blandishment of her lips she enticeth him away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֤וֹלֵ֥ךְ אַחֲרֶ֗יהָ פִּ֫תְאֹ֥ם כְּ֭שׁוֹר אֶל־טֶ֣בַח יָבֹ֑א וּ֝כְעֶ֗כֶס אֶל־מוּסַ֥ר אֱוִֽיל׃
verses.translation: He goeth after her straightway, As an ox that goeth to the slaughter, Or as one in fetters to the correction of the fool;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֤ד יְפַלַּ֪ח חֵ֡ץ כְּֽבֵד֗וֹ כְּמַהֵ֣ר צִפּ֣וֹר אֶל־פָּ֑ח וְלֹא־יָ֝דַ֗ע כִּֽי־בְנַפְשׁ֥וֹ הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: 'd yplch chts khbdv khmhr tspvr 'lpch vl'yd' khybnpshv hv'
verses.translation: Till an arrow strike through his liver; As a bird hasteneth to the snare— And knoweth not that it is at the cost of his life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִ֑י וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבוּ לְאִמְרֵי־פִֽי׃
verses.translation: Now therefore, O ye children, hearken unto me, And attend to the words of my mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־יֵ֣שְׂטְ אֶל־דְּרָכֶ֣יהָ לִבֶּ֑ךָ אַל־תֵּ֝֗תַע בִּנְתִיבוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translation: Let not thy heart decline to her ways, Go not astray in her paths.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־רַבִּ֣ים חֲלָלִ֣ים הִפִּ֑ילָה וַ֝עֲצֻמִ֗ים כׇּל־הֲרֻגֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translation: For she hath cast down many wounded; Yea, a mighty host are all her slain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּרְכֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל בֵּיתָ֑הּ יֹ֝רְד֗וֹת אֶל־חַדְרֵי־מָֽוֶת׃ {פ}
verses.translation: Her house is the way to the nether-world, Going down to the chambers of death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹֽא־חׇכְמָ֥ה תִקְרָ֑א וּ֝תְבוּנָ֗ה תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלָֽהּ׃
verses.translation: Doth not wisdom call, And understanding put forth her voice?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּרֹאשׁ־מְרֹמִ֥ים עֲלֵי־דָ֑רֶךְ בֵּ֖ית נְתִיב֣וֹת נִצָּֽבָה׃
verses.translation: In the top of high places by the way, Where the paths meet, she standeth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְיַד־שְׁעָרִ֥ים לְפִי־קָ֑רֶת מְב֖וֹא פְתָחִ֣ים תָּרֹֽנָּה׃
verses.translation: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, At the coming in at the doors, she crieth aloud:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲלֵיכֶ֣ם אִישִׁ֣ים אֶקְרָ֑א וְ֝קוֹלִ֗י אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.translation: ’Unto you, O men, I call, And my voice is to the sons of men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָבִ֣ינוּ פְתָאיִ֣ם עׇרְמָ֑ה וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים הָבִ֥ינוּ לֵֽב׃
verses.translation: O ye thoughtless, understand prudence, And, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֭מְעוּ כִּֽי־נְגִידִ֣ים אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וּמִפְתַּ֥ח שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י מֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.translation: Hear, for I will speak excellent things, And the opening of my lips shall be right things.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אֱ֭מֶת יֶהְגֶּ֣ה חִכִּ֑י וְתוֹעֲבַ֖ת שְׂפָתַ֣י רֶֽשַׁע׃
verses.translit: khy'mt yhgh chkhy vtv'bt shpty rsh'
verses.translation: For my mouth shall utter truth, And wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּצֶ֥דֶק כׇּל־אִמְרֵי־פִ֑י אֵ֥ין בָּ֝הֶ֗ם נִפְתָּ֥ל וְעִקֵּֽשׁ׃
verses.translation: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness, There is nothing perverse or crooked in them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֣ם נְ֭כֹחִים לַמֵּבִ֑ין וִ֝ישָׁרִ֗ים לְמֹ֣צְאֵי דָֽעַת׃
verses.translit: khlm nkhchym lmbyn vyshrym lmts'y d't
verses.translation: They are all plain to him that understandeth, And right to them that find knowledge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קְחֽוּ־מוּסָרִ֥י וְאַל־כָּ֑סֶף וְ֝דַ֗עַת מֵחָר֥וּץ נִבְחָֽר׃
verses.translation: Receive my instruction, and not silver, And knowledge rather than choice gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־טוֹבָ֣ה חׇ֭כְמָה מִפְּנִינִ֑ים וְכׇל־חֲ֝פָצִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִֽשְׁווּ־בָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: khytvbh chkhmh mpnynym vkhlchptsym l' yshvvbh
verses.translation: For wisdom is better than rubies, And all things desirable are not to be compared unto her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲֽנִי־חׇ֭כְמָה שָׁכַ֣נְתִּי עׇרְמָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת מְזִמּ֣וֹת אֶמְצָֽא׃
verses.translation: I wisdom dwell with prudence, And find out knowledge of devices.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֥רְאַ֣ת יְהֹוָה֮ שְֽׂנֹ֫את־רָ֥ע גֵּ֘אָ֤ה וְגָא֨וֹן  וְדֶ֣רֶךְ רָ֭ע וּפִ֨י תַהְפֻּכ֬וֹת שָׂנֵֽאתִי׃
verses.translit: yr't yhvh shn'tr' g'h vg'vn  vdrkh r' vpy thpkhvt shn'ty
verses.translation: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil; Pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, And the froward mouth, do I hate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִֽי־עֵ֭צָה וְתוּשִׁיָּ֑ה אֲנִ֥י בִ֝ינָ֗ה לִ֣י גְבוּרָֽה׃
verses.translation: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom; I am understanding, power is mine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּ֭י מְלָכִ֣ים יִמְלֹ֑כוּ וְ֝רֹזְנִ֗ים יְחֹ֣קְקוּ צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.translit: by mlkhym ymlkhv vrznym ychqqv tsdq
verses.translation: By me kings reign, And princes decree justice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּ֭י שָׂרִ֣ים יָשֹׂ֑רוּ וּ֝נְדִיבִ֗ים כׇּל־שֹׁ֥פְטֵי צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.translit: by shrym yshrv vndybym khlshpty tsdq
verses.translation: By me princes rule, And nobles, even all the judges of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲ֭נִי (אהביה) [אֹהֲבַ֣י] אֵהָ֑ב וּ֝מְשַׁחֲרַ֗י יִמְצָאֻֽנְנִי׃
verses.translation: I love them that love me, And those that seek me earnestly shall find me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹֽשֶׁר־וְכָב֥וֹד אִתִּ֑י ה֥וֹן עָ֝תֵ֗ק וּצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.translation: Riches and honour are with me; Yea, enduring riches and righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֣וֹב פִּ֭רְיִי מֵחָר֣וּץ וּמִפָּ֑ז וּ֝תְבוּאָתִ֗י מִכֶּ֥סֶף נִבְחָֽר׃
verses.translit: tvb pryy mchrvts vmpz vtbv'ty mkhsf nbchr
verses.translation: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; And my produce than choice silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאֹֽרַח־צְדָקָ֥ה אֲהַלֵּ֑ךְ בְּ֝ת֗וֹךְ נְתִיב֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translation: I walk in the way of righteousness, In the midst of the paths of justice;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְהַנְחִ֖יל אֹהֲבַ֥י ׀ יֵ֑שׁ וְאֹצְרֹ֖תֵיהֶ֣ם אֲמַלֵּֽא׃
verses.translation: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance, And that I may fill their treasuries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה קָ֭נָנִי רֵאשִׁ֣ית דַּרְכּ֑וֹ קֶ֖דֶם מִפְעָלָ֣יו מֵאָֽז׃
verses.translit: yhvh qnny r'shyt drkhv qdm mp'lyv m'z
verses.translation: The LORD made me as the beginning of His way, The first of His works of old.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵ֭עוֹלָם נִסַּ֥כְתִּי מֵרֹ֗אשׁ מִקַּדְמֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translation: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, Or ever the earth was.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאֵין־תְּהֹמ֥וֹת חוֹלָ֑לְתִּי בְּאֵ֥ין מַ֝עְיָנ֗וֹת נִכְבַּדֵּי־מָֽיִם׃
verses.translation: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; When there were no fountains abounding with water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּטֶ֣רֶם הָרִ֣ים הׇטְבָּ֑עוּ לִפְנֵ֖י גְבָע֣וֹת חוֹלָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.translit: btrm hrym htb'v lpny gb'vt chvllty
verses.translation: Before the mountains were settled, Before the hills was I brought forth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־לֹ֣א עָ֭שָׂה אֶ֣רֶץ וְחוּצ֑וֹת וְ֝רֹ֗אשׁ עַפְר֥וֹת תֵּבֵֽל׃
verses.translation: While as yet He had not made the earth, nor the fields, Nor the beginning of the dust of the world.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּהֲכִינ֣וֹ שָׁ֭מַיִם שָׁ֣ם אָ֑נִי בְּחֻ֥קוֹ ח֝֗וּג עַל־פְּנֵ֥י תְהֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: bhkhynv shmym shm 'ny bchqv chvg 'lpny thvm
verses.translation: When He established the heavens, I was there; When He set a circle upon the face of the deep,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאַמְּצ֣וֹ שְׁחָקִ֣ים מִמָּ֑עַל בַּ֝עֲז֗וֹז עִינ֥וֹת תְּהֽוֹם׃
verses.translation: When He made firm the skies above, When the fountains of the deep showed their might,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּשׂ֘וּמ֤וֹ לַיָּ֨ם  חֻקּ֗וֹ וּ֭מַיִם לֹ֣א יַֽעַבְרוּ־פִ֑יו בְּ֝חוּק֗וֹ מ֣וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: bshvmv lym  chqv vmym l' y'brvpyv bchvqv mvsdy 'rts
verses.translation: When He gave to the sea His decree, That the waters should not transgress His commandment, When He appointed the foundations of the earth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶהְיֶ֥ה אֶצְל֗וֹ אָ֫מ֥וֹן וָאֶהְיֶ֣ה שַׁ֭עֲשׁוּעִים י֤וֹם  י֑וֹם מְשַׂחֶ֖קֶת לְפָנָ֣יו בְּכׇל־עֵֽת׃
verses.translit: v'hyh 'tslv 'mvn v'hyh sh'shv'ym yvm  yvm mshchqt lpnyv bkhl't
verses.translation: Then I was by Him, as a nursling; And I was daily all delight, Playing always before Him,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְ֭שַׂחֶקֶת בְּתֵבֵ֣ל אַרְצ֑וֹ וְ֝שַׁעֲשֻׁעַ֗י אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃ {פ}
