verses.translation: Playing in His habitable earth, And my delights are with the sons of men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִ֑י וְ֝אַשְׁרֵ֗י דְּרָכַ֥י יִשְׁמֹֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: v'th bnym shm'vly v'shry drkhy yshmrv
verses.translation: Now therefore, ye children, hearken unto me; For happy are they that keep my ways.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְע֖וּ מוּסָ֥ר וַחֲכָ֗מוּ וְאַל־תִּפְרָֽעוּ׃
verses.translation: Hear instruction, and be wise, And refuse it not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי־אָדָם֮ שֹׁמֵ֢עַֽ֫ לִ֥י לִשְׁקֹ֣ד עַל־דַּ֭לְתֹתַי י֤וֹם  י֑וֹם לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר מְזוּזֹ֥ת פְּתָחָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'shry'dm shm' ly lshqd 'ldltty yvm  yvm lshmr mzvzt ptchy
verses.translation: Happy is the man that hearkeneth to me, Watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י מֹ֭צְאִי (מצאי) [מָצָ֣א] חַיִּ֑ים וַיָּ֥פֶק רָ֝צ֗וֹן מֵיְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy mts'y (mts'y) [mts'] chyym vypq rtsvn myhvh
verses.translation: For whoso findeth me findeth life, And obtaineth favour of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽ֭חֹטְאִי חֹמֵ֣ס נַפְשׁ֑וֹ כׇּל־מְ֝שַׂנְאַ֗י אָ֣הֲבוּ מָֽוֶת׃
verses.translation: But he that misseth me wrongeth his own soul; All they that hate me love death.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חׇ֭כְמוֹת בָּנְתָ֣ה בֵיתָ֑הּ חָצְבָ֖ה עַמּוּדֶ֣יהָ שִׁבְעָֽה׃
verses.translation: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טָבְחָ֣ה טִ֭בְחָהּ מָסְכָ֣ה יֵינָ֑הּ אַ֝֗ף עָרְכָ֥ה שֻׁלְחָנָֽהּ׃
verses.translation: She hath prepared her meat, she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁלְחָ֣ה נַעֲרֹתֶ֣יהָ תִקְרָ֑א עַל־גַּ֝פֵּ֗י מְרֹ֣מֵי קָֽרֶת׃
verses.translation: She hath sent forth her maidens, she calleth, upon the highest places of the city:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־פֶ֭תִי יָסֻ֣ר הֵ֑נָּה חֲסַר־לֵ֝֗ב אָ֣מְרָה לּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: ’Whoso is thoughtless, let him turn in hither’; as for him that lacketh understanding, she saith to him:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֭כוּ לַחֲמ֣וּ בְֽלַחֲמִ֑י וּ֝שְׁת֗וּ בְּיַ֣יִן מָסָֽכְתִּי׃
verses.translit: lkhv lchmv blchmy vshtv byyn mskhty
verses.translation: 'Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִזְב֣וּ פְתָאיִ֣ם וִֽחְי֑וּ וְ֝אִשְׁר֗וּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ בִּינָֽה׃
verses.translation: Forsake all thoughtlessness, and live; and walk in the way of understanding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֹ֤סֵ֨ר  לֵ֗ץ לֹקֵ֣חַֽ ל֣וֹ קָל֑וֹן וּמוֹכִ֖יחַ לְרָשָׁ֣ע מוּמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: ysr  lts lqch lv qlvn vmvkhych lrsh' mvmv
verses.translation: He that correcteth a scorner getteth to himself shame, and he that reproveth a wicked man, it becometh unto him a blot.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תּ֣וֹכַח לֵ֭ץ פֶּן־יִשְׂנָאֶ֑ךָּ הוֹכַ֥ח לְ֝חָכָ֗ם וְיֶאֱהָבֶֽךָּ׃
verses.translation: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee; reprove a wise man, and he will love thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תֵּ֣ן לְ֭חָכָם וְיֶחְכַּם־ע֑וֹד הוֹדַ֥ע לְ֝צַדִּ֗יק וְי֣וֹסֶף לֶֽקַח׃
verses.translit: tn lchkhm vychkhm'vd hvd' ltsdyq vyvsf lqch
verses.translation: Give to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser; teach a righteous man, and he will increase in learning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּחִלַּ֣ת חׇ֭כְמָה יִרְאַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת קְדֹשִׁ֣ים בִּינָֽה׃
verses.translit: tchlt chkhmh yr't yhvh vd't qdshym bynh
verses.translation: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and the knowledge of the All-holy is understanding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־בִ֭י יִרְבּ֣וּ יָמֶ֑יךָ וְיוֹסִ֥יפוּ לְּ֝ךָ֗ שְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּֽים׃
verses.translit: khyby yrbv ymykh vyvsypv lkh shnvt chyym
verses.translation: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.translation: If thou art wise, thou art wise for thyself; And if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣שֶׁת כְּ֭סִילוּת הֹמִיָּ֑ה פְּ֝תַיּ֗וּת וּבַל־יָ֥דְעָה מָּֽה׃
verses.translation: The woman Folly is riotous; She is thoughtless, and knoweth nothing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽ֭יָשְׁבָה לְפֶ֣תַח בֵּיתָ֑הּ עַל־כִּ֝סֵּ֗א מְרֹ֣מֵי קָֽרֶת׃
verses.translation: And she sitteth at the door of her house, On a seat in the high places of the city,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִקְרֹ֥א לְעֹֽבְרֵי־דָ֑רֶךְ הַֽ֝מְיַשְּׁרִ֗ים אֹֽרְחוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translation: To call to them that pass by, Who go right on their ways:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־פֶ֭תִי יָסֻ֣ר הֵ֑נָּה וַחֲסַר־לֵ֝֗ב וְאָ֣מְרָה לּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mypty ysr hnh vchsrlb v'mrh lv
verses.translation: ’Whoso is thoughtless, let him turn in hither’; And as for him that lacketh understanding, she saith to him:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַֽיִם־גְּנוּבִ֥ים יִמְתָּ֑קוּ וְלֶ֖חֶם סְתָרִ֣ים יִנְעָֽם׃
verses.translation: ’Stolen waters are sweet, And bread eaten in secret is pleasant.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽלֹא־יָ֭דַע כִּֽי־רְפָאִ֣ים שָׁ֑ם בְּעִמְקֵ֖י שְׁא֣וֹל קְרֻאֶֽיהָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vl'yd' khyrp'ym shm b'mqy sh'vl qr'yh {p}
verses.translation: But he knoweth not that the shades are there; that her guests are in the depths of the nether-world.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִשְׁלֵ֗י שְׁלֹ֫מֹ֥ה בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם יְשַׂמַּח־אָ֑ב וּבֵ֥ן כְּ֝סִ֗יל תּוּגַ֥ת אִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mshly shlmh bn chkhm yshmch'b vbn khsyl tvgt 'mv
verses.translation: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father; but a foolish son is the grief of his mother.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־י֭וֹעִילוּ אוֹצְר֣וֹת רֶ֑שַׁע וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה תַּצִּ֥יל מִמָּֽוֶת׃
verses.translation: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing; but righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יַרְעִ֣יב יְ֭הֹוָה נֶ֣פֶשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וְהַוַּ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים יֶהְדֹּֽף׃
verses.translit: l'yr'yb yhvh npsh tsdyq vhvt rsh'ym yhdf
verses.translation: The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish; but He thrusteth away the desire of the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָ֗אשׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה כַף־רְמִיָּ֑ה וְיַ֖ד חָרוּצִ֣ים תַּעֲשִֽׁיר׃
verses.translation: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand; but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹגֵ֣ר בַּ֭קַּיִץ בֵּ֣ן מַשְׂכִּ֑יל נִרְדָּ֥ם בַּ֝קָּצִ֗יר בֵּ֣ן מֵבִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: 'gr bqyts bn mshkhyl nrdm bqtsyr bn mbysh
verses.translation: A wise son gathereth in summer; but a son that doeth shamefully sleepeth in harvest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּ֭רָכוֹת לְרֹ֣אשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְכַסֶּ֥ה חָמָֽס׃
verses.translit: brkhvt lr'sh tsdyq vpy rsh'ym ykhsh chms
verses.translation: Blessings are upon the head of the righteous; but the mouth of the wicked concealeth violence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֵ֣כֶר צַ֭דִּיק לִבְרָכָ֑ה וְשֵׁ֖ם רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִרְקָֽב׃
verses.translit: zkhr tsdyq lbrkhh vshm rsh'ym yrqb
verses.translation: The memory of the righteous shall be for a blessing; but the name of the wicked shall rot.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲכַם־לֵ֭ב יִקַּ֣ח מִצְוֺ֑ת וֶאֱוִ֥יל שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יִלָּבֵֽט׃
verses.translit: chkhmlb yqch mtsvt v'vyl shptym ylbt
verses.translation: The wise in heart will receive commandments; but a prating fool shall fall.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בַּ֭תֹּם יֵ֣לֶךְ בֶּ֑טַח וּמְעַקֵּ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכָ֗יו יִוָּדֵֽעַ׃
verses.translit: hvlkh btm ylkh btch vm'qsh drkhyv yvd'
verses.translation: He that walketh uprightly walketh securely; but he that perverteth his ways shall be found out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קֹ֣רֵֽץ עַ֭יִן יִתֵּ֣ן עַצָּ֑בֶת וֶאֱוִ֥יל שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יִלָּבֵֽט׃
verses.translation: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow; and a prating fool shall fall.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְק֣וֹר חַ֭יִּים פִּ֣י צַדִּ֑יק וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְכַסֶּ֥ה חָמָֽס׃
verses.translit: mqvr chyym py tsdyq vpy rsh'ym ykhsh chms
verses.translation: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life; but the mouth of the wicked concealeth violence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׂ֭נְאָה תְּעֹרֵ֣ר מְדָנִ֑ים וְעַ֥ל כׇּל־פְּ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תְּכַסֶּ֥ה אַהֲבָֽה׃
verses.translit: shn'h t'rr mdnym v'l khlpsh'ym tkhsh 'hbh
verses.translation: Hatred stirreth up strifes; but love covereth all transgressions.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּשִׂפְתֵ֣י נָ֭בוֹן תִּמָּצֵ֣א חׇכְמָ֑ה וְ֝שֵׁ֗בֶט לְגֵ֣ו חֲסַר־לֵֽב׃
verses.translit: bshpty nbvn tmts' chkhmh vshbt lgv chsrlb
verses.translation: In the lips of him that hath discernment wisdom is found; but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲכָמִ֥ים יִצְפְּנוּ־דָ֑עַת וּפִֽי־אֱ֝וִ֗יל מְחִתָּ֥ה קְרֹבָֽה׃
verses.translation: Wise men lay up knowledge; but the mouth of the foolish is an imminent ruin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֣וֹן עָ֭שִׁיר קִרְיַ֣ת עֻזּ֑וֹ מְחִתַּ֖ת דַּלִּ֣ים רֵישָֽׁם׃
verses.translation: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city; the ruin of the poor is their poverty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּעֻלַּ֣ת צַדִּ֣יק לְחַיִּ֑ים תְּבוּאַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע לְחַטָּֽאת׃
verses.translit: p'lt tsdyq lchyym tbv't rsh' lcht't
verses.translation: The wages of the righteous is life; The increase of the wicked is sin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹ֣רַח לְ֭חַיִּים שׁוֹמֵ֣ר מוּסָ֑ר וְעֹזֵ֖ב תּוֹכַ֣חַת מַתְעֶֽה׃
verses.translit: 'rch lchyym shvmr mvsr v'zb tvkhcht mt'h
verses.translation: He is in the way of life that heedeth instruction; But he that forsaketh reproof erreth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְכַסֶּ֣ה שִׂ֭נְאָה שִׂפְתֵי־שָׁ֑קֶר וּמוֹצִ֥א דִ֝בָּ֗ה ה֣וּא כְסִֽיל׃
verses.translit: mkhsh shn'h shptyshqr vmvts' dbh hv' khsyl
verses.translation: He that hideth hatred is of lying lips; And he that uttereth a slander is a fool.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּרֹ֣ב דְּ֭בָרִים לֹ֣א יֶחְדַּל־פָּ֑שַׁע וְחוֹשֵׂ֖ךְ שְׂפָתָ֣יו מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃
verses.translit: brb dbrym l' ychdlpsh' vchvshkh shptyv mshkhyl
verses.translation: In the multitude of words there wanteth not transgression; But he that refraineth his lips is wise.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֶּ֣סֶף נִ֭בְחָר לְשׁ֣וֹן צַדִּ֑יק לֵ֖ב רְשָׁעִ֣ים כִּמְעָֽט׃
verses.translit: khsf nbchr lshvn tsdyq lb rsh'ym khm't
verses.translation: The tongue of the righteous is as choice silver; The heart of the wicked is little worth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׂפְתֵ֣י צַ֭דִּיק יִרְע֣וּ רַבִּ֑ים וֶ֝אֱוִילִ֗ים בַּחֲסַר־לֵ֥ב יָמֽוּתוּ׃
verses.translit: shpty tsdyq yr'v rbym v'vylym bchsrlb ymvtv
verses.translation: The lips of the righteous feed many; But the foolish die for want of understanding. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּרְכַּ֣ת יְ֭הֹוָה הִ֣יא תַעֲשִׁ֑יר וְלֹֽא־יוֹסִ֖ף עֶ֣צֶב עִמָּֽהּ׃
verses.translation: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, And toil addeth nothing thereto.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּשְׂח֣וֹק לִ֭כְסִיל עֲשׂ֣וֹת זִמָּ֑ה וְ֝חׇכְמָ֗ה לְאִ֣ישׁ תְּבוּנָֽה׃
verses.translit: khshchvq lkhsyl 'shvt zmh vchkhmh l'ysh tbvnh
verses.translation: It is as sport to a fool to do wickedness, And so is wisdom to a man of discernment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְגוֹרַ֣ת רָ֭שָׁע הִ֣יא תְבוֹאֶ֑נּוּ וְתַאֲוַ֖ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִתֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: mgvrt rsh' hy' tbv'nv vt'vt tsdyqym ytn
verses.translation: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him; And the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּעֲב֣וֹר ס֭וּפָה וְאֵ֣ין רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק יְס֣וֹד עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: kh'bvr svph v'yn rsh' vtsdyq ysvd 'vlm
verses.translation: When the whirlwind passeth, the wicked is no more; But the righteous is an everlasting foundation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּחֹ֤מֶץ  לַשִּׁנַּ֗יִם וְכֶעָשָׁ֥ן לָעֵינָ֑יִם כֵּ֥ן הֶ֝עָצֵ֗ל לְשֹׁלְחָֽיו׃
verses.translit: khchmts  lshnym vkh'shn l'ynym khn h'tsl lshlchyv
verses.translation: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, So is the sluggard to them that send him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הֹוָה תּוֹסִ֣יף יָמִ֑ים וּשְׁנ֖וֹת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּקְצֹֽרְנָה׃
verses.translit: yr't yhvh tvsyf ymym vshnvt rsh'ym tqtsrnh
verses.translation: The fear of the LORD prolongeth days; But the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תּוֹחֶ֣לֶת צַדִּיקִ֣ים שִׂמְחָ֑ה וְתִקְוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃
verses.translit: tvchlt tsdyqym shmchh vtqvt rsh'ym t'bd
verses.translation: The hope of the righteous is gladness; But the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָע֣וֹז לַ֭תֹּם דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהֹוָ֑ה וּ֝מְחִתָּ֗ה לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.translit: m'vz ltm drkh yhvh vmchth lp'ly 'vn
verses.translation: The way of the LORD is a stronghold to the upright, But ruin to the workers of iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צַ֭דִּיק לְעוֹלָ֣ם בַּל־יִמּ֑וֹט וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִשְׁכְּנוּ־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: tsdyq l'vlm blymvt vrsh'ym l' yshkhnv'rts
verses.translation: The righteous shall never be moved; But the wicked shall not inhabit the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פִּֽי־צַ֭דִּיק יָנ֣וּב חׇכְמָ֑ה וּלְשׁ֥וֹן תַּ֝הְפֻּכ֗וֹת תִּכָּרֵֽת׃
verses.translit: pytsdyq ynvb chkhmh vlshvn thpkhvt tkhrt
verses.translation: The mouth of the righteous buddeth with wisdom; But the froward tongue shall be cut off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׂפְתֵ֣י צַ֭דִּיק יֵדְע֣וּן רָצ֑וֹן וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: shpty tsdyq yd'vn rtsvn vpy rsh'ym thpkhvt
verses.translation: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable; But the mouth of the wicked is all frowardness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֹאזְנֵ֣י מִ֭רְמָה תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֑ה וְאֶ֖בֶן שְׁלֵמָ֣ה רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: m'zny mrmh tv'bt yhvh v'bn shlmh rtsvnv
verses.translation: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD; But a perfect weight is His delight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּֽא־זָ֭דוֹן וַיָּבֹ֣א קָל֑וֹן וְֽאֶת־צְנוּעִ֥ים חׇכְמָֽה׃
verses.translation: When pride cometh, then cometh shame; But with the lowly is wisdom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תֻּמַּ֣ת יְשָׁרִ֣ים תַּנְחֵ֑ם וְסֶ֖לֶף בֹּגְדִ֣ים (ושדם) [יְשׇׁדֵּֽם]׃
verses.translation: The integrity of the upright shall guide them; But the perverseness of the faithless shall destroy them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יוֹעִ֣יל ה֭וֹן בְּי֣וֹם עֶבְרָ֑ה וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה תַּצִּ֥יל מִמָּֽוֶת׃
verses.translit: l'yv'yl hvn byvm 'brh vtsdqh ttsyl mmvt
verses.translation: Riches profit not in the day of wrath; But righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צִדְקַ֣ת תָּ֭מִים תְּיַשֵּׁ֣ר דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְרִשְׁעָת֗וֹ יִפֹּ֥ל רָשָֽׁע׃
verses.translit: tsdqt tmym tyshr drkhv vbrsh'tv ypl rsh'
verses.translation: The righteousness of the sincere shall make straight his way; But the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צִדְקַ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים תַּצִּילֵ֑ם וּ֝בְהַוַּ֗ת בֹּגְדִ֥ים יִלָּכֵֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: tsdqt yshrym ttsylm vbhvt bgdym ylkhdv
verses.translation: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them; But the faithless shall be trapped in their own crafty device.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּמ֤וֹת אָדָ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע תֹּאבַ֣ד תִּקְוָ֑ה וְתוֹחֶ֖לֶת אוֹנִ֣ים אָבָֽדָה׃
verses.translation: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish, And the hope of strength perisheth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צַ֭דִּיק מִצָּרָ֣ה נֶחֱלָ֑ץ וַיָּבֹ֖א רָשָׁ֣ע תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: tsdyq mtsrh nchlts vyb' rsh' tchtyv
verses.translation: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, And the wicked cometh in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּפֶ֗ה חָ֭נֵף יַשְׁחִ֣ת רֵעֵ֑הוּ וּ֝בְדַ֗עַת צַדִּיקִ֥ים יֵחָלֵֽצוּ׃
verses.translit: bph chnf yshcht r'hv vbd't tsdyqym ychltsv
verses.translation: With his mouth the impious man destroyeth his neighbour; But through knowledge shall the righteous be delivered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּט֣וּב צַ֭דִּיקִים תַּעֲלֹ֣ץ קִרְיָ֑ה וּבַאֲבֹ֖ד רְשָׁעִ֣ים רִנָּֽה׃
verses.translit: btvb tsdyqym t'lts qryh vb'bd rsh'ym rnh
verses.translation: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth; And when the wicked perish, there is joy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּבִרְכַּ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים תָּר֣וּם קָ֑רֶת וּבְפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תֵּהָרֵֽס׃
verses.translit: bbrkht yshrym trvm qrt vbpy rsh'ym thrs
verses.translation: By the blessing of the upright a city is exalted; But it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בׇּז־לְרֵעֵ֥הוּ חֲסַר־לֵ֑ב וְאִ֖ישׁ תְּבוּנ֣וֹת יַחֲרִֽישׁ׃
verses.translation: He that despiseth his neighbour lacketh understanding; But a man of discernment holdeth his peace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ רָ֭כִיל מְגַלֶּה־סּ֑וֹד וְנֶאֱמַן־ר֝֗וּחַ מְכַסֶּ֥ה דָבָֽר׃
verses.translit: hvlkh rkhyl mglhsvd vn'mnrvch mkhsh dbr
verses.translation: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets; But he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth a matter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאֵ֣ין תַּ֭חְבֻּלוֹת יִפׇּל־עָ֑ם וּ֝תְשׁוּעָ֗ה בְּרֹ֣ב יוֹעֵֽץ׃
verses.translit: b'yn tchblvt ypl'm vtshv'h brb yv'ts
verses.translation: Where no wise direction is, a people falleth; But in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַע־יֵ֭רוֹעַ כִּי־עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וְשֹׂנֵ֖א תֹקְעִ֣ים בּוֹטֵֽחַ׃
verses.translit: r'yrv' khy'rb zr vshn' tq'ym bvtch
verses.translation: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it; But he that hateth them that strike hands is secure.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵֽשֶׁת־חֵ֭ן תִּתְמֹ֣ךְ כָּב֑וֹד וְ֝עָרִיצִ֗ים יִתְמְכוּ־עֹֽשֶׁר׃
verses.translation: A gracious woman obtaineth honour; And strong men obtain riches.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גֹּמֵ֣ל נַ֭פְשׁוֹ אִ֣ישׁ חָ֑סֶד וְעֹכֵ֥ר שְׁ֝אֵר֗וֹ אַכְזָרִֽי׃
verses.translation: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul; But he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָשָׁ֗ע עֹשֶׂ֥ה פְעֻלַּת־שָׁ֑קֶר וְזֹרֵ֥עַ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה שֶׂ֣כֶר אֱמֶֽת׃
verses.translation: The wicked earneth deceitful wages; But he that soweth righteousness hath a sure reward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֵּן־צְדָקָ֥ה לְחַיִּ֑ים וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף רָעָ֣ה לְמוֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: Stedfast righteousness tendeth to life; But he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הֹוָה עִקְּשֵׁי־לֵ֑ב וּ֝רְצוֹנ֗וֹ תְּמִ֣ימֵי דָֽרֶךְ׃
verses.translation: They that are perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD; But such as are upright in their way are His delight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָ֣ד לְ֭יָד לֹא־יִנָּ֣קֶה רָּ֑ע וְזֶ֖רַע צַדִּיקִ֣ים נִמְלָֽט׃
verses.translit: yd lyd l'ynqh r' vzr' tsdyqym nmlt
verses.translation: My hand upon it! the evil man shall not be unpunished; But the seed of the righteous shall escape. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֶ֣זֶם זָ֭הָב בְּאַ֣ף חֲזִ֑יר אִשָּׁ֥ה יָ֝פָ֗ה וְסָ֣רַת טָֽעַם׃
verses.translit: nzm zhb b'f chzyr 'shh yph vsrt t'm
verses.translation: As a ring of gold in a swine’s snout, so is a fair woman that turneth aside from discretion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּאֲוַ֣ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים אַךְ־ט֑וֹב תִּקְוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים עֶבְרָֽה׃
verses.translation: The desire of the righteous is only good; But the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵ֣שׁ מְ֭פַזֵּר וְנוֹסָ֥ף ע֑וֹד וְחֹשֵׂ֥ךְ מִ֝יֹּ֗שֶׁר אַךְ־לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃
verses.translation: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; And there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth only to want.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֶֽפֶשׁ־בְּרָכָ֥ה תְדֻשָּׁ֑ן וּ֝מַרְוֶ֗ה גַּם־ה֥וּא יוֹרֶֽא׃
verses.translation: The beneficent soul shall be made rich, and he that satisfieth abundantly shall be satisfied also himself.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֹ֣נֵֽעַ בָּ֭ר יִקְּבֻ֣הוּ לְא֑וֹם וּ֝בְרָכָ֗ה לְרֹ֣אשׁ מַשְׁבִּֽיר׃
verses.translit: mn' br yqbhv l'vm vbrkhh lr'sh mshbyr
verses.translation: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him; But blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֹׁ֣חֵֽר ט֭וֹב יְבַקֵּ֣שׁ רָצ֑וֹן וְדֹרֵ֖שׁ רָעָ֣ה תְבוֹאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: shchr tvb ybqsh rtsvn vdrsh r'h tbv'nv
verses.translation: He that diligently seeketh good seeketh favour; But he that searcheth for evil, it shall come unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בּוֹטֵ֣חַ בְּ֭עׇשְׁרוֹ ה֣וּא יִפּ֑וֹל וְ֝כֶעָלֶ֗ה צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִפְרָֽחוּ׃
verses.translit: bvtch b'shrv hv' ypvl vkh'lh tsdyqym yprchv
verses.translation: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall; But the righteous shall flourish as foliage.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹכֵ֣ר בֵּ֭יתוֹ יִנְחַל־ר֑וּחַ וְעֶ֥בֶד אֱ֝וִ֗יל לַֽחֲכַם־לֵֽב׃
verses.translation: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind; And the foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּֽרִי־צַ֭דִּיק עֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים וְלֹקֵ֖חַ נְפָשׁ֣וֹת חָכָֽם׃
verses.translation: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; And he that is wise winneth souls.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֣ן צַ֭דִּיק בָּאָ֣רֶץ יְשֻׁלָּ֑ם אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־רָשָׁ֥ע וְחוֹטֵֽא׃
verses.translit: hn tsdyq b'rts yshlm 'f khyrsh' vchvt'
verses.translation: Behold, the righteous shall be requited in the earth; How much more the wicked and the sinner!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹהֵ֣ב מ֭וּסָר אֹ֣הֵֽב דָּ֑עַת וְשׂוֹנֵ֖א תוֹכַ֣חַת בָּֽעַר׃
verses.translation: Whoso loveth knowledge loveth correction; But he that is brutish hateth reproof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֗וֹב יָפִ֣יק רָ֭צוֹן מֵיְהֹוָ֑ה וְאִ֖ישׁ מְזִמּ֣וֹת יַרְשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.translit: tvb ypyq rtsvn myhvh v'ysh mzmvt yrshy'
verses.translation: A good man shall obtain favour of the LORD; But a man of wicked devices will He condemn.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יִכּ֣וֹן אָדָ֣ם בְּרֶ֑שַׁע וְשֹׁ֥רֶשׁ צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים בַּל־יִמּֽוֹט׃
verses.translation: A man shall not be established by wickedness; But the root of the righteous shall never be moved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵֽשֶׁת־חַ֭יִל עֲטֶ֣רֶת בַּעְלָ֑הּ וּכְרָקָ֖ב בְּעַצְמוֹתָ֣יו מְבִישָֽׁה׃
verses.translation: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband; But she that doeth shamefully is as rottenness in his bones.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת צַדִּיקִ֣ים מִשְׁפָּ֑ט תַּחְבֻּל֖וֹת רְשָׁעִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: mchshbvt tsdyqym mshpt tchblvt rsh'ym mrmh
verses.translation: The thoughts of the righteous are right; But the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֱרׇב־דָּ֑ם וּפִ֥י יְ֝שָׁרִ֗ים יַצִּילֵֽם׃
verses.translation: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood; But the mouth of the upright shall deliver them. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָפ֣וֹךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים וְאֵינָ֑ם וּבֵ֖ית צַדִּיקִ֣ים יַעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.translit: hpvkh rsh'ym v'ynm vbyt tsdyqym y'md
verses.translation: The wicked are overthrown, and are not; But the house of the righteous shall stand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְֽפִי־שִׂ֭כְלוֹ יְהֻלַּל־אִ֑ישׁ וְנַעֲוֵה־לֵ֝֗ב יִהְיֶ֥ה לָבֽוּז׃
verses.translation: A man shall be commended according to his intelligence; But he that is of a distorted understanding shall be despised.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֣וֹב נִ֭קְלֶה וְעֶ֣בֶד ל֑וֹ מִ֝מִּתְכַּבֵּ֗ד וַחֲסַר־לָֽחֶם׃
verses.translit: tvb nqlh v'bd lv mmtkhbd vchsrlchm
verses.translation: Better is he that is lightly esteemed, and hath a servant, Than he that playeth the man of rank, and lacketh bread.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹדֵ֣עַ צַ֭דִּיק נֶ֣פֶשׁ בְּהֶמְתּ֑וֹ וְֽרַחֲמֵ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים אַכְזָרִֽי׃
verses.translit: yvd' tsdyq npsh bhmtv vrchmy rsh'ym 'khzry
verses.translation: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast; But the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹבֵ֣ד אַ֭דְמָתוֹ יִֽשְׂבַּֽע־לָ֑חֶם וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף רֵיקִ֣ים חֲסַר־לֵֽב׃
verses.translation: He that tilleth his ground shall have plenty of bread; But he that followeth after vain things is void of understanding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָמַ֣ד רָ֭שָׁע מְצ֣וֹד רָעִ֑ים וְשֹׁ֖רֶשׁ צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִתֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: chmd rsh' mtsvd r'ym vshrsh tsdyqym ytn
verses.translation: The wicked desireth the prey of evil men; But the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּפֶ֣שַׁע שְׂ֭פָתַיִם מוֹקֵ֣שׁ רָ֑ע וַיֵּצֵ֖א מִצָּרָ֣ה צַדִּֽיק׃
verses.translit: bpsh' shptym mvqsh r' vyts' mtsrh tsdyq
verses.translation: In the transgression of the lips is a snare to the evil man; But the righteous cometh out of trouble.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִפְּרִ֣י פִי־אִ֭ישׁ יִשְׂבַּע־ט֑וֹב וּגְמ֥וּל יְדֵי־אָ֝דָ֗ם (ישוב) [יָשִׁ֥יב] לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mpry py'ysh yshb'tvb vgmvl ydy'dm (yshvb) [yshyb] lv
verses.translation: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth, And the doings of a man’s hands shall be rendered unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֱ֭וִיל יָשָׁ֣ר בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְשֹׁמֵ֖עַ לְעֵצָ֣ה חָכָֽם׃
verses.translit: drkh 'vyl yshr b'ynyv vshm' l'tsh chkhm
verses.translation: The way of a fool is straight in his own eyes; But he that is wise hearkeneth unto counsel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱוִ֗יל בַּ֭יּוֹם יִוָּדַ֣ע כַּעְס֑וֹ וְכֹסֶ֖ה קָל֣וֹן עָרֽוּם׃
verses.translation: A fool’s vexation is presently known; But a prudent man concealeth shame.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָפִ֣יחַ אֱ֭מוּנָה יַגִּ֣יד צֶ֑דֶק וְעֵ֖ד שְׁקָרִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: ypych 'mvnh ygyd tsdq v'd shqrym mrmh
verses.translation: He that breatheth forth truth uttereth righteousness; But a false witness deceit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵ֣שׁ בּ֭וֹטֶה כְּמַדְקְר֣וֹת חָ֑רֶב וּלְשׁ֖וֹן חֲכָמִ֣ים מַרְפֵּֽא׃
verses.translit: ysh bvth khmdqrvt chrb vlshvn chkhmym mrp'
verses.translation: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword; But the tongue of the wise is health.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְֽׂפַת־אֱ֭מֶת תִּכּ֣וֹן לָעַ֑ד וְעַד־אַ֝רְגִּ֗יעָה לְשׁ֣וֹן שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.translit: shpt'mt tkhvn l'd v'd'rgy'h lshvn shqr
verses.translation: The lip of truth shall be established for ever; But a lying tongue is but for a moment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֭רְמָה בְּלֶב־חֹ֣רְשֵׁי רָ֑ע וּֽלְיֹעֲצֵ֖י שָׁל֣וֹם שִׂמְחָֽה׃
verses.translit: mrmh blbchrshy r' vly'tsy shlvm shmchh
verses.translation: Deceit is in the heart of them that devise evil; But to the counsellors of peace is joy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יְאֻנֶּ֣ה לַצַּדִּ֣יק כׇּל־אָ֑וֶן וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים מָ֣לְאוּ רָֽע׃
verses.translit: l'y'nh ltsdyq khl'vn vrsh'ym ml'v r'
verses.translation: There shall no mischief befall the righteous; But the wicked are filled with evil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הֹוָה שִׂפְתֵי־שָׁ֑קֶר וְעֹשֵׂ֖י אֱמוּנָ֣ה רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD; But they that deal truly are His delight. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָדָ֣ם עָ֭רוּם כֹּ֣סֶה דָּ֑עַת וְלֵ֥ב כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים יִקְרָ֥א אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
verses.translation: A prudent man concealeth knowledge; But the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַד־חָרוּצִ֥ים תִּמְשׁ֑וֹל וּ֝רְמִיָּ֗ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לָמַֽס׃
verses.translation: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule; But the slothful shall be under tribute.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דְּאָגָ֣ה בְלֶב־אִ֣ישׁ יַשְׁחֶ֑נָּה וְדָבָ֖ר ט֣וֹב יְשַׂמְּחֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: d'gh blb'ysh yshchnh vdbr tvb yshmchnh
verses.translation: Care in the heart of a man boweth it down; But a good word maketh it glad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָתֵ֣ר מֵרֵעֵ֣הוּ צַדִּ֑יק וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תַּתְעֵֽם׃
verses.translit: ytr mr'hv tsdyq vdrkh rsh'ym tt'm
verses.translation: The righteous is guided by his friend; But the way of the wicked leadeth them astray.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יַחֲרֹ֣ךְ רְמִיָּ֣ה צֵיד֑וֹ וְהוֹן־אָדָ֖ם יָקָ֣ר חָרֽוּץ׃
verses.translit: l'ychrkh rmyh tsydv vhvn'dm yqr chrvts
verses.translation: The slothful man shall not hunt his prey; But the precious substance of men is to be diligent.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאֹֽרַח־צְדָקָ֥ה חַיִּ֑ים וְדֶ֖רֶךְ נְתִיבָ֣הֿ אַל־מָֽוֶת׃
verses.translation: In the way of righteousness is life, And in the pathway thereof there is no death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם מ֣וּסַר אָ֑ב וְ֝לֵ֗ץ לֹא־שָׁמַ֥ע גְּעָרָֽה׃
verses.translit: bn chkhm mvsr 'b vlts l'shm' g'rh
verses.translation: A wise son is instructed of his father; But a scorner heareth not rebuke.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִפְּרִ֣י פִי־אִ֭ישׁ יֹ֣אכַל ט֑וֹב וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ בֹּגְדִ֣ים חָמָֽס׃
verses.translit: mpry py'ysh y'khl tvb vnpsh bgdym chms
verses.translation: A man shall eat good from the fruit of his mouth; But the desire of the faithless is violence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֹצֵ֣ר פִּ֭יו שֹׁמֵ֣ר נַפְשׁ֑וֹ פֹּשֵׂ֥ק שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו מְחִתָּה־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: ntsr pyv shmr npshv pshq shptyv mchthlv
verses.translation: He that guardeth his mouth keepeth his life; But for him that openeth wide his lips there shall be ruin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִתְאַוָּ֣ה וָ֭אַיִן נַפְשׁ֣וֹ עָצֵ֑ל וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ חָרֻצִ֣ים תְּדֻשָּֽׁן׃
verses.translit: mt'vh v'yn npshv 'tsl vnpsh chrtsym tdshn
verses.translation: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing; But the soul of the diligent shall be abundantly gratified.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דְּבַר־שֶׁ֭קֶר יִשְׂנָ֣א צַדִּ֑יק וְ֝רָשָׁ֗ע יַבְאִ֥ישׁ וְיַחְפִּֽיר׃
verses.translit: dbrshqr yshn' tsdyq vrsh' yb'ysh vychpyr
verses.translation: A righteous man hateth lying; But a wicked man behaveth vilely and shamefully.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צְ֭דָקָה תִּצֹּ֣ר תׇּם־דָּ֑רֶךְ וְ֝רִשְׁעָ֗ה תְּסַלֵּ֥ף חַטָּֽאת׃
verses.translit: tsdqh ttsr tmdrkh vrsh'h tslf cht't
verses.translation: Righteousness guardeth him that is upright in the way; But wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵ֣שׁ מִ֭תְעַשֵּׁר וְאֵ֣ין כֹּ֑ל מִ֝תְרוֹשֵׁ֗שׁ וְה֣וֹן רָֽב׃
verses.translit: ysh mt'shr v'yn khl mtrvshsh vhvn rb
verses.translation: There is that pretendeth himself rich, yet hath nothing; There is that pretendeth himself poor, yet hath great wealth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣פֶר נֶפֶשׁ־אִ֣ישׁ עׇשְׁר֑וֹ וְ֝רָ֗שׁ לֹא־שָׁמַ֥ע גְּעָרָֽה׃
verses.translation: The ransom of a man’s life are his riches; But the poor heareth no threatening.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוֹר־צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִשְׂמָ֑ח וְנֵ֖ר רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִדְעָֽךְ׃
verses.translation: The light of the righteous rejoiceth; But the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַק־בְּ֭זָדוֹן יִתֵּ֣ן מַצָּ֑ה וְאֶת־נ֖וֹעָצִ֣ים חׇכְמָֽה׃
verses.translation: By pride cometh only contention; But with the well-advised is wisdom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֭וֹן מֵהֶ֣בֶל יִמְעָ֑ט וְקֹבֵ֖ץ עַל־יָ֣ד יַרְבֶּֽה׃
verses.translation: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished; But he that gathereth little by little shall increase. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תּוֹחֶ֣לֶת מְ֭מֻשָּׁכָה מַחֲלָה־לֵ֑ב וְעֵ֥ץ חַ֝יִּ֗ים תַּאֲוָ֥ה בָאָֽה׃
verses.translit: tvchlt mmshkhh mchlhlb v'ts chyym t'vh b'h
verses.translation: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick; But desire fulfilled is a tree of life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּ֣ז לְ֭דָבָר יֵחָ֣בֶל ל֑וֹ וִירֵ֥א מִ֝צְוָ֗ה ה֣וּא יְשֻׁלָּֽם׃
verses.translit: bz ldbr ychbl lv vyr' mtsvh hv' yshlm
verses.translation: Whoso despiseth the word shall suffer thereby; But he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תּוֹרַ֣ת חָ֭כָם מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים לָ֝ס֗וּר מִמֹּ֥קְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃
verses.translit: tvrt chkhm mqvr chyym lsvr mmqshy mvt
verses.translation: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, To depart from the snares of death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֵֽׂכֶל־ט֭וֹב יִתֶּן־חֵ֑ן וְדֶ֖רֶךְ בֹּגְדִ֣ים אֵיתָֽן׃
verses.translation: Good understanding giveth grace; But the way of the faithless is harsh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־עָ֭רוּם יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה בְדָ֑עַת וּ֝כְסִ֗יל יִפְרֹ֥שׂ אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
verses.translation: Every prudent man dealeth with forethought; But a fool unfoldeth folly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַלְאָ֣ךְ רָ֭שָׁע יִפֹּ֣ל בְּרָ֑ע וְצִ֖יר אֱמוּנִ֣ים מַרְפֵּֽא׃
verses.translit: ml'kh rsh' ypl br' vtsyr 'mvnym mrp'
verses.translation: A wicked messenger falleth into evil; But a faithful ambassador is health.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֵ֣ישׁ וְ֭קָלוֹן פּוֹרֵ֣עַ מוּסָ֑ר וְשֹׁמֵ֖ר תּוֹכַ֣חַת יְכֻבָּֽד׃
verses.translit: rysh vqlvn pvr' mvsr vshmr tvkhcht ykhbd
verses.translation: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction; But he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּאֲוָ֣ה נִ֭הְיָה תֶּעֱרַ֣ב לְנָ֑פֶשׁ וְתוֹעֲבַ֥ת כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים ס֣וּר מֵרָֽע׃
verses.translit: t'vh nhyh t'rb lnpsh vtv'bt khsylym svr mr'
verses.translation: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul; And it is an abomination to fools to depart from evil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (הלוך) [הוֹלֵ֣ךְ] אֶת־חֲכָמִ֣ים (וחכם) [יֶחְכָּ֑ם] וְרֹעֶ֖ה כְסִילִ֣ים יֵרֽוֹעַ׃
verses.translation: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise; But the companion of fools shall smart for it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַ֭טָּאִים תְּרַדֵּ֣ף רָעָ֑ה וְאֶת־צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים יְשַׁלֶּם־טֽוֹב׃
verses.translation: Evil pursueth sinners; But to the righteous good shall be repaid.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֗וֹב יַנְחִ֥יל בְּנֵֽי־בָנִ֑ים וְצָפ֥וּן לַ֝צַּדִּ֗יק חֵ֣יל חוֹטֵֽא׃
verses.translit: tvb ynchyl bnybnym vtspvn ltsdyq chyl chvt'
verses.translation: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children’s children; And the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the righteous.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רׇב־אֹ֭כֶל נִ֣יר רָאשִׁ֑ים וְיֵ֥שׁ נִ֝סְפֶּ֗ה בְּלֹ֣א מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: rb'khl nyr r'shym vysh nsph bl' mshpt
verses.translation: Much food is in the tillage of the poor; But there is that is swept away by want of righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חוֹשֵׂ֣ךְ שִׁ֭בְטוֹ שׂוֹנֵ֣א בְנ֑וֹ וְ֝אֹהֲב֗וֹ שִׁחֲר֥וֹ מוּסָֽר׃
verses.translit: chvshkh shbtv shvn' bnv v'hbv shchrv mvsr
verses.translation: He that spareth his rod hateth his son; But he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צַדִּ֗יק אֹ֭כֵֽל לְשֹׂ֣בַע נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּבֶ֖טֶן רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֶּחְסָֽר׃
verses.translit: tsdyq 'khl lshb' npshv vbtn rsh'ym tchsr
verses.translation: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his desire; But the belly of the wicked shall want.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַכְמ֣וֹת נָ֭שִׁים בָּנְתָ֣ה בֵיתָ֑הּ וְ֝אִוֶּ֗לֶת בְּיָדֶ֥יהָ תֶהֶרְסֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: chkhmvt nshym bnth byth v'vlt bydyh thrsnv
verses.translation: Every wise woman buildeth her house; But the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּ֭יׇשְׁרוֹ יְרֵ֣א יְהֹוָ֑ה וּנְל֖וֹז דְּרָכָ֣יו בּוֹזֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: hvlkh byshrv yr' yhvh vnlvz drkhyv bvzhv
verses.translation: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD; But he that is perverse in his ways despiseth Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּֽפִי־אֱ֭וִיל חֹ֣טֶר גַּאֲוָ֑ה וְשִׂפְתֵ֥י חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים תִּשְׁמוּרֵֽם׃
verses.translit: bpy'vyl chtr g'vh vshpty chkhmym tshmvrm
verses.translation: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride; But the lips of the wise shall preserve them. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאֵ֣ין אֲ֭לָפִים אֵב֣וּס בָּ֑ר וְרׇב־תְּ֝בוּא֗וֹת בְּכֹ֣חַ שֽׁוֹר׃
verses.translation: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean; But much increase is by the strength of the ox.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵ֣ד אֱ֭מוּנִים לֹ֣א יְכַזֵּ֑ב וְיָפִ֥יחַ כְּ֝זָבִ֗ים עֵ֣ד שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.translation: A faithful witness will not lie; But a false witness breatheth forth lies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּקֶּשׁ־לֵ֣ץ חׇכְמָ֣ה וָאָ֑יִן וְדַ֖עַת לְנָב֣וֹן נָקָֽל׃
verses.translit: bqshlts chkhmh v'yn vd't lnbvn nql
verses.translation: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not; But knowledge is easy unto him that hath discernment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵ֣ךְ מִ֭נֶּגֶד לְאִ֣ישׁ כְּסִ֑יל וּבַל־יָ֝דַ֗עְתָּ שִׂפְתֵי־דָֽעַת׃
verses.translit: lkh mngd l'ysh khsyl vblyd't shptyd't
verses.translation: Go from the presence of a foolish man, for thou wilt not perceive the lips of knowledge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חׇכְמַ֣ת עָ֭רוּם הָבִ֣ין דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וְאִוֶּ֖לֶת כְּסִילִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: chkhmt 'rvm hbyn drkhv v'vlt khsylym mrmh
verses.translation: The wisdom of the prudent is to look well to his way; But the folly of fools is deceit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱ֭וִלִים יָלִ֣יץ אָשָׁ֑ם וּבֵ֖ין יְשָׁרִ֣ים רָצֽוֹן׃
verses.translation: Amends pleadeth for fools; But among the upright there is good will.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵ֗ב י֭וֹדֵעַ מׇרַּ֣ת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּ֝בְשִׂמְחָת֗וֹ לֹא־יִתְעָ֥רַב זָֽר׃
verses.translit: lb yvd' mrt npshv vbshmchtv l'yt'rb zr
verses.translation: The heart knoweth its own bitterness; And with its joy no stranger can intermeddle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית רְ֭שָׁעִים יִשָּׁמֵ֑ד וְאֹ֖הֶל יְשָׁרִ֣ים יַפְרִֽיחַ׃
verses.translit: byt rsh'ym yshmd v'hl yshrym yprych
verses.translation: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown; But the tent of the upright shall flourish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵ֤שׁ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יָ֭שָׁר לִפְנֵי־אִ֑ישׁ וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ דַּרְכֵי־מָֽוֶת׃
verses.translit: ysh drkh yshr lpny'ysh v'chryth drkhymvt
verses.translation: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, But the end thereof are the ways of death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־בִּשְׂחֹ֥ק יִכְאַב־לֵ֑ב וְאַחֲרִיתָ֖הּ שִׂמְחָ֣ה תוּגָֽה׃
verses.translation: Even in laughter the heart acheth; And the end of mirth is heaviness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִדְּרָכָ֣יו יִ֭שְׂבַּע ס֣וּג לֵ֑ב וּ֝מֵעָלָ֗יו אִ֣ישׁ טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: mdrkhyv yshb' svg lb vm'lyv 'ysh tvb
verses.translation: The dissembler in heart shall have his fill from his own ways; And a good man shall be satisfied from himself.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּ֭תִי יַאֲמִ֣ין לְכׇל־דָּבָ֑ר וְ֝עָר֗וּם יָבִ֥ין לַאֲשֻׁרֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: pty y'myn lkhldbr v'rvm ybyn l'shrv
verses.translation: The thoughtless believeth every word; But the prudent man looketh well to his going.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָכָ֣ם יָ֭רֵא וְסָ֣ר מֵרָ֑ע וּ֝כְסִ֗יל מִתְעַבֵּ֥ר וּבוֹטֵֽחַ׃
verses.translit: chkhm yr' vsr mr' vkhsyl mt'br vbvtch
verses.translation: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil; But the fool behaveth overbearingly, and is confident.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קְֽצַר־אַ֭פַּיִם יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה אִוֶּ֑לֶת וְאִ֥ישׁ מְ֝זִמּ֗וֹת יִשָּׂנֵֽא׃
verses.translation: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly; And a man of wicked devices is hated.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָחֲל֣וּ פְתָאיִ֣ם אִוֶּ֑לֶת וַ֝עֲרוּמִ֗ים יַכְתִּ֥רוּ דָֽעַת׃
verses.translation: The thoughtless come into possession of folly; But the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁח֣וּ רָ֭עִים לִפְנֵ֣י טוֹבִ֑ים וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים עַֽל־שַׁעֲרֵ֥י צַדִּֽיק׃
verses.translit: shchv r'ym lpny tvbym vrsh'ym 'lsh'ry tsdyq
verses.translation: The evil bow before the good, And the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־לְ֭רֵעֵהוּ יִשָּׂ֣נֵא רָ֑שׁ וְאֹהֲבֵ֖י עָשִׁ֣יר רַבִּֽים׃
verses.translation: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour; But the rich hath many friends. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בׇּז־לְרֵעֵ֥הוּ חוֹטֵ֑א וּמְחוֹנֵ֖ן (עניים) [עֲנָוִ֣ים] אַשְׁרָֽיו׃
verses.translation: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth; But he that is gracious unto the humble, happy is he.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲֽלוֹא־יִ֭תְעוּ חֹ֣רְשֵׁי רָ֑ע וְחֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת חֹ֣רְשֵׁי טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: hlv'yt'v chrshy r' vchsd v'mt chrshy tvb
verses.translation: Shall they not go astray that devise evil? But mercy and truth shall be for them that devise good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּכׇל־עֶ֭צֶב יִהְיֶ֣ה מוֹתָ֑ר וּדְבַר־שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם אַךְ־לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃
verses.translation: In all labour there is profit; But the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲטֶ֣רֶת חֲכָמִ֣ים עׇשְׁרָ֑ם אִוֶּ֖לֶת כְּסִילִ֣ים אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
verses.translation: The crown of the wise is their riches; But the folly of fools remaineth folly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַצִּ֣יל נְ֭פָשׁוֹת עֵ֣ד אֱמֶ֑ת וְיָפִ֖חַ כְּזָבִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.translation: A true witness delivereth souls; But he that breatheth forth lies is all deceit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הֹוָה מִבְטַח־עֹ֑ז וּ֝לְבָנָ֗יו יִהְיֶ֥ה מַחְסֶֽה׃
verses.translit: byr't yhvh mbtch'z vlbnyv yhyh mchsh
verses.translation: In the fear of the LORD a man hath strong confidence; And his children shall have a place of refuge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הֹוָה מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים לָ֝ס֗וּר מִמֹּ֥קְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃
verses.translit: yr't yhvh mqvr chyym lsvr mmqshy mvt
verses.translation: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּרׇב־עָ֥ם הַדְרַת־מֶ֑לֶךְ וּבְאֶ֥פֶס לְ֝אֹ֗ם מְחִתַּ֥ת רָזֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: brb'm hdrtmlkh vb'ps l'm mchtt rzvn
verses.translation: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory; But in the want of people is the ruin of the prince.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם רַב־תְּבוּנָ֑ה וּקְצַר־ר֝֗וּחַ מֵרִ֥ים אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
verses.translation: He that is slow to anger is of great understanding; But he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַיֵּ֣י בְ֭שָׂרִים לֵ֣ב מַרְפֵּ֑א וּרְקַ֖ב עֲצָמ֣וֹת קִנְאָֽה׃
verses.translit: chyy bshrym lb mrp' vrqb 'tsmvt qn'h
verses.translation: A tranquil heart is the life of the flesh; But envy is the rottenness of the bones.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹ֣שֵֽׁק דָּ֭ל חֵרֵ֣ף עֹשֵׂ֑הוּ וּ֝מְכַבְּד֗וֹ חֹנֵ֥ן אֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.translation: He that oppresseth the poor blasphemeth his Maker; But he that is gracious unto the needy honoureth Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּֽ֭רָעָתוֹ יִדָּחֶ֣ה רָשָׁ֑ע וְחֹסֶ֖ה בְמוֹת֣וֹ צַדִּֽיק׃
verses.translit: br'tv ydchh rsh' vchsh bmvtv tsdyq
verses.translation: The wicked is thrust down in his misfortune; But the righteous, even when he is brought to death, hath hope.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּלֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן תָּנ֣וּחַ חׇכְמָ֑ה וּבְקֶ֥רֶב כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים תִּוָּדֵֽעַ׃
verses.translit: blb nbvn tnvch chkhmh vbqrb khsylym tvd'
verses.translation: In the heart of him that hath discernment wisdom resteth; But in the inward part of fools it maketh itself known.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צְדָקָ֥ה תְרוֹמֵֽם־גּ֑וֹי וְחֶ֖סֶד לְאֻמִּ֣ים חַטָּֽאת׃
verses.translation: Righteousness exalteth a nation; But sin is a reproach to any people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְֽצוֹן־מֶ֭לֶךְ לְעֶ֣בֶד מַשְׂכִּ֑יל וְ֝עֶבְרָת֗וֹ תִּהְיֶ֥ה מֵבִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: rtsvnmlkh l'bd mshkhyl v'brtv thyh mbysh
verses.translation: The king’s favour is toward a servant that dealeth wisely; But his wrath striketh him that dealeth shamefully.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַֽעֲנֶה־רַּ֭ךְ יָשִׁ֣יב חֵמָ֑ה וּדְבַר־עֶ֝֗צֶב יַעֲלֶה־אָֽף׃
verses.translation: A soft answer turneth away wrath; But a grievous word stirreth up anger.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְשׁ֣וֹן חֲ֭כָמִים תֵּיטִ֣יב דָּ֑עַת וּפִ֥י כְ֝סִילִ֗ים יַבִּ֥יעַ אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
verses.translit: lshvn chkhmym tytyb d't vpy khsylym yby' 'vlt
verses.translation: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright; But the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּֽכׇל־מָ֭קוֹם עֵינֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה צֹ֝פ֗וֹת רָעִ֥ים וְטוֹבִֽים׃
verses.translation: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, Keeping watch upon the evil and the good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַרְפֵּ֣א לָ֭שׁוֹן עֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים וְסֶ֥לֶף בָּ֝֗הּ שֶׁ֣בֶר בְּרֽוּחַ׃
verses.translit: mrp' lshvn 'ts chyym vslf bh shbr brvch
verses.translation: A soothing tongue is a tree of life; But perverseness therein is a wound to the spirit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱוִ֗יל יִ֭נְאַץ מוּסַ֣ר אָבִ֑יו וְשֹׁמֵ֖ר תּוֹכַ֣חַת יַעְרִֽים׃
verses.translation: A fool despiseth his father’s correction; But he that regardeth reproof is prudent.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית צַ֭דִּיק חֹ֣סֶן רָ֑ב וּבִתְבוּאַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע נֶעְכָּֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: byt tsdyq chsn rb vbtbv't rsh' n'khrt
verses.translation: In the house of the righteous is much treasure; But in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׂפְתֵ֣י חֲ֭כָמִים יְזָ֣רוּ דָ֑עַת וְלֵ֖ב כְּסִילִ֣ים לֹא־כֵֽן׃
verses.translit: shpty chkhmym yzrv d't vlb khsylym l'khn
verses.translation: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge; But the heart of the foolish is not stedfast.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֣בַח רְ֭שָׁעִים תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֑ה וּתְפִלַּ֖ת יְשָׁרִ֣ים רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: zbch rsh'ym tv'bt yhvh vtplt yshrym rtsvnv
verses.translation: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD; But the prayer of the upright is His delight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הֹוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ רָשָׁ֑ע וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף צְדָקָ֣ה יֶאֱהָֽב׃
verses.translit: tv'bt yhvh drkh rsh' vmrdf tsdqh y'hb
verses.translation: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD; But He loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מוּסָ֣ר רָ֭ע לְעֹזֵ֣ב אֹ֑רַח שׂוֹנֵ֖א תוֹכַ֣חַת יָמֽוּת׃
verses.translit: mvsr r' l'zb 'rch shvn' tvkhcht ymvt
verses.translation: There is grievous correction for him that forsaketh the way; And he that hateth reproof shall die.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁא֣וֹל וַ֭אֲבַדּוֹן נֶ֣גֶד יְהֹוָ֑ה אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־לִבּ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי־אָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: sh'vl v'bdvn ngd yhvh 'f khylbvt bny'dm
verses.translation: The nether-world and Destruction are before the LORD; How much more then the hearts of the children of men!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א יֶאֱהַב־לֵ֭ץ הוֹכֵ֣חַֽ ל֑וֹ אֶל־חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים לֹ֣א יֵלֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: l' y'hblts hvkhch lv 'lchkhmym l' ylkh
verses.translation: A scorner loveth not to be reproved; He will not go unto the wise.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵ֣ב שָׂ֭מֵחַ יֵיטִ֣ב פָּנִ֑ים וּבְעַצְּבַת־לֵ֝֗ב ר֣וּחַ נְכֵאָֽה׃
verses.translit: lb shmch yytb pnym vb'tsbtlb rvch nkh'h
verses.translation: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance; But by sorrow of heart the spirit is broken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן יְבַקֶּשׁ־דָּ֑עַת (ופני) [וּפִ֥י] כְ֝סִילִ֗ים יִרְעֶ֥ה אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
verses.translation: The heart of him that hath discernment seeketh knowledge; But the mouth of fools feedeth on folly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־יְמֵ֣י עָנִ֣י רָעִ֑ים וְטֽוֹב־לֵ֝֗ב מִשְׁתֶּ֥ה תָמִֽיד׃
verses.translation: All the days of the poor are evil; But he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טוֹב־מְ֭עַט בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֑ה מֵאוֹצָ֥ר רָ֝֗ב וּמְה֥וּמָה בֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: tvbm't byr't yhvh m'vtsr rb vmhvmh bv
verses.translation: Better is little with the fear of the LORD, Than great treasure and turmoil therewith.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֤וֹב אֲרֻחַ֣ת יָ֭רָק וְאַהֲבָה־שָׁ֑ם מִשּׁ֥וֹר אָ֝ב֗וּס וְשִׂנְאָה־בֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, Than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ חֵ֭מָה יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וְאֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם יַשְׁקִ֥יט רִֽיב׃
verses.translit: 'ysh chmh ygrh mdvn v'rkh 'pym yshqyt ryb
verses.translation: A wrathful man stirreth up discord; But he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דֶּ֣רֶךְ עָ֭צֵל כִּמְשֻׂ֣כַת חָ֑דֶק וְאֹ֖רַח יְשָׁרִ֣ים סְלֻלָֽה׃
verses.translit: drkh 'tsl khmshkht chdq v'rch yshrym sllh
verses.translation: The way of the sluggard is as though hedged by thorns; But the path of the upright is even.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם יְשַׂמַּח־אָ֑ב וּכְסִ֥יל אָ֝דָ֗ם בּוֹזֶ֥ה אִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translation: A wise son maketh a glad father; But a foolish man despiseth his mother.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֭וֶּלֶת שִׂמְחָ֣ה לַחֲסַר־לֵ֑ב וְאִ֥ישׁ תְּ֝בוּנָ֗ה יְיַשֶּׁר־לָֽכֶת׃
verses.translation: Folly is joy to him that lacketh understanding; But a man of discernment walketh straightforwards.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָפֵ֣ר מַ֭חֲשָׁבוֹת בְּאֵ֣ין ס֑וֹד וּבְרֹ֖ב יוֹעֲצִ֣ים תָּקֽוּם׃
verses.translit: hpr mchshbvt b'yn svd vbrb yv'tsym tqvm
verses.translation: For want of counsel purposes are frustrated; But in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׂמְחָ֣ה לָ֭אִישׁ בְּמַעֲנֵה־פִ֑יו וְדָבָ֖ר בְּעִתּ֣וֹ מַה־טּֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: shmchh l'ysh bm'nhpyv vdbr b'tv mhtvb
verses.translation: A man hath joy in the answer of his mouth; And a word in due season, how good is it!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹ֣רַח חַ֭יִּים לְמַ֣עְלָה לְמַשְׂכִּ֑יל לְמַ֥עַן ס֝֗וּר מִשְּׁא֥וֹל מָֽטָּה׃
verses.translit: 'rch chyym lm'lh lmshkhyl lm'n svr msh'vl mth
verses.translation: The path of life goeth upward for the wise, that he may depart from the nether-world beneath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית גֵּ֭אִים יִסַּ֥ח ׀ יְהֹוָ֑ה וְ֝יַצֵּ֗ב גְּב֣וּל אַלְמָנָֽה׃
verses.translation: The LORD will pluck up the house of the proud; But He will establish the border of the widow.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הֹוָה מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת רָ֑ע וּ֝טְהֹרִ֗ים אִמְרֵי־נֹֽעַם׃
verses.translation: The thoughts of wickedness are an abomination to the LORD; But words of pleasantness are pure.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹכֵ֣ר בֵּ֭יתוֹ בּוֹצֵ֣עַ בָּ֑צַע וְשׂוֹנֵ֖א מַתָּנֹ֣ת יִחְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: 'khr bytv bvts' bts' vshvn' mtnt ychyh
verses.translation: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; But he that hateth gifts shall live.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵ֣ב צַ֭דִּיק יֶהְגֶּ֣ה לַעֲנ֑וֹת וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יַבִּ֥יעַ רָעֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: lb tsdyq yhgh l'nvt vpy rsh'ym yby' r'vt
verses.translation: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer; But the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָח֣וֹק יְ֭הֹוָה מֵרְשָׁעִ֑ים וּתְפִלַּ֖ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.translit: rchvq yhvh mrsh'ym vtplt tsdyqym yshm'
verses.translation: The LORD is far from the wicked; But He heareth the prayer of the righteous.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְֽאוֹר־עֵ֭ינַיִם יְשַׂמַּֽח־לֵ֑ב שְׁמוּעָ֥ה ט֝וֹבָ֗ה תְּדַשֶּׁן־עָֽצֶם׃
verses.translation: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart; And a good report maketh the bones fat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹ֗זֶן שֹׁ֭מַעַת תּוֹכַ֣חַת חַיִּ֑ים בְּקֶ֖רֶב חֲכָמִ֣ים תָּלִֽין׃
verses.translit: 'zn shm't tvkhcht chyym bqrb chkhmym tlyn
verses.translation: The ear that hearkeneth to the reproof of life abideth among the wise.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פּוֹרֵ֣עַ מ֭וּסָר מוֹאֵ֣ס נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וְשׁוֹמֵ֥עַ תּ֝וֹכַ֗חַת ק֣וֹנֶה לֵּֽב׃
verses.translit: pvr' mvsr mv's npshv vshvm' tvkhcht qvnh lb
verses.translation: He that refuseth correction despiseth his own soul; But he that hearkeneth to reproof getteth understanding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הֹוָה מוּסַ֣ר חׇכְמָ֑ה וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָב֣וֹד עֲנָוָֽה׃
verses.translit: yr't yhvh mvsr chkhmh vlpny khbvd 'nvh
verses.translation: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom; And before honour goeth humility.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
